title: Print Designer (Love & Roses)
description:
Role Purpose:

The Print Designer is responsible for designing and creating beautiful prints that are distinctive to a dedicated brand handwriting. This role requires high levels of creative and artistic flair to generate fresh, innovative ideas for a team that is deeply passionate about print.

Role Responsibilities:

Design & Creative Leadership

  • Drive the print direction for the brand, delivering commercial and inspirational prints that resonate with the customer.
  • Identify key seasonal prints, colors, and trends, interpreting them specifically for the brand's unique handwriting.
  • Create seasonal mood and trend boards to guide the collection's aesthetic direction.
  • Design original artworks in both repeat and engineered placements tailored to specific garments.
  • Present new print designs and emerging trends to the Design team and senior management.
  • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with both the Design and Buying

Technical & Commercial Execution

  • Prepare clear and understandable print packs to ensure factories execute designs accurately.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of pricing, margins, and designing to specific price points.
  • Apply expert knowledge of various print techniques to ensure high-quality production.
  • Manage multiple projects with excellent organisation, maintaining high-quality output and meeting all deadlines.
  • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with both the Design and Buying

Technical Requirements:

  • Previous experience working in a high-street brand, print studio, or supplier environment.
  • Expert proficiency in the Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator.
  • Proven ability to design trend-relevant and commercial prints by translating global trends for the specific brand customer.
  • Broad understanding of the current competitive marketplace and consumer landscape.
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong interpersonal communication skills.

title: Studenterstudievejleder til 3D-print-rum (Digital Prototyping) ved Institut for Teknologi og Innovation
description:
SDU Innovation and Design Engineering søger en studenterstudievejleder til vores 3D-printrum ”Digital Prototyping” på campus i Odense til ca. 2 timer om ugen med tiltrædelse d. 1. februar 2027 i en tidsbegrænset stilling på et år med mulighed for forlængelse.

Vi har en række Prusa-printere, som anvendes af studerende, primært fra Maskinteknik/Mekanik og IDE/ID.

Som studenterstudievejleder vil dine primære arbejdsopgaver være at sikre, at printerne altid er oppe at køre, samt at afholde instruktionskurser for nye brugere. Dertil kommer indkøb af materialer og reservedele, samt at holde området med printerne ryddeligt og opdatere evt. beskeder i rummet.

Yderligere oplysninger kan fås ved henvendelse til laboratorieingeniør Jesper Bergholdt Sørensen, tlf. 6550 7493 jbs@sdu.dk.

Ansøgningsfrist er mandag d. 19.10.2026 kl. 23:59

Ansættelse finder sted i henhold til overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Studenterundervisernes Landsforbund.

For at kunne ansættes som studenterstudievejleder skal medarbejderen være indskrevet på en videregående uddannelse ved et universitet eller en anden anerkendt højere uddannelsesinstitution
Ansøgning skal indeholde følgebrev, CV og eksamensudskrift hvoraf det fremgår, hvor langt du er i dit studium ved SDU. Såfremt du endnu ikke har været til eksamen, skal ansøgningen i stedet for eksamensudskrift indeholde din indskrivningsbekræftelse. Alle dokumenter i forbindelse med ansøgning bør ikke indeholde CPR-nummer – i så fald skal CPR-nummer overstreges.
Alle vedhæftede filer skal være i Adobe PDF.
Følgebrev og CV må max. fylde 5 Mb.
Vejledning i forbindelse med ansøgning findes her.
Syddansk Universitet ønsker at afspejle det omgivende samfund og opfordrer derfor alle uanset personlig baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Løn fastsættes i henhold til gældende overenskomst og på baggrund af objektive og kønsneutrale kriterier, herunder stillingens indhold, ansvar og krav til kvalifikationer.

Du har som ansøger ret til information om startløn og lønspænd for stillingen. Disse oplysninger kan fås i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen.

SDU indhenter ikke oplysninger om ansøgeres tidligere løn.

title: IT Domain Team Lead
description:
Uw rol
Je maakt deel uit van een multidisciplinair team waarin verschillende expertises samenkomen om een optimaal beheer van het IT-domein te verzekeren. Als IT Domain Team Lead ben je verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkelingsteams binnen jouw domein (4 ontwikkelingsteams - totaal 25 personen). Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de IT-directeur van het ontwikkelingsdepartement.

Als tactisch organisator vertaal je de strategische doelstellingen van het departement naar een duidelijk en werkbaar kader voor je teams. Je zorgt ervoor dat deze visie wordt gedragen en omgezet in concrete acties en resultaten.

Je coördineert de werking en projecten van je teams en bewaakt kwaliteit, voortgang en prioriteiten. Met een helikopterview stem je af met stakeholders en stuur je tijdig bij voor een efficiënte en betrouwbare uitvoering.

In je rol als manager en coach ondersteun je je medewerkers in hun dagelijkse werking en ontwikkeling. Je zorgt voor een stimulerende werkomgeving waarin autonomie, samenwerking, feedback en talentontwikkeling centraal staan zodat teams optimaal kunnen presteren.

Als coach ondersteun je medewerkers in hun ontwikkeling en creëer je een veilige, inclusieve werkomgeving met ruimte voor feedback, autonomie en groei. Je stimuleert talentontwikkeling, een sterke teamdynamiek en gaat proactief om met spanningen.

Daarnaast treed je op als kennismanager met inzicht in de functionele, architecturale en technologische context van het ICT-domein. Je volgt evoluties op, bevordert kennisdeling en maakt expertise breed toegankelijk.

Tot slot bouw en onderhoud je sterke relaties met interne en externe stakeholders en sla je bruggen tussen ICT, business, teams en partners om maximale businesswaarde te realiseren.

Uw profiel

- Je hebt een masterdiploma behaald, bij voorkeur in IT, of je kan een equivalente ervaring aantonen door relevante ervaringen in het beheer en de opvolging van één of meerdere ontwikkelingsteams.
- Je hebt ervaring in het organisatorisch aansturen van technische teams en toont leiderschap. Ook heb je ervaring in projectbeheer.
- Je hebt minstens 5 jaar ervaring in projectmanagement.
- Je bent analytisch en innovatief, trekt verbanden tussen gegevens en werkt creatieve, onderbouwde oplossingen uit. Je begeleidt en motiveert medewerkers, bevordert teamspirit en onderhoudt constructieve relaties met klanten en stakeholders. Je handelt integer, neemt verantwoordelijkheid, plant je eigen ontwikkeling en zet daadkrachtig resultaten om in actie.
- Je hebt kennis van Agile, Scrum en Prince2.
- Een pluspunt is je technische background in Java, JEE, OpenShift, SOA-webservices.
- Je drukt je vlot uit in het Frans en Engels.


Ons aanbod

- Je krijgt een gevarieerde, uitdagende en maatschappelijk relevante job waarbij je bijdraagt aan IT-oplossingen die een belangrijke rol spelen in de samenleving. Onze slogan 'ICT for society' weerspiegelt dit perfect.
- Zoek je een goede balans tussen werk en privéleven? Geniet van flexibele werkuren en maak gebruik van ons zeer uitgebreid telewerkbeleid.
- We bieden ruime interne en externe opleidingsmogelijkheden, waardoor je je technische skills en persoonlijke vaardigheden voortdurend kunt aanscherpen.
- We bieden je een competitief salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen zoals hospitalisatieverzekering, aanvullend pensioenplan, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques,...
IT-functies kunnen rekenen op een mobiliteitsbudget met de keuze voor een bedrijfswagen en/of terugbetaling openbaar vervoer. Onder bepaalde voorwaarden kan je dit budget zelfs gebruiken voor de betaling van je huur... -

title: Senior Learning & Development Administrator
description:
We have a new opportunity for a Senior Learning & Development Administrator to join our team in Oldham.

This is a 12-month fixed-term contract, working 35 hours per week from Monday to Thursday, on a hybrid working basis.

The Learning & Development team supports colleagues across the business by providing access to training and development opportunities that help them succeed and grow. As a Senior Learning & Development Administrator, you will be the first point of contact for L&D enquiries, delivering excellent customer service to colleagues, managers and external training providers.

title: Sr Product Manager - Compliance & Regulatory
description:
About the role and team

Product at Uber means making big decisions without perfect information—and owning the outcomes. As a Senior Product Manager (Tech), you will turn massive complexity into clarity at speed, navigating the "messy" reality of multi-sided marketplaces and high-stakes technical integrations. You will be at the heart of our most ambitious missions, architecting solutions that bridge the digital and physical worlds for millions of users globally.

Our Team’s vision is to build a Global Payment Compliance Platform to support Uber’s growth and expansion, while meeting regulatory obligations. As a Senior Product Manager on the Payments Compliance Platform team, you'll be at the forefront of building a world-class compliance platform for all Payments Methods, Products and User Personas in Global Markets. This role is also critical to enable faster scaling of Uber’s Global Business while navigating the complex and ever-changing landscape of financial regulations and compliance standards.

What you’ll do

  • Define long term vision for charter with Product Leadership focused on New Opportunities and evolving landscape of Global financial regulations and User Needs.
  • Build & evolve core capabilities such as KYB (Know your Business), KYC (Know your customer), PRRM (Partner Risk Rating Model), EDD (Enhanced Due Diligence), ODD(Ongoing Due Diligence), etc. leveraging AI as needed & driving automation.
  • Partner with key stakeholders such as Compliance Officers , Comm Ops Leads, Legal, Payments and Operations teams and convert them into Product Requirements.
  • Define and prioritise a detailed product roadmap balancing Regulatory Needs, User requirements & Business Growth.
  • Align Leadership & cross-org. product teams on Core problems and Influence cross-org. product roadmap collaborating with them for roadmap execution.
  • Collaborate and Communicate with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Design, Data science, Data Engineering, ML, TPM, Compliance Operations & Business Operations to build & deliver high-impact products.
  • Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation/feature definition to launch and post-launch feedback & improvements

Basic Qualifications

  • 7 + years of experience as a Product Manager
  • Experience in compliance, regulatory products with strong understanding of compliance Modules & Processes (e.g. AML, KYC, ODD, EDD, Screening, etc.)
  • Define and prioritise a detailed product roadmap balancing Regulatory Needs, User requirements & Business Growth.
  • Strong technical depth: Able to coordinate large engineering efforts, identify potential technical risks, and act as an effective partner for engineering managers across teams.
  • Experience defining OKRs and roadmaps for complex programs/platforms, ensuring teams operate with minimal noise and a rapid clip of high-quality delivery.
  • Collaborate and Communicate with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Design, Data science, Data Engineering, ML, TPM, Compliance Operations & Business Operations to build & deliver high-impact products
  • Experience representing significant areas of work to executives to gather feedback, generate alignment, and garner support.
  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related technical/quantitative field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Has built & managed Internal/Enterprise Platforms at a global scale
  • Global experience: Building and launching products that bridge digital and physical worlds across diverse regional contexts.

title: Full Stack Java Developer
description:
Full Stack Java Developer (32-40 uur)

Bouw mee aan het platform achter Qnect

Ben jij een ervaren Java developer die graag verder kijkt dan alleen code schrijven? Wil je werken aan een modern low-code platform dat dagelijks organisaties helpt bij kwaliteit, veiligheid en compliance? En krijg jij energie van technische uitdagingen, architectuurvraagstukken en innovatie?

Dan zoeken wij jou.

Jouw uitdaging

Als Full Stack Java Developer werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van Qnect, ons eigen low-code platform. Op dit platform bouwen organisaties toepassingen voor onder meer audits, incidentmanagement, RI&E's, inspecties en complianceprocessen.

Je wordt onderdeel van een ervaren en betrokken team van vier developers en een DevOps Engineer. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat het platform stabiel, schaalbaar en toekomstbestendig blijft.

Je denkt mee over meer dan alleen de implementatie van functionaliteiten. Ook architectuur, technische keuzes, performance, security en innovatie behoren tot jouw werkterrein. Daarbij krijg je veel vrijheid, verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte om ideeën in de praktijk te brengen.

Daarnaast werk je regelmatig samen met collega's uit andere ontwikkelteams binnen onze organisatie, waardoor je kunt sparren met een grotere groep van circa 25 softwareontwikkelaars.

AI als onderdeel van ons ontwikkelproces

Bij Kader Digital zetten we AI actief in om slimmer en efficiënter software te ontwikkelen. We werken dagelijks met Claude AI voor ondersteuning bij design, ontwikkeling en testen.

We zoeken daarom een developer die AI niet ziet als vervanging van vakmanschap, maar als een krachtig hulpmiddel. Iemand die begrijpt wanneer AI helpt, maar ook kritisch blijft op kwaliteit, veiligheid en onderhoudbaarheid.

Wat ga je doen?

· Ontwikkelen van nieuwe functionaliteiten binnen het Qnect-platform

· Verbeteren en onderhouden van bestaande componenten

· Meedenken over architectuur, softwaredesign en technische keuzes

· Samenwerken met onze low-code configuratoren die klantoplossingen bouwen

· Uitvoeren van code reviews en bewaken van codekwaliteit

· Inzetten van AI-tools zoals Claude AI binnen het ontwikkelproces

· Verminderen van technische schuld en verbeteren van maintainability

· Bijdragen aan kwartaalreleases en platformupdates

· Experimenteren met nieuwe technologieën tijdens innovatiedagen

Wat breng jij mee?

· HBO werk- en denkniveau

· Meerdere jaren ervaring als softwareontwikkelaar

· Ervaring met zowel backend- als frontendontwikkeling

· Een analytische en pragmatische werkwijze

· Interesse in architectuur en ontwerpvraagstukken

· Goede samenwerkingsvaardigheden

· Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal

Je hebt ervaring met

· Java

· Spring Boot

· Hibernate / JPA

· SQL-databases

· Angular

· Git

Nice to have

· Azure

· Docker

· Kubernetes

· Low-code platformen

· Security en ISO27001

· DevOps-principes

Wat bieden wij?

· Een uitdagende functie voor 32 tot 40 uur per week

· Salaris tussen €4.000 en €5.500 per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring

· Hybride werken met minimaal 50% aanwezigheid in Den Bosch

· Reiskosten- en thuiswerkvergoeding

· 28 vakantiedagen (op fulltime basis)

· Mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen bij te kopen

· 50/50 pensioenregeling

· Arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering

· Ruimte voor opleidingen, certificeringen en persoonlijke ontwikkeling

· Vier innovatiedagen per jaar om nieuwe ideeën en technologieën te verkennen

· Dagelijkse gezamenlijke lunch

· Een informele werksfeer met korte lijnen en veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid

Over Kader Digital

Kader Digital ontwikkelt, verkoopt en ondersteunt het Qnect-platform. Hiermee helpen we organisaties hun kwaliteits-, veiligheids-, gezondheids- en milieuprocessen te digitaliseren en automatiseren.

Binnen onze softwareorganisatie werken ongeveer 50 collega's op het gebied van development, support, sales, marketing en projectmanagement. Je standplaats is Den Bosch, waar ongeveer 25 collega's werkzaam zijn.

Wat ons kenmerkt? Een combinatie van inhoudelijke kennis van het QHSE-domein, moderne softwareontwikkeling, cloudtechnologie en AI. We geloven in eigenaarschap, pragmatisme en continu verbeteren. Je krijgt bij ons de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én directe invloed uit te oefenen op de toekomst van ons platform.

Interesse?

Wil jij bouwen aan software die dagelijks door duizenden gebruikers wordt ingezet, werken met moderne technologieën én onderdeel worden van een hecht ontwikkelteam?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

title: Analyst
description:
Job Description: Voice – Analyst

As a Customer Care Executive for the Inbound US Voice Process with a focus on Sales and Upselling, you will be responsible for delivering outstanding customer service to customers in the United States and also selling products and services to increase revenue. You will be the first point of contact for customers who call in with inquiries, and your primary goal will be to ensure that their needs are addressed, their questions are answered, and their interest in purchasing products and services is captured.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Answering incoming calls from customers in a professional and courteous manner.
  • Listening actively to customers and asking probing questions to fully understand their needs and concerns.
  • Providing accurate and timely information to customers about products and services, pricing, and promotions, while actively seeking opportunities to upsell.
  • Handling customer objections and concerns with empathy and professionalism, and working to address them to close the sale.
  • Documenting all customer interactions and details of inquiries, issues, and sales in the company's CRM system.
  • Meeting or exceeding individual and team sales targets. Upselling on every opportunity call.
  • Maintaining a high level of knowledge about the company's products and services, as well as industry trends and best practices.

Requirements:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Previous experience in a customer service and sales role, preferably in a call center environment.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think on your feet.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Flexibility to work in rotational shifts, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Familiarity with basic computer skills and knowledge of CRM systems.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in any field is preferred.

If you are a people-person with a passion for delivering outstanding customer service and have the necessary skills and experience to drive sales and upselling, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer: Cloud-Native AI Platform

title: Director of Product & Design
description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 80 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Director of Product & Design

Salary range: €130,000-180,000/annum

We're looking for a highly hands-on and influential Director of Product & Design to join our team in Berlin. This pivotal role sits at the intersection of product and design: you'll own end-to-end product experiences from the problem worth solving through to the pixels users see, shape both our product and design strategy, and lead and uplevel our Design team. You'll combine a product mindset with the craft to make it exceptional. You're equally at home defining a product bet and refining an interaction.

What You'll Do 🎯

  • Own Product Areas End to End: Take full ownership of key parts of the Freecash experience, from discovery, problem framing, and prioritisation through to design, launch, and iteration, with clear accountability for the outcomes, not just the output.

  • Shape Product & Design Strategy: Partner with leadership, Engineering, and Data to define where our products should go next, drawing on user insight, competitor landscapes, and business goals to decide what to build, what to cut, and how it should feel.

  • Lead & Uplevel the Design Team: Act as a hands-on leader, coaching and mentoring designers to raise the bar for visual and interaction design, while growing their product thinking so the team owns problems, not just screens.

  • Run Experiments That Move Metrics: Turn ideas into hypotheses and hypotheses into fast experiments, using user research, automated metric tracking, and performance data to make decisions that move engagement, retention, and monetisation for users and advertisers.

  • Drive AI-Native Ways of Working: Bring AI into how product and design operate, from rapid prototyping and research synthesis to faster iteration, and explore where AI can create better experiences for our users.

  • Own & Enhance the Experience: Proactively identify opportunities across our products, then define, redesign, and ship solutions that improve usability, emotional connection, and overall user satisfaction.

What You'll Bring 💡

  • Extensive experience across product and design in mobile-first B2C products, with a portfolio and track record that show both impactful UI/UX work and product decisions that moved business results.

  • Experience owning product outcomes, whether as a product manager, a product-minded design lead, or in a hybrid role: defining problems, setting priorities, writing specs, and making trade-off calls.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design skills, with a meticulous eye for detail, hierarchy, and accessibility, and a deep care for quality and polish.

  • Proven ability to lead, coach, and grow a design team, and to inspire cross-functional teams toward high-quality outcomes.

  • A highly data-driven mindset: comfortable digging into the data yourself, designing experiments, and setting up the metrics that show what truly moves the needle.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to speed up how you and your team discover, prototype, and ship.

What Makes You a Great Fit 🌟

  • Product Mind, Designer's Eye: You think in problems, bets, and outcomes, and you can't let a feature ship until it looks and feels right. You move comfortably between the strategy and the details.

  • Highly Hands-On & Quality-Obsessed: You naturally dive in, aren't satisfied until things are polished, and actively fix what doesn't look or feel right.

  • Impact-Driven & Business-Minded: You're passionate about seeing your work move real metrics and deeply curious about how product and design decisions drive growth for users and advertisers.

  • Built for Pace: You've thrived in fast-moving, lean startup or scale-up environments where ownership, speed, and ambiguity are the norm.

  • Proactive & Emotionally Intelligent: You take full ownership, seek out improvements, and think constantly about how users feel, creating rewarding and motivating experiences.

Why Almedia? 🚀

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager

About Vertical Mechanical Group (VMG)

Vertical Mechanical Group (VMG) is a leading mechanical contractor specializing in commercial HVAC, Plumbing, Piping, and Mechanical Construction. Originally formed through Anderson Mechanical Services, Inc. and Inspiration Plumbing Company, VMG brings decades of industry experience together with a forward-thinking approach to delivering high-quality mechanical solutions.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead commercial mechanical construction projects from preconstruction through final closeout. This position will have responsibility for project financial performance, scheduling, procurement, coordination, client relationships, and successful field execution.

The ideal candidate is an experienced construction professional with a strong understanding of HVAC, plumbing, piping, and MEP systems who can effectively manage project teams, build strong relationships, and deliver projects safely, on schedule, and within budget.

What You'll Do

Lead Projects from Start to Finish

  • Manage commercial mechanical construction projects from preconstruction and planning through final turnover and closeout

  • Establish project goals, schedules, budgets, procurement plans, and execution strategies

  • Coordinate project activities across Project Management, field operations, VDC, Engineering, Procurement, and other internal teams

  • Maintain ownership of project performance, ensuring milestones and contractual requirements are achieved

  • Identify potential challenges early and develop solutions to keep projects moving forward

  • Manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced construction environment

Manage Project Financial Performance

  • Develop, manage, and maintain project budgets, forecasts, and cost projections

  • Monitor labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, and other project costs

  • Review project financial performance and identify risks or opportunities that could impact profitability

  • Manage change orders, pricing, documentation, and contract modifications

  • Support procurement planning and major equipment and material purchasing decisions

  • Identify value-engineering and cost-saving opportunities

  • Maintain accountability for the overall financial success of assigned projects

Coordinate MEP Construction

  • Lead coordination efforts for HVAC, plumbing, piping, and related MEP systems

  • Review project drawings, specifications, contracts, RFIs, submittals, coordination drawings, and other construction documents

  • Participate in design reviews, constructability reviews, and BIM/VDC coordination

  • Work with Superintendents and Foremen to develop sequencing, manpower plans, and field execution strategies

  • Coordinate with other trades to resolve conflicts and maintain project schedules

  • Ensure project teams have the information, materials, equipment, and resources needed for successful execution

Build Strong Client & Partner Relationships

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for owners, general contractors, architects, engineers, subcontractors, and project partners

  • Lead and participate in project meetings, progress reviews, and client discussions

  • Communicate project status, schedule, financial considerations, and potential challenges clearly and proactively

  • Build strong relationships through responsiveness, accountability, and consistent project execution

  • Manage subcontractor and vendor relationships throughout the project lifecycle

  • Represent VMG professionally with customers and industry partners

Drive Schedule, Quality & Safety

  • Develop and maintain project schedules in coordination with field leadership and project partners

  • Monitor project milestones, procurement requirements, and construction progress

  • Partner with Superintendents and Foremen to maintain productivity and resolve field challenges

  • Support VMG's safety expectations and ensure project teams comply with applicable safety requirements

  • Maintain quality standards and ensure installations comply with drawings, specifications, codes, and contractual requirements

  • Proactively manage project risks and escalate significant concerns when necessary

Manage Project Closeout

  • Coordinate equipment startup, testing, commissioning, and system turnover

  • Manage punch-list activities and outstanding project requirements

  • Ensure closeout documentation, as-built drawings, O&M manuals, warranties, and other deliverables are completed

  • Coordinate final project acceptance with clients and project partners

  • Support warranty transition and resolution of post-construction items

  • Conduct project reviews and capture lessons learned to improve future performance

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of Project Management experience in commercial construction, mechanical contracting, MEP contracting, or with a General Contractor

  • Strong understanding of commercial HVAC, plumbing, piping, and MEP systems

  • Demonstrated experience managing projects from preconstruction through closeout

  • Strong knowledge of project budgeting, forecasting, scheduling, procurement, and contract administration

  • Experience managing RFIs, submittals, change orders, project documentation, and cost controls

  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, contracts, and technical documentation

  • Proven ability to coordinate field teams, subcontractors, vendors, and multiple trades

  • Strong financial acumen and understanding of project profitability

  • Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, organization, and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities

  • Experience with Procore, Bluebeam, Microsoft Project, Primavera P6, or similar construction management platforms

  • Ability to travel to project locations as required

Preferred Experience

  • Experience managing commercial construction projects ranging from $2M to $50M+

  • Previous Project Management experience with a commercial mechanical contractor

  • Experience managing large and complex HVAC, plumbing, piping, or MEP scopes

  • Experience with negotiated, design-build, and design-assist projects

  • Familiarity with BIM/VDC coordination and constructability review processes

  • Experience managing projects involving multiple trades and complex construction schedules

  • Experience with commissioning, project turnover, and closeout

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent industry experience considered

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation based on experience

  • Performance-based bonus opportunities

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid time off and company holidays

  • Company vehicle or vehicle allowance based on position

  • Ongoing professional development and leadership opportunities

  • Career advancement within a rapidly growing organization

  • Opportunity to manage complex, high-profile commercial mechanical projects

  • A collaborative, team-oriented environment with strong leadership support

Why VMG?

At VMG, our Project Managers are responsible for more than keeping projects on schedule. They lead teams, manage client relationships, drive financial performance, solve complex construction challenges, and help ensure every project is positioned for success.

As a Project Manager, you'll have the opportunity to take true ownership of your projects, collaborate closely with experienced field and operational teams, and continue developing your career within a growing mechanical contractor.

If you're an experienced construction Project Manager with a strong background in commercial mechanical construction, HVAC, plumbing, piping, or MEP project management, we'd like to hear from you.

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employment visa sponsorship.

Vertical Mechanical Group participates in a drug testing program. All candidates are required to submit to a drug test as a condition of employment.

Apply today and continue building your career with VMG.

VMG is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Data Functional Analyst
description:
About the Role

Oliver James is partnering with a leading enterprise organization migrating its core legacy systems from Adabas (Mainframe) to PostgreSQL.

We are seeking a Data Functional Analyst to bridge the gap between legacy business logic and modern database architecture. Working directly alongside Data Engineers and DBAs, you will define data mappings and ensure a seamless, high-integrity migration.

Key Responsibilities
  • Legacy Data Analysis & Mapping: Deep-dive into Mainframe data structures and define accurate functional target mappings to PostgreSQL relational schemaq.
  • Technical & Functional Guidance: Act as the primary functional advisor for Data Engineers and DBAs, writing clear functional specifications to guide ETL/ELT pipeline development and schema design.
  • Data Quality & Reconciliation: Design data validation strategies, define test scenarios, and execute cross-database reconciliation checks (Mainframe legacy vs. PostgreSQL) to guarantee 100% data integrity and consistency.
  • Data Lineage & Documentation: Maintain comprehensive data dictionaries, mapping rulebooks, and lineage documentation throughout the migration lifecycle.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the functional point of contact for resolving legacy data ambiguities and translating complex business rules for the technical delivery team.
Requirements & Qualifications
  • Functional Data Expertise: 3 years of experience as a Data Functional Analyst, Business Data Analyst, or Data Consultant on large-scale data transformation projects.
  • Database & SQL Skills: Strong, mandatory expertise in PostgreSQL and advanced proficiency in SQL and relational data modelling concepts.
  • Mainframe Experience: Solid functional understanding of Mainframe database environments (knowledge of Adabas is nice to have, but not mandatory).
  • Migration Track Record: Hands-on experience working on complex legacy-to-relational data migration projects.
  • Language Skills:
    • Fluent English (written and spoken).
    • Professional fluency in French and/or Dutch (essential for local team and business stakeholder collaboration).
  • Communication & Mindset: Excellent analytical skills, rigorous attention to detail, and the ability to articulate complex functional rules clearly to technical teams.

title: Senior InfoSec Engineer
description:
Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) has developed a new generation of nanopore-based sensing technology for faster, information-rich, accessible and affordable molecular analysis. The technology is used to understand and characterise the biology of humans, animals, plants, bacteria, viruses and diseases such as cancer. By enabling biological insights, we strive to improve life on Earth and beyond.

We are looking for an experienced individual to join our Information Security team as a Senior InfoSec Engineer.

The Details...

The Senior InfoSec Engineer in responsible for enhancing the cybersecurity defences of ONT’s information systems.

You will investigate suspicious activity across the organisation's security telemetry, contain incidents and develop new procedures. You will also improve our internal SOC processes by developing detections, automating repeatable tasks, testing monitoring coverage, and sharing practical knowledge with the wider team.

You will lead the design, testing, identification and communication of security weaknesses to stakeholders across ONT and improve security controls and practices.

You will fully exploit the security tools available and enhance ONT’s technical assurance activities, working alongside Global IT teams to implement proactive security configurations including Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), User Entity and behaviour Analytics (UEBA), Secure Web Gateway (SWG), Data Loss Prevention (DLP), email filtering, and vulnerability scanning tools and have the opportunity to uncover security flaws and control weaknesses across Oxford Nanopore's IT and application estate, while performing security operations functions to bolster the Managed Security Operations Centre (MSOC) in order to protect Oxford Nanopore and its information, and respond in a timely manner to cyber threats.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop the blue team and threat hunting capability to harden and enhance the technological controls on Oxford Nanopore's IT estate.

  • Design, deploy and harden system configuration across enterprise IT devices.

  • Perform day-to-day BAU security operation activities including triaging and prioritising alerts from SIEM, EDR, identity, cloud, and other monitoring sources, separating genuine threats from benign activity.

  • Lead or contribute to incident investigations from initial validation through scoping, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.

  • Develop, tune, and validate detection logic, queries, rules, and dashboards so that monitoring is useful, explainable, and aligned to realistic risks.

  • Work with the MSOC and as part of the Incident Response Team.

  • Work with third parties to securely configure the platforms contributing to Oxford Nanopore’s security stack: EDR, SIEM/SOAR, SWG, DLP and vulnerability management.

  • Advise on security architecture improvements: changing vendors, enhancing services and identifying solutions

  • Produce high-quality technical documentation.

  • Turn recurring findings into measurable improvements to playbooks, detections, telemetry, response processes, and service reporting.

You might be a good fit if you have:

  • An interest in uncovering security flaws.

  • Experience working within a complex hybrid environment.

  • Previous experience with incident response and can bring suggestions on good practices that suit Oxford Nanopore.

  • An enthusiasm for self-learning and continually expanding one’s knowledge and skills.

  • The ability to work as part of a wider team, and be confident in making decisions.

  • High attention to detail with excellent organisational and planning skills.

  • Experience of security incident management.

  • Several years of hands-on experience in a SOC, CSIRT, detection engineering, incident response, or equivalent blue-team role.

  • Experience with SIEM, SOAR, DLP, vulnerability management, and threat intelligence.

Preferred Skills and Experience:

  • An undergraduate degree in a relevant subject or relevant experience.

  • Previous experience in a similar role such as engineer, analyst, or specialist.

  • Working knowledge of common attack techniques, the MITRE ATT&CK framework, incident handling, evidence preservation, and risk-based escalation.

  • Cybersecurity certification such as OSCP, OSDA, CRTO, GPEN, CDSA, or similar.

  • Experience with vulnerability scanning tools like InsightVM or Nexpose.

  • Scripting or automation experience in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or a comparable language, including use of APIs or repeatable response steps.

  • Experience with TI (Threat Intelligence) tools.

  • Experience working within an ISO 27001 compliant environment.

  • Familiarity with software engineering or application security.

Personal Qualities and Additional Skills

  • Calm and methodical during incidents, with the confidence to act and the judgement to escalate uncertainty.
  • Curious about how systems and attackers behave, and willing to test assumptions against evidence.
  • Clear and respectful in written and verbal communication, including when explaining risk to non-specialists.
  • A dependable team mate who shares knowledge, accepts review, and takes ownership of improvements beyond the immediate ticket.

Please note that no terminology in this advert is intended to discriminate on the grounds of a person's gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability or sexual orientation. Every candidate will be assessed only in accordance with their merits, qualifications and abilities to perform the duties of the job.

title: Estimator
description:
Estimator

About Vertical Mechanical Group (VMG)

Vertical Mechanical Group (VMG) is a leading mechanical contractor specializing in commercial HVAC, Plumbing, Piping, and Mechanical Construction. Originally formed through Anderson Mechanical Services, Inc. and Inspiration Plumbing Company, VMG brings decades of industry experience together with a forward-thinking approach to delivering high-quality mechanical solutions.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for an experienced Estimator to join our Preconstruction team at our headquarters in Sterling, Virginia. This role is responsible for developing accurate and competitive estimates for commercial HVAC and plumbing projects, including negotiated work, hard bids, and design-build opportunities.

The ideal candidate combines strong mechanical knowledge with attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to collaborate with project teams to develop successful project strategies.

What You'll Do

Develop Accurate Estimates

  • Prepare detailed estimates for commercial HVAC, plumbing, piping, and mechanical construction projects
  • Perform quantity takeoffs and develop labor, material, equipment, and subcontractor pricing
  • Review drawings, specifications, addenda, and other bid documents to understand project requirements
  • Develop estimates for negotiated, hard-bid, and design-build opportunities
  • Evaluate project scope and identify potential risks, exclusions, and cost considerations
  • Maintain accurate and organized estimating documentation throughout the bid process

Manage the Bid Process

  • Review bid invitations and project documents to determine scope and estimating requirements
  • Solicit and evaluate subcontractor and supplier pricing
  • Compare proposals to ensure scope coverage and identify potential gaps
  • Coordinate bid requirements, deadlines, and deliverables
  • Assist with preparing final proposals, clarifications, qualifications, and scope documentation
  • Support bid reviews to ensure estimates are complete, competitive, and aligned with project requirements

Collaborate Across Teams

  • Partner with Preconstruction, Operations, Project Management, Engineering, and field teams to develop comprehensive project estimates
  • Participate in project reviews, scope discussions, and preconstruction meetings
  • Work with vendors, subcontractors, engineers, and other project partners to clarify requirements
  • Support project handoffs from Preconstruction to Operations following award
  • Share lessons learned and historical cost information to improve future estimates

Support Preconstruction Strategy

  • Analyze project plans and specifications to identify opportunities for value engineering and cost optimization
  • Assist with conceptual budgeting and early-stage project pricing
  • Maintain current knowledge of material pricing, labor costs, market conditions, and construction trends
  • Utilize historical project data to improve estimating accuracy
  • Help identify potential project risks and opportunities during the preconstruction process

What You Bring

  • 3+ years of estimating, engineering, construction, or project management experience within related markets
  • Experience working with Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems
  • Strong understanding of commercial construction principles, methods, and practices
  • Technical understanding of building systems and commercial construction projects
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and project documents
  • Strong analytical skills with excellent attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple estimates and deadlines simultaneously
  • Strong organizational, written, and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse project teams
  • Positive attitude and ability to succeed in a fast-paced environment

Preferred Experience

  • Experience estimating commercial HVAC, plumbing, piping, or mechanical construction projects
  • Experience with negotiated work, hard bids, and design-build projects
  • Knowledge of labor, material, equipment, subcontractor, and resource planning
  • Experience with estimating and construction management software
  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Project Management, Architecture, Engineering, or a related field preferred

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Performance-based bonus opportunities
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
  • Opportunities for continued career growth within a rapidly growing organization
  • A collaborative environment where your expertise and ideas make an impact

Why VMG?

At VMG, Preconstruction plays an important role in setting our projects up for success before work ever begins in the field.

Our Estimators work closely with internal teams, clients, vendors, and project partners to develop thoughtful, competitive solutions for complex commercial mechanical projects. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to projects from the earliest stages while building your expertise within a growing mechanical contractor.

If you're a detail-oriented construction professional who understands commercial mechanical systems, estimating, and what it takes to build a successful project, we'd like to hear from you.

This position is based at VMG's headquarters in Sterling, VA and is 100% onsite.

Apply today and continue building your career with VMG.

VMG is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

description:

We are all employee-owners at HDR, which is the foundation of our collaborative culture that connects employees around the world.


Position Summary
HDR is looking for a Construction Engineer with approximately five years of aviation construction experience. In this role you will be responsible for supporting the planning, coordination, execution, and delivery of airport infrastructure and facility improvement projects. The role involves managing construction activities within active airport environments while ensuring compliance with contract requirements, safety regulations, quality standards, operational constraints, and project schedules. Working closely with airport authorities, airlines, consultants, contractors, and regulatory agencies, the Construction Engineer helps facilitate the successful delivery of airside and landside projects with minimal disruption to airport operations


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and support the execution of aviation construction projects, including terminal renovations, airfield improvements, utility relocations, runway rehabilitations, taxiway improvements, service road upgrades, baggage handling systems, and support facilities.

  • Coordinate with stakeholders including airport authorities, airlines, TSA, FAA representatives, contractors, designers, and utility providers.
  • Support commissioning, testing, punch list completion, and project closeout activities.
  • Identify and mitigate construction risks associated with operating airports, security-sensitive areas, and passenger-facing facilities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Approximately 5 years of experience supporting aviation, transportation, or large infrastructure projects.
  • Experience working on airport terminal, airfield, runway, taxiway, service road, utility, or support facility projects.
  • Familiarity with FAA Advisory Circulars, airport operational requirements, and aviation construction phasing.
  • Understanding of project controls, scheduling, cost management, and contract administration.

title: Scrum Master AI (Project Manager)
description:
THE POSITION:

The Scrum Master (Project Manager) plays a key role in enabling Agile delivery by facilitating and coordinating Agile Scrum processes across the organization. The role is responsible for ensuring that Scrum Teams work collaboratively and efficiently to deliver high-quality products and solutions. The Scrum Master serves as a coach and mentor to the team, removes impediments, promotes continuous improvement, and works closely with Product Owners, Product Development teams, business stakeholders, and project/program leadership to support delivery within agreed timelines, budget, scope, and quality expectations.

The role requires strong facilitation, communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and Agile coaching skills, with the ability to foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Facilitate and coordinate Agile Scrum processes within the organization and ensure effective adoption of the Scrum framework.
  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including Daily Scrum, Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective, and Backlog Refinement sessions.
  • Guide and coach Scrum Team members, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile Scrum principles, practices, roles, and responsibilities.
  • Ensure the team works collaboratively and efficiently to deliver high-quality products and solutions.
  • Work closely with the Product Owner/Product Developer to support product backlog prioritization, refinement, story readiness, and sprint planning.
  • Identify, track, troubleshoot, and remove impediments and obstacles that may hinder the team's progress.
  • Promote continuous improvement through retrospectives, feedback sessions, coaching, and implementation of improvement actions.
  • Communicate project and sprint status, delivery progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and impediments to relevant stakeholders.
  • Track Agile KPIs and metrics such as velocity, sprint burndown/burnup, capacity, throughput, cycle time, and delivery predictability.
  • Monitor sprint and release progress and proactively identify risks that may impact timelines, budget, scope, or quality.
  • Facilitate effective collaboration across Product, Development, QA, Business Analysis, Project Management, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Support release planning and ensure alignment between sprint objectives, product priorities, and broader delivery milestones.
  • Ensure the Scrum Team follows the Scrum framework and operates in accordance with Agile principles and agreed ways of working.
  • Encourage self-organization, accountability, transparency, and sustainable delivery practices within the team.
  • Maintain appropriate Agile dashboards, action logs, RAID items, metrics, and status reporting.
  • Support resolution of conflicts within the team and facilitate constructive discussions to achieve outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve team productivity, delivery quality, and Agile maturity.
  • Collaborate with project/program managers and leadership on delivery planning, dependencies, escalations, and governance.
  • Support distributed and cross-functional teams by establishing effective communication and collaboration practices.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
  • Experience using Agile project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent.

PEOPLE LEADER

People leaders must possess both the skills to effectively accomplish these tasks and the emotional intelligence to do so in alignment with our cultural values. In addition to the critical management and leadership tasks listed above, this role also includes the following unique responsibilities:

  • Responsible for and overseeing their respective department.
  • Interview, select and supervise the activities of the department staff; communicate interpret and discuss with team the company policies and procedures.
  • Determine job objectives, work methods and performance standards; review performance relative to departmental objectives discussion appraisal with each employee and performance; authorize and communicate salary changes, promotions, transfers, discipline, and discharge and administer all other personnel actions.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience as a Scrum Master, with preferred experience of 3–5 years in Agile software/product delivery.
  • Experience in software development, programming concepts, databases, and DB querying.
  • Understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) and Agile development methodologies.
  • Good understanding of application architecture and software development processes.
  • Ability to understand technical requirements, application dependencies, integrations, APIs, and data flows.
  • Basic to intermediate understanding of relational databases and database concepts.
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) certification is preferred/required for the role.
  • Strong knowledge and practical understanding of Agile Scrum principles, practices, roles, events, artifacts, and accountabilities.
  • Hands-on experience facilitating Daily Scrum, Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, Sprint Retrospective, and Backlog Refinement.
  • Strong coaching and mentoring skills with the ability to guide teams toward self-organization, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify, manage, and remove impediments and delivery blockers.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, organizational, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to lead and facilitate Scrum ceremonies effectively for cross-functional teams.
  • Experience working collaboratively with Product Owners, Developers, QA teams, Business Analysts, Project Managers, and other stakeholders.
  • Experience tracking and communicating Agile KPIs, delivery metrics, risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Prior knowledge of Agile project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally, or Trello.
  • Experience in software development, programming concepts, databases, and DB querying.
  • Ability to work effectively with geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong ability to promote continuous improvement and drive actionable outcomes from retrospectives and feedback sessions.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, client-focused environmen

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree/Masters Degree in IT Stream
  • Additional certification in Agile methodologies, such as Professional Scrum Master (PSM), Advanced Certified ScrumMaster (A-CSM), or equivalent.
  • SAFe Scrum Master certification is a plus.
  • Kanban certification or practical Kanban experience is a plus.
  • Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally, Trello, or equivalent Agile delivery tools.
  • Experience working with technology, healthcare, life sciences, or other regulated environments is preferred.
  • Experience supporting Agile transformation, organizational change, or Scrum maturity initiatives is an advantage.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Are you motivated by turning complex data into clear insight and practical business value? The Global Data Intelligence team in DNV Energy Systems is looking for a Data Analyst to join our team in Oslo and help shape how data is used in our regions and functions to support better decisions, stronger performance, and more effective ways of working. We deliver the insights portal for Energy Systems, we participate in improvements projects with Operational Excellence teams, and we engage in AI adoption initiatives.

In this role, you will work with large and complex datasets from multiple sources, transforming data into trusted analytics, dashboards, and visual stories that make insights accessible to stakeholders across the business. You will combine curiosity, analytical rigour, and strong business understanding to identify patterns, explain performance, and support data-driven decision-making.

You will be part of a collaborative analytics environment where data quality, usability, and stakeholder adoption matter as much as technical delivery. The position is well suited for someone with 2–4 years of relevant experience who enjoys working hands-on with business intelligence tools and translating analytical findings into clear recommendations.

What you will do

  • Analyse large, complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities that support business priorities.
  • Design, build, and maintain effective dashboards and reports using Power BI. (Experience with Tableau, Qlik, or similar business intelligence tools is valuable)
  • Translate business questions into analytical approaches, define relevant measures and KPIs, and present findings in a clear and actionable way.
  • Work closely with business stakeholders, data engineers, product teams, and subject matter experts to understand requirements and improve analytical solutions.
  • Contribute to improving reporting processes, data models, data definitions, and self-service analytics capabilities, tied closely with DNV wide initiatives
  • Engage in the adoption of AI across Energy Systems, including identifying, exploring, and supporting relevant agent and agentic use cases that can improve analytics, decision support, and ways of working.

  • A meaningful role where your analytical work will help colleagues and leaders make better, data-informed decisions.
  • The opportunity to work with varied and complex datasets in an international, knowledge-driven environment.
  • A collaborative culture built on knowledge sharing, professional development, and respect for different perspectives.
  • Good opportunities to grow your skills in analytics, business intelligence, stakeholder engagement, and modern data platforms.
  • Flexible working arrangements supporting a healthy work-life balance and Høvik campus facilities
  • Competitive benefits aligned with Norwegian market practices, including pension, insurance, annual vacation, and employee wellbeing initiatives.
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

Must-have experience

  • 2–4 years of relevant experience as a Data Analyst, BI Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role.
  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field such as data analytics, economics, business, engineering, computer science, statistics, or a related discipline.
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets and turning them into structured analysis, reports, or dashboards.
  • Strong ability to understand business needs and translate them into data requirements, analytical questions, and practical outputs.
  • Experience presenting insights to non-technical stakeholders through clear visualisations, storytelling, and concise recommendations.

Technical skills

  • Strong hands-on skills in at least one leading BI and visualisation tool, preferably Power BI.
  • Good understanding of data modelling, dashboard design, report performance, and user-friendly visual analytics.
  • Experience with data quality checks, data reconciliation, and documenting definitions, assumptions, and calculations.
  • Experience with Excel for analysis and ad hoc business support; experience with Python, R, Power Query, DAX, or similar tools/languages is an advantage.
  • Experience extracting, transforming, and analysing data from relational databases, data warehouses, or lakehouse environments.
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms, APIs, or modern analytics environments is beneficial, but not required.

Ways of working

  • You are curious, structured, and comfortable exploring data to understand what is really happening behind the numbers.
  • You take ownership of tasks from problem framing to analysis, visualisation, communication, and follow-up.
  • You have strong attention to detail and care about data quality, consistency, and trust.
  • You collaborate well with both technical and business colleagues and enjoy making data useful for others.
  • You communicate clearly, ask good questions, and are able to explain analytical findings in a simple and relevant way.
  • You are motivated by continuous improvement and look for opportunities to simplify reporting, automate repetitive work, and improve how insights are delivered.
Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.

title: Production Process Supervisor
description:
Thermoteknix Systems Ltd, founded in 1982 and based in Cambridge, is a world leader in thermal imaging, night vision, and augmented reality systems. Our award-winning technologies are trusted by defence, security, and industrial customers in over 70 countries. With in-house R&D, cutting-edge innovation, and a global reputation for quality, we design and manufacture solutions that perform in the toughest environments. The Production Process Supervisor is responsible for ensuring that manufacturing within the production department is optimised for efficiency, consistency, and quality. The role is to ensure that all production activities follow approved procedures, documentation is maintained, and improvement opportunities are identified and implemented.

This position plays a key role in maintaining operational control, supporting process improvements, and ensuring production teams are properly resourced and guided to achieve business objectives.
Daily management of staff, to set jobs and expected performance levels, leading the shop floor and ensuring production schedules are met.
Daily reporting on the Production status will be required.

Key Responsibilities

Process Control and Optimisation
  • Oversee day-to-day manufacturing processes to ensure they are carried out efficiently and in accordance with documented procedures.
  • Identify and implement opportunities for process improvement to optimise production flow, resource use, and quality outcomes.
  • Drive data-based decision-making using shop floor data collection and analysis (e.g., CIM ERP system).
Documentation and Compliance
  • Ensure all work instructions, build documents, and process controls are current and complete.
  • Maintain visibility of controlled documents and ensure production technicians are using the latest versions.
  • Investigate any deviations from process and implement corrective actions where necessary.
  • Maintain accurate results and records as required.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Represent production in NPI (New Product Introduction) activities to ensure smooth transition of new products into manufacturing.
  • Work closely with the Quality team to review process performance, identify nonconformities, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Participate in ECN (Engineering Change Notice) meetings and ensure all relevant production changes are communicated and implemented.
Workflow and Resource Management
  • Define and maintain clear workflows on the production floor, including kitting quantities, workstation allocation, and process sequencing.
  • Ensure all production technicians have the tools, materials, and information required to complete tasks efficiently.
  • Support the development of resource plans to meet build schedules and operational targets.
  • Maintain acceptable housekeeping standards to ensure an organised, clean & safe working environment for all employees.
  • Undertake / Supervise - Assembly, Test, Calibration and Rework activity as required

Quality and Continuous Improvement
  • Collaborate with Quality Assurance to identify and resolve production-related issues and defects.
  • QA for all Production bugs.
  • Lead or support process audits and improvement initiatives to ensure compliance with company standards.
  • Promote continuous improvement and lean practices within the production area.
  • Comply with all health and safety requirements as stipulated within standard operating procedures & company procedures.
  • Basic understanding of 5/6S.

Communication and Reporting
  • Provide regular updates to Production Management on performance, risks, and improvement activities.
  • Ensure clear communication between production teams and cross-functional departments to maintain alignment and efficiency.
  • Maintain KPI’s and throughput metrics to guide decisions.

Qualifications and Skills
  • Proven experience in a manufacturing or supervisory role.
  • Strong understanding of production workflows, process control, and quality management.
  • Experience using production systems such as CIM and MRP/ERP.
  • Strong analytical skills and a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Working knowledge of lean manufacturing principles and health and safety standards.

Interfaces
  • Internal: Production Technicians, Production Engineering, Quality, NPI, Stores, and Operations.
  • External: May liaise with suppliers or service providers as required.
  • Involvement in cutting-edge imaging technologies.
  • Collaborative working environment with strong technical expertise.
  • Training and career development opportunities.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

title: IT Infrastructure Coordinator
description:
Meer dan 2000 professionals omarmen bij Smals elke dag de toekomst door zich in te zetten voor ICT for Society. Hoogtechnologische ICT-systemen zorgen voor meer efficiëntie in de belangrijke sociale verantwoordelijkheidsdomeinen van onze klanten zoals werk, gezin en gezondheid. Het eHealthplatform, een beveiligd uitwisselingsplatform voor medische informatie, zal papieren doktersbriefjes en doktersvoorschriften op termijn overbodig maken. Daarnaast zorgt de ICT-service Dimona er voor dat de RSZ de sociale bescherming van 4 miljoen werknemers snel kan laten evolueren, ongeacht hoe snel ze van job veranderen. Handig? Jazeker, en uitdagend ook.


Jobomschrijving

Als IT Infrastructure Coordinator ben je verantwoordelijk voor de stabiliteit, veiligheid en evolutie van de IT-infrastructuur.

Je stuurt het Infra-team aan en je bepaalt en evalueert de doelstellingen van een team van ongeveer zeven medewerkers, bestaande uit Support- en System Engineers/Administrators. In deze rol neem je een constructieve plaats in binnen het management van de ICT-afdeling en ben je verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van de volledige IT-infrastructuur, waaronder netwerken, servers, storage, cloudoplossingen, datacenters en beveiligingssystemen (o.a. Cisco, NetApp, Veeam en Trend Micro).

Samen met de ICT-directeur ontwikkel en implementeer je de infrastructuurstrategieën die aansluiten bij de algemene bedrijfsdoelstellingen. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in de verdere evolutie naar een infrastructuurmodel dat in toenemende mate steunt op de G-Cloud omgeving. In dat kader draagt de functie actief bij aan de transitie naar cloudgebaseerde diensten en aan het optimaal benutten van deze federale infrastructuur binnen de strategie van de instelling.

Daarnaast coördineer je diverse projecten, zoals G-Cloud initiatieven (IaaS en PaaS), NIS2 compliance, security initiatieven zoals phishingcampagnes en disaster recovery. Je stelt een IT-roadmap op voor de volledige infrastructuur en vertaalt businessbehoeften naar concrete technische oplossingen, bijvoorbeeld op het vlak van Microsoft Copilot/AI, SharePoint en cloudmigraties.

De functie omvat ook het onderhouden van relaties met externe partners en leveranciers, evenals actieve deelname aan Service Level Meetings, de opvolging van KPI’s en het beheer van certificaten. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen, opvolgen en bewaken van het INFRA IT-budget, met bijzondere aandacht voor kostenbeheersing.

Tot slot wordt de performantie en betrouwbaarheid van systemen en netwerken continu opgevolgd via automatisatie en monitoringtools zoals XDR Vision One, SOC, SIEM en Nagios. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met andere IT-afdelingen en de DPO om te verzekeren dat alle veiligheids- en compliancevereisten correct worden nageleefd.

Je beschikt over een bachelor- of masterdiploma in Informatica en je hebt minimaal vijf jaar ervaring in infrastructuurbeheer of infrastructuurarchitectuur waarvan minstens drie jaar ervaring in een leidinggevende rol binnen IT.

Je beschikt over een brede technische kennis van netwerken, servers, operating systems (Linux en Windows), virtualisatie, storage, back-up, security, firewalling en monitoring.

Kennis van de Atlassian-stack, met name Jira en Confluence, vormt een troef. Ook ervaring met infrastructuurarchitectuur of solution design is een pluspunt.

Je bent hands-on, oplossingsgericht en neemt verantwoordelijkheid binnen jouw domein. Sterke analytische vaardigheden en interesse in strategische IT-initiatieven zijn daarbij essentieel.

Je bent een motiverende peoplemanager die helder kan communiceren met zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders. Je werkt graag samen in teamverband en je hebt een positieve, klantgerichte ingesteldheid.

Een goede kennis van het Frans is een meerwaarde.

Tot slot vormt kennis van overheidsopdrachten, zoals raamcontracten en aankoopcentrales, evenals ervaring met het e-Procurementplatform, een bijkomend pluspunt.

title: M365 & AI Specialist
description:
Hybrid working - our approach is to be in the office a minimum of 2 days per week.

We are looking for a Microsoft 365 & AI Specialist to help our people work more effectively using Microsoft 365, Copilot, agents and emerging AI technologies.

Working within the internal IT department, you'll independently engage stakeholders, understand business problems and turn ideas into practical solutions. You'll build confidence in AI-enabled working and support adoption and continuous improvement across Microsoft 365 services.

The role is suited to someone with growing subject matter expertise in Microsoft 365 and AI who is curious, delivery-focused and comfortable working across users, technical teams, service owners and stakeholders.

Dimensions of Role

You'll work across the business as a practical enabler, helping teams identify opportunities, define needs and deliver usable, supportable solutions across Copilot, SharePoint, Teams, Power Platform, agent-building tools and related Microsoft technologies. The role combines hands-on delivery with consultation, adoption and service improvement, bridging the gap between business users, technical teams and service owners.

Activities may include shaping an agent or workflow, facilitating an AI workshop, supporting a pilot, resolving an issue, creating guidance, evaluating a new capability or coordinating technical and business stakeholders. You'll follow opportunities from initial idea through design, testing, adoption and transition into support, ensuring that lessons learned inform future services and ways of working.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage stakeholders to understand business problems, identify opportunities and recommend practical Microsoft 365, Copilot and AI-enabled solutions

  • Run structured discovery activities to clarify requirements, desired outcomes, constraints, risks and measures of success

  • Build or support agents, workflows, automations and low-code solutions, working with service owners and technical specialists where needed

  • Translate requirements into clear designs, user stories, prototypes, guidance or implementation plans appropriate to the scale of the opportunity

  • Drive adoption through demonstrations, workshops, training, communications and clear user guidance tailored to different audiences to support the adoption and effective use of Microsoft 365 Copilot and other AI capabilities across the organisation

  • Support pilots and proofs of concept, including requirements, testing, feedback, success measures and follow-up actions

  • Apply responsible AI, governance, security, licensing, lifecycle and supportability considerations to new solutions

  • Evaluate new Microsoft capabilities and use adoption, usage, feedback and support data to recommend improvements and prioritise next steps

  • Contribute to reusable patterns, standards and communities of practice so that successful approaches can be shared and scaled

  • Plan and organise work, manage risks and issues, communicate progress and share learning across Microsoft 365 and AI services.

Essential Experience / Personal Qualities

  • Growing subject matter expertise in Microsoft 365, Copilot, AI-enabled working or related digital workplace technologies

  • Ability to work independently, organise complex tasks and deliver to agreed standards and deadlines

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to engage stakeholders, facilitate discussions, adapt to different audiences and explain technical concepts simply

  • Practical problem-solving skills and the ability to turn ambiguous needs into usable solutions, guidance or next steps

  • Experience contributing to pilots, change initiatives or service improvements and working through feedback to reach a practical outcome

  • Awareness of information protection, security, governance and support considerations in a managed technology environment

  • Curiosity about AI and emerging technology, with sound judgement about responsible and ethical use

  • A collaborative, evidence-led approach to continuous improvement, relationship building and sharing knowledge

  • Enthusiastic about helping people use technology confidently and effectively

  • Proactive in building relationships, seeking feedback and following work through to a clear outcome.

Desirable Experience / Personal Qualities

  • Hands-on experience with Teams, SharePoint, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, SharePoint agents, Agent Builder or similar Microsoft 365 tools

  • Experience building simple agents, automations, workflows or low-code solutions

  • Experience delivering demonstrations, training or adoption activities and creating supporting materials

  • Relevant Microsoft certifications or equivalent practical experience.
