title: Program Coordinator
description:
About UHP

UHP — Unlock Human Potential is building a new category of education centered around whole-human experiential vocational training, leadership development, and purpose-driven transformation. UHP serves veterans, transitioning service members, and purpose-driven individuals through immersive programs that integrate human performance, leadership, wellness, vocational skills, and personal growth.

Our environment is fast-moving, mission-driven, and deeply experiential. We are not a traditional university, gym, military program, or trade school — we are building a scalable human development institution designed for the future workforce.

The Opportunity

UHP is seeking a Program Coordinator to run the day-to-day operations behind our trade programs at Ignite America Trade Schools. You will own scheduling, purchasing, and inventory across every trade program, including new programs as they launch, along with cohort events and student records, so instructors and veterans never lose time to a missing tool, room, or supply. This role executes and documents. Policy, curriculum, and budget stay with school leadership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain the integrated cohort schedule and calendar for all trades; publish controlled versions and keep a change log

  • Run purchasing for all trades: intake requests, quotes, purchase orders or card buys, order tracking, and monthly reconciliation with Finance

  • Build cohort purchase lists ahead of time for tooling, consumables, PPE, student gear, and uniforms

  • Receive deliveries, keep the inventory and asset register current, set reorder points, and run counts at cohort launch and closeout

  • Run the cohort readiness tracker so every cohort launches with nothing missing

  • Coordinate arrivals, graduations, employer visits, and events, including run-of-show, travel, housing, and guest logistics

  • Keep student rosters, records, and the issue log current; support Student Outcomes with employer handoffs and 30/60/90-day follow-up

  • Coordinate onboarding logistics for instructors, graduate assistants, and staff

  • Track action items, maintain SOPs and templates, and keep a weekly exception dashboard for school leadership

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • 3+ years coordinating operations, programs, or logistics in a school, training center, construction, manufacturing, or similar setting

  • Hands-on purchasing, receiving, and inventory control experience, including purchase orders, card reconciliation, and asset tracking

  • Experience building and maintaining complex schedules across people, rooms, and sites

  • Strong skills in Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, especially spreadsheets and shared calendars

  • Clear written communication and sound judgment on what to handle and what to escalate

  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel between Gentry, Bentonville, and Maysville

  • Ability to lift and move supplies and equipment up to 50 pounds

Preferred

  • Associate's or bachelor's degree in business, operations, supply chain, or education administration

  • Familiarity with trade tools, consumables, and PPE used in skilled trades programs

  • Experience with NCCER programs, VA-approved training, or other career and technical education

  • Event planning experience, including travel and housing logistics

  • Military service or experience working with veterans

Schedule & Work Environment

Schedule: Typically Monday through Friday. Flexibility is required based on program delivery and campus operational needs, including varying start and end times, occasional evenings and weekends, and support of immersive student experiences.

Work Environment: Fully onsite at 25200 Ranch Road, Gentry, Arkansas 72734. This role operates in a dynamic and immersive environment supporting classroom instruction, hands-on trades training labs, shop environments, student engagement, employer activities, and broader campus operations.

Candidates must currently live within a reasonable commuting distance of Gentry or be willing to relocate to Northwest Arkansas.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Pay range: $55,000 - $65,000 depending on experience

  • 401(k)

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Professional development support

  • Access to UHP performance and recovery facilities

Veterans, transitioning service members, and military spouses are strongly encouraged to apply.

Why UHP

At UHP, you are joining more than a company — you are helping build something designed to create lasting impact.

You will have the opportunity to:

  • Contribute to a mission larger than yourself

  • Help shape and build new systems and programs

  • Work alongside passionate and purpose-driven people

  • Directly impact the lives of veterans and future generations

  • Be part of building the future workforce

title: Assistant Project Manager
description:
Assistant Project Manager

Jumpstart Your Career: Seize the Opportunity to Excel!

About Vertical Mechanical Group

Vertical Mechanical Group (VMG) is a full-service commercial HVAC and Plumbing contractor serving customers throughout the region. Formed by bringing together Anderson Mechanical Services, Inc. and Inspiration Plumbing Company, VMG delivers award-winning expertise in HVAC and plumbing for new construction, renovations, tenant improvements, upfits, design-build projects, and commercial installations.

VMG performs complex mechanical construction across commercial office, multifamily, government, healthcare, higher education, hospitality, and mission-critical environments.

As a family-owned and operated business, VMG takes pride in offering a personalized, hands-on approach to every project-combining attentive service with the strength, scale, and capabilities of a large specialty contractor.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to take the next step in your career in mechanical construction?

Join our team as an Assistant Project Manager and play a pivotal role in delivering high-quality mechanical projects. This is an opportunity to work alongside experienced Project Managers, Superintendents, and field teams while gaining hands-on experience and continuing to develop your project management skills.

The Assistant Project Manager will support projects from preconstruction through completion, helping ensure work is completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and according to project requirements.

What You'll Do

  • Assist Project Managers with the day-to-day management of commercial mechanical construction projects.

  • Support project planning, scheduling, documentation, and coordination.

  • Assist with tracking project budgets, costs, schedules, and deadlines.

  • Review project drawings, specifications, and other construction documents.

  • Assist with RFIs, submittals, change orders, purchase orders, and project documentation.

  • Coordinate with Project Managers, Superintendents, subcontractors, vendors, and field teams.

  • Help ensure materials, equipment, and project information are available when needed.

  • Maintain organized and accurate project records.

  • Assist with identifying and resolving project-related issues.

  • Participate in project meetings and communicate updates as needed.

  • Support project closeout activities and documentation.

  • Help ensure projects are completed in accordance with VMG quality and safety standards.

What We're Looking For

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Project Coordinator or in a construction administrative role.

  • Familiarity with methods, equipment, and tools used in the HVAC service and installation trade.

  • High school diploma or G.E.D. required.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including tact, diplomacy, and influence.

  • Excellent communication and relationship management skills.

  • Familiarity with mechanical drawings and commercial construction projects.

  • Basic proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel.

  • Experience with industry software such as Procore, Bluebeam Revu, Revit, and AutoCAD is a plus.

  • Ability to understand, prioritize, and manage project deadlines.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced construction environment and manage multiple priorities.

Location & Travel

This position is based at our HQ in Sterling, VA. The role also requires travel to project sites throughout the DMV area, which may account for approximately 30–40% of the position.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits.

  • 401(k) retirement plan.

  • Paid time off (PTO) and holidays.

  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.

  • Hands-on experience working on complex commercial mechanical construction projects.

  • Supportive, team-oriented work environment where your contributions are valued.

Join Our Team

At VMG, we believe our people are the foundation of our success. We are committed to developing our employees and providing opportunities to learn, grow, and build long-term careers in the mechanical construction industry.

If you are motivated, organized, eager to learn, and ready to grow your career in commercial mechanical construction, we encourage you to apply and become part of the VMG team.

Vertical Mechanical Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

No sponsorship is available for this position.

title: HR Intern (Philippines)
description:
Location: Cabangan,Central Luzon,Philippines

title: Area Director (Kordofan and White Nile)
description:
SCOPE OF ROLE:

  • Reports to: Deputy Country Director of Program Operations
  • Staff directly reporting to this post: This position will line manage HPIs, Area/Field Managers, Area Programme, Finance manager and area supply chain coordinators.
  • Budget Responsibilities: as per in-country the SOD
  • Role Dimensions: To lead, coordinate and drive all Save the Children operations in the Kordofan region and White Nile, ensuring humanitarian and development programmes are delivered effectively, safely, accountably and aligned with country strategy. The Area Director is responsible for oversight of programme quality, risk management, staff leadership, external representation, and ensuring that children in Kordofan and White Nile – especially those in displacement, conflict-affected, and underserved areas — are reached with timely, high-quality interventions.

KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY:

1. Strategy, Planning & Programme Leadership

  • Lead development of the Kordofan and White Nile area strategy and annual operational plans, including multi-year planning, in alignment with overall country strategic plan, humanitarian response plan (HRP), donor priorities, and nexus (humanitarian-development) approaches.
  • Conduct and maintain a robust contextual analysis (political, security, conflict dynamics, humanitarian access, macroeconomic, climate) for Kordofan and White Nile, ensuring periodic updates and scenario planning.
  • Ensure programmes are conflict-sensitive, do-no-harm, protection-centred, inclusive (gender, disability, marginalized groups), and sensitive to local dynamics and community feedback.
  • Oversee programme design and quality assurance for all sectors in Kordofan and White Nile (e.g. education in emergencies, child protection, nutrition, health, WASH, livelihoods, cash and voucher assistance, shelter) and ensure integrated programming where feasible.
  • Provide technical review and oversight for proposals, concept notes, donor submissions, sub-grants, and new funding streams (e.g. pooled funds, crisis modifiers, humanitarian bridging funds).
  • Identify funding opportunities specific to Kordofan and White Nile (e.g. regional donors, crisis funds, thematic windows) and lead efforts to expand the programme footprint or scale-up interventions in under-served areas.
  • Ensure adaptive management: use monitoring, evidence, lessons learned, and rapid assessments to adjust implementation in response to changing circumstances (e.g. displacement, conflict flare-ups, seasonal variations

2. Programme Implementation, Monitoring & Accountability

  • Establish and supervise implementation of detailed workplans, outputs, indicators, milestones, and budgets for Kordofan and White Nile programmes.
  • Monitor progress, review performance regularly (e.g. monthly, quarterly), detect bottlenecks, and lead corrective action and contingency planning.
  • Ensure robust MEAL (Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, Learning) systems are in place (e.g. community feedback mechanisms, complaints and response systems, real-time monitoring, post-distribution monitoring).
  • Oversee baseline, midline, and endline evaluations for major interventions, and ensure documentation of best practices, case studies, lessons learned, and knowledge products.
  • Ensure accountability to affected populations, including child- and gender-sensitive participation and feedback, and ensure safeguarding, protection, and reporting mechanisms are functioning.
  • Promote cross-learning among area offices and support internal learning initiatives across Kordofan and White Nile and country.

3. Financial, Administrative & Asset Oversight

  • Hold financial responsibility for the Kordofan and White Nile portfolio: approve expenditures, monitor budget vs actual, ensure budget controls, compliance with donor rules and internal policies.
  • Ensure timely, accurate and compliant financial reporting to HQ, donors, and country office.
  • Oversee Kordofan and White Nile-level logistics, procurement, fleet, asset management, infrastructure (field offices, guest houses, storage), and inventory control, ensuring that systems are secure and efficient even under access constraints.
  • Ensure contingency and emergency stockpiles are maintained (prepositioning of supplies, buffer stocks) given risk of supply chain disruption.
  • Liaise with country office support functions (HR, procurement, admin, IT) to ensure Kordofan and White Nile operations receive necessary support and compliance.
  • Manage authorization levels, ensure segregation of duties, and enforce internal control, audit compliance, donor audit preparedness, and risk mitigation.

4. People Leadership & Capacity Building

  • Directly manage a senior Kordofan and White Nile management team (e.g. Field Coordinators, Programme Managers, MEAL, Logistics leads) and oversee larger indirect reports across field offices.
  • Set clear performance objectives and KPIs for direct and indirect reports; conduct regular performance reviews, coaching, mentoring, and development discussions.
  • Identify capacity gaps and training needs among staff, and facilitate capacity-building (technical, project management, security, leadership).
  • Promote staff well-being, psychological support, staff rotation, safety culture, retention, and duty of care especially in challenging field conditions.
  • Develop succession plans and cultivate strong national staff leadership potential to strengthen localization.
  • Lead regular coordination meetings, promote teamwork, and ensure effective communication across field offices and with the country office.

5. Risk Management, Security & Compliance

  • Maintain continuous security and risk assessment for the Kordofan and White Nile area: monitor conflict trends, internal threats, external threats, and travel security.
  • Lead or oversee development and updating of Kordofan and White Nile-specific security SOPs, Standard Operating Procedures, evacuation plans, movement protocols, ICT security, and crisis response plans.
  • Ensure all staff adhere to rules and policies on security, child safeguarding, code of conduct, anti-fraud/anti-corruption, and incident reporting procedures.
  • Escalate significant security, compliance, safeguarding or reputational risks immediately to country leadership, and lead incident management response.
  • Ensure that programmes and operations are informed by risk analyses and mitigate negative consequences (e.g. inadvertent exposure, beneficiary security).
  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, permits, access approvals, and coordination with authorities, including in hard-to-reach areas.

6. External Representation & Partnerships

  • Represent Save the Children across Kordofan and White Nile with local authorities (state and federal), non-state actors, security actors, UN agencies, NGOs, clusters, community leaders, customary authorities, and donors.
  • Engage actively in Kordofan and White Nile-level humanitarian coordination forums, cluster meetings, inter-agency task forces, sector coordination, and advocacy platforms.
  • Build and maintain strategic partnerships with local civil society, community-based organizations, credible local NGOs, traditional leadership, and CBOs.
  • Lead stakeholder mapping and manage relationships to secure access, negotiate safe passage, advocate for humanitarian space, and influence local policies and priorities.
  • Advocate for children’s rights and protection, using evidence, impact data, and field stories to influence government and donors at Kordofan and White Nile level.
  • Promote Save the Children’s visibility, transparency, and credibility in Kordofan and White Nile, ensuring accountability to communities and stakeholders.

7. Learning, Innovation & Reporting

  • Foster a culture of innovation, adaptive programming, and continuous learning in Kordofan and White Nile operations, encouraging pilot approaches, new modalities (e.g. cash, digital, remote management) where feasible.
  • Ensure documentation and dissemination of success stories, lessons learned, operational learning briefs, and communications products to country, HQ, donors, and external audiences.
  • Participate actively in internal coordination with country office functions (Programs, MEAL, Security, Advocacy, Finance) and promote integration of learning from Kordofan and White Nile into country strategy.
  • Oversee preparation and submission of regular Kordofan and White Nile -level reports (narrative, technical, financial) to the country office, donors, HQ, and key stakeholders.
  • Support donor visits, field missions, and learning exchanges, ensuring that findings and feedback are documented and acted upon.

8. Other

- Tasks as assigned by line manager.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Advanced university degree (master’s preferred) in International Development, Humanitarian Studies, Social Sciences, Management, or related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in humanitarian and/or development programming, with at least 5 years in senior leadership or field management roles in complex, insecure, or conflict-affected environments.
  • Proven track record of managing large-scale, multi-sector portfolios (e.g. Education, Child Protection, Health, Nutrition, WASH, Livelihoods, and Cash & Voucher Assistance).
  • Strong financial and operational management skills, including experience with budget oversight, donor compliance, audits, and risk management.
  • Demonstrated leadership of large, multi-disciplinary teams across multiple field offices, with the ability to inspire, mentor, and build capacity.
  • Deep understanding of the humanitarian principles, cluster system, and access negotiation in complex emergencies, particularly in Sudan or similar contexts.
  • Strong experience in security management and risk mitigation in volatile operational settings.
  • Excellent representational, coordination, and diplomatic skills, with experience engaging government authorities, UN agencies, donors, and local partners.
  • Strong analytical, planning, and problem-solving abilities; able to make effective decisions under pressure.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; working proficiency in Arabic is a strong advantage.
  • High commitment to child rights, gender equality, diversity, and inclusion, and alignment with Save the Children’s mission and values.

SKILLS AND BEHAVIOURS (our Values in Practice)

Accountability:

  • Holds self and team accountable for achieving ambitious goals and high performance, in line with Save the Children’s values.
  • Demonstrates responsibility and ownership of decisions, resources, and outcomes.
  • Ensures transparency and compliance across financial, operational, and programmatic activities.
  • Empowers teams by delegating responsibility, providing coaching and clear expectations, and applying consequences when results are not achieved.
  • Promotes an organizational culture of integrity, accountability, and ethical conduct, especially in complex and high-risk environments.

Ambition:

  • Sets bold and achievable goals for the Kordofan and White Nile programme portfolio, inspiring staff and partners to achieve measurable impact for children.
  • Leads strategic planning and anticipates future challenges and opportunities in the Kordofan and White Nile context.
  • Drives innovation and resilience in programming and operations amid adversity, conflict, and resource constraints.
  • Champions localization, national staff leadership, and sustainable long-term impact.

Collaboration

  • Builds and maintains strong, trust-based relationships with team members, other departments, partners, authorities, and communities.
  • Promotes teamwork, inclusion, and a positive working culture across dispersed and remote locations.
  • Values diversity as a source of strength; ensures respect for all staff, partners, and beneficiaries regardless of background, gender, or identity.
  • Encourages open communication, constructive feedback, and cross-functional coordination.

Creativity

  • Identifies and promotes innovative solutions to operational and programmatic challenges, including alternative delivery models and remote management approaches.
  • Encourages teams to pilot new ideas, document learning, and adapt quickly to contextual changes.
  • Fosters a culture of continuous improvement, learning, and problem-solving.
  • Advocates for flexible, adaptive programming and innovative partnership modalities suitable for Kordofan and White Nile’s access and security constraints.

Integrity

  • Demonstrates honesty, fairness, and consistency in all actions and decisions.
  • Upholds Save the Children’s Code of Conduct, Child Safeguarding, Anti-Fraud, and Anti-Bribery policies.
  • Acts as a role model for ethical leadership, ensuring compliance and reinforcing organizational values at all times.
  • Promotes a zero-tolerance culture towards misconduct, safeguarding breaches, and corruption.

title: GM - Government, JV and External Relations.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Search & Index
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

The Search & Indexing team, part of Compute and Data Platform (AI Platform), makes Wayve's multimodal driving data discoverable. We build the indexing infrastructure behind vector and metadata-based retrieval, powering data curation, training set construction and ML research. You'd be the first hire in the team, in our Sunnyvale office.


🧠 Your day-to-day

You'll design, build and operate the search and indexing platform for hundreds of thousands of hours of video and sensor data, with the system scaling beyond 10B vectors. You'll work with the Technical Lead on architecture, own complex components from design through production, and help decide what to build versus buy. Expect to move fast: use off-the-shelf tools and ship an MVP in months, not quarters. You'll work with ML, Data, Evaluation and Platform teams, and support other engineers through code reviews and mentoring.


🧩 What you'll be working on:

  • Production search and indexing systems at billion-vector scale

  • Ingestion and indexing pipelines across video, sensor data, embeddings and metadata

  • Backend services and APIs for vector similarity, semantic retrieval and metadata-filtered search

  • Evaluating and integrating embedding models, vector databases, ANN libraries and external vendors

  • Evaluation frameworks measuring retrieval quality, recall, relevance, filtering accuracy, latency, freshness, scalability and cost

  • Integrating search into training-set construction, data curation and research workflows


👋 You should apply if:

  • You have 7+ years in backend, infrastructure or ML systems, building production systems

  • You have hands-on experience with vector databases or ANN technologies such as FAISS, LanceDB or similar

  • You understand multimodal embeddings and have evaluated search quality across relevance, recall, filtering accuracy and performance

  • You code strongly in Python or another systems language

  • You have built search services, APIs, and large-scale ingestion and indexing pipelines

  • You have delivered 0→1 systems in ambiguous problem spaces

  • You are comfortable working across infra, ML and data curation

Nice to have:

  • Large-scale ML pipelines or distributed data infrastructure

  • Multimodal data, including video, images, sensor data and metadata

  • Active learning, semantic retrieval or training-data selection workflows

  • Autonomy, robotics or large-scale data infrastructure

  • Evaluating technical vendors and working with external providers

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews [programming, system design & domain-specific interviews; 3 hours total]

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment [45 mins].

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

title: HR – en salarismedewerker
description:
Ben jij nauwkeurig, servicegericht en goed met cijfers? Vind je het leuk om collega’s te ondersteunen en ervoor te zorgen dat zowel de HR- als salarisadministratie soepel verloopt? Dan hebben wij een mooie uitdaging voor je!

Van arbeidsovereenkomsten en personeelsdossiers tot personeels- en salarismutaties: jij zorgt ervoor dat alles juist, volledig en op tijd wordt verwerkt. Je ondersteunt bij de in-, door- en uitstroom van medewerkers, draagt bij aan de salarisadministratie en denkt mee over het verbeteren van HR-processen. Dankzij jouw nauwkeurige en gestructureerde manier van werken kunnen collega's en leidinggevenden rekenen op een professionele en betrouwbare ondersteuning.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Verwerken van personeelsmutaties, zoals wijzigingen in uren, contracten en persoonsgegevens, in onze HR-systemen;

  • Opstellen van arbeidsovereenkomsten, verlengingen, addenda en andere HR-documenten;

  • Beheren, controleren en actualiseren van personeelsdossiers;

  • Ondersteunen bij de salarisadministratie door salarismutaties te verzamelen, verwerken en controleren;

  • Signaleren en controleren van afwijkingen in personeels- en salarisgegevens;

  • Administratief verwerken van in- en uitdiensttredingen;

  • Beantwoorden van vragen van medewerkers en leidinggevenden over HR-processen;

  • Ondersteunen van HR-adviseurs bij administratieve werkzaamheden;

  • Meedenken over het verbeteren en digitaliseren van HR-processen.

Wat jij als HR- en salarismedewerker meeneemt

Jij houdt van structuur, werkt nauwkeurig en hebt oog voor detail. Je voelt je prettig bij cijfers en controles en ziet afwijkingen snel. Je begrijpt hoe belangrijk het is dat personeels- en salarisgegevens correct en op tijd worden verwerkt.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Mbo+ werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting HRM;

  • Ervaring met administratieve werkzaamheden;

  • Ervaring met of aantoonbare interesse in salarisadministratie;

  • Ervaring met HR-systemen, bij voorkeur Nmbrs;

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal;

  • Een nauwkeurige, gestructureerde en integere werkwijze;

  • Een proactieve houding en het vermogen om zelfstandig te werken.

Het team

Je komt terecht in een gezellig en gedreven HR-team. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat medewerkers en leidinggevenden kunnen rekenen op een goede en betrouwbare HR-ondersteuning. Je werkt nauw samen met de HR-adviseurs en je collega’s binnen de administratie. Iedereen heeft zijn eigen verantwoordelijkheden, maar jullie helpen elkaar waar nodig en kunnen altijd bij elkaar terecht met vragen.

Wat jij als HR- en salarismedewerker krijgt

  • Een contract voor 24 tot 32 uur per week;

  • Een salaris van maximaal € 3.500 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring;

  • en goede pensioenregeling, waarbij wij als werkgever 50% van de premie betalen;

  • 24 vakantiedagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,23 per kilometer, met een maximum van € 250 netto per maand.

Over ons

Stepp Footcare is het medisch kenniscentrum op het gebied van voetzorg. Binnen Stepp werken alle disciplines aan één missie: samen voor totale voetzorg. Van podotherapie en orthopedische schoentechniek tot pedicure, stores en manufacturing: Stepp biedt een integrale aanpak, gericht op preventie en herstel.

Met een multidisciplinair team van meer dan 700 professionals, waaronder behandelaars in de eerste- en tweedelijnszorg, technici, ondersteunende afdelingen en innovatie-experts, behandelt Stepp dagelijks ruim 1.000 cliënten met voetproblemen. De zorg wordt geleverd op meer dan 600 locaties, ondersteund door meerdere productiecentra voor orthopedische hulpmiddelen. Samen stellen we mensen in staat om vol vertrouwen te lopen.

Nieuwsgierig geworden?

We zien jouw sollicitatie graag tegemoet! Heb je vragen? Bel of app gerust naar Harmke Dirkse via 06 – 41 24 05 97.

title: Systemförvaltare/tekniker
description:
Är du en serviceinriktad systemförvaltare/tekniker som är redo att anta nya utmaningar? Vill du dessutom arbeta på ett branschledande företag med stora utvecklingsmöjligheter? Nu söker vi på Bravida Linköping systemförvaltare/tekniker till vårt team! Välkommen med din ansökan!

Ditt nya jobb

Som systemförvaltare/tekniker på Bravida arbetar du självständigt i många olika typer av projekt, avtal och serviceuppdrag. Ingen dag är den andra lik, beroende av din kompetensprofil kommer dina arbetsuppgifter kunna bestå av exempelvis.

Du kommer att vara ansvarig för att utföra varje uppdrag enligt våra höga krav på kvalitet och säkerhet. Arbetet innebär både teknisk problemlösning och mycket kontakt med kunder.

Ditt nya team

Vi har bred kundkrets och har behov av förstärkningar inom flera områden.

Vi söker dig som har

Har erfarenhet av systemförvaltning/it.
God förståelse för IT-infrastruktur och tekniska lösningar, erfarenhet av AI och Microsoft 365-plattformen
Innehar B-körkort

Det är viktigt för oss att du är resultatorienterad och brinner för uppgiften att genomföra uppdragen av högsta kvalitet. En person med öppet sinne, bra driv, lösnings orienterad med god samarbetsförmåga.



Tjänsten förutsätter att du godkänns vid en kontroll hos Polismyndigheten innan anställning kan erbjudas.

På Bravida ser vi till att det som måste fungera, fungerar. Våra medarbetare har byggt förtroende hos våra kunder sedan 1922 och är hjärtat i vår organisation. Tillsammans levererar vi de mest energieffektiva tekniska lösningarna. Hos oss har du möjlighet att göra skillnad för en mer hållbar framtid. Vi värdesätter mångfald och strävar efter att skapa en säker och inkluderande arbetsplats där alla känner sig välkomna och uppskattade. Din säkerhet kommer först, alltid. Genom våra interna utbildningar erbjuder vi utvecklingsmöjligheter, och i vår starka gemenskap hjälper vi varandra att lyckas. Som en del av vårt team får du chansen att utvecklas både personligt och professionellt. Vi är stolta över att vara ett av Nordens ledande företag inom vår bransch, vilket ger oss möjlighet att erbjuda förmåner som exempelvis förmånliga pensionsavtal, friskvårdsbidrag och vidareutbildning. title: Retail Loss Prevention Detective  - FT
description:
Retail Loss Prevention Detective
Use your experience in retail loss prevention to launch an exciting career as a Loss Prevention Detective with one of the nation’s leading retailers! Boscov's is a chain of full service department stores serving the total family needs of our customers. For nearly 100 years, Boscov's has been known for its great values and famous brands, and for offering a broad selection of quality merchandise in its stores and online. We are looking for retail LP Detectives to join our growing Loss Prevention team.

As a Loss Prevention Detective, you will use your experience in loss prevention to reduce profitability losses due to theft or incorrect business procedures in a dynamic retail environment. If you are looking for an opportunity to grow your career in security and retail operations asset management with a company known for quality and big savings, apply today!

Job Responsibilities
As a Loss Prevention Detective, you will perform loss prevention as part of the retail operations team. You will be responsible for guarding, patrolling, and monitoring premises to prevent theft, violence, or infractions of rules.

Additional responsibilities of the Detective include:

  • Providing loss prevention support and awareness through policies, procedures, and personal involvement
  • Providing surveillance and assisting police with apprehensions of shoplifters
  • Conducting store opening and closing procedures
  • Performing safety audits, safety, and fire prevention and inspections
  • Answering alarm responses
  • Performing insurance inspections and investigations

Job Requirements
Successful candidates for the Detective role should have effective communication skills and the interpersonal skills required to work with customers, management, and coworkers. Someone who has strong analytical and problem solving skills and is looking for a challenging opportunity working in a dynamic retail environment would be a good fit for this retail operations role.

Additional requirements of the Detective include:

  • Prior experience in retail loss prevention, preferred

Benefits
At Boscov’s, we value our employees, and that’s why we provide a competitive compensation and benefits package. As a Full-Time member of our retail operations team, you will be eligible to receive:

title: Juridisch administratief medewerker Vastgoed
description:
Word onze nieuwe collega!

De vastgoedmarkt is vaak in het nieuws. Prijsschommelingen, de struggles voor starters op de woningmarkt, CO2-neutraal bouwen; het houdt de gemoederen flink bezig. Als je op onze afdeling Vastgoed werkt, is geen dag hetzelfde.

Wij zoeken dan ook een juridisch administratief medewerker vastgoed die ons team in Rijssen komt versterken.

Jouw rol

Als juridisch administratief medewerker vastgoed weet jij als geen ander wat ontzorgen is. Je doet namelijk al het voorbereidende werk met betrekking tot de dossiers van onze cliënten. Je maakt dossiers aan, verzamelt alle benodigde (cliënt)informatie, plant afspraken in en zorgt dat alles klaarligt voor de behandelaar. Wij ondersteunen dit met mooie digitale oplossingen. Zoals een besloten online omgeving, waarin jij en je collega’s de laatste stand van zaken bijhouden. Helder en transparant; daar houden wij van. Zo ben jij als juridisch administratief medewerker vastgoed van begin tot eind nauw betrokken bij de klantreis, in een afwisselende functie.

Daarnaast ben jij verantwoordelijke voor de binnenkomende telefoon. Jij weet (straks) als geen ander welke klantvraag naar welke collega of afdeling, doorverbonden moet worden.

Team

Je komt terecht op een ambitieus, dynamisch kantoor. Wij krijgen energie van het aanbrengen van structuur in de complexe casuïstiek waar we ons dagelijks mee bezighouden. Het team is een mooie mix van functies en er werken collega’s van verschillende leeftijden met een gevarieerd ‘trackrecord’ aan werkervaring. Hierdoor kun je veel van elkaar leren en jezelf goed ontwikkelen.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Salaris 
    Wij bieden jou een salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vrije tijd
    Je hebt 25 verlofdagen (op basis van fulltime dienstverband). Daarnaast ben je de dag na Hemelvaartsdag én Goede Vrijdag vrij op onze kosten. Als je verjaardag op een werkdag valt, dan ben je die middag vanaf 15.00 uur vrij.

  • Verlofsparen 
    Droom jij van een grote reis of een sabbatical? Of ben jij bijvoorbeeld mantelzorger? Bij ons kun je verlofuren sparen en/of bijkopen, zodat je extra tijd hebt op een moment dat jij dit wenst.

  • Pensioen 
    Wij betalen de helft van jouw maandelijkse pensioenafdracht.

  • Reiskosten 
    Kom je met de auto, fiets of lopend naar het werk? Dan zorgen wij voor een passende woon-werkvergoeding, van deur tot deur. Kom je liever met het OV? Dan zorgen wij voor een NS-businesscard.

  • Ontwikkeling 
    Wij organiseren door het hele jaar heen allerlei cursussen waar jij kosteloos aan kunt deelnemen. Er is dan ook brede expertise in het concern aanwezig die onderling volop met elkaar gedeeld wordt. Zo sta jij er nooit alleen voor. Wij investeren in onze medewerkers; bij ons is er ruimte voor ontwikkeling.

  • Cultuur 
    Bij Het Notarieel tref je een informele, open werksfeer met een hechte groep collega’s. Een gezonde werk-privébalans hoort daar wat ons betreft bij.

  • Het Notarieel Fietsplan 
    Vitaliteit vinden wij belangrijk. Daarom bieden wij jou de mogelijkheid om via ons fietsplan voordelig een gloednieuwe fiets te leasen.

Wat neem je mee?

  • Jij bent 24 uur per week beschikbaar.

  • Jij hebt bij voorkeur al ervaring binnen het juridische werkveld.

  • Je hebt een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

  • Je bent communicatief vaardig, punctueel en secuur.

  • Contact met cliënten geeft jou energie.

  • Heb je eerder gewerkt met de software van Notarisdossier? Dan worden wij extra enthousiast!

title: Lead Product Data Scientist
description:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

About the team

Zego’s Data team delivers high-impact projects across the whole business - from AI tools that let anyone query data and publish dashboards in Zego Lens, to the customer insights that shape our growth strategy.

We already have established data science teams in Pricing and Telematics. This is the first data science role in our central Data team, focused on the huge untapped potential across the rest of the business - from experimentation to churn, marketing and fraud. We’re a fast-moving disruptor in insurance, driven by great tech products and data. We adopt new technology quickly - we’re AI-first, so most of our code is now written by AI and reviewed by people.

About the role

As our first Lead Product Data Scientist, you’ll shape how Zego makes its biggest product and commercial decisions. You’ll work directly with senior leaders across Product, Growth and Operations to decide where to focus, which bets to back and how we’ll know they’ve worked.

You’ll start by building the foundations - a trusted experimentation framework and customer models that tell us who to acquire, how to engage them and where to invest. As teams learn to run routine experiments themselves, your focus will shift to guiding product investment and making sure evidence, rather than intuition, drives our roadmap.

This is a senior, hands-on role with real scope to shape a new capability - and the chance to use AI to scale data science across a growing business.

What you will be doing

  • Work with senior leaders to embed data science in strategy and decision making. Create and own a prioritised roadmap for where data science can have the biggest impact.

  • Own Zego’s experimentation framework - design standards, power, guardrail metrics and decision rules. Coach teams to run routine experiments themselves.

  • Partner with Product teams before anything is built, shaping ideas into evidence-based hypotheses and well-designed experiments. Apply causal inference where randomised tests aren’t possible.

  • Build models of customer behaviour across the lifecycle - acquisition, conversion, retention, churn and lifetime value - with teams such as Marketing and Fraud.

  • Use AI to scale data science across Zego, automating experiment analysis and readouts. Build self-serve tools that help teams sharpen their hypotheses.

  • Take the most impactful models into production with our ML Platform team.

  • Set technical direction and mentor analysts and data scientists as the capability grows.

What you’ll need

  • Significant data science experience in a product-led business, with a track record of work that changed product or commercial decisions.

  • Strong executive presence - you influence senior leaders, challenge decisions with evidence and explain results clearly to any audience.

  • Expertise in experimentation and causal inference, with many online experiments designed and analysed.

  • Experience building customer models such as churn, propensity, LTV or segmentation - and getting them used in real decisions.

  • Strong Python and SQL, with confidence working AI-first (and the judgement to spot when AI output is wrong).

  • Experience taking models into production on AWS SageMaker or a similar ML platform.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with experimentation or product analytics platforms such as Statsig or Amplitude.

  • Experience with Snowflake, dbt and Looker or a similar modern data stack.

  • Experience of marketing measurement such as media mix modelling or incrementality testing.

  • A background in insurance, fintech or another regulated or subscription business.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

Equal opportunities 🌈

We're an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

  • Validate that repositories can be consistently executed and tested

Code Modification & LLM Evaluation

  • Identify failure patterns across different programming languages and task types

  • Identify missing edge cases and weak verification mechanisms
  • Develop or refine tests where stronger validation is required
  • Ensure evaluation tasks have objective and reproducible outcomes

Research Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Identify software-engineering problems that remain challenging for LLMs

  • Support expansion across programming languages and task complexity

  • Strong expertise in at least one of Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C, C++, C#, or Ruby

title: Information Security Advisor
description:
Meer dan 2000 professionals omarmen bij Smals elke dag de toekomst door zich in te zetten voor ICT for Society. Hoogtechnologische ICT-systemen zorgen voor meer efficiëntie in de belangrijke sociale verantwoordelijkheidsdomeinen van onze klanten zoals werk, gezin en gezondheid. Het eHealthplatform, een beveiligd uitwisselingsplatform voor medische informatie, zal papieren doktersbriefjes en doktersvoorschriften op termijn overbodig maken. Jazeker, en uitdagend ook.


Jobomschrijving

Als Information Security Advisor draag je bij aan de ontwikkeling en implementatie van de visie, het beleid en de richtlijnen rond informatieveiligheid. Je versterkt de cyberweerbaarheid van organisaties door risico's te analyseren, beveiligingsmaatregelen uit te werken en projecten rond informatieveiligheid te realiseren.

Je neemt een leidende rol op binnen de cybersecuritygovernance van de organisatie en adviseert management en stakeholders over cyberrisico's, compliancevereisten en strategische beveiligingskeuzes. Daarbij draag je bij aan de ontwikkeling van de cybersecuritystrategie en ondersteun je de besluitvorming op management- en directieniveau. Je coördineert risicoanalyses, audits en verbetertrajecten en ondersteunt de organisatie bij cyberincidenten en crisissituaties.

Je vertaalt behoeften en risico's naar concrete technische, organisatorische en procedurele maatregelen. Daarbij werk je beleidslijnen, procedures en preventieve maatregelen uit, begeleid je de implementatie ervan en help je informatieveiligheid te verankeren in de dagelijkse werking van de organisatie.

Tot slot volg je evoluties inzake regelgeving, normen en best practices op de voet, draag je bij aan initiatieven rond risicobeheer, business continuity en security awareness, en waak je over de naleving van de veiligheidsrichtlijnen binnen de organisatie.

Je beschikt over een bachelor- of masterdiploma, bij voorkeur in Informatica, Cybersecurity of een verwante richting, en hebt meerdere jaren relevante ervaring binnen informatieveiligheid, cybersecurity, risk management of compliance.

Je hebt een grondige kennis van informatiebeveiligingsstandaarden en relevante wet- en regelgeving, en ervaring met domeinen zoals ISO 27001, GDPR, NIS2, risicoanalyse, audit, security governance, incidentbeheer of business continuity.

Je hebt ervaring met cybersecuritygovernance, compliance en het adviseren van management- en directieniveau. Ervaring als CISO (Chief Information Security Officer) of in een vergelijkbare strategische securityfunctie is een belangrijke meerwaarde.

Je bent een sterke gesprekspartner die complexe veiligheidsvraagstukken vertaalt naar heldere adviezen en aanbevelingen voor uiteenlopende stakeholders.

Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en communiceert vlot en overtuigend.

Je spreekt en schrijft vlot Nederlands en beschikt over een goede mondelinge kennis van het Frans.

We are seeking a highly motivated Methods & Tools Software Developer engineer to join the Data Processing and Analysis Development group within Ground Station Team as part of the Flight and Integration Test Centre. You will be responsible for developing, optimizing, and maintaining the software ecosystem used by the Test/System Specialists to perform their analysis of Rig/Benches/Ground/Flight tests data. Additionally, you will act as a bridge between the Analysis Community in the Spanish perimeter and Ground Station in terms of tools and infrastructure, ensuring direct communication and providing technical support. In this role, you will contribute to all current Airbus Defence & Space programs—including A330 MRTT, A400M, C295, Eurofighter, SIRTAP, Eurodrone—while developing analysis tools and providing technical support to multiple areas – ranging from Avionics and Mission, Performance, Handling Qualities, Powerplant, General systems, Aerial Delivery, Datalinks…

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Tool Development & Maintenance: Design, implement, and maintain software tools to be used by the Test Centre Analysis Teams.
  • Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Work closely with specialized Test Analysis groups (Performance, Handling Qualities, Avionics and Mission, Aerial Delivery, etc), to translate and integrate their mathematical models into functional software tools.
  • Shape the Future: Play a key role in the definition of the future technology stack for Analysis Tools, ensuring the migration and integration of our current toolset into the new Time Series Analysis Tool Platform for Military (TSASM).
  • Cross-Functional Liaison: Act as a technical point of contact between the Ground Station Team and the Analysis Community in Spain, ensuring a constant communication and providing support related to Analysis Tools when needed.

SKILLS

  • Educational background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aeronautical Engineering or Aerospace Engineering with a focus on scientific computing.
  • Programming Expertise: Strong knowledge of MATLAB for scientific applications.
  • Proficiency in Python, with deep experience in core data analysis libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Matplotlib, and the Jupyter ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with other Python libraries like SimPy and Numba is highly desirable.
  • Experience compiled languages, Fortran 77/90 and C++, or a strong willingness to learn them.
  • CI/CD: Git mandatory, Jenkins and Nexus desirable.
  • Methodologies: Experience working in Agile environments using Jira and Confluence.
  • Analytical Mindset: A deep interest in scientific programming and the ability to implement mathematical equations into efficient code.
  • Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate technical software concepts to non-software engineers (and vice versa).
  • Language Skills: English advanced.

title: Virtual IOP Coordinator
description:
About Team Recovery: Team Recovery is an addiction treatment center dedicated to supporting individuals affected by substance use and mental health disorders. We offer a full continuum of care, including inpatient detox, residential treatment, outpatient services, and recovery housing, designed to meet people where they are in their recovery journey. Our team is made up of professionals, many with lived experience, who understand the challenges of addiction and the power of connection. With a mission to improve lives and a vision to redefine treatment, we're committed to creating lasting change in the communities we serve. Team Recovery is more than a treatment center. We're a new approach to an old problem.

Job Summary:

The Virtual Intensive Outpatient Program (VIOP) Therapist provides telehealth-based substance use and co-occurring mental health treatment services to adults participating in the Virtual Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP). This position is responsible for facilitating group therapy sessions, providing individual therapy, completing assessments and ASAM level-of-care determinations, coordinating treatment planning, supporting prior authorization processes, and maintaining timely clinical documentation.

The therapist supports individuals in developing recovery skills, emotional regulation, relapse prevention strategies, and healthy coping mechanisms while maintaining a safe, structured, and therapeutic virtual treatment environment. This role collaborates closely with interdisciplinary team members to ensure quality care, treatment engagement, and compliance with Medicaid, CARF, Ohio Administrative Code, and agency standards.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Diagnose substance use disorders and/or co-occurring psychiatric disorders within scope of practice.
  • Evaluate client functioning, clinical presentation, and treatment needs while participating in the development, implementation, updating, and review of individualized treatment plans based on ASAM criteria, medical necessity, and recommended level of care.
  • Complete ASAM assessments and level-of-care determinations to support admissions, prior authorization requests, continued stay reviews, discharge planning, and coordination of care with insurance providers and interdisciplinary treatment teams.
  • Facilitate individual and group treatment services utilizing evidence-based practices including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT), Motivational Interviewing (MI), psychoeducation, trauma-informed interventions, relapse prevention, emotional regulation, coping skill development, and recovery-oriented treatment approaches.
  • Create and maintain a safe, structured, and therapeutic treatment environment while maintaining appropriate group dynamics, therapeutic boundaries, emotional safety, and participation expectations within both virtual and in-person settings.
  • Monitor client participation, treatment progress, emotional regulation, relapse risk, psychiatric stability, and ongoing appropriateness for continued treatment services.
  • Assist clients in developing healthy coping skills, communication skills, relapse prevention strategies, emotional regulation techniques, recovery supports, and healthy lifestyle behaviors.
  • Complete accurate, timely, clinically appropriate, and audit-ready documentation for all services rendered, including progress notes, treatment plans, treatment plan reviews, ASAM assessments, discharge summaries, and other required clinical documentation that demonstrates medical necessity, treatment plan linkage, interventions provided, client progress, and continued need for services.
  • Verify and document telehealth appropriateness, client participation, and client location during virtual treatment services in accordance with agency policy and applicable regulations.
  • Conduct outreach and follow-up efforts related to missed appointments, disengagement, barriers to treatment participation, and identified clinical concerns.
  • Assist in de-escalating behavioral health crises and responding to emergencies while coordinating with appropriate emergency personnel and support systems when clinically indicated.
  • Collaborate with psychiatry, medical providers, case management, peer recovery support, admissions, utilization review, and leadership staff to ensure continuity and coordination of care.
  • Participate in departmental meetings, supervision, audits, trainings, quality improvement initiatives, and company meetings.
  • Stay informed regarding current evidence-based practices, treatment modalities, behavioral health trends, and regulatory standards related to substance use and co-occurring mental health treatment.
  • Assist in maintaining a safe and secure treatment environment for clients and staff.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
The New Technologies Group identifies, evaluates and develops the emerging technologies that will shape Plessey's future products. The team turns new concepts into validated technologies, supports the company's technology roadmap and makes sure new developments transfer successfully into manufacturing.

As Principal Engineer, you'll be the technical authority for VCSEL and surface-emitting laser technologies within the group. You'll track the state of the art across industry and academia, set technical direction, propose new device concepts and lead them from first principles to proof-of-concept and on towards manufacture. The role suits someone who wants to shape strategy and still stay hands-on with the technology.
  • Report to the Director of New Technologies and shape the roadmap for next-generation VCSEL and optical interconnect devices.
  • Act as the technical lead for VCSEL development, setting direction for device architecture, cavity and DBR mirror design, current and optical confinement, and array design.
  • Identify and evaluate emerging technologies in VCSELs, microLEDs and optical interconnects, including high-speed datacom, sensing and co-packaged optics applications.
  • Develop IP and drive high-quality invention generation, patent filings and strategic growth of the IP portfolio.
  • Monitor competitor and academic developments and turn emerging opportunities into protectable IP.
  • Design, model and simulate VCSEL devices, covering optical, electrical and thermal performance.
  • Develop and validate proof-of-concept devices and prototype wafers, from design through fabrication and characterisation.
  • Lead feasibility studies, device modelling and performance optimisation, including speed, efficiency, reliability and thermal behaviour.
  • Define process development requirements and drive technology transfer into manufacturing.
  • Assess manufacturability, scalability, yield and technical risk.
  • Mentor engineers and scientists and act as a technical reference across R&D, engineering and manufacturing teams.
  • Represent Plessey technically with partners, customers, suppliers and academic collaborators.
  • PhD in Physics, Materials Science, Electronic Engineering or a related discipline, or an MSc with equivalent industrial experience.
  • Significant industrial experience in III-V semiconductor R&D, with a strong focus on VCSELs or related surface-emitting lasers.
  • In-depth knowledge of VCSEL device physics and design: DBR mirrors, oxide or buried-tunnel-junction apertures, cavity design, modal control and thermal management.
  • A proven track record of high-impact innovation, including substantial IP output (patents and invention disclosures).
  • Experience taking new technologies from concept through proof-of-concept to manufacturing.
  • Hands-on experience in device characterisation (LIV, spectral, high-speed and reliability testing), modelling and performance optimisation.
  • Strong understanding of compound semiconductor fabrication processes and technology transfer.
  • Experience leading technical projects and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, including presenting to senior stakeholders.

Advantage
  • Epitaxy experience, such as MOCVD or MBE growth, epi structure design or working closely with epi suppliers.
  • Knowledge of microLEDs, optical interconnects, co-packaged optics or silicon photonics integration.
  • Experience with VCSEL simulation tools, such as optical, electrical and thermal solvers.

title: Leveranciersmanager
description:
Jouw baan

Bij CZ werken we met betekenis, daadkracht en als één team.

We nemen verantwoordelijkheid, tonen lef, blijven leren en maken impact. Samen zetten we ons elke dag in voor toegankelijke en betaalbare zorg voor iedereen.

Als Leveranciersmanager IT stuur je op resultaat binnen een leveranciersportfolio van ongeveer 125 IT-partners, goed voor een jaarlijkse spend van circa €100 miljoen. Jij zorgt ervoor dat CZ maximale waarde haalt uit strategische leveranciers, risico's beheerst en afspraken worden nagekomen. Je hebt de regie op onze belangrijkste IT-leveranciers en bent verantwoordelijk voor prestaties, contracten, governance en risicobeheersing. Je onderhandelt op senior niveau over contracten met grote impact op onze organisatie en adviseert management en directie over strategische sourcingkeuzes.

Concrete werkzaamheden:

  • Je stuurt strategische en kritieke IT-leveranciers aan op prestaties, kwaliteit en resultaat.

  • Je voert stevige onderhandelingen over contracten, kosten, continuïteit en risico's.

  • Je bewaakt KPI's, SLA's, compliance-afspraken en leveranciersrisico's.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor Third Party Risk Management en DORA-compliance binnen jouw portefeuille.

  • Je adviseert management, directie en bestuur over leveranciersprestaties, sourcing en contractuele risico's.

  • Je vertaalt ontwikkelingen zoals cloud en AI naar duidelijke afspraken met leveranciers.

  • Je leidt escalaties, audits en verbetertrajecten bij leveranciers die cruciaal zijn voor de continuïteit van CZ.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met Procurement, Security, Architectuur, Juridische Zaken en IT-management.

Jouw team

Jij bent van groot belang

Binnen je team werk je nauw samen met diverse stakeholders als Business en IT management, collega leveranciersmanagers, senior product owners, product owners, IT leads en de strategic sourcing manager.

Jouw voordelen

Dit krijg je van ons

  • Je ontvangt 8% vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,5%, zodat je naast een aantrekkelijk salaris kunt rekenen op mooie extra's gedurende het jaar.

  • Een fulltime werkweek is bij CZ 38 uur waarbij we ook flexibiliteit bieden voor passende werk-prive balans per CZ’er.

  • Je bouwt zorgeloos aan je toekomst met een sterke pensioenregeling via SBZ Pensioen, waarbij jij zelf maar 0,29% van de premie betaalt en CZ het resterende bedrag. Dit resulteert in een hogere nette tegemoetkoming.

  • Je reist op een manier die bij jou past, met een reiskostenvergoeding of een NS Business Card. Ook stimuleren we duurzaam reizen met een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling.

  • Ruimte en vrijheid om je werkzaamheden en scope in te vullen zoals jij nodig acht om de doelen te bereiken.

Jouw profiel

Dit neem je mee naar onze organisatie

  • Je hebt minimaal een aantal jaar werkervaring waarbij aantoonbare ervaring met het managen van complexe leveranciersrelaties en verder professionaliseren van leveranciersmanagement.

  • Je hebt een sterke toewijding aan je functie als leveranciersmanager. Je volgt actief de nieuwste trends, technologieën en best practices in je vakgebied. Deze kennis pas je toe om de prestaties van je leveranciers te optimaliseren en innovatieve oplossingen te implementeren.

  • Je luistert actief, begrijpt verschillende perspectieven en bouwt sterke relaties op. Je bent een goede gesprekspartner die in staat is om te overtuigen, daadkrachtig is en weet draagvlak te creëren op alle niveaus binnen en buiten de organisatie.

  • Je hebt ervaring in de financiële sector en bent bekend met toezichthouders, externe wetgeving en naleving daarvan.

  • Daarnaast heb je aantoonbare ervaring met complexe IT-omgevingen met een grote diversiteit aan partners en leveranciers.

  • Je hebt diepgaande kennis van IT-sourcing en leveranciersmanagement, cloud-, platform- en securitymodellen, DORA, TPRM, assurance en auditprocessen.

  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met strategische onderhandelingen op C-level en advisering richting MT/RvB.

  • Je bent in staat om onjuiste besluitvorming of contractuele afspraken tijdig te herkennen en te voorkomen, gezien de organisatiebrede impact van deze rol op continuïteit, compliance en reputatie.

  • Je beschikt over een WO werk- en denkniveau.

Onze vragen

Een motivatiebrief is niet nodig, in plaats daarvan ontvangen we graag jouw antwoord op de volgende drie vragen:

  • Op basis van welke criteria zou je leveranciers indelen in categorieën en wat betekent dat vervolgens
    voor de relatie met die leveranciers?

  • Beschrijf hoe je succesvol stakeholdermanagement toepast in een complexe organisatie als CZ.

  • Met welke wet- en regelgeving heb je te maken (gehad) en kan je beschrijven hoe dat je werk
    beïnvloed (heeft).

title: B Lineman - Transmission
description:
Position Summary

The Class B Lineman is a safety focused professional with the ability to construct and repair electrical transmission systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized powerlines and may be required to travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized transmission systems while putting safety first.

  • Install and repair overhead transmission lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of switching and tagging procedures, EPZ -grounding and understanding induced voltage on de-energized lines using the proper tools and test equipment.

  • Climb different structures (wood, steel, concrete) using approved climbing methods and equipment.

  • Work at heights and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Proficient in all aspects of heavy lifting and rigging.

  • Operate and maintain bucket trucks, digger derricks, tensioners and pullers and other pieces of transmission line equipment.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential on energized lines.

Minimum Requirements

  • Three (3) years of recent transmission line experience.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at different job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

Work Environment

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at construction job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family.

About Us

Founded in 1945, Pike is a leading provider of construction, repair and engineering services for electric and gas utilities, as well as telecommunications companies with a growing portfolio of turnkey renewable projects. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

Pike Electric, LLC, is an equal opportunity employer.

Ensure GDPR and PII compliance across data flows at scale.
Contribute to data and architecture best practices that may span across the whole organisation.

Who you are

A few years of experience as a Data Engineer or data-heavy backend engineer.
Solid programming and data skills (e.g. SQL, Python, and/or JVM-based languages).
Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in a modern cloud data stack.
Experience managing infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform or similar).
A good understanding of data quality, observability, and reliability.
Clear written communication skills in English and comfort working cross-functionally.
Experience with streaming systems or near real-time data infrastructure (e.g. Kafka, Flink, or similar).

title: Research Assistant I Lab

The Brugge lab studies breast and ovarian cancer, striving to discover the mechanisms behind disease initiation, progression and drug resistance. In this position, you will work under the direct supervision of a postdoctoral fellow to study breast cancer initiation and progression using a newly developed mouse model of breast cancer together with primary patient samples. title: Senior HR Advisor
description:
Hybrid | Knutsford | £44,000 - £50,000 DOE

About the role

People are at the heart of what we do at Speedy Freight, and as we continue to grow across our UK operations and franchise network, we’re looking for an experienced Senior HR Advisor to join our People Team.

This is a hands-on role for someone who knows their ER, is comfortable dealing with complexity and enjoys being the person managers can come to for clear, practical advice.

You’ll work closely with managers and leaders across Speedy Freight, Speedy Parcels and our franchise network, helping them navigate people matters confidently, while making sure we’re doing things consistently, fairly and in line with UK employment legislation.
No two days will be exactly the same. You’ll be managing your own caseload and supporting managers across a broad range of people matters, including:

  • Managing employee relations cases from initial advice through to resolution – including absence, performance, disciplinary, grievance, capability, conduct and probation matters.
  • Coaching and challenging managers to help them take ownership of people issues and handle them confidently.
  • Supporting formal meetings, investigations and appeals where required.
  • Providing practical advice on employment legislation, HR policies and best practice.
  • Reviewing investigation plans, correspondence and outcome documentation to make sure things are accurate, consistent and appropriate.
  • Building strong relationships with managers, operational teams and franchisees across our network.
  • Spotting potential people risks early and knowing when something needs to be escalated.
  • Looking at ER data and trends to identify recurring issues, risks and opportunities to improve.
  • Supporting HR projects, process improvements and the continued development of our People Services model.
You’ll be part of a small People Team, so we’re looking for someone who is happy to get stuck in, work independently and make things happen, rather than waiting to be told what to do.
We’re looking for someone with solid HR advisory experience who can confidently manage a varied and sometimes complex ER caseload.

You'll ideally have:

  • Proven experience as an HR Advisor, Senior HR Advisor or HR Generalist, with experience managing ER cases through to resolution.
  • Strong knowledge of UK employment law and HR best practice.
  • The confidence to coach, challenge and influence managers at different levels.
  • Excellent judgement and organisation, with the ability to prioritise a busy caseload and keep on top of sensitive or high-risk matters.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear and accurate HR documentation.
  • A pragmatic, solutions-focused approach – you’ll know when to find a practical solution and when something needs escalating.
  • The ability to work independently while also being a collaborative member of a small People Team.
  • Confidence using HR systems, Microsoft Office and HR data.
Nice to have

Experience in franchise, logistics, transport, distribution, sales or another fast-paced operational environment would be a real advantage, particularly if you’ve supported a geographically dispersed or networked workforce.

We’d also be interested in people who have experience balancing commercial priorities, employee experience and employment risk, rather than simply applying policy by the book.

CIPD Level 5 or above and a full driving licence are also desirable/required for the role.
This isn’t a role where you’ll sit on the sidelines giving advice from a distance.

You’ll have real relationships with managers, operational teams and franchisees, and your advice will directly influence how people matters are handled across the business.

We’re growing, changing and continuing to develop how we support our people, so there’s plenty of opportunity to make your mark, improve how we do things and help managers become better at managing people.

If you’re an experienced HR Advisor who enjoys variety, likes solving problems and wants to be part of a People Team where your experience and judgement really matter, we’d love to hear from you.
