title: Lift Operations Supervisor
description:
Keep the Mountain Moving. Lead the Crew. Make Every Ride Count.

At Tenney, lift operations are about more than getting people from the bottom of the mountain to the top. It's about keeping things safe, organized, efficient-and making sure our guests have a great experience from the moment they enter the corral to the moment they step off the chair.

We're looking for a Lift Operations Supervisor who can lead from the front, keep a crew engaged, and stay cool when the mountain gets busy.

You'll be the go-to leader for our Lift Attendants, making sure everyone knows where they need to be, what they need to do, and-most importantly-how to do it safely.

If you like working outside, leading a team, solving problems on the fly, and being part of the action on the mountain, this could be your spot.

What You'll Do

Run a Safe, Smooth Lift Operation

  • Oversee the daily operation of Tenney's lifts and make sure established safety procedures are followed.

  • Lead Lift Attendants in proper loading, unloading, chair handling, and guest management.

  • Make sure employees are in the right positions, paying attention, and ready to respond when needed.

  • Keep lift corrals, mazes, loading areas, and unloading areas organized and safe.

  • Manage guest flow and help keep lift lines moving during busy periods.

  • Respond appropriately to falls, misloads, guest concerns, and other operational situations.

  • Maintain required lift operation logs and documentation.

  • Help coordinate emergency procedures and lift evacuations when needed.

Be the Connection Between Lift Operations & Maintenance

Lift Operations and Lift Maintenance have different jobs-but they need to work closely together.

Lift Operations owns the people and the process. Lift Maintenance owns the equipment.

You'll maintain strong communication with the Lift Maintenance team regarding lift starts, stops, equipment concerns, shutdowns, and reopening procedures.

You'll make sure Lift Attendants understand any equipment-specific operating requirements or restrictions communicated by Lift Maintenance.

You won't be repairing or adjusting lifts-that's the Lift Maintenance team's job. Your job is to make sure the operational side of the mountain is organized, informed, and ready to go.

Lead & Schedule the Crew

  • Build daily and weekly Lift Operations schedules based on mountain needs.

  • Assign employees to lifts and operating positions.

  • Make sure every required position is properly staffed.

  • Monitor attendance and make sure employees show up on time and ready to work.

  • Adjust staffing throughout the day based on weather, crowds, lift demand, and changing conditions.

  • Coach Lift Attendants and provide regular feedback.

  • Address attendance, performance, safety, and conduct issues as they arise.

  • Keep Mountain Operations leadership informed of staffing challenges or concerns.

Train People to Do the Job Right

A great lift crew starts with great training.

  • Train new Lift Attendants on operating procedures, safety, guest service, and Tenney-specific expectations.

  • Make sure employees demonstrate competency before working independently.

  • Provide ongoing coaching and refresher training throughout the season.

  • Reinforce proper chair handling and loading/unloading techniques.

  • Work with Lift Maintenance when employees need to understand equipment-specific procedures.

  • Keep training and certification records organized and up to date.

Create a Great Guest Experience

You'll help set the tone for how guests experience the mountain.

  • Make sure Lift Attendants are friendly, professional, helpful, and engaged.

  • Keep lift lines organized and moving.

  • Help guests navigate corrals and loading areas.

  • Address guest questions and concerns quickly and professionally.

  • Work with Ski Patrol and other Mountain Operations teams when guest safety or operational issues arise.

  • Balance efficiency with safety and good old-fashioned mountain hospitality.

What Makes Someone Great in This Role?

You don't need to know everything on day one. We're looking for someone who is:

  • A natural leader who isn't afraid to get involved.

  • Comfortable giving direction and holding people accountable.

  • Organized enough to manage schedules, staffing, and changing priorities.

  • Calm and decisive when things get busy.

  • A strong communicator who knows when to speak up and when to listen.

  • Serious about safety without taking the fun out of the job.

  • Comfortable working closely with other mountain departments.

  • Willing to spend the day outside-yes, even when it's snowing sideways.

  • Someone who understands that a well-run lift operation makes everyone's day better.

Previous ski resort, lift operations, or supervisory experience is preferred, but the right attitude, leadership skills, and willingness to learn go a long way.

What You Can Expect

  • A fast-paced outdoor work environment where no two days are exactly alike.

  • A leadership role with real responsibility.

  • A team that works hard and has each other's backs.

  • Plenty of time outside in the best office around.

  • The opportunity to help build and shape the Lift Operations team at Tenney.

  • Weekends, holidays, early mornings, and changing weather are part of mountain life-so flexibility is a must.

Physical & Environmental Requirements

This is a hands-on, outdoor mountain position. Employees must be able to:

  • Work outdoors for extended periods in cold, snowy, windy, and changing weather.

  • Stand and walk for extended periods.

  • Bend, reach, climb stairs, and move throughout lift loading and unloading areas.

  • Lift and carry equipment and supplies as needed.

  • Work safely around moving lifts and other mountain equipment.

  • Respond appropriately to changing weather and operational conditions.

We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Mechanical Foreman

About Vertical Mechanical Group (VMG)

Vertical Mechanical Group (VMG) is a leading mechanical contractor specializing in commercial HVAC, Plumbing, Piping, and Mechanical Construction. Originally formed through Anderson Mechanical Services, Inc. and Inspiration Plumbing Company, VMG brings decades of industry experience together with a forward-thinking approach to delivering high-quality mechanical solutions.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for an experienced Mechanical Foreman to lead field crews and support the successful execution of commercial mechanical projects in the Blacksburg, Virginia area. This role is ideal for a hands-on field leader who takes pride in quality craftsmanship, safe operations, and keeping projects moving efficiently.

What You'll Do

Lead Field Operations

  • Lead and supervise mechanical crews performing commercial HVAC, plumbing, piping, and related installations
  • Assign daily work and communicate production goals and expectations to field employees
  • Plan manpower, materials, tools, and equipment to maintain productivity
  • Coordinate daily activities with the Superintendent, project team, subcontractors, and other trades
  • Review upcoming work and identify potential field conflicts before they impact the schedule
  • Participate in daily coordination meetings and short-term project planning
  • Work alongside the crew when needed to support production and project goals

Drive Safety & Quality

  • Promote and enforce VMG safety policies, OSHA requirements, and project-specific safety procedures
  • Lead toolbox talks and reinforce safe work practices with field employees
  • Inspect work areas, tools, equipment, and PPE to maintain a safe jobsite
  • Identify and address unsafe conditions, behaviors, and potential hazards
  • Ensure installations meet project drawings, specifications, applicable codes, and VMG quality standards
  • Monitor workmanship and verify completed work before inspections
  • Maintain accountability for company tools, equipment, and materials

Keep Projects Moving

  • Track daily production, employee time, and completed work
  • Monitor material needs and coordinate deliveries to prevent unnecessary delays
  • Support project schedules and communicate potential challenges to the Superintendent
  • Provide accurate information for daily reports and project documentation
  • Coordinate inspections, testing, and quality-control activities
  • Help minimize material waste, rework, and unnecessary labor costs
  • Communicate field conditions and project needs clearly with jobsite leadership

Lead & Develop the Crew

  • Provide day-to-day leadership to mechanics, helpers, and apprentices
  • Train and mentor employees to strengthen their technical skills and field knowledge
  • Set clear expectations for safety, productivity, quality, and professionalism
  • Hold team members accountable while maintaining a respectful and team-oriented environment
  • Encourage strong communication and collaboration across the jobsite
  • Lead by example through reliability, craftsmanship, and a strong work ethic

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of commercial mechanical construction experience
  • Previous experience leading crews as a Foreman, Lead Mechanic, or similar field leader
  • Strong knowledge of commercial HVAC, plumbing, piping, or mechanical systems
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and project documents
  • Experience planning daily work, coordinating manpower, and tracking productivity
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing and field coordination
  • Working knowledge of OSHA requirements and jobsite safety practices
  • OSHA 30 certification preferred or willingness to obtain
  • Strong leadership, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to perform the physical requirements of an active construction environment
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation

Preferred Experience

  • Experience leading mechanical crews on large commercial construction projects
  • Hands-on background in HVAC, plumbing, hydronic piping, or related mechanical systems
  • Experience coordinating work with Superintendents, Project Managers, general contractors, and other trades
  • Experience developing mechanics, helpers, or apprentices into stronger field professionals

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
  • Opportunities to advance into Superintendent and other field leadership roles
  • The opportunity to work on challenging commercial mechanical projects
  • A collaborative, team-oriented environment where your experience and leadership make an impact

Why VMG?

At VMG, we're focused on more than completing projects. We're focused on building strong teams and creating opportunities for our people to grow.

Our field teams are essential to delivering the safe, high-quality mechanical work our customers expect. As a Mechanical Foreman, you'll have the opportunity to lead from the field, develop your crew, and play a direct role in the successful completion of our projects.

If you're an experienced mechanical professional who knows how to lead crews, solve problems, and deliver quality work safely and efficiently, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply today and continue building your career with VMG.

VMG is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Assistant Mobile Engineer
description:

The Assistant Mobile Engineer supports the Mobile Radar Engineering Team in maintaining and delivering radar capability across a range of systems deployed in the field. Working closely with the Waterfront Team, customers and key stakeholders, the role assists with engineering activities, fault resolution and system support to ensure operational effectiveness. The successful candidate will contribute across the wider Radar Portfolio, developing technical knowledge and practical experience while supporting the delivery, maintenance and continuous improvement of radar systems in a dynamic engineering environment

The Mobile Waterfront team\:

The Mobile Waterfront Team supports UK military operations both within the UK and overseas, while also providing support to export customers worldwide. The role may involve rapid response to operational deployments as required

Why BAE Systems?

Here you’ll build a career with purpose and limitless possibilities. With lifelong learning and meaningful work, this is a place where you can grow your career with confidence and be empowered to be your best. In an environment embracing sustainable ways of working and with a strong sense of shared purpose, our supportive culture is a place you can feel you belong and proud of the difference you make.

A place where everyone can thrive\:

We’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. We know that a diversity of backgrounds, perspectives and experiences strengthens our teams and is vital to the work we do.

We welcome applications from all suitably qualified people, who are BAE Systems employees and have been in their current role for 12 months or longer.

These restrictions mean that factors such as your nationality, any nationalities you may have previously held, and your place of birth can restrict the roles you are eligible to perform within the organisation. title: Brand Strategy Director - (3-month Fixed Term Contract)
description:
About the company:

50 Sport is The Sports Entertainment Agency.

We build and grow social communities, deliver entertainment-led creative campaigns, and drive sponsorship value; connecting fans, brands, and rights holders worldwide. Uniting sport, entertainment, and culture through industry-leading creativity, social media, strategy and performance for clients including Qatar Airways, Ferrari F1 Team, FIFA, Prime Video Sport, DHL, and Jim Beam.

About the role:

This is an exciting opportunity to join our Strategy & Performance team as a Brand Strategy Director, helping us shape and lead our strategic offering and the value we bring to our clients. You'll play a senior role in shaping how we think, how we work with clients and how we bring strategy into the wider agency. This role is for an initial 3-month FTC with the possibility to extend to full-time.

We're looking for someone who can operate beyond the immediate brief, someone who wants to understand the wider business and brand challenge, identify what needs to change, and determine the strategic role that communications can play in getting there.

You'll work across major global brands, sports properties and entertainment platforms, developing integrated strategies. This could mean defining a brand's strategic direction, changing perceptions or shifting how a brand is understood, developing a new proposition, shaping a partnership strategy, building an audience framework, determining the role of different communications channels, or creating a broader strategic narrative that brings products, content, social, partnerships and experiences together. You'll be comfortable taking a complex client challenge and turning it into a clear strategic direction that teams can understand, act on and build from.
Above all, you'll bring relentless curiosity, commercial thinking and a passion for understanding how brands can create meaningful connections with audiences through sport, entertainment and culture.

You'll be joining a team that believes strategy should make every decision smarter, challenging assumptions, finding the insight that changes the brief, turning ambiguity into clear direction and connecting audience behaviour to commercial opportunity.

Responsibilities

  • Lead clients beyond the immediate brief, understanding the wider business, commercial, brand and audience challenge, identifying the real strategic problem to solve and reframing briefs where necessary
  • Develop brand positioning, propositions, platforms, territories and strategic frameworks that address the client's broader objectives
  • Understand the role that sport, entertainment, culture, partnerships and talent can play in helping brands achieve their wider business and brand ambitions
  • Identify the right blend of communications channels and disciplines to address a client challenge
  • Develop integrated brand and communications strategies that connect brand, audience, products, content, social, partnerships, experiences and channels
  • Turn complex information, research and multiple stakeholder perspectives into clear, compelling strategic points of view and actionable recommendations
  • Bring together business, brand, audience and cultural understanding to identify distinctive and credible opportunities for the client
  • Lead strategic workshops, working sessions and client conversations to uncover challenges, align stakeholders and develop solutions
  • Present strategic recommendations confidently to senior client stakeholders and defend the thinking behind them
  • Work collaboratively across account, creative, insights, social, content, production and commercial teams to ensure strategic thinking is reflected throughout the work
  • Lead or play a senior strategic role in pitches and new business opportunities, developing strategic responses that demonstrate a strong understanding of the client's business and the opportunity for sport, entertainment and culture
  • Stay curious about changes in business, culture, technology, sport, entertainment, media and audience behaviour, bringing relevant thinking into our work
  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, becoming a strategic partner who can influence thinking beyond the immediate scope of work

Requirements

  • 8+ years' experience in brand strategy, strategic planning, consultancy or a similar role, ideally within an agency environment
  • Commercially astute, with the ability to understand the business problem behind a communications challenge
  • Proven ability to take a complex or ambiguous client challenge and turn it into a clear strategic direction
  • Strong understanding of how different communications channels and disciplines can work together to achieve different objectives
  • Able to connect business objectives, brand, audience and culture into a coherent strategic point of view
  • Strong presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to make complex strategic thinking clear and persuasive
  • An excellent strategic writer who can make complex thinking clear, compelling and actionable
  • Comfortable facilitating workshops and bringing different stakeholders together around a common challenge
  • Naturally curious and interested in what is happening across sport, entertainment, culture, business and technology
  • Motivated by collaboration and able to work effectively across multiple agency disciplines
  • Able to balance strategic depth with pace, pragmatism and delivery
  • Proven ability to lead complex strategic engagements from problem definition through to strategic direction and delivery
  • Experience influencing senior client stakeholders and shaping strategic decisions beyond the marketing or communications brief
  • Someone who challenges constructively, asks the difficult questions and isn't afraid to reframe the problem when there is a better question to solve
  • You naturally look beyond the brief, bringing the outside world of culture, audiences, competitors, platforms and trends, into the room
  • Passionate about the role that sport, entertainment and culture can play in building brands and driving business growth

Desirable:
  • Experience working across international markets
  • Experience in brand transformation or repositioning
  • Experience across both B2C and B2B audiences
  • Experience working with major sports partnerships

Benefits

  • Hybrid working with flexible working hours
  • 23 days holiday (+ additional 1 day for each year of service capped at 5)
  • Private health insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • 1 x paid Wellness Day
  • 1 x paid Volunteering Day

  • Bike2Work scheme
  • Training and development budget
  • Enhanced family leave policies
  • Referral awards
  • Onsite gym
  • Regular company socials

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Full-Stack Engineer, AI Products - Remote

About the role

Finagra builds software for agriculture — planning, field operations, and the data that connects them. We're early enough that the product surface is still expanding: what exists today is the first two systems, not the last two.

Right now that's Morpheus, which generates seasonal operations plans and SOPs from a corpus of agronomic source material using LLM agents and deterministic Python, and Trinity, the mobile-first execution system where agronomists approve those plans and field teams work them — daily checklists, evidence capture, deviations. More is coming: new products, new surfaces, and problems in this domain nobody has built software for yet.

You'll build across all of it — user-facing applications, the services behind them, and the AI features that make them worth using.

What you'll do

  • Build product across the stack: TypeScript end to end (Next.js/React on the front, a hexagonal core and Postgres behind it), plus Python where the domain logic lives

  • Build AI features that ship: agent pipelines, retrieval over domain corpora, structured generation validated against schema — not chat wrappers

  • Work on output quality where it matters: prompts, evals, schema gates, and the judgement to know when a deterministic script beats a model call

  • Take new products from nothing: greenfield services and apps as the roadmap opens up, alongside the systems already in production

  • Own features end to end — scope, build, deploy, watch them in production, iterate

  • Keep the domain honest: approval gates, audit trails and state machines here are product requirements, not plumbing

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years shipping production web applications

  • Strong TypeScript across frontend and backend; comfortable picking up Python

  • Hands-on LLM integration in real products — you've dealt with context limits, latency, cost and non-deterministic output reaching real users

  • Instinct for where a model belongs and where it doesn't. Half of good AI engineering is choosing not to use one

  • Comfortable with typed contracts, schema validation and tests as the way work gets accepted

  • Product sense: you ask who uses this and what breaks for them before writing code

  • You want range. This is not one codebase for three years

Nice to have

  • Structured generation, evals, or agent frameworks (we use the Claude Agent SDK)

  • Postgres schema design, or hexagonal/ports-and-adapters architecture

  • Vercel, Cloud Run, Docker, CI as a real gate

  • Agriculture, commodity trading, or agri-finance domain exposure

  • Work we can look at — repos, live products, demos

Why this is worth your time

  • Genuinely remote. Not hybrid, not "remote-friendly, three days in." The company is built to work distributed — decisions happen in writing, so being in a room isn't how you get heard. Work from wherever you're actually productive, on a schedule that fits your life.

  • Funded and growing, not scraping. We're backed by investor, with runway to build properly rather than ship whatever demos next quarter. You won't be rewriting your own work every six weeks because the company pivoted to survive.

  • Ownership, not tickets. Small team, flat structure, no product-manager layer between you and the problem. You'll talk to agronomists and field teams directly, decide what to build, and ship it. The architecture decisions in this codebase were made by the engineers who write it — and yours will be too.

  • An AI-native engineering environment. We don't just build AI features, we build with AI: our development process runs on machine-enforced gates from intent through spec, plan and PR, and agents are first-class contributors to the codebase. If you want to be genuinely good at engineering in 2027 rather than watching it happen, this is where that practice is being worked out.

  • Real range, fast. Frontend, backend, domain modelling, LLM pipelines, infrastructure — inside one year, not one per role change. Very few companies this size will hand you that surface area.

title: Senior SDET
description:
Senior QA Automation & Performance Engineer

Location: Bengaluru
Employment Type: Full-time, On-site

About

is building next-generation AI infrastructure and voice technology to power intelligent products at scale. We work across speech, LLMs and real-time AI systems, building products and infrastructure that developers and businesses rely on.

We are looking for a hands-on Senior QA Automation & Performance Engineer to own quality engineering across our backend systems. You will design and build automation frameworks, perform functional and performance testing, and help ensure that our APIs and services remain reliable as traffic, customers and system complexity grow.

This is an individual-contributor role requiring strong technical ownership and close collaboration with engineering, product and infrastructure teams.

What You’ll Do

  • Own functional, integration, end-to-end and performance testing for backend services and APIs.

  • Design, build and maintain scalable automation frameworks rather than only adding test cases to an existing framework.

  • Automate testing across a multi-service, multi-tenant platform.

  • Validate tenant isolation, authentication, permissions, configuration differences, data integrity and concurrent tenant activity.

  • Design and execute load, stress, spike, scalability and endurance tests.

  • Define performance benchmarks and acceptance criteria for latency, throughput, concurrency, reliability and error rates.

  • Identify performance bottlenecks and work with backend and infrastructure engineers to resolve them.

  • Test business logic, data flows, asynchronous processes, integrations and complete customer workflows.

  • Build reusable test utilities, fixtures, test-data strategies and environment-management capabilities.

  • Integrate functional and performance test suites into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Analyse failures using logs, metrics and traces, and distinguish product defects from environment or test-framework issues.

  • Identify edge cases, regressions, failure scenarios and production risks before release.

  • Improve test coverage, quality gates and overall QA processes across the engineering organisation.

  • Collaborate effectively with engineers while independently driving testing priorities and execution.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in software quality engineering, test automation or SDET roles.

  • Strong hands-on experience with both functional testing and performance testing.

  • Demonstrated experience building or significantly extending an automation framework from the ground up.

  • Experience testing backend APIs, distributed services and end-to-end workflows.

  • Experience working with multi-service architectures; exposure to multi-tenant SaaS systems is strongly preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with performance-testing tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling or Locust.

  • Ability to design realistic workload models and analyse latency percentiles, throughput, concurrency, saturation and failure rates.

  • Strong programming or scripting skills in at least one language such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript or Go.

  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD systems.

  • Working knowledge of databases, queues, caching, APIs and asynchronous workflows.

  • Familiarity with logs, monitoring and observability tools for troubleshooting test failures and performance bottlenecks.

  • Strong understanding of testing fundamentals, SDLC, STLC and defect-management practices.

  • Ability to operate as an independent contributor while working closely with multiple engineering teams.

  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and clear written and verbal communication.

Good to Have

  • Experience in a high-growth or product-led technology startup.

  • Experience testing real-time, AI, voice, streaming or other latency-sensitive systems.

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker and cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience testing WebSockets, streaming APIs or event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with security, resilience, failover or chaos testing.

  • Experience validating SLA/SLO requirements and production performance metrics.

Why Join

  • Build the testing and automation foundation for cutting-edge AI products.

  • Work on real-time, large-scale and latency-sensitive systems.

  • Own quality engineering across a complex, multi-service platform.

  • Work in a high-ownership environment with direct engineering impact.

  • Help the organisation ship faster while maintaining reliability and performance.

title: A Lineman - Transmission
description:
Position Summary

The Class A Lineman is a safety focused professional with the ability to construct and repair electrical transmission systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized powerlines and may be required to travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized transmission systems while putting safety first.

  • Lead crew members in the absence of the Employee in Charge and conduct pre-job and tailgate safety briefings.

  • Train and mentor apprentices and ground workers.

  • Install and repair overhead transmission lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of switching and tagging procedures, EPZ -grounding and understanding induced voltage on de-energized lines using the proper tools and test equipment.

  • Climb different structures (wood, steel, concrete) using approved climbing methods and equipment.

  • Work at heights and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Willing and capable to obtain knowledge in bare hand work – 44kV and 500kV.

  • Proficient in all aspects of heavy lifting and rigging.

  • Operate and maintain bucket trucks, digger derricks, tensioners and pullers and other pieces of transmission line equipment.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential on energized lines.

Minimum Requirements

  • Five (5) years of recent transmission line experience.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at different job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

Work Environment

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at constructions job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKE family.

About Us

Founded in 1945, Pike is a leading provider of construction, repair and engineering services for electric and gas utilities, as well as telecommunications companies with a growing portfolio of turnkey renewable projects. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

Pike Electric, LLC, is an equal opportunity employer.

description:
Where applicants provide multiple location preferences, reserve lists will be managed in accordance with location preference/s, as indicated in your application. After appointments have been made using this locational appointment process, any remaining candidates who met the benchmark for the role will remain on a locational reserve list in accordance with their preferences for 12 months.

Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other live applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

The post is currently advertised without VISOR Vetting to enable appointment to take place as soon as possible, however, VISOR vetting will be required to be completed post offer.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Eligibility

Support

title: Customer Data Engineer

Simon AI was founded in 2015 by a team of successful serial entrepreneurs. Simon’s platform empowers businesses to use enterprise‑scale data and machine learning to power customer communications across every channel. Why Monetate?

title: Senior Ethical Hacker IoT & Cloud Security (In dienst of freelance)
description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Dienst: Cybersecurity – offensieve beveiliging binnen een IoT-ecosysteem (ANPR-camera's, sensoren, cloud en applicaties)

Voor de beveiliging van IoT-platformen wordt een ervaren Senior Pentester / Ethical Hacker gezocht met aantoonbare expertise in offensieve security. Je werkt in een technisch complexe omgeving met ANPR-camera's, verbonden veldapparatuur, embedded systemen, netwerkinfrastructuur, cloudplatformen, API's, webapplicaties en centrale verwerkings- en raadplegingssystemen.

Je opdracht bestaat uit het identificeren, gecontroleerd exploiteren en documenteren van kwetsbaarheden die de vertrouwelijkheid, integriteit, beschikbaarheid of authenticiteit van systemen en gegevens kunnen beïnvloeden. Alle activiteiten gebeuren binnen een geautoriseerd kader, op basis van een afgebakende scope en formeel vastgelegde rules of engagement.

Missie

De rol omvat de voorbereiding en uitvoering van penetratietesten op het volledige ecosysteem: terreinapparatuur, netwerken, cloudomgevingen, applicaties en mobiele componenten. Daarnaast lever je bruikbare rapportering op en ondersteun je teams bij de remediëring van vastgestelde kwetsbaarheden.

Op te leveren (deliverables)

  • Volledige, nauwkeurige en reproduceerbare technische rapporten per kwetsbaarheid, inclusief betrokken systemen, exploitatievoorwaarden, bewijsmateriaal, impact, risiconiveau en aanbevelingen
  • Duidelijke executive summary voor management
  • Geformaliseerde scope, doelstellingen en rules of engagement per opdracht
  • Ontwikkelde of aangepaste proof-of-concepts en scripts waar nodig
  • Retests om de effectiviteit van correcties te valideren
  • Aanbevelingen voor de verbetering van architecturen, beveiligingsstandaarden en ontwikkelingsprocedures

Voornaamste taken

  • Technische architecturen en datastromen analyseren, met identificatie van kritieke assets, aanvalsoppervlakken en vertrouwensrelaties
  • Meewerken aan de afbakening van scope, doelstellingen en rules of engagement
  • Pentesten uitvoeren in black box-, grey box- en white box-context op het volledige ecosysteem, waaronder camera's, edge-apparatuur, gateways en centrale systemen
  • IoT- en embedded systemen beoordelen op veiligheid, met aandacht voor firmware-analyse, hardware-interfaces zoals UART/JTAG/SWD, update-mechanismen, OTA-updates en secure boot
  • Communicatieprotocollen analyseren en testen, zoals TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, REST/SOAP/WebSocket/gRPC, MQTT/AMQP/CoAP, RTSP, VPN, Wi‑Fi/BLE en TLS/mTLS/PKI
  • Cloud-pentesten uitvoeren op Azure, AWS of GCP, met focus op IAM, virtuele netwerken, opslag, databases, containers/Kubernetes en CI/CD-pipelines
  • Webapplicaties, API's en backendservices testen op onder meer authenticatie, autorisatie en OWASP-risico's, inclusief OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML en JWT
  • Mobiele Android- en iOS-applicaties testen wanneer deze binnen scope vallen
  • Pentesten uitvoeren op Windows-, Linux- en Active Directory-omgevingen
  • Offensieve tooling inzetten zoals Kali/Parrot, Burp Suite/OWASP ZAP, Nmap/Wireshark/Nessus, Metasploit/Impacket en gelijkaardige tools
  • Scripting en automatisering toepassen met Python, PowerShell, Bash en minstens één bijkomende taal zoals JavaScript of C
  • Resultaten documenteren en presenteren aan technische teams en management, en adviseren over remediëring

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Aantoonbare ervaring in offensieve security en penetratietesten in complexe technische omgevingen
  • Grondige beheersing van penetratietestmethodologieën, waaronder black box, grey box en white box, evenals gecontroleerde exploitatie, post-exploitatie en lateral movement
  • Uitgebreide expertise in IoT- en embedded systemen, inclusief firmware-analyse, hardware-interfaces, update-mechanismen en secure boot
  • Sterke kennis van netwerk-, protocol- en cloudbeveiliging, waaronder Azure, AWS of GCP, IAM, segmentatie, containers/Kubernetes en CI/CD
  • Ervaring met applicatie-, API- en mobiele beveiliging, inclusief OWASP-referentiekaders en standaarden zoals WSTG, ASVS, API Security Top 10, MASVS/MSTG en IoT Security-richtlijnen
  • Vaardigheid in het opstellen van technische en executive rapporten en in het begeleiden van remediëringstrajecten
  • In staat om minder ervaren profielen te begeleiden en kennisdeling binnen het team te ondersteunen
  • Tweetalig Frans/Nederlands is een troef, of voldoende kennis van de tweede landstaal; daarnaast een uitstekende beheersing van technisch Engels, schriftelijk en mondeling
  • Minimaal 10 jaar ervaring in offensieve security en in staat om opdrachten volledig zelfstandig te leiden, van scopebepaling tot presentatie van de resultaten
  • Hoger diploma in informatica, cybersecurity, elektronica of telecommunicatie, of gelijkwaardige professionele ervaring
  • Technische certificeringen in offensieve security, zoals OSCP/OSCP+, OSWE, OSEP, GPEN/GWAPT of SEC556/PIPA voor IoT, zijn een pluspunt maar niet individueel vereist

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).
(Freelance is ook mogelijk)

title: Chief Technology Officer (Mobile app, M/F/D)
description:
Arise is a globally active weight-loss app with over 10 million downloads and a 4.6 rating on the App Store. Our mission is simple but ambitious: empower millions of people to become healthier and happier.

We're looking for a CTO who is a true architect on both iOS and Android — someone deeply skilled in iOS who can take full ownership of our existing app and raise it further, and who can also build our Android app from scratch. You'll develop primarily through AI rather than by hand, and you'll thrive on ownership, precision, and long-term thinking. This role is for someone who ships high-quality code today while foreseeing how today's decisions shape the app for years ahead — technically, strategically, and financially.

Today Arise is iOS-only, so this is where you'll start and where you'll prove yourself: owning, deepening, and future-proofing a mature codebase used by millions. From there, you'll architect and build our Android app from the ground up.

If you excel at structured, autonomous work, build with AI as your default way of working, understand the importance of monetization, and want to own the technology behind a product used by millions, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Role

  • Own and architect the existing iOS app — maintain, optimize, deepen, and future-proof a codebase used by millions.
  • Build the Arise Android app from scratch — architecture, delivery, and long-term ownership.
  • Ensure cross-platform consistency and a coherent technical vision across both platforms.
  • Develop and test features that enhance the Arise experience.
  • Use AI agents and automated workflows as your primary means of building, testing, and shipping — not as an occasional helper.
  • Anticipate technical pitfalls and proactively design solutions.
  • Collaborate with design to refine usability for a smooth user experience.
  • Support monetization by integrating features with measurable business impact.

Requirements

  • Proven track record architecting and shipping production mobile apps, ideally as a senior engineer, lead, or technical founder.
  • Deep, architect-level iOS expertise — you can own a mature codebase end to end and make the hard structural calls with confidence.
  • Demonstrated ability to build an Android app from scratch to the same standard.
  • Hands-on fluency building through AI — agentic coding tools, LLM-driven workflows, automated testing and release. You've actually shipped this way, not just experimented.
  • Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Comfortable working fully in English.

Technical Skills

  • Expert-level iOS/Swift — architecture, patterns, performance, and the judgment to keep a large app maintainable as it grows.
  • Strong Android development (Kotlin) with the ability to architect a new app end to end.
  • Familiarity with mobile build and release tooling (e.g. Fastlane).
  • Deep understanding of Apple and Android design principles, patterns, and best practices.
  • Ability to write clean, well-documented, maintainable code — and to direct AI to do the same.

Who You Are

  • A decisive builder who takes a problem and runs with it — you'd rather ship and iterate than wait for certainty.
  • Direct and results-driven, comfortable owning outcomes and making the call.
  • Energized by autonomy and full ownership of the technology.
  • Allergic to bureaucracy — "meetings that should have been emails" are your enemy.

Why You'll Love Working with Us

  • High autonomy: own the entire tech stack from idea to release.
  • Clear decision-making with minimal bureaucracy.
  • Work with the newest hardware and technologies.
  • Complimentary Claude Max subscription.
  • Flexible, remote-first role (full-time).
  • Paid annual leave.
  • Direct collaboration with the founder — your work will have visible impact from day one.

How to Apply

Send us your application including:

  • Your CV
  • A history of the mobile apps you've built (iOS and Android)
  • Salary expectations
  • (Optional) Code samples or GitHub repositories

Help us build and refine a product that runs like a well-oiled machine — and improves millions of lives in the process.

title: Microsoft Security Engineer
description:
About Us

Integrity360 is a leading independent cybersecurity and PCI specialist operating across Europe, Africa, the Caribbean, and North America. The company has office locations in Ireland, the UK, Bulgaria, Italy, Sweden, Spain, Lithuania, Ukraine, Africa, the Caribbean, and Canada, supported by seven Security Operations Centres (SOCs) located in Dublin, Sofia, Madrid, Stockholm, Rome, Johannesburg and Cape Town.

With over 780 employees, including more than 585 dedicated cybersecurity professionals, Integrity360 delivers a full suite of professional, support, and managed security services. These span the complete cyber risk lifecycle, from identification and prevention to detection, response, and recovery. Integrity360 supports over 3000 mid-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, and utilities.


At Integrity360, people come first. We invest heavily in learning, development and progression, fostering a dynamic culture where innovation, collaboration and continuous growth are at the heart of what we do. If you're ready to take your cyber security career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you.

Job Role / Responsibilities

As a Microsoft Security Engineer, you will be responsible for onboarding clients to our managed security service, with Microsoft Sentinel at the centre of the solution. You will configure and integrate Sentinel environments, onboard and validate log sources, and prepare each deployment for effective monitoring and operational handover to the Security Operations Centre.

Your primary focus will be the technical delivery of new Microsoft Sentinel onboardings. This includes workspace and connector configuration, data collection design, log-source integration, ingestion filtering, validation, detection tuning and the production of high-level design and implementation documentation. You will work closely with clients, architects and SOC teams to ensure each deployment is supportable, secure and aligned with the contracted service scope.

The role also requires hands-on experience, or a clear ability to develop quickly, in onboarding Microsoft Defender XDR workloads such as Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps. You will help establish the integrations, policies and operational workflows required to provide joined-up detection and response across the Microsoft security ecosystem.

This is a client-facing engineering role within Professional Services, reporting to the Head of Cloud Security & Microsoft Security Services. You will manage assigned onboarding activities from discovery and design through implementation, testing, documentation and handover. You will be supported by an experienced team and have access to training and certification opportunities across Microsoft security technologies.

Key Responsibilities



  • Deliver end-to-end onboarding of client Microsoft Sentinel environments into the MSSP service.
  • Configure Sentinel workspaces, content solutions, data connectors, analytics rules, automation rules, watchlists, workbooks and related components in accordance with approved designs and service standards.
  • Run technical discovery sessions to identify log sources, connectivity requirements, data volumes, retention needs, dependencies and onboarding priorities.
  • Onboard Microsoft, third-party, cloud, network, identity and application log sources using supported collection methods, including Azure Monitor Agent, Data Collection Rules, APIs, syslog, CEF and custom connectors where appropriate.
  • Design and implement data filtering and transformation to improve signal quality, control ingestion costs and ensure the service receives the telemetry required for monitoring and detection.
  • Validate data ingestion, parsing, field mapping, timestamps, health and coverage, and troubleshoot issues across source systems, collectors, networks and Azure services.
  • Tune analytics rules, alert logic and incident generation in collaboration with SOC and detection engineering teams to reduce unnecessary noise while maintaining appropriate coverage.
  • Onboard and integrate Microsoft Defender XDR workloads, including Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Defender for Office 365 and Defender for Cloud Apps.
  • Produce accurate high-level designs, implementation plans, configuration records, test evidence, operational runbooks and handover documentation.
  • Coordinate with clients, project managers, architects, SOC analysts and service teams to manage dependencies, risks, actions and readiness for service transition.
  • Apply repeatable engineering standards, peer review and change control, and contribute improvements to onboarding templates, technical patterns and internal procedures.
  • Support troubleshooting and remediation during onboarding and early-life support, escalating product or service dependencies where required.
  • Undertake occasional travel where required to support client delivery.

Essential

  • Hands-on experience deploying, configuring or supporting Microsoft Sentinel in production or customer environments.
  • Practical knowledge of Sentinel data connectors, Log Analytics workspaces, Azure Monitor Agent, Data Collection Rules, syslog and CEF collection patterns.
  • Strong Kusto Query Language skills for data validation, troubleshooting, investigation and detection tuning.
  • Experience onboarding and troubleshooting log sources across Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoints, identity, network, security and third-party platforms.
  • Understanding of ingestion filtering, data transformation, parsing, normalisation, retention and the cost implications of security telemetry.
  • Experience creating clear technical designs and delivery documentation, including HLDs, implementation plans, test records and operational handover materials.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender XDR and the integration of its workloads with Microsoft Sentinel.
  • Sound understanding of SIEM operations, detection engineering principles, incident workflows and the requirements of a managed security service.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Azure, APIs, identity, networking and data collection components.
  • Confident written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work directly with technical and non-technical client stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage assigned work independently while collaborating effectively with project, architecture, SOC and service teams.

Desired

  • Experience working for an MSSP, MDR provider, Security Operations Centre or security-focused professional services team.
  • Development of custom log parsers, KQL functions, ASIM-compatible content or other normalisation patterns for non-standard data sources.
  • Experience with DevOps pipelines and source control for Microsoft Sentinel content, configuration and deployment.
  • Practical knowledge of detection as code, including versioning, testing, peer review and controlled promotion of analytics content between environments.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and automation using technologies such as Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI, Logic Apps or APIs.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Sentinel repositories, content management and repeatable multi-customer deployment patterns.
  • Experience integrating Microsoft security services across tenants, subscriptions or delegated administration models such as Azure Lighthouse.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and its application to detection coverage and use-case mapping.

Desired Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200).
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500/SC-500).
  • Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100).
  • Relevant Microsoft Applied Skills covering Sentinel, Defender XDR, security operations or automation.
  • Other relevant security or cloud certifications are beneficial but not essential.

title: Wellness  Associate
description:
Job Description

Terrapin is looking for a Wellness Associate to join our growing company. As a Clinton County, Penn.-based cannabis company, Terrapin is a pioneer in the emerging industry. Terrapin is a cultivator and processor of high-quality medical and recreational cannabis products with plans to open a retail footprint in Pennsylvania. With over 15 years of industry experience, Terrapin was licensed to operate in the Pennsylvania marketplace in 2017, growing to more than 200 employees. Retail expansion plans in Pennsylvania have created a need for a Wellness Associate.

Wellness Associates are the face of the Medical Marijuana Industry that represent the mission and the goals of Terrapin Care Station while providing superior customer service and maintaining a level of product knowledge to meet the needs of the patient, while providing an education on the safe consumption of available products. They are also responsible for knowing the laws that govern a legal sale of marijuana in a medical setting to ensure that the business is operating within the confines of compliance. They are the last people in the seed-to-sale chain of production who have the task of delivering products while giving the customer the best experience Terrapin Care Station can provide.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • A customer service professional, greeting all patients in a warm, sincere and helpful manner
  • Consistently delivers the ultimate customer experience in all facets from patient entry to exit; ensures each patient receives full attention during their transaction
  • Assists patients with choosing the right products according to their ailments
  • Ensures orders are fulfilled efficiently with 100% accuracy at all times
  • Abides by product handling procedures, including company safety and health policies as well as regulatory agency compliance
  • Checks patient IDs and conducts transactions at POS
  • Remains upright on their feet, particularly for sustained periods of time, up to 88% of the work day
  • Moves about on foot to accomplish tasks to meet customer/patient needs
  • Helps keep the store clean and tidy, including sweeping and mopping
  • Provides customer education about products and uses
  • Works with leadership to understand company goals and procedures
  • Other duties as assigned by management

Minimum Qualifications and Requirements

  • Must be able to pass state-mandated background checks and successfully complete the Department of Health's 2-hour training course
  • Must be organized and maintain a neat and clean work station
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, to manage high stress situations, and to be flexible and adaptable when a situation requires it
  • Must be able to perform simple math
  • Must be willing to learn about new products and cannabinoids
  • Must be aware of and abide by all laws and compliance surrounding retail operations
  • Must possess a willingness to learn the effects and applications of concentrates and other THC infused products
  • Experience in the use of cannabis with a willingness to learn strain genetics, including their properties and effects
  • Is familiar with Windows, Microsoft Office and Google Drive
  • Must be able to operate the point-of-sale system and maintain accurate cash handling practices
  • Must have 1-year of cash handling experience
  • Must have 1-year of customer service experience
  • Experience frequently interacting with customers, fulfilling customer requests and addressing customer issues, questions, or suggestions
  • Must have reliable transportation to/from work

Benefits

  • Sick and Volunteer Paid time off
  • 401(k) w/company match upon 1yr of employment
  • Tip Share

If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may contact us at careers@terrapincarestation.com

About Terrapin

Founded in Boulder, Colorado in 2009 as Terrapin Care Station, the legacy, family-owned cannabis company in 2017 was one of the first 12 initial recipients of a Pennsylvania medical cannabis grower/processor license. With a headquarters in Boulder, Colo. that oversees operations in Clinton County, Pennsylvania, Terrapin is consistently held as an industry model for patient-focused cultivation and production of high-quality medical cannabis products. Terrapin's medical cannabis products can be found in every dispensary in Pennsylvania thanks to a loyal patient base that appreciates our commitment to quality, transparency and affordable products. With a strong commitment to corporate responsibility and advancing equity across the industry, Terrapin believes in "planting local roots." We operate in Pennsylvania under the brands: Double Bear (extracts, vapes and troches), The Woods (premium flower), Terrapin (whole flower), and Resolute Remedies (topicals, capsules, and tinctures). Terrapin has plans to open dispensary operations in Pennsylvania and is actively pursuing locations. For more information, visit TerrapinCareStation.com.

Location: Oxford, UK

About Oxford Nanopore Technologies
Oxford Nanopore Technologies aims to bring the widest benefits to society by enabling the analysis of anything, by anyone, anywhere. We have developed a new generation of nanopore-based sensing technology for faster, information-rich, accessible, and affordable molecular analysis.

Our first application is DNA/RNA sequencing, and we are developing technology for the analysis of other molecules, including proteins. Our tools help characterize the biology of humans, diseases (like cancer), plants, animals, bacteria, viruses, and whole environments. We are a UK-headquartered company with a thriving culture of ambition and strong innovation goals, operating globally with customers in more than 125 countries.

Role Overview
We are looking for a highly motivated individual to join our Sequencing Development Team as a Development Scientist. This exciting and challenging role assists in the technical development of current and future sequencing products, focusing on using sequencing techniques to drive the integration and development of hardware, software, firmware, and flow cell chemistry.

You will be responsible for improving the performance and reliability of contemporary core sequencing platforms and guide the design & development of future sequencing technologies: advancing performance, scalability, and innovation to enable next-generation genomic sequencing platforms.

Candidate Profile
We encourage applications from individuals who:

If you are looking to utilize your skills to make a real difference, consider joining our team and apply today!

title: Arts (ANIOS) eetstoornissen
description:
Wil jij als arts of ANIOS iets kunnen betekenen binnen een unieke organisatie die gespecialiseerd is in eetstoornissen? Human Concern in Nijmegen is een gespecialiseerde GGZ-instelling met de beste behandeling voor eetstoornissen waarbij ervaringsprofessionals laten zien dat het herstellen van een eetstoornis mogelijk is.

Wij zijn Human Concern, een gespecialiseerde GGZ instelling voor eetstoornissen. Wij bieden multidisciplinair op zes locaties door heel Nederland ambulante behandelingen aan op voornamelijk individueel niveau, waarbij er onder begeleiding van een ervaringsprofessional wordt toewerkt naar een leven waarin de eetstoornis niet meer de baas is. Er wordt gewerkt met een combinatie van therapievormen zoals CGT, schematherapie, creatieve therapie en EMDR waarbij het verstoorde eetgedrag (symptomen), de functie hiervan en de uitlokkende- en in stand houdende factoren de focus vormen. De ervaringsprofessionals hebben een geaccrediteerde training gevolgd om een eigen levenservaring zoals een eetstoornis of het herstellen van een burnout in te zetten. De therapie is gericht op een duurzaam herstel en de ervaringsprofessional laat zien dat dit mogelijk is.

title: Java Developer
description:
Company Description

Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 10 countries, and more than 160 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.

Job Description

The Avaloq Security team is an international team of analysts, senior and expert software engineers and architects. The Avaloq Security team develops and maintains central application security frameworks and tools for all companywide technology stacks and consults the business teams on best practice implementations for context specific security requirements. It furthermore operates the group-wide application security assessments, monitors the security vulnerabilities and supports the business teams in related risk mitigation plans.

Your key tasks

  • Analyse, design, and develop requirements in collaboration with Product Development, customers, business analysts, and software partners.
  • Design, implement, and maintain internal CI/CD pipelines and automated tools to support vulnerability management, security reporting, and efficient development workflows.
  • Contribute to and collaborate across departments on cross-functional projects.
  • Check and maintain the daily automated build process, analysing security warnings and providing guidance or fixes as required.
  • Monitor third-party library enrolment, updates, and removals using in-house tools and Mend (or similar solutions).
  • Evaluate and validate detected vulnerabilities, assess exploitability, provide expert analysis on false positives, and develop potential fixes.
  • Maintain configuration control and ensure accuracy of the release baseline.
  • Coordinate security-related actions across multiple teams to ensure the high quality and security of Avaloq products.
  • Prepare and distribute documentation and reports related to security risks, findings, and remediation progress.
  • Conduct periodic reviews to verify compliance with internal security policies, guidelines, and best practices.
  • Participate in internal technical discussions, sharing knowledge on security implementation, vulnerabilities, and opportunities for improvement.

Qualifications

  • University degree in IT, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline.
  • Must have at least 1-3years of relevant work experience
  • Strong experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining internal CI/CD pipelines and automation tooling.
  • Senior-level engineering expertise with hands-on skills in Python, Java, JavaScript, Gradle, Jenkins (or other CI/CD tools).
  • Knowledge of containerized applications and experience with Kubernetes and/or OpenShift (or similar container orchestration platforms).
  • Deep understanding of security concepts, industry standards, and best practices.
  • Practical experience with vulnerability management tools and automated security scanning solutions.
  • Ability to communicate technical information effectively to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Exposure to financial markets and understanding of financial products is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical capabilities, attention to detail, and commitment to delivering high-quality results.
  • Positive, collaborative mindset with the ability to promote best practices across the organization.

Additional Information

We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.

In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.

We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.

Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

title: MTS - Engineering (Security)
description:
About the role

As a Member of Technical Staff - Engineering (Security), you will own security across Collinear's infrastructure, products, and customer data. We build RL environments and training data for frontier AI labs and large enterprises. They trust us with sensitive data and access to their systems, and many of our environments run AI agents that are being trained to find and exploit vulnerabilities.

This is a senior, hands-on role. You will work alongside our researchers and engineering team to set the direction for, and implement, new security measures.

What you'll do

  • Harden the sandboxes where AI agents run untrusted code, including cyber tasks where agents are actively trying to break out

  • Own AWS security, including IAM design, least-privilege access, network boundaries, and short-lived credentials in place of long-lived keys

  • Build detection and response across our cloud and Kubernetes environments, and tune alerts so the team acts on them

  • Protect customer data from the moment it arrives to the moment we deliver, including access controls, secure delivery, and PII removal at terabyte scale

  • Lead customer security reviews and compliance work, from security questionnaires and supplier onboarding to SOC 2

  • Secure our software supply chain, including dependencies, CI/CD, secrets, and our GitHub organization

  • Set guardrails for engineers and coding agents that work directly against production infrastructure

  • Test our systems the way an attacker would, and fix what you find


About you

  • You have 8+ years of experience in security engineering, much of it securing cloud infrastructure in production

  • You have deep hands-on experience with AWS security, including IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, KMS, and VPC design

  • You have an offensive security background, such as penetration testing, red teaming, or vulnerability research, and use it to decide what to defend first

  • You have isolated untrusted workloads with containers or microVMs, using tools such as gVisor, Firecracker, or Kata Containers, and know where that isolation tends to fail

  • You write production-quality code, ideally in Python, and prefer automation to manual process

  • You have built or grown a security program at a startup, and know how to prioritize when you can't fix everything at once

  • You explain risk clearly to engineers, leadership, and customers' security teams

Director of Strategic Partnerships and Operations (Part-Time)

PeerForward Bermuda

This is an opportunity to become the first-ever hire of PeerForward Bermuda and the on-the-ground leader of a movement that has spent the last five years unlocking the power of peers across the island. Working with Berkeley Institute, CedarBridge Academy, and Bermuda College, PeerForward Bermuda helps students take charge of their postsecondary futures and we're looking for someone excited to hit the ground running and build on everything we've already put in place.

Backed by PeerForward’s U.S. national team, which has spent 30 years perfecting the peer-led model and reaching more than 700,000 students, the Director of Strategic Partnerships and Operations will have two connected areas of focus: building the strategic partnerships with funders, donors, community and government stakeholders that support PeerForward Bermuda’s growth and sustainability; and providing the on-the-ground operational support that keeps the programme running smoothly. The role works under the direction of the CEO and his team on fundraising and external relations.

This is a home-based role for a Bermuda resident, as there is no central office, with regular in-person meetings, school visits, funder meetings and community events across the island.

Your new role

  • Identify, cultivate and steward local donors and funders who support PeerForward Bermuda’s sustainability, in coordination with the CEO and Board Chair.
  • Lead execution of PeerForward Bermuda’s annual fundraising and development efforts.
  • Represent PeerForward Bermuda and its mission at donor meetings, community events, and civic and government convenings.
  • Build and steward strategic partnerships with community organisations, civic leaders and government officials.
  • Prepare grant applications, stewardship reports and donor communications in coordination with the PeerForward U.S. team.
  • Provide on-the-ground programme support to the Director of Postsecondary Success [U.S.] as needed.
  • Connect with school partners, including principals, counsellors and administrators, to maintain strong local relationships and support programme delivery.
  • Build and manage vendor relationships supporting PeerForward Bermuda’s programme and organisational operations.
  • Help coordinate logistics for Peer Leader onboarding and school-based activities.
  • Support Board meeting preparation, including agendas, materials and follow-up.
  • Help ensure the subsidiary operates in compliance with Bermuda regulatory requirements, working with PeerForward’s U.S. finance and legal teams.



Key Requirements:

  • Genuine enthusiasm for PeerForward’s mission of empowering students from low-income communities through the power of peers.
  • 7+ years of professional experience in management, fundraising, development, operations or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required.
  • Demonstrated experience in strategic development, including both resources and relationships, and comfort representing an organisation with public, private and community stakeholders.
  • A track record of building strategic partnerships with community, civic or government stakeholders.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and a collaborative, steady operating style.
  • Comfortable working within a U.S.-based organisational structure with regular virtual collaboration across time zones.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear, professional reports and donor-facing materials.

If you have a passion for PeerForward’s mission and the experience to help build the partnerships and local operations that will support PeerForward Bermuda’s continued impact and growth, we encourage you to apply no later than October 16, 2026. For questions, email hr@psolutions.bm or call 441-232-5270.
