title: Lead AI Architect - Build PA's AI Capability
description:
We're building out our AI capability team in Copenhagen and are looking for a Lead AI Architect to be its technical center of gravity. You'll set the technical direction for how we design and deliver enterprise AI solutions to our clients, taking architecture from the whiteboard into production. This is a role for someone who is deeply curious about technology and continually exploring what's next in AI.

You're the person who has already tried the latest model release, built something with a new agent framework, and can explain why it matters. More importantly, you can say whether it's ready for a regulated enterprise.

You're equally at home in a room with a client's executive team. You can explain an architecture decision in terms of risk, cost, speed and competitive advantage, without losing either the technical integrity or the audience.

You'll work with leading organisations on some of the most complex challenges in financial services, the public sector, energy, life sciences and other regulated industries across the Nordics and global markets.

What you'll do

Own the technical vision of the AI capability team

  • Define reference architectures, reusable patterns and technical standards for enterprise AI solutions.
  • Track the fast-moving AI landscape, including models, frameworks, tooling and infrastructure, and decide what we adopt, test or ignore.
  • Build accelerators, reusable components and demos that make our delivery faster and our proposals more convincing.

Architect and build enterprise AI solutions

  • Design end-to-end solutions spanning data integration, retrieval and knowledge layers, model orchestration, agentic workflows, security and operations.
  • Stay hands-on. Prototype, write code, review code and unblock delivery teams when it gets hard.
  • Take solutions from proof of concept to scalable, secure, production-grade systems integrated with clients' existing enterprise landscapes.

Shape agentic and knowledge-driven architectures

  • Design multi-agent systems, tool-using agents and human-in-the-loop workflows that automate real business processes.
  • Build the foundations that make AI useful at enterprise scale: unified data access, institutional memory, and the capture and reuse of organizational knowledge.
  • Put evaluation, observability, guardrails and cost control in place from day one.

Translate technology for executives

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to CxOs, CIOs and CTOs at our clients.
  • Explain architecture choices and trade-offs, such as build vs. buy, cloud vs. sovereign, open vs. proprietary models, and platform vs. point solution, in clear business terms.
  • Support business development through technical solutioning, client workshops and proposal architecture.

Grow the team and collaborate across PA and Jacobs

  • Mentor engineers, data scientists and consultants, and raise the technical bar across PA.
  • Work closely with engineers, data scientists and technical specialists from Jacobs. Combine their deep engineering and infrastructure expertise with PA's AI and transformation capabilities to deliver solutions neither could deliver alone.
  • Collaborate with PA's international AI and engineering experts, and contribute to our thought leadership in Europe.
  • Extensive hands-on experience architecting and delivering AI, data or software solutions in enterprise environments, as an architect, principal engineer, tech lead or CTO.
  • Deep, practical knowledge of modern AI engineering, for example:
    • LLMs, both frontier and open-weight, prompt and context engineering, fine-tuning and model selection
    • RAG, vector databases, knowledge graphs and semantic layers
    • Agentic frameworks and orchestration, tool use, and protocols such as MCP
    • LLMOps and MLOps, evaluation frameworks, observability and AI security
  • Strong cloud and platform experience with Azure, AWS or GCP, and modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake or Microsoft Fabric.
  • Solid software engineering skills. You can still build things yourself, typically in Python and/or TypeScript.
  • A strong understanding of enterprise architecture, integration, identity and security in complex organizations.
  • Working knowledge of responsible AI, the EU AI Act, GDPR and data sovereignty, and how they shape architecture decisions.
  • The ability to communicate complex technology clearly and convincingly to non-technical senior stakeholders.
  • Experience working in cross-organizational, multidisciplinary teams that bring together engineers, data scientists and business consultants.
  • Real curiosity. You experiment constantly, and you have opinions backed by evidence.
  • Fluent English and Danish.

It's a plus if you have:

  • Consulting or client-facing advisory experience.
  • Experience in financial services, the public sector, energy, health or other regulated industries.
  • Experience building and leading technical teams or communities of practice.
  • Public contributions such as open-source work, talks, articles or side projects you're proud of.

We don't expect you to tick every box. If this role excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

What we offer

  • The opportunity to define and build the technical direction of a strategic, growing AI capability at PA.
  • Hands-on work with the latest AI technologies on problems that matter, for clients across Europe.
  • Direct exposure to executive decision-makers and their biggest transformation agendas.
  • A curious, ambitious team with a strong community feel, backed by the combined global network of PA and Jacobs: AI, data, engineering and innovation experts working together on some of the most complex challenges in industry and society.
  • Room to grow in both breadth and depth: technically, commercially and as a leader.

Send us your CV and a short note about something you've built that you're proud of. A link to a repo, demo or article works too.

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis.

About PA Consulting

PA Consulting is a global innovation and transformation consultancy with deep expertise in financial services, the public sector, energy, transport and health. We help our clients create value and navigate a world shaped by constant change, new technology and growing complexity. Our 4,000 specialists worldwide combine strategic insight, technical expertise and creative thinking to deliver sustainable, meaningful results.

PA is part of Jacobs, a global leader in engineering, infrastructure and technology solutions. Together, we combine PA's strategy, innovation and AI expertise with Jacobs' engineering depth and scale.

Inclusion and diversity

We believe diversity makes us stronger, and we work deliberately to create an inclusive, dynamic environment where everyone can thrive. We recruit and promote solely on the basis of demonstrated experience, regardless of gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, age or background.

title: Trainee Buyer - 2027
description:
Be Brave. Be You. Be NEXT.

Future talent applications!

Ready to launch your career? Whether you’re graduating in 2027 or available to hit the ground running sooner, we’d love to meet you!

We are opening our applications for those looking to join us on a full time permanent basis.

Trainee Buyers

  • Develop an understanding of the product development process
    • Sourcing the right materials
    • Negotiating the best cost
    • Approving colour, fabric and fit for production.
  • Liaise with suppliers from Europe to the Far East to Track samples for selection meetings and production.
  • Prepare garments/accessories for selection meetings, trade meetings and online photoshoots.
  • Have an awareness of high end fashion and market trends by gaining inspiration from a variety of sources
  • Use your knowledge of relevant trends to find new product initiatives that you believe are missing from the departments current product offering
  • Conduct competitor shop analysis and present findings back to your team to gain an understanding of where Next sits in the market .
  • Maintain accurate buying systems
  • Work closely with the trainee merchandiser to analyse daily best/ worst sellers and make recommendations
  • Maintain an organised department - sample storage and approval library

The Scheme
You will start your 12 - 18 month training programme on one of our ‘Product’ teams - Womenswear, Menswear, Childrenswear, Home or on our Brands team (who work with a portfolio of over 750 brands).

With support from your team, you will learn the skills required to progress within our Buying function. Responsibility comes early and you will be looking after millions of pounds worth of stock from day one!

You will receive regular feedback from your Buying team who will coach and develop you throughout the scheme, supporting you in reaching your goals.

Once you are ready to take the next step you will be promoted to Assistant Buyer!

Your Team
It's all about collaboration and great teamwork! You will be working alongside our amazing Merchandisers and Designers on tasks from sourcing materials and even conducting competitor analysis to influence what our NEXT product ranges look like. You will learn to trade those ranges, reacting to what our customers are telling us they love. If placed within an own-brand team you will be involved in product development activities, or if you go into a branded team you will work with an exciting selection of external brands.

It's fast paced, exciting, challenging and very rewarding!

About You
Are you the kind of person who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? Do you excel at juggling a wide range of tasks while maintaining impeccable organisation? If so, you might be the perfect fit for our team. We’re looking for someone who is not just a great communicator but a relationship builder, someone who can effortlessly connect with both colleagues and clients.

Your analytical skills are sharp; you live and breathe fashion and are able to present your ideas in a clear and compelling way. In our bustling workplace, your approachable nature and team spirit make you a go-to person, fostering collaboration and positivity. You’re driven and decisive, confident when presenting, always aiming to make a meaningful impact. If this sounds like you, then you’re exactly who we need to help take our team to the next level.

As part of your application, please include a cover letter detailing the below:

  • What skills do you have that will make you a successful Trainee buyer?
  • What are your main interests and how do these relate to the Buying role?
  • What do you think the most challenging aspect of the Trainee buyer role will be?
  • What current trend are you most excited about?


At Next we embrace technology and innovation, but we want to see the real you! A generic AI response won't help you stand out from the crowd and may hinder your application.

We appreciate you might want to use Gen AI to help structure your responses, and check for grammar and spelling but the content needs to reflect your unique self, your passion and your understanding of the role.

Sponsorship
NEXT has assessed the role advertised and based on current UKVI criteria, the Merchandiser/Buyer role is not eligible for skilled worker sponsorship. If you hold a Visa that allows you to complete the training, NEXT will be unable to sponsor you at the conclusion of the training, and expects that you will have alternative Immigration status to take up the role.

Be Brave. Be You. Be NEXT.

About Manulife and John Hancock

description:

Essential Functions:

  1. Own paid search, Performance Max, Local Service Ads, and YouTube/OLV strategy and investment allocation for the organization's single largest acquisition spend category

Employee perks/discounts:

This plan allows for flexibility and discretion between employees and managers in taking time off - with no set accrual for vacation or sick time. Employees can use Flexible PTO for any reason and is compliant with the Colorado Healthy Families Work Act.

title: Data Analyst Support Engineer
description:

title: Senior ICT Administrator
description:
Ben jij de Senior ICT administrator waar wij naar op zoek zijn?

De ICT afdeling is verantwoordelijk voor de beleidsontwikkeling en realisatie van het ICT beleid van Gate terminal. De senior ICT administrator wordt aangestuurd door de afdelingsmanager en is verantwoordelijk voor de ondersteuning van hem op het gebied van beleidsontwikkeling, architectuur, security en het operationele beheer van de systemen en netwerken. Als senior is hij veelal eerste aanspreekpunt en werkt hij nauw samen met de ICT administrator.

Wat ga je doen?

In de functie van Senior ICT administrator ben je binnen de afdeling IT verantwoordelijk voor het implementeren en realisatie van ICT (gebruikers)beleid, procedures, architectuur, security. Je beheert, optimaliseert en past hardware en systemen aan zodat deze adequaat functioneren, continu beschikbaar zijn en voldoen aan wensen en (veiligheids-) eisen van gebruikersorganisatie.

Je belangrijkste uitdagingen en taken

Welke functie je bij ons ook vervult, je kunt altijd een pionier zijn. In onze organisatie is volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief. In deze functie bestaan je taken en verantwoordelijkheden onder andere uit :

  • Ondersteunen van ICT manager ten aanzien van ICT (gebruikers-)beleid en bijbehorende procedures en passende systeemintegraties

  • Het (mede) ontwikkelen, optimaliseren en (projectmatig) implementeren van ICT architectuur en toezien op de vereiste (technische) infrastructuur

  • Het (mede) kiezen en implementeren van standaarden voor de inrichting van de architectuur

  • Het (mede) verrichten van haalbaarheidsonderzoeken e.e.a. in overleg met leidinggevende

  • Het initiëren en uitwerken van vernieuwingen, vervangingen, kostenreducties etc

  • Het beheren van licenties en releases, beveiligen van systemen en data (waaronder de gehele Microsoft 365 suite: Azure, security, collaboration en Intune), VMware, network monitoring (PRTG) en analyseren en adviseren ten aanzien van security policy inclusief procedures en systeemonderdelen

  • inventariseren van risico’s ter zake en adviseren van management hierover en uitzetten in overleg met CISO/ISO

  • Het (mede) analyseren met betrekking tot een effectieve en efficiënte koppeling van bedrijfsbehoefte aan ICT beleid en technische toepassing

  • Het beheren en onderhouden van standaarden en normen

  • Het onderhouden van het systeem- en netwerkbeheer binnen de organisatie

Functie-eisen

Veiligheid en kwaliteit in je werk zijn belangrijk voor je. Je bent een teamspeler en je voelt je betrokken bij onze organisatie en onze klantenkring. Bovendien wil je jezelf ontwikkelen. Je bent resultaatgericht, communicatief sterk, zelfstandig en hebt oog voor detail, waardoor je goed past in onze organisatie.

Medewerkers van Gate hebben een uiteenlopende achtergrond: technisch, economisch, administratief en van MBO- tot WO-niveau. Voor deze functie zijn wij op zoek naar kandidaten met;

  • Minimaal MBO werk- en denkniveau

  • Minimaal een afgeronde MBO opleiding (niveau 4) op het gebied van ICT

  • Werkervaring met Microsoft 365 suite, VMware, Windows w2k16, w2k19, DNS/DHCP, Networking & Firewalls

  • Aantoonbare werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift

Ons aanbod

Wij bieden je een boeiende baan in de groeiende Liquefied Natural Gas – LNG sector binnen een bedrijf met veel uitdagingen, korte lijnen en een prettige informele werksfeer. Jij leert van ons, wij leren van jou. Wij staan open voor goede ideeën en voor medewerkers die beslissingen durven nemen. Ons team is deskundig, energiek en altijd bereid om klanten de beste oplossing te bieden.

Interesse?

Lijkt het je interessant om een nieuwe stap in je loopbaan te zetten bij één van de grootste en meest moderne LNG-terminals in Europa? Stuur je CV via onderstaande knop.

Mocht je nog vragen hebben over de vacature? Neem contact op met Juan Romberg 06 21 54 65 74 juan.romberg@gateterminal.com

title: Operations Geoscience Specialist (Senior Reservoir Petrophysicist) / IES
description:
Job Overview

The Senior Reservoir Petrophysicist is responsible for delivering advanced integrated reservoir characterization, petrophysical evaluation, and production optimization solutions across the Asia Geozone and global projects. The role combines strong expertise in wireline and drilling log interpretation, reservoir engineering, reservoir simulation, production analysis, and field development studies to support reservoir management and hydrocarbon recovery optimization.

This position plays a critical role in bridging subsurface geoscience, reservoir engineering, and digital technologies by integrating petrophysical interpretation with production behavior, dynamic reservoir performance, and AI-driven analytical workflows. The candidate is expected to provide technical leadership, mentor junior engineers and geoscientists, and contribute to business growth through innovative reservoir evaluation solutions and cross-product line collaboration.

Responsibilities

  • Perform advanced petrophysical evaluation using wireline and drilling services logs, including open hole and cased hole interpretation for conventional and unconventional reservoirs.
  • Analyze and integrate Gamma Ray, Resistivity, Density, Neutron, Sonic, NMR, Image Logs, Pulsed Neutron, and advanced logging data for reservoir characterization and production optimization.
  • Support reservoir engineering studies including reservoir simulation, material balance, production forecasting, decline curve analysis, pressure transient analysis, and reservoir surveillance.
  • Conduct integrated reservoir studies by combining geology, geophysics, petrophysics, drilling, production, and facility data.
  • Support field development planning, reservoir management, IOR/EOR screening, geothermal/EGS, CCS, and mature field redevelopment projects.
  • Work with modern reservoir and well analysis software such as OFM, IPM Suite (PROSPER, GAP, MBAL), PanSystem, WellFlow, and ECLIPSE applications.
  • Develop competency and technical expertise in ECLIPSE reservoir simulation workflows and dynamic reservoir modeling.
  • Apply coding and digital workflows using Python, SQL, AI/ML tools, and automation engines to improve interpretation efficiency, reservoir analytics, and operational workflows.
  • Support development of AI-assisted interpretation workflows, predictive analytics, and digital reservoir management solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with Geoscience, Production, Drilling, and other Product Line teams to identify production enhancement opportunities.
  • Provide technical mentoring, coaching, and guidance to less experienced engineers and geoscientists.
  • Support client engagement activities including technical presentations, proposal preparation, business development, and technology promotion.
  • Contribute to technical publications, industry conferences, and professional organizations.

Skills

  • Strong understanding of both static and dynamic reservoir evaluation workflows.
  • Experience in wireline logging interpretation and drilling services log analysis.
  • Proficiency in reservoir engineering software including Petrel, RMS, TechLog, tNavigator, PI Systems, Spotfire, Eclipse, WellFlow, Prosper, Python, MBAL, GAP, PanSystem, WellFlow, etc.
  • Experience with coding and data analytics tools such as Python, SQL, MATLAB, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML applications, digital workflows, and automation in subsurface studies.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities in multidisciplinary environments.
  • Ability to work effectively within cross-functional and multicultural teams.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively interact with clients and stakeholders.
  • Ability to identify issues, develop solutions, and implement strategies effectively.
  • Strong understanding of the oil and gas industry, market dynamics, and business development principles.
  • Proficient with a wide variety of business productivity and infrastructure solution including Microsoft Windows, UNIX, data networks, audio-visual systems, and more.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convey the message to non-technical personnel.
  • Excellent teamwork and communication skills to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English.
  • Demonstrate ability to adapt to changing project requirements and work in a dynamic environment.
  • Experience in new technologies (e.g., CCUS, Green Energy, etc.) and digital solutions (e.g., IoT, AI, machine learning).

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Petroleum Engineering, Reservoir Engineering, Geoscience, or related discipline.
  • Minimum 7–10 years of relevant experience in reservoir engineering, petrophysics, reservoir characterization, and field development.

Preferred

  • Operator company background or direct operator project experience.
  • Experience in unconventional reservoirs, hydraulic fracturing, geothermal, CCS, or mature field redevelopment.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted reservoir interpretation and cloud-based digital platforms.
  • Active participation in SPE, SPWLA, or other professional organizations.

title: AIOS - De opleiding tot psychiater - GGz Centraal
description:
Zo werk jij

Als arts in opleiding tot medisch specialist (AIOS) in de psychiatrie volg je bij ons een opleidingstraject van 4,5 jaar. De opleiding duurt 4,5 jaar en leidt de aios op tot een breed inzetbare psychiater. De aios verdiept zich in behandelcontexten voor verschillende levensfasen: kinder- en jeugd (0-23 jaar), volwassenen (16-65 jaar) en ouderen (60+). Wie wil specialiseren, kan zich richten op kinder- en jeugdpsychiatrie of ouderenpsychiatrie.

  • Volwassenenpsychiatrie

  • Kinder- en jeugdpsychiatrie

  • Ouderenpsychiatrie

  • Wetenschap

  • Psychotherapie

  • Beleidspsychiatrie.

1 juli 2020 is het nieuwe landelijke opleidingsprogramma “De Psychiater” van start gegaan (zie voor nadere details).

Jaarlijks kunnen bij ons 11 artsen instromen in de opleiding tot medisch specialist in de psychiatrie (AIOS). De instroommomenten zijn in april en oktober. Als je nu solliciteert, nemen we je, bij gebleken geschiktheid, mee in de sollicitatierondes in februari 2027.

Je kunt alle onderdelen van de opleiding binnen GGz Centraal volgen op een van onze locaties in: G&V (Gooi & Vechtstreek), V&VV (Veluw &Veluwevallei, Eemland en Flevoland. Deze locaties hebben ieder een specifieke profilering. Denk aan focus op psychotherapie, sociale psychiatrie, somatiek of een forensisch accent.

Onder begeleiding van een ervaren psychiater word je opgeleid tot een kundige diagnosticus die weet hoe je vervolgens een behandelingsplan opstelt en dit professioneel uitvoert. Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams, waarbij je naast jouw eigen collega’s ook veel samenwerkt met diverse externe specialisten. In deze multidiscipliaire teams heb je een belangrijk rol om er voor te zorgen dat de behandeling niet alleen evidence maar ook personalized based is.

Wij zorgen voor jou

Werk dat er toe doet en waar je van betekenis bent, dat is alvast onze eerste belofte. Omdat we een grote organisatie zijn met verschillende werklocaties kunnen we inspelen op ontwikkelwensen en voorkeuren qua functie-inhoud, type behandelprogramma en woon-werkafstand. We zien wie je bent en wat je kan. Als arts in opleiding tot medisch specialist (AIOS) bij GGz Centraal kun je in ieder geval rekenen op:

  • een bruto maandsalaris volgens salarisschaal AIOS van de CAO GGZ, maximaal IP 52 (€ 6.159,- o.b.v. 36 uur). Bereken hier jouw netto salaris.

  • een contract voor 38 uur per week voor de duur van de opleiding. Na het eerste half jaar van de opleiding kun je indien gewenst ook kiezen voor een deeltijd invulling van 32 uur per week.

  • een goede begeleiding/coaching door ervaren psychiaters die jou graag de fijne knepen van het vak laten leren kennen en op wie je kan terugvallen bij vragen of om mee te sparren. Naast je werk als arts, volg je het lokale en regionale onderwijs, en is er ruimte onderzoek en beleid, als daar je interesse naar uit gaat.

  • een vakantietoeslag en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%.

  • 166 verlofuren en 35 levensfase-uren o.b.v. 36 uur. Zo willen we bijdragen aan een goede werk-privébalans.

  • een jaarlijks balansbudget van €1.000,- naar rato. Dit budget kun je besteden aan iets waar jij blij van wordt. Denk aan een cursus, extra salaris of verlofuren, aan jou de keuze.

Boven alles bieden we je een uitdagende en afwisselende baan met de ruimte om jezelf professioneel en persoonlijk te ontwikkelen via opleidingen, trainingen en interne scholing.

Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn conform de CAO GGZ. Heb je vragen? Laat het ons weten.

Dit breng je mee

Vooropgesteld is jouw affiniteit met de psychiatrie. De doelgroep, de casuïstiek en de ontwikkelingen in dit brede werkveld spreken jouw interesse buitengewoon aan. Eigenschappen als betrokkenheid, flexibiliteit, nieuwsgierigheid en proactiviteit helpen jou het beste uit jezelf en jouw specialisatieopleiding te halen. Kortom, je bent er klaar voor om jezelf als basisarts te ontplooien binnen de psychiatrie en je te ontwikkelen tot een vakman of vakvrouw pur sang.

Belangrijk: Enige werkervaring (minimaal 1 jaar) is aan te raden, alvorens je solliciteert. De keuze voor de psychiatrie is dan echt op ervaring gestoeld, en tevens neem je je werkervaring dan mee in de opleiding.

Wie zijn wij?

Bij GGz Centraal rekenen elk jaar zo’n 25.000 patiënten op ons als de specialist in geestelijke gezondheidszorg. Samen met bijna 3.000 collega’s willen we elke dag het verschil maken voor onze patiënten. Dit doen we door strategisch te verbinden, te blijven innoveren en als collega’s op elkaar te bouwen. Zo werken we samen aan de ggz van nu én van morgen. Meer weten over onze strategische koers? Je leest het hier.
Wist je dat?

  • GGz Centraal is één van de grootste A-opleiders van Nederland. Didi Rhebergen (psychiater en hoofdopleider) is de A-opleider van GGz Centraal. Arjan Schröder (psychiater en opleider) is de plaatsvervangend A-opleider.

  • Wij hebben voor de beste onderwijsprestatie De Grote Klimaatprijs in huis. De Grote Klimaatprijs erkent aios die zich het afgelopen jaar extra hebben ingezet voor een positief opleidingsklimaat. Een goede leeromgeving wordt niet alleen door opleiders gecreëerd, maar ook door supervisoren, het secretariaat en de aios zelf. Deze prijs benadrukt hoe belangrijk de gezamenlijke inspanning is voor een optimaal leerklimaat.

  • Door de grootte van onze organisatie en de verscheidenheid aan disciplines kunnen wij specialistische stages aanbieden. Denk aan stages op het terrein van kinder- en jeugdpsychiatrie, ouderenpsychiatrie, verslavingszorg en neuropsychiatrie. Ook zijn er verschillende mogelijkheden binnen ons gespecialiseerde Centrum voor Psychotherapie. Het behalen van je ECT-licentie behoort tevens tot de mogelijkheden.

Solliciteren

Wij komen graag met jou in contact. Face to face met een kop koffie erbij, telefonisch, via beeldbellen of gewoon even snel via LinkedIn. Je motivatiebrief mag je richten aan Didi Rhebergen (psychiater en hoofdopleider) en Arjan Schröder (psychiater en opleider).

Wil je meer informatie over de vacature? Bel of app dan naar 06 519 841 99. Uiteraard kan je ook contact opnemen via de mail: a-opleiding@ggzcentraal.nl Zij nemen graag de tijd voor je!

De vacature heeft geen sluitingsdatum. Gedurende het hele jaar kun je jouw belangstelling voor een opleidingsplaats kenbaar maken. De selectiegesprekken worden doorlopend gepland. De instroommomenten zijn in april en oktober.

Uitgebreide informatie over de sollicitatieprocedure kun je hier vinden.


Een referentiecheck is onderdeel van ons aannamebeleid. Bij indiensttreding vragen we je om een actuele Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG). Wij vragen deze voor je aan en vergoeden de kosten.

Leer ons kennen

Zowel jong als oud kan bij ons terecht voor behandelingen in de generalistische basis ggz (gb-ggz) en specialistische ggz (s-ggz). We zijn gespecialiseerd in het behandelen van lichte tot matige klachten die te maken hebben met depressie, angststoornissen, trauma, ADHD, autisme en somatisch-symptoomstoornissen. Het verminderen van klachten is echter niet het enige waaraan wij werken: bij iedere behandeling zorgen we ervoor dat mensen groeien in hun zelfredzaamheid en weer de regie over hun eigen leven kunnen oppakken, ongeacht hun leeftijd. Klik hier als je meer wilt weten over Mentaal Beter.

Over Mental Care Group

Mentaal Beter, HSK en Opdidakt zijn allemaal onderdeel van Mental Care Group. Met meer dan 2000 medewerkers door het land zetten wij ons iedere dag in om de beste zorg te bieden aan onze cliënten, van jong tot oud en van Groningen tot Maastricht. Samen staan wij sterk voor een mentaal gezond, vitaal en veerkrachtig Nederland. Meer weten over Mental Care Group? Je leest het hier.

Binnen Mentaal Beter streven we naar een harmonieuze samenwerking tussen verschillende individuen, disciplines en expertises. Het is daarom belangrijk dat je innovatief bent, openstaat voor nieuwe ontwikkelingen en het leuk vindt hierover mee te denken. Daarnaast vinden we de volgende punten belangrijk:

title: KREASI Inclusive Education Specialist
description:
ROLE PURPOSE

The Inclusive Education Specialist provides technical expertise and quality assurance for KREASI’s Inclusive Education package. Based at the national level, the role ensures the technical quality, coherence, and effectiveness of inclusive education approaches across implementing partners and provinces.

The Specialist leads the design, adaptation, and quality assurance of inclusive education approaches and technical resources, including teacher professional development, classroom accommodations, disability identification, Child Functioning Module (CFM), Student Needs Action Pack (SNAP), and support to Unit Layanan Disabilitas (ULD). The role also provides technical support to strengthen the integration of disability inclusion and GEDSI across relevant KREASI packages.

The Specialist provides technical support to implementing partners and provincial teams through training, coaching, mentoring, technical guidance, and quality assurance to ensure the effective implementation of inclusive education approaches. The Specialist also provides technical direction and coordination to the GEDSI Consultant working under the Inclusive Education function.

Under the direction of the Education Manager, the role works closely with KREASI technical teams, implementing partners, government counterparts, OPDs, and other stakeholders to strengthen inclusive education practices and systems. The Specialist also contributes to research, learning, stakeholder engagement, and policy discussions to promote evidence-based and sustainable approaches to inclusive education.


KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY

Technical Leadership and Oversight

  • Provide technical expertise and support for the design and implementation of KREASI’s inclusive education approach, ensuring alignment with Save the Children standards, national education priorities, and disability rights principles.
  • Contribute to the development of technical guidance, standards, tools, and resources for inclusive and disability-inclusive education, including disability identification, classroom accommodations, inclusive pedagogy, and inclusive approaches to Catch-up Clubs.
  • Provide technical support for the implementation of the Child Functioning Module (CFM) to assess functional difficulties among children enrolled in Catch-up Clubs, and support the application of recommendations from the Student Needs Action Pack (SNAP) in classroom practice.
  • Support the development, adaptation, and rollout of the Inclusive Education teacher professional development package, including training materials, coaching tools, and practical resources for classroom support, drawing on relevant lessons and good practices from INOVASI.
  • Provide technical support for the development of KKG community of practice modules on inclusive education and GEDSI.
  • Contribute to the development of technical assistance approaches for Unit Layanan Disabilitas (ULD), including guidance on assistive technology, low-tech classroom accommodations, and disability rights-based approaches to inclusive education.
  • Support the integration of GEDSI and disability-inclusive approaches into School-based Child Protection (SBCP) mechanisms.

Support to Local Implementing Partners

  • Provide technical assistance to implementing partners on the design and delivery of inclusive education activities, including disability-inclusive classroom practices and reasonable accommodations.
  • Support partners to assess their capacity on inclusive education and identify areas for targeted technical assistance and capacity strengthening.
  • Develop and deliver training, coaching, mentoring, and other technical support to partners, government counterparts, teachers, and relevant education stakeholders on inclusive education.
  • Support KREASI provincial teams to provide quality technical assistance to implementing partners on inclusive education.
  • Provide technical feedback and support to partners to ensure inclusive education activities are implemented in line with agreed technical standards and program requirements.

Quality Assurance and Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and apply quality assurance mechanisms for inclusive education activities, tools, training, and technical assistance.
  • Review and provide technical feedback on inclusive education materials, modules, training packages, and implementation plans developed by KREASI and its partners.
  • Monitor implementation progress and identify technical challenges, risks, and areas requiring additional support.
  • Contribute to the review and improvement of inclusive education approaches based on implementation experience and evidence.

Coordination and Collaboration

  • Coordinate closely with KREASI technical teams, including TPD, PPD, Child Protection, Ecosystem, and MEAL teams, to ensure inclusive education is integrated across relevant program components.
  • Work closely with the MEAL team to ensure appropriate inclusive education indicators, disability-disaggregated data, and learning questions are incorporated into monitoring and evaluation activities.
  • Support coordination with the INOVASI-KREASI technical working group on inclusive education and contribute to technical learning and exchange.
  • Build and maintain working relationships with government counterparts, organizations of persons with disabilities (OPDs), academic institutions, parent groups, and other relevant stakeholders to support inclusive education implementation.

GEDSI Consultant Coordination

  • Provide day-to-day technical direction and coordination to the GEDSI Consultant to ensure alignment of GEDSI-related work with KREASI’s inclusive education approach.
  • Support the GEDSI Consultant in planning, prioritizing, and delivering technical outputs, and provide regular technical feedback and guidance.
  • Work with the Education Manager and/or REALM Manager on performance support and other matters requiring management-level oversight.
  • Budget management, contracting, and invoice approval for the GEDSI Consultant remain with the designated manager.
Stakeholder Engagement and Technical Representation
  • Support engagement with government stakeholders and relevant education partners on inclusive education, disability inclusion, and related technical issues.
  • Provide technical input to meetings, workshops, technical working groups, and other forums related to inclusive education, as delegated.
  • Support the development of technical inputs for policy discussions, advocacy activities, research products, and policy briefs related to inclusive education.
  • Contribute technical perspectives and evidence to support KREASI’s engagement with national and sub-national stakeholders on inclusive education.

Monitoring, Learning, and Adaptation

  • Support partners and KREASI teams to establish practical systems for monitoring the implementation and quality of inclusive education activities.
  • Collaborate with the KREASI MEAL team to monitor inclusive education outcomes and generate evidence to inform program adaptation and improvement.
  • Document implementation experiences, lessons learned, promising practices, and challenges related to inclusive education.
  • Contribute to research and learning activities related to inclusive education, including identifying relevant learning questions and supporting evidence generation.
  • Support the development of learning products, case studies, technical briefs, and other knowledge products to share lessons and good practices on inclusive education.
  • Facilitate learning exchange among KREASI teams, implementing partners, government stakeholders, OPDs, and other relevant actors.

Reporting and Documentation

  • Contribute to KREASI’s Results Framework reporting, donor reports, and internal updates on inclusive education activities and results.
  • Provide regular technical updates on implementation progress, technical assistance, capacity strengthening, and key learning related to inclusive education.
  • Ensure accurate and timely documentation of inclusive education activities, achievements, challenges, lessons learned, and recommendations.
  • Review and provide technical input to inclusive education sections of program reports and other relevant documentation.

Compliance, Safeguarding, and Representation

  • Ensure inclusive education activities comply with Save the Children and KREASI policies, including safeguarding, risk management, inclusion, and disability rights standards.
  • Promote inclusive and respectful practices in all interactions with children, persons with disabilities, partners, government counterparts, and other stakeholders.
  • Support responsible representation of Save the Children and KREASI in technical forums and engagements related to inclusive education, as delegated.

General

  • Carry out other tasks assigned by the Education Manager, Head of Programs, or Chief of Party.
  • Ensure adherence to Save the Children policies on child protection, code of conduct, health and safety, equal opportunities, and other relevant standards.
  • In the event of a major humanitarian emergency, the role holder may be required to work outside normal duties and adjust working hours as needed, including temporary deployment to affected areas.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in Education, Inclusive or Special Education, Disability Studies, Social Sciences, or a related field with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience (or a Master's degree with at least 3 years), including experiences in inclusive or disability-inclusive education programs.
  • Demonstrated experience in inclusive education practices, including disability-inclusive pedagogy, classroom accommodations, and supporting children with disabilities.
  • Familiarity with disability identification and functional assessment tools, such as the Child Functioning Module (CFM), Washington Group tools, or comparable approaches.
  • Good understanding of Indonesia’s education system, inclusive education policies, and disability inclusion, including familiarity with Unit Layanan Disabilitas (ULD).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia and English, including the ability to develop technical materials, reports, and presentations.
  • Strong interpersonal and facilitation skills, with the ability to work collaboratively and provide technical support to partners and colleagues.

    Desirable:
  • Experience working with ULDs, OPDs, or disability-focused organizations.
  • Experience developing or adapting teacher professional development modules, coaching tools, or other technical resources related to inclusive education
  • Familiarity with assistive technology and practical classroom accommodations for children with disabilities.

description:
About the job

Mid SRE DevOps Engineer (Spain)

A quick note about the role: Since 2026, Xplicity has been part of the Present Connection group, bringing our teams and technology communities closer together and creating more opportunities for talented professionals across both companies. Although this opportunity is shared through the Xplicity community, the position is with Present Connection, and the successful candidate will join the Present Connection team.

Present Connectionis an international technology partner with offices in Lithuania, the Netherlands, and Spain. For more than 14 years, we have worked with companies across Europe, combining software engineering expertise with a strong understanding of business and technology. We bring together experienced technology specialists with a drive to experiment, explore new possibilities, and find better ways forward. We believe technology is more than something businesses use. It can change how they work, grow, and compete. That's why we work alongside our clients to challenge existing ways of working and build solutions that move their business forward.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Mid engineer with a strong inclination towards Site Reliability Engineering to join one of the largest internet service providers in Europe. Your main focus will be on monitoring services, servers and devices -- you will join the SMSA (Service Monitoring, Service Assurance) squad, working on managing, enhancing, and implementing monitoring solutions, both third-party industrial-standard software and in-house developed ones.

The top priority for the team is to support mission-critical systems in an operational state and perform maintenance of monitoring solutions and services.

The position involves working within one dedicated team of engineers across several sub-projects within the client's organization, including managing both passive and proactive monitoring platforms, supporting pipelines, and reacting on incidents.

The work scope is not limited to support and maintenance. Due to the vast nature of the existing networks and multiple solutions, it is essential to pursue a policy of unification -- the team has the power to affect the solutions' landscape and push improvements that bring a positive impact on the stability and efficiency of network operations.

This is a flexible role rather than a single fixed project -- you'll work against an evolving backlog of monitoring and service assurance initiatives, and your exact focus areas will be shaped around your strengths as you settle into the team.

  • Understanding of active monitoring suites (Selenium, Playwright)

What We Offer

title: Director, Communications, ISC
description:
When you join Honeywell Technologies, you become a member of our global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers and doers who keep the world's most essential industries running. From energy and manufacturing to logistics and critical infrastructure, our solutions make operations safer, smarter and more sustainable.

The Director, Communications, Integrated Supply Chain (ISC) serves as the communications leader for Honeywell Technologies’ global Integrated Supply Chain function. This individual is responsible for developing and executing an integrated communications strategy spanning internal and external communications, executive communications, change communications, leadership visibility, digital communications, organizational storytelling and reputation support.

Reporting to the Vice President, Communications, Corporate and Functions, this individual will serve as the primary communications partner to the Senior Vice President and Chief ISC Officer. The role is based in Charlotte, North Carolina. The Director will provide strategic counsel, translate business priorities into clear and compelling narratives, and deliver communications that build awareness, deepen understanding and inspire action across Honeywell Technologies’ global supply chain organization.

The role will connect ISC priorities to Honeywell Technologies’ broader strategy and transformation agenda, helping employees understand where the organization is going, why it matters and how their work contributes. The Director will develop cohesive messaging across corporate ISC, business supply chain teams, regions and sites, with particular emphasis on reaching frontline manufacturing employees and equipping leaders and people managers to communicate effectively.

As part of an integrated Brand and Communications function, this individual will work closely with communications Centers of Excellence and business communications partners to align employee and external narratives, identify opportunities for proactive storytelling, reinforce the Honeywell Technologies brand and ensure consistent execution across channels. The Director will also partner with key functions to lead communications for organizational change, transformation initiatives and issues affecting employees.

Fluency in AI, analytics and modern communications practices is essential as this leader helps transform how ISC communications are planned, delivered and measured. This individual will have outstanding written and verbal communication skills, strong business acumen and the ability to work effectively in a global, matrixed environment with rapidly shifting priorities.

Key Responsibilities:

• Lead the development and execution of an integrated communications strategy for the global Integrated Supply Chain organization, aligning employee, executive, digital, change and storytelling programs with ISC and Honeywell Technologies priorities.
• Serve as the primary communications advisor to the Senior Vice President and Chief ISC Officer, providing strategic counsel on leadership communications, employee engagement, external communications, organizational positioning, transformation, reputation and emerging issues.
• Translate ISC strategy, operational priorities and business performance into clear, compelling and accessible narratives for internal and external stakeholders.
• Lead employee communications and engagement programs that strengthen culture, reinforce safety, quality, customer focus and operational excellence, and help employees understand how their work contributes to company performance.
• Lead the strategy on how to leverage the officer’s presence externally in coordination with the Media COE.
• Build communications approaches that effectively reach a global and diverse ISC workforce, including frontline manufacturing employees, office-based employees, regional teams and functional experts.
• Develop and execute communications strategies for major ISC transformations, organizational changes, leadership transitions, operating-model changes and other significant initiatives, ensuring timely, coordinated and thoughtful stakeholder engagement.
• Equip ISC leaders, site leaders and people managers with messaging, toolkits, templates, training and guidance that enable effective communication through their organizations.
• Identify and develop stories for internal and external channels that demonstrate ISC’s impact on customers, growth, innovation, resilience, safety, quality, manufacturing excellence, digital transformation and operational performance.
• Oversee the strategy, content and execution of ISC leadership meetings, town halls, employee campaigns, recognition programs, digital channels and other key engagement moments.
• Use stakeholder feedback, channel analytics and business insights to measure communications effectiveness, identify gaps and continuously improve programs.
• Champion AI-enabled communications practices, tools and analytics that improve productivity, audience relevance, content development, measurement and business impact.
• Advocate for the Honeywell Technologies brand and serve as a visible brand ambassador across the ISC organization.
• People leadership. This role will have one direct report.

You must have:
• Minimum of 10 years of experience in corporate communications or a closely related field
• Demonstrated experience in communications and executive partnership
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to develop and deliver executive-level content
• Experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment managing multiple competing priorities

We value:
• Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing or a related field
• Experience supporting C-suite communications and events in a large, complex, international corporate environment
• Experience with manufacturing and supply chain, especially with a global lens
• Strong project management capabilities with the ability to simultaneously manage multiple events and communications workstreams
• Intimate understanding of internal and external communications channels, including LinkedIn, intranet platforms and enterprise tools such as Viva Engage, and how to leverage them to promote employee engagement
• Excellent verbal communication skills and the ability to present effectively to senior management.
• Strong business acumen and the ability to build and navigate relationships at all levels of the organization, particularly at the executive level
• Self-starter with ability to thrive in a matrix organizational structure where priorities can shift quickly.
• Strong (AP style) writing skills, with the ability to develop clear, concise messages that align closely with corporate messaging
• A willingness to challenge the status quo, think creatively, and take intelligent risks in raising the bar on event and communications quality across Honeywell Technologies

title: Director of Finance and Administration, Jerusalem (national contract)
description:
Location: Jerusalem,Jerusalem District,Israel

Location: Jerusalem (frequent travels to the West Bank)
Contract duration: 5 years (possibility of extension)
Contract: national contract
Reports to: LWF Representative in Jerusalem, technical supervision by the Head of World Service Finance and Support Functions (Geneva-based)
Starting date: end of 2026 / beginning of 2027

The Applicant must hold a Jerusalem ID.

Lutheran World Federation (LWF) World Service
LWF World Service is the humanitarian and development arm of the Lutheran World Federation. We are a widely recognized, international, faith-based organization working in more than 20 countries globally. We seek to bring people of all backgrounds together in the common quest for justice, peace, and reconciliation in an increasingly complex and fragmented world. A commitment to the human rights of every individual, regardless of their status, guides our work, actions, and operations. We are particularly known for our timely, compassionate, and professional humanitarian work, and for our field presence in hard-to-reach areas. Our work is people-centered and community-based. Above all, we work with the most vulnerable, and to claim and uphold their rights, we engage proactively with local government and community structures. For additional information, please see LWF World Service.

LWF has been present in Jerusalem since 1950, serving Palestinians through healthcare, education, and humanitarian programs. Today, the Jerusalem program operates the Augusta Victoria Hospital (AVH), a leading referral hospital for Palestinians from the West Bank and Gaza, as well as vocational training centers in Jerusalem and Ramallah. In line with its humanitarian mandate, LWF is also expanding its emergency response and development programming. For additional information, please see LWF Jerusalem.

Purpose
The Director of Finance and Administration is a senior level position and provides strategic leadership and oversight of all financial, administrative, procurement, logistics, and property management functions across LWF Jerusalem programs. This includes responsibility for the financial management of Augusta Victoria Hospital, vocational training centers, humanitarian and development projects, and any future program expansions, ensuring compliance, accountability, operational efficiency, and sound stewardship of resources. The position may assume the responsibilities and authority of the Representative during periods of absence, when designated by the LWF Representative, ensuring continuity of leadership, organizational oversight, and external representation as required.

Required Qualifications
University degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
A relevant postgraduate qualification or professional certification (e.g., CPA, CMA, ACCA, CIA) is an advantage.

Knowledge and Experience
Minimum 10 years of progressively responsible experience in finance, administration, operations, human resources, including senior leadership responsibility.
Significant experience within an INGO, hospital or healthcare institution, humanitarian / development organization, or other complex mission driven organization.
Leadership experience in finance, HR, procurement, administration, and operational support functions.
Strong expertise in financial management, budgeting, reporting, risk management, and compliance.
Knowledge of procurement, contract management, IFRS, and relevant legal and regulatory requirements.
Proven ability to drive organizational effectiveness, change management, and process improvement.
Strong people leadership, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.
Excellent strategic thinking, decision-making, communication, and problem-solving abilities.
Experience managing complex operations, multiple priorities, and cross-functional teams in diverse environments.

Language Skills
English and Arabic: fluency required
Hebrew: working knowledge is a strong advantage

LWF Core Skills
Analytical thinking - resource level*
Achieving results - advanced level
Accountability - resource level
Initiative - advanced level
Leadership - resource level
Working effectively with others - resource level

LWF Functional Skills
Strategic thinking - resource level
Resource Mobilization - advanced level
Stakeholder Management - resource level
Networking - advanced level
People Management - resource level
Innovation - advanced level

*LWF 3 skills levels are: basis - advanced – resource

Main Duties
Direct Financial Accountability and Strategic Oversight for all LWF Jerusalem Program operations, including Augusta Victoria Hospital (AVH), the Vocational Training Centre (VTC), and Property Management.

Financial Leadership and Management
Provide strategic leadership and oversight of the financial management of all LWF Jerusalem Program entities.
Lead the annual budgeting process and ensure alignment of financial plans with organizational priorities and strategic objectives.
Oversee financial performance, reviewing income, expenditure, and financial trends against approved budgets and targets.
Review, analyze, and present monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports to senior management, offering recommendations for informed decision-making.
Ensure effective cash flow management, financial sustainability, and the organization's ability to meet its financial obligations.
Lead financial forecasting and scenario planning, identifying financial risks and opportunities and advising leadership accordingly.
Direct and supervise the accounting, treasury, payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and financial reporting functions, ensuring efficient and compliant operations.
Ensure robust internal controls, financial systems, and accountability mechanisms are in place and function effectively.
Develop, implement, and periodically review financial policies, procedures, and operational guidelines to ensure compliance with organizational requirements, donor regulations, and international standards.
Provide leadership and capacity development to finance teams, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Serve as a strategic adviser to the Representative, Executive Leadership Team, and governing bodies on financial matters, resource allocation, and long-term financial planning.

Advisory Boards and Management Reporting.
Provide the LWF senior management team with clear financial information.
Prepare financial reports for the Advisory Boards and the AVH Finance Committee meetings.
Help leadership evaluate the financial implications of new programs or projects.

Grants and Restricted Funding
Track grants and restricted funds.
Ensure expenditures comply with grant agreements and donor restrictions.
Oversee financial reports required by funders and monitor grant budgets and deadlines.

Audit, Compliance, Internal Controls, and Risk Management
Lead coordination of external and internal financial audits and other assurance reviews.
Ensure timely implementation and monitoring of audit recommendations.
Maintain a robust internal control framework safeguarding organizational resources and assets.
Ensure appropriate segregation of duties, authorization controls, bank reconciliations, procurement controls, and financial monitoring.
Establish mechanisms for identifying, assessing, monitoring and mitigating financial and operational risks.
Ensure compliance with applicable LWF policies, donor requirements, accounting standards.
Ensure proper financial documentation and records are maintained.
Ensure appropriate compliance with applicable labor laws, taxation, National Insurance, pension, employee benefits and other statutory requirements.
Promote fraud-prevention, accountability and ethical resource-management practices.
Ensure appropriate insurance coverage and risk-transfer arrangements for organizational assets and operations.
Regularly advise senior management regarding material financial, compliance and operational risks.

Administration, Procurement, Logistics & Property Maintenance
Provide strategic oversight of procurement, logistics, administration, property/facilities management and related support services.
Ensure transparent, competitive and cost-effective procurement systems consistent with LWF and donor requirements.
Oversee tendering, contracting, vendor management, and procurement planning.
Oversee administrative systems, office/facility services, maintenance and related operational support.
Promote environmentally responsible, efficient and sustainable use of organizational facilities and resources.
Ensure appropriate records management and document retention systems.
Develop, review and continuously improve administrative, procurement and operational policies and procedures.

Human Resources and Organizational Development
Ensure appropriate oversight of payroll governance, personnel-related financial obligations, and workforce cost planning as part of the organization's overall financial management framework.

Digital Transformation, Systems and Process Improvement
Lead modernization, digitalization and continuous improvement of Finance and Support Function processes.
Promote integrated management-information systems and reliable data to support timely management decision-making.
Identify opportunities to automate administrative and financial processes, reduce duplication and improve efficiency.
Ensure appropriate controls, accountability and data governance are incorporated into digital processes.
Promote organizational learning and appropriate adoption of emerging technologies.

Leadership and People Management for the Finance Department
Provide leadership to the HR function when delegated by the LWF Representative.
Establish clear objectives, responsibilities, performance standards and accountability mechanisms for supervised functions.
Build management and technical capacity within Finance and promote succession planning and knowledge transfer.
Ensure adequate staffing structures and appropriate segregation of duties within Finance and Support Functions.

title: Analyst - Revenue Management
description:
About Wynn Al Marjan Island:

On schedule to open in the United Arab Emirates in 2027, Wynn Al Marjan Island has been created as an opulent and entertaining beachside destination for discerning guests to play and relax. Located less than 50 miles from Dubai International Airport, this integrated resort offering 1,530 rooms and suites, 22 restaurants and lounges, a theater, nightclub, and five-star spa is currently under construction on a picturesque island that gracefully curves into the Arabian Gulf.

About the Position:

Wynn Al Marjan Island is currently seeking a Revenue Analyst to join the resort’s Revenue Management team.

The primary duties and responsibilities of this role are:

  • Analyze Booking Trends by Channel: Monitor and interpret booking pace, booking window, length of stay, regrets and denials, channel performance, and demand patterns to identify revenue opportunities and support pricing strategies.

  • Channel Mix Optimization: Analyze production, profitability, acquisition costs, and booking behaviour across all distribution channels to optimize channel mix and maximize net revenue.
  • Track Competitor Rates and Market Performance: Conduct regular competitive benchmarking and rate shopping to evaluate market positioning, identify pricing opportunities, and monitor competitor strategies.
  • Group Displacement & Business Evaluation: Perform group displacement analyses to evaluate the revenue impact of group opportunities versus transient demand and support group pricing and acceptance decisions. This aligns with Revenue Management's role in occupancy impact, displacement, and rate evaluation.
  • Forecast Demand and Revenue Performance: Analyze historical, current, and future booking trends to forecast occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, room revenue, and other key business metrics.
  • Executive Reporting & Performance Analysis: Prepare and present executive-level reports, dashboards, and insights on business performance, market trends, forecast accuracy, and revenue opportunities to support strategic decision-making.
  • Manage Rates, Inventory, and Data Integrity: Maintain accurate rates, restrictions, and inventory across all distribution channels and systems while performing audits to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
  • Support Pricing and Revenue Strategies: Provide analytical recommendations for pricing, inventory controls, promotions, segmentation, and demand management initiatives to maximize revenue and profitability.
  • Develop Business Intelligence and Reporting Tools: Create, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and analytical models using Excel, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and other business intelligence tools.

  • Provide Cross-Functional Commercial Support: Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Distribution teams by providing data-driven insights and recommendations that support commercial objectives and revenue growth

About You:

The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:

  • Minimum 2-5 years of experience in Revenue Management, Pricing, Forecasting, preferably within a luxury hotel or integrated resort environment.
  • Strong knowledge of forecasting methodologies, demand planning, budgeting, long-range planning, and business performance analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining monthly, quarterly, annual, and long-range revenue forecasts and budgets.
  • Strong understanding of pricing strategy, inventory controls, demand management, market segmentation, and revenue optimization principles.
  • Experience performing group displacement analysis, transient demand analysis, and evaluating the profitability of group and negotiated business.
  • Experience producing executive reports, performance presentations, and strategic recommendations for senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of key hotel revenue metrics including Occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, TRevPAR, Net ADR, Revenue Index, Market Penetration Index (MPI), ARI, and RGI.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data modeling, Power Query, Pivot Tables, scenario analysis, and forecasting models.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to effectively convey insights to executive leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.

About Wynn Al Marjan Island’s Benefits:

We offer an attractive salary, paid in Dirhams (AED), the local currency of the UAE. title: Behavioural Science Consultant
description:
About Samsung Food (Whisk)

At Samsung Food (you might know us as Whisk), we are pioneering the future of everyday care and health — helping individuals and families around the world live better through connected, proactive, and personalized experiences. Our mission is to connect food, health, and home across the Samsung ecosystem, turning data from your devices into personalized guidance that supports you and your loved ones.

We work at the intersection of AI, nutrition, behavior change, and digital health. The Samsung Food app was included in Google Play’s Best of 2020 Everyday Essentials list, has been regularly featured on the Apple App Store, and was nominated for a 2021 Webby Award. We’ve also launched Vision AI, which recognises food and meals using our global Food Genome, and developed deep integrations with Samsung Health and SmartThings.

We are a remote-first team of more than 100 people in over 30 countries, united by our commitment to innovation and impact. As part of Samsung Electronics, we combine the agility of a startup with the scale of the world’s largest consumer electronics company. Join us and help build technology that improves daily life for tens of millions of people across phones, wearables, TVs, and kitchen appliances in the years to come.

Learn more about how we’ve shaped a high-performing global team over the past 14 years.

Summary

Project Overview

We're looking for a behavioural-science specialist to take ownership of a set of currently unratified behavioural parameters inside an AI-powered weight management coaching engine, and to help shape the engagement mechanics (nudges, loop design) that sit on top of it. This is a fixed-scope consulting engagement structured around five defined deliverable milestones, not an ongoing support role.

You'll be working against a live backlog of flagged parameters across the engine's logic and content files, reviewing agent behaviour against COM-B and related behaviour-change frameworks, and helping design the daily/weekly engagement loops for a beta product surface. You'll work closely with our product managers and content team, and review material coming in from specialist freelance writers across a range of target behaviours. We have clinical reviewers on the team who handle medical safety sign-off directly — this is a behavioural science role, not a medical one: you're assessing whether the logic holds up against behaviour-change theory, not making clinical calls yourself.

Primary project deliverable: Close the provisional-parameter backlog to "no unowned parameters" in the shipped coaching engine, delivered as:

- A completed ratification register (item, decision, evidence, standing).

- Reviewed and edited the instructions that guide the engine's decision-making steps — working out a user's overall coaching approach, spotting the gap between where they are and their goal, deciding what to act on, and turning that into the message the user actually sees;

- A behavioural-guardrail evidence pass, confirming the product's safety-adjacent behavioural patterns are backed by real evidence;

- Flagging and framing anything that needs medical sign-off — the specific question, the options, and your recommended read — ready for the internal team to batch and route;

- An agreed pass bar and scored golden set for a set of currently uncalibrated evaluation criteria;

- Nudge/engagement-loop design recommendations for the beta surfaces.

- Behavioural sign-off on intervention contracts as they arrive from the freelance programme — barrier framing, and alignment with our internal behaviour-change model — across our full set of target behaviours.

Success metric/acceptance standard:

All seven deliverables above are complete: flagged items in the register carry a cited decision, a replacement value, or are flagged and framed for medical sign-off; the engine's decision-making steps have delivered, reviewed diffs; the evaluation criteria carry an agreed pass bar and a scored golden set; items needing medical sign-off are flagged and framed on a standing basis, ready for the internal team to batch and route; review turnaround on shipped engine changes is ≤2 working days, measured weekly; and all target-behaviour intervention contracts have received a behavioural sign-off (approved, sent back with named revisions, or escalated) within 5 working days of receipt.

Project Milestones

1. Finish reviewing the highest-priority behavioural rules and settings. Clear out any pending contract reviews. Flag and frame the first batch of items needing medical sign-off, ready for routing, by 15 Nov 2026.

2. Finish checking the behavioural guardrails. Agree on a scoring system for the review criteria and test it on sample cases, by 15 Dec 2026.

3. Finish reviewing the engine's decision-making steps. Clear all flagged items in the main settings files. Finish the engagement/nudge design work. Sign off on the remaining behaviour-contract reviews, by 15 Jan 2027.

4. Finish reviewing how the system performs with real (beta) users. Make sure nothing is left unreviewed, by 15 Feb 2027.

5. Update the review scoring system using real user data. Clear every review queue completely, by 15 Apr 2027.

What This Role Does Not Cover

- Final medical sign-off, and the batching/routing of flagged items to the clinical reviewer (owned internally) — you flag and frame what needs review, we handle the rest

- Content authoring (freelance specialists own first-draft writing)

- Final product or engineering decisions

Engagement Details

Structure: Hourly, with a weekly hours cap (max 20 hours). The five milestones are review points where we confirm progress

Duration: 6-month term

Location: Meaningful overlap with UK/CET working hours is preferred

What We're Looking For

- Strong grounding in behaviour-change theory (COM-B or equivalent), ideally with a research background

- Demonstrated experience evaluating or designing behavioural loops, nudges, or habit-forming product mechanics — not theory alone

- Comfortable working with structured, protocol-style content (reasoning rules, decision trees) rather than writing consumer-facing copy

- Experience working with cross-functional product/engineering teams on shipped features

Application Notes

Please share examples of behavioural frameworks you've applied to a shipped product feature.

title: Assistant Superintendent
description:
Assistant Superintendent

About Vertical Mechanical Group (VMG)

Vertical Mechanical Group (VMG) is a leading mechanical contractor specializing in commercial HVAC, Plumbing, Piping, and Mechanical Construction. What You'll Do

Support Field Operations

  • Support project activities from startup through closeout, including sequencing and field coordination

  • Track field activities, subcontractor work, and project-related information

  • Work closely with the Superintendent and project team to resolve field challenges efficiently

Manage Planning & Documentation

  • Complete and maintain accurate daily reports, timesheets, job logs, and other required documentation
  • Review drawings, specifications, schedules, and project requirements
  • Maintain organized and accurate project documentation
  • Assist with tracking costs, invoices, subcontractor activities, and project progress
  • Support project closeout documentation and coordination

Support & Develop the Team

  • Assist with leading and coordinating field crews and subcontractors

  • Promote accountability, teamwork, and strong communication across the jobsite
  • Lead by example and help maintain a respectful, results-driven work environment
  • Continue developing the leadership and technical skills needed to advance into a Superintendent role

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in commercial construction
  • Commercial HVAC, Plumbing, Mechanical, or MEP experience strongly preferred
  • Experience supporting field crews and day-to-day jobsite operations
  • Understanding of construction scheduling, sequencing, manpower planning, and field coordination
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and project documents
  • Strong communication, organization, leadership, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced construction environment
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and construction/project management technology
  • OSHA 30 preferred or willingness to obtain
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working on large commercial mechanical construction projects
  • Hands-on experience with HVAC, plumbing, piping, or related mechanical systems
  • Previous experience as a Foreman, Lead Mechanic, Project Engineer, or similar construction role
  • Experience coordinating field activities with Superintendents, Project Managers, general contractors, subcontractors, and other trades
  • Interest in developing into a Superintendent or other field leadership position

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation based on experience
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
  • Opportunities to advance into Superintendent and other field leadership roles
  • The opportunity to work on challenging commercial mechanical projects
  • A collaborative, team-oriented environment where your experience and leadership make an impact

Why VMG?

At VMG, we believe strong field leadership is essential to delivering safe, high-quality projects and building successful teams.

As an Assistant Superintendent, you'll work alongside experienced construction leaders while gaining hands-on experience managing field operations, coordinating teams, solving jobsite challenges, and driving projects forward. You'll have the opportunity to expand your leadership skills and build a clear path toward greater responsibility within VMG.

If you're a motivated construction professional who understands the field and is ready to take the next step into project leadership, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply today and continue building your career with VMG.

VMG is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Head of Maths
description:
Organisation: Leicestershire County Council

Oakfield Short Stay School is Leicestershire’s provision for school aged children who have been permanently excluded from school. We have undergone a programme of significant growth and as a result we are recruiting more teaching staff. This role is to work as part of a growing specialist Maths team and will work across sites to deliver education to pupils who are at risk of exclusion, or who have been excluded from mainstream education. This is an exciting opportunity, and we look forward to welcoming you into a vibrant working environment that prioritises staff well-being and joy in the workplace, high-quality education, innovative practice, and a truly inclusive approach to educational design.

About the Role

This role is to teach Maths to groups of pupils who have diverse needs. We are looking for a person to teach in a creative, flexible, holistic, and trauma-informed manner, to raise engagement and drastically improve the outlook of student’s educational journey. As such, you will be at the heart of our mission.

The role would suit a teacher with excellent communication and interpersonal skills who can inspire others. Many of our young people present with challenging behaviour, and we are looking for someone who can demonstrate strong empathy and the ability to intrinsically connect with pupils with complex SEMH needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Teach and Inspire: Plan, prepare, and deliver engaging lessons to a small group of learners, fostering a love for learning.
  • Support Reintegration: Assist in reintegrating pupils back into mainstream schools, ensuring they receive the support they need and equipping them with the skills they need to be successful.
  • Collaborate with Agencies: Work closely with educational psychologists, SEN coordinators, and other external agencies to support pupil progress.
  • Promote Inclusion: Demonstrate a commitment to inclusion, ensuring all pupils feel valued and supported.

A DBS enhanced check for a regulated activity is required for this post.

For information on our approach to the recruitment of ex-offenders, please see our policy statement.

About You

To apply for this post, you must be able to evidence in your application how you meet the following criteria:

  • Qualified teacher status. A specialism in Maths would be preferable.
  • Experience of working with pupils with special educational needs in a secondary school, secondary pupil referral unit or special school.
  • Experience of teaching pupils with challenging social, emotion and mental health needs.
  • Experience of educational development and planning.
  • SEN legislation and county SEN policy and procedures
  • Ability to provide leadership and support to staff in providing high quality teaching.
  • Effective IT skills and the ability to use IT to develop service delivery and monitoring.

In addition, we also expect you to share our commitment to our values and to delivering accessible and inclusive services which meet the needs of all of our residents. You will be asked to demonstrate your understanding of these commitments as part of the selection process.

Reasonable adjustments will be considered for applicants with a disability. We are a Disability Confident Employer.

Interested in Flexible Working?

We are open to discussions about flexible working, which may include part time working, job sharing, term-time working, flexible start and finish times, and hybrid working, depending on the requirements of the role and the service. If you would like to discuss the possible flexible working options that might be applicable to this role, please contact the person named below.

For more information or an informal discussion, please contact:

Vicky Edwards - Executive Headteacher

Telephone: 07860611280

Email: Victoria.edwards@leics.gov.uk

How to Apply

At Leicestershire County Council we’re looking for top talent from all walks of life. Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, and whatever your background - we care about what you bring to our organisation, not just what’s on your CV.
