title: Senior Geophysicist
description:
Locations: Based Hereford, Silsoe, Cleckheaton or Boxworth. We will also consider candidates based at RSK Group offices, including Romsey, Didcot and Manchester. Regular travel to sites across the UK will be required.
Contract Type: Permanent (with 6 month probationary period)
Closing Date: November 6th 2026

Following the creation of a new Geophysics and Exploration section, Headland is expanding its geophysical survey team and recruiting experienced staff to meet its increasing project portfolio.

Do you want to be at the forefront of innovation and the development of geophysical survey techniques in the commercial field? Do you want to join a large team with a range of experience delivering nationally important and interesting projects throughout the United Kingdom and the EU?

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and we may fill existing vacancies before the closing date, so you are advised to submit your application as early as possible.

Why Should You Apply?
We are a privately owned archaeological business, part of the RSK Group, a leader in integrated environmental, engineering, and technical services. We provide heritage services to the development and construction sectors in UK and across the world. With four offices in England and one in Scotland, we offer our employees:
  • Unique knowledge and expertise. For the past 30 years, Headland has provided not only business-focused archaeology but also people-focused business. We are highly respected within our industry for our achievements in innovation, tailor-made development coaching and training, and our expertise in commercial archaeology.
  • Strong pioneering spirit. Our corporate culture is characterised by a healthy appetite for originality and development.
  • Stable company with excellent growth. Over the years, we have demonstrated steady, positive economic development and formed successful partnerships.
  • Good work environment. You will be surrounded by colleagues who are pleasant, professional, and enthusiastic about their work.
  • Opportunity to influence. You get to work in an open climate, close to decision makers and with the possibility of making a difference.
  • Part of RSK group. You will have further opportunities to become involved in nationally and internationally prominent projects with exciting prospects for career development. The group has c.17000 employees and c.230 environmentally lead companies.
We are looking for candidates who are self-driven with a positive outlook and excellent understanding of archaeological geophysics and British archaeology. The Senior Geophysicist role provides regular rotation between running geophysical surveys in the field and the office-based production of project documentation, reports, research and analysis. For surveys in the field, you will be responsible for day-to-day running of sites of all sizes including delivery of on-site activities, undertaking data collection, recording, quality control, SHEQ, on-site point of contact for client, archaeological advisor, and other stakeholders. You will have experience and knowledge of a range of techniques (magnetometer, electromagnetic, earth resistance, GPR) and be able to assist managers in supporting field and reporting teams on projects beyond those you are directly responsible for.

As part of the geophysical survey team you will get involved in several large and exciting projects across the UK and EU. We have many large-scale infrastructure projects throughout 2026, which include landscape wide 1000+ha sites and linear schemes. Working away and travelling in new places is a normal part of this role.

In Headland we are proud of our people. We will support you to your meet your goals and train you in specific archaeological and other skills to feel confident and succeed in your role.
Essential Key Skills
  • Be an accomplished geophysicist with a minimum of 3 years’ experience in commercial archaeological geophysics with at least 12 months at a Lead Geophysicist level,
  • Thorough knowledge of magnetometry
  • A sound knowledge of the principles of operation of the most frequently used geophysical survey equipment,
  • Sound understanding of all relevant policies and laws, and can discuss with team members, stakeholders, and clients how they might apply to a given situation on site,
  • Proficient in use and understanding of MS Office suite,
  • A relevant degree, or proven experience,
  • Full, valid driving licence and willingness to travel,
  • Sound knowledge of safe working practices for typical geophysical survey projects, competent at assessing and managing risk,
  • Good time and pressure management skills, ability to use your own initiative within the company structure,
  • Very good written and oral communication skills,
  • A desire to lead, develop and learn,
  • Experience of sole responsibility for geophysical survey projects of significant scale including survey logistics, data quality control, post-processing and reporting.,
  • An ability to support managers in their duties and assist with overseeing projects, producing paperwork and providing input to tenders
  • A willingness to travel, work on projects across the UK and when required stay on site and/or occasionally work weekends on geographically distant projects,
  • Experience in the use of commercially available survey processing and graphics packages such as QGIS.

Desirable Skills
  • Membership of the CIfA
  • Ability to motivate and help coordinate teams
  • An ability to carry out prolonged manual work in an outdoor environment
  • Ability to work under pressure and use your own initiative
  • SHEQ Accreditations (SSSTS, First aid, Asbestos Awareness, Lantra Sit Astride)
  • Competitive paid subsistence when applicable

title: Product Led - Growth Lead
description:
Zinc's committed contracts sell across SMB, mid-market and enterprise. Alongside them sits a substantial and fast-growing pay-as-you-go (PayG) revenue stream: mostly small organisations signing up to run checks on a credit card, self-serve. We have never tried to optimise this channel for growth or retention. It has succeeded organically regardless, become a meaningful contributor to revenue and customer base, and proven a reliable discovery route into future committed contracts.

This is a single senior owner for the PayG / Consumption Core: responsible for maximising ARR growth from PayG accounts, and acting as the internal champion, operational lead and strategic lead for the revenue stream. Broadly greenfield, with room for real, measurable impact.

You will start hands-on as an individual contributor, with scope to build a team as the channel scales.

What success looks like

  • ARR growth from PayG. Grow revenue from PayG accounts, covering both consumption revenue, conversion into committed contracts, and making sure we’re full utilising pay as you go and self serve as a marketing channel in it’s own right.
  • Retention. PayG accounts that stay and grow. Low churn, healthy expansion within the base.
  • A playbook. A repeatable, testable operating model for the channel that can be iterated and improved.
  • Own the PayG GTM with Marketing, Partnerships and sales: focussing on messaging, channel growth and conversion to improve customer acquisition.
  • Demo conversion of small accounts. Work sales to enable fast follow-up, automating as much of the process as possible to help them handle the
  • Support the product flows, with Tech and Product: helping to feedback to improve self-enablement, and conversion. Small tweaks to wording and positioning might make a huge difference.
  • Pricing strategy, with the CRO and CFO: packaging and price built for a high-volume channel.
  • PayG Retention & committed conversion, with the Customer team and Lifecycle Marketing team. There are two desirable outcomes for the customer team 1) converting suitable PayG accounts into subscriptions 2) Keeping them supported and successful across support and account management in a low touch away. As the overall PAYG owner, you will support and help them optimise these outcomes.
  • Reporting and insight for the channel. Own the numbers end to end.
  • Strong commercial background. You understand GTM fundamentals in a high-volume environment in a B2B context.
  • You have owned a self-serve / PLG funnel end to end: activation, conversion, retention. Not just top of funnel.
  • Highly numerically literate. Comfortable in the data yourself, running A/B tests and using data to optimise conversion systems.
  • Pricing and packaging instinct. You run price and packaging tests, you don't just execute someone else's.
  • Strong instincts for messaging and for building growth and referral loops.
  • Bias to action. This is greenfield. You build the playbook, you don't inherit one. You need to be comfortable with ambiguity, good at imposing not requiring structure and have a strong entrepreneurial streak
  • 50% Bonus/OTE
  • 24 days holiday + Bank Holidays + your birthday off 🎉
  • £1200 annual benefits allowance (ThanksBen, from month 2)
  • Early finish Fridays (16:00)
  • Yearly company retreat abroad ✈️
  • 30 days to Work from anywhere 🌍
  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, and Adoption Leave (13 weeks full pay, 17 weeks half pay, then SMP for maternity, 1 month full pay for paternity/adoption) 🐣

  • Company socials, quarterly team socials Free Monday lunches

title: Shipping & Receiving Specialist
description:
Job Title: Shipping & Receiving Specialist

Hours: 8:00am-5:00pm M-F

Job Responsibilities

  • Prepares required shipping documents for outgoing goods, ensuring shipments comply with export and destination import requirements.
  • Schedules and coordinates both domestic and international freight forwarder transactions as required.
  • Maintains shipping records, including providing tracking or shipping history information to customers on request.
  • Uses supplier supplied and internet-based shipping software to transact orders.
  • Label outgoing material with appropriate documents as required.
  • Review open customer orders, coordinate completion with manufacturing to meet the customer shipping schedule and satisfy the requested ship dates.
  • Ensure proper revenue recognition by completing the final transaction as appropriate and generate the customer invoicing upon final dispatch. Audit waiting-to-ship reports daily to ensure all invoicing is completed.
  • Ensure that the most appropriate freight forwarders and carriers are selected to achieve company targets and objectives in quality, delivery and cost.
  • Coordinate the shipping of freight by contacting appropriate freight carriers.
  • Shop rates for prepaid shipments to ensure that best possible freight rates are being utilized.
  • Works to resolve any issues related to the final customs clearance associated with any export and/or import of Qualitrol materials as required.
  • Maintain knowledge of current international import/export regulatory requirements. Update applicable standard operating procedures as necessary.
  • Formally document new or changed procedures. Identify who requires training and execute training if needed.
  • Enters data into an automated inventory control system using a computer.
  • Distribute by fax, email, courier, and file documents related to export shipments or other shipments requiring additional documentation.
  • Store and archive shipment documents and provide as required.
  • Conducts physical inventory of parts and maintains storage areas in a neat and orderly fashion.
  • Maintains work area in accordance with 5S standards.
  • Assist on a backup basis, the Shipping and Receiving areas to complete daily standard work including, but not limited to, loading/unloading trucks, receive, count, and deliver and/or stock material in the destination location, pick up packaged items from cell locations and process for shipment, package material and over-pack cartons when required, prepare skids and cartons for transport.
  • Acts as Shipping and Receiving group leader in the absence of the Shipping Coordinator and/or Shipping and Receiving Supervisor.
  • Perform similar, comparable, or related duties as required and assigned.

Qualifications

  • HSD/GED required; bachelor's degree preferred.
  • 2-5 years relevant experience (clerical, data entry, customer service, similar functions) and at least 1 year shipping experience
  • Solid knowledge and understanding or US Export Administration Regulations a plus
  • Working knowledge of export document preparation a plus
  • Working knowledge of carrier supplied and internet-based shipping software – UPS Worldship, DHL & FedEx Internet shipping is a must.
  • Oracle experience a plus
  • Must have proficient English reading and writing skills and be able to read and comprehend MSDS sheets and standard work instructions.
  • Ability to work within established procedures with a moderate degree of supervision.
  • Ability to prioritize work, self-starter, organized, detail oriented.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Delivers quality work consistently.

  • Recognize and solves problems; evaluates and selects solutions from established options.

title: GZ-psycholoog
description:
Voor onze locatie van impegno GGZ in Zoetermeer zoeken we een GZ-Psycholoog die graag psychotherapeutische behandelingen biedt aan volwassenen. Je werkt zowel individueel als in groepsverband en krijgt de ruimte om jouw expertise breed in te zetten. Je komt te werken in een nieuw behandelteam dat volop in ontwikkeling is. Vanuit jouw expertise bouw je mee aan het team, het psychotherapeutische behandelaanbod en de verdere ontwikkeling van onze zorg.

Werken bij impegno GGZ

Bij impegno GGZ bieden we ambulante psychotherapeutische behandelingen aan volwassenen met uiteenlopende psychische problematiek. Een belangrijk onderdeel van ons behandelaanbod zijn verschillende vormen van groepsbehandeling, waaronder voor cliënten met persoonlijkheidsproblematiek. We hebben een persoonsgerichte visie op psychotherapie en bieden behandeling zowel kortdurend als langer wanneer dat nodig is.

Daarnaast behandelen we onder andere angst, depressie, dwang, trauma/PTSS en somatische symptoomstoornissen. Ook zien we regelmatig cliënten met ADHD, autisme, een licht verstandelijke beperking of verschillen in cognitief functioneren.

Omdat psychische problematiek vaak samenhangt met de leefomgeving van de cliënt, werken we waar nodig samen met collega’s van impegno Jeugd en impegno Begeleiding. Zo kijken we niet alleen naar de cliënt, maar ook naar de omgeving en omstandigheden die van invloed zijn op het herstel.

Je werkt binnen een dynamische en informele organisatie met korte lijnen, waar ruimte is voor eigen initiatief en professionele verantwoordelijkheid. Binnen het multidisciplinaire team is er ruimte om jouw kennis en expertise in te zetten, te sparren over casuïstiek en mee te denken over de verdere ontwikkeling van de zorg.

impegno GGZ maakt deel uit van het Forta Netwerk, een landelijke organisatie binnen de geestelijke gezondheidszorg met verschillende gespecialiseerde labels. Hierdoor combineer je de zelfstandigheid van impegno met de brede expertise en ontwikkelmogelijkheden van een groter netwerk. Je kunt gebruikmaken van opleidingen, intervisie en kennisuitwisseling en samenwerken met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines.

Jouw rol als GZ-psycholoog

Als GZ-Psycholoog krijg je bij ons de ruimte om jouw vakmanschap volop in te zetten. Je hebt een zelfstandige en inhoudelijk uitdagende rol, waarin je behandeling combineert met diagnostiek en indicatiestelling. Tegelijkertijd krijg je de mogelijkheid om jouw kennis en ervaring te delen met collega’s en bij te dragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze zorg.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Je behandelt volwassenen met uiteenlopende psychische problematiek en biedt kwalitatief hoogwaardige, passende en evidence-based psychologische behandeling;

  • Je voert diagnostiek en indicatiestelling uit en weet complexe hulpvragen te vertalen naar een heldere probleemanalyse en passend behandelplan;

  • Je neemt de regie over je behandelingen en werkt vanuit jouw professionele verantwoordelijkheid nauw samen met collega’s en andere betrokken disciplines;

  • Je begeleidt en coacht collega’s, waaronder basispsychologen. Afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en ambities kun je ook een rol spelen in de begeleiding van GZ-psychologen in opleiding;

  • Je krijgt ruimte voor inhoudelijke ontwikkeling. Je kunt meedenken over de ontwikkeling van behandelmethodieken, beleid en de kwaliteit van onze zorg. Heb je een goed idee? Dan is er ruimte om dit samen verder te brengen;

  • Je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze organisatie. Vanuit jouw expertise denk je mee over onze positie binnen de lokale behandelmarkt en help je mee om onze zorg verder op de kaart te zetten.

Je team & je werkplek

Je komt te werken in het team in Zoetermeer, dat uit ongeveer 6 collega’s bestaat en nog volop in ontwikkeling is. Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met het hechte behandelteam in Den Haag, dat uit ongeveer 12 collega’s bestaat. De teams worden ondersteund door een betrokken teamleider en regiomanager en werken intensief samen.

Je werkt samen met collega’s met verschillende achtergronden en expertises, waardoor er ruimte is voor kennisdeling, samenwerking en ontwikkeling. Vanuit jouw kennis en ervaring kun je in Zoetermeer een belangrijke bijdrage leveren aan de verdere opbouw van het team en het behandelaanbod.

Wat bieden we jou?

Bij impegno GGZ krijg je als GZ-Psycholoog de ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en jouw expertise volop in te zetten. Je hebt invloed op je eigen behandeling en krijgt ruimte om mee te denken over het team en de verdere ontwikkeling van onze zorg. De doelgroep is breed, waardoor je met verschillende hulpvragen en behandelvormen werkt en volop ruimte hebt om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. Binnen het Forta Netwerk kun je daarnaast blijven leren, kennis delen en jezelf verder ontwikkelen.

  • Een salaris conform de CAO GGZ, functiegroep 65, tussen €5.140 en €6.716 bruto per maand bij een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van ervaring en achtergrond;

  • Een contract vanaf 24 uur per week, met ruimte om je werkdagen in overleg af te stemmen;

  • Een persoonlijk opleidingsbudget en volop mogelijkheden voor professionele ontwikkeling, intervisie en kennisdeling;

  • Ruimte om jouw expertise in te zetten bij individuele en groepsbehandelingen en mee te denken over de ontwikkeling van het behandelaanbod;

  • Ondersteuning bij het behalen van herregistratie-eisen conform de CAO GGZ;

  • Een informele en professionele werkomgeving met korte lijnen, waar jouw ideeën welkom zijn en je samen met collega’s kunt bouwen aan een sterk behandelteam.

  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarde: collectiviteitskorting bij je ziektekostenverzekering, pensioenopbouw bij Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn, uitruil reiskosten. Naast 166 vakantie-uren bij een fulltime dienstverband, 35 uur aan levensfasebudget (LFB) een jaarlijkse vakantietoeslag van 8,33% en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering. Tot slot is er een balansbudget. Het balansbudget kan je inzetten voor persoonlijke scholing, vrije dagen of laten uitbetalen.

Wat verwachten wij van jou?

Bij impegno GGZ bied je ambulante psychotherapeutische behandelingen aan volwassenen met uiteenlopende psychische problematiek. Je werkt persoonsgericht en biedt zowel individuele als groepsbehandeling, kortdurend of langer wanneer dat nodig is.

Als GZ-Psycholoog combineer je behandeling met diagnostiek en indicatiestelling. Je hebt een belangrijke rol als regiebehandelaar en werkt nauw samen met collega’s binnen het multidisciplinaire team.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Je verricht intakes, psychodiagnostiek en indicatiestelling.

  • Je biedt psychotherapeutische behandelingen aan volwassenen, individueel en in groepsverband.

  • Je voert regiebehandelaarstaken uit en bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van behandelingen.

  • Je denkt mee over casuïstiek en draagt bij aan MDO, intervisie en behandelbeleid.

  • Je begeleidt en ondersteunt basispsychologen en psychologen in opleiding.

  • Je draagt bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van behandelmethodieken en de kwaliteit van zorg.

Laten we kennismaken.

Ben jij een ervaren GZ-Psycholoog en wil je jouw expertise inzetten? Bij impegno krijg je de ruimte om zowel professioneel als persoonlijk te groeien binnen een betrokken en deskundig team. Wil je kennismaken met impegno GGZ en de sfeer ervaren? Neem dan gerust contact op met Celine Castel via c.castel@forta.nl of 06-34612852. We maken graag kennis met je.

title: Clinical Liaison - Long Term Acute Care
description:
The LTACH Clinical Liaison is responsible for transitioning patients from the acute care environment to Mosaic LTACH, St. Joseph. The Clinical Liaison will advocate for referred patients in the pre-admission process by collaborating with discharge planners to assess patient needs. The CL will serve as a resource for healthcare professionals through fostering relationships within medical facilities. With clinical expertise and problem-solving skills, the CL will coordinate care plans with physicians and families. Additionally, the CL will assist in the facilitation of patient transfers and address barriers to admission. The CL will develop and maintain new and current relationships with various areas of Mosaic Life Care Hospital, Clinics and PAC providers. This position reports to the LTACH President.

  • Assesses potential patient's condition and past medical history and obtains appropriate documentation to support the appropriate post-acute care eligibility.
  • Knowledgeable of payor coverage requirements pertaining to LTACH criteria.
  • Provides an overview of the appropriate post-acute care service.

  • Assists in planning and executing educational offerings for physicians, case management, hospital staff and community regarding LTACH services.

Education
  • Graduate from school of nursing. - Preferred

  • 3 Years - Clinical experience in post-acute care - Required

Interpersonal Skills

  • Sufficient strength and mobility to sit for long periods of time (depending on assignment).
  • Ability to drive to various locations in and around the service area.

Essential Mental Abilities

  • Critical thinking skills, problem-solving skills, negotiating abilities.
  • Capable of determining appropriate response to emergency situations.
  • Ability to focus and concentrate in order to correctly perform tasks despite numerous distractions and interruptions.
  • Ability to maintain professional demeanor to communicate and interact with patients, customers and team members.

title: Material Coordinator (Electrical)

  • Ability to establish and maintain professional relationships and effectively manage customer and employee concerns.

title: Laboratoriohoitaja Diagnostiikkakeskus Patologia
description:
Kiinnostaako sinua päivätyö monipuolisessa ja kehittyvässä työyhteisössä Meilahden patologian laboratorioissa?

HUS Diagnostiikkakeskus on Suomen johtava kliinisten laboratorio- ja kuvantamispalvelujen tuottaja. Pääasiallinen toiminta-alueemme on HUS-yhtymän erikoissairaanhoito ja HUSiin kuuluvien hyvinvointialueiden perusterveydenhuolto. Vastaamme myös Kymenlaakson hyvinvointialueen ja Etelä-Karjalan hyvinvointialueen laboratorio- ja kuvantamistoiminnasta.

Toimimme kahdeksalla lääketieteen erikoisalalla. Vastaamme valtakunnallisesti useista erityisosaamista vaativista tutkimuksista sekä yliopistolliselle sairaalalle kuuluvasta tutkimuksesta ja opetuksesta. Diagnostiset tutkimukset ovat keskeisessä roolissa sairauksien varmistamisessa, poissulkemisessa, osana hoitoa sekä hoidon seurannassa ja seulonnassa. HUS Diagnostiikkakeskuksessa työskentelee noin 3300 laboratorio- ja kuvantamisalan asiantuntijaa yli 150 toimipisteessä.

Haemme laboratoriohoitajaa vakituiseen tehtävään Meilahden patologian laboratorioon. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

Meilahden patologian laboratorioissa tehdään monipuolisia kliinisen histologian ja sytologian tutkimuksia päivätyönä, mikä mahdollistaa pääsyn haasteelliseen ja mielenkiintoiseen työhön ja mukavaan työyhteisöön. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm. kudos- ja solunäytteiden käsittely, erilaisia patologian prosessiin liittyviä töitä osaamistasosi mukaan sekä osastonäytteenotto.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Olet koulutukseltasi bioanalyytikko/laboratoriohoitaja ja haluat olla mukana tekemässä laadukasta diagnostiikkaa osana asiantuntevaa ja kannustavaa työyhteisöä.

Etsimme tiimiimme oma-aloitteista ja yhteistyökykyistä bioanalyytikkoa/laboratoriohoitajaa. Sinulla voi olla kokemusta kliinisen patologian laboratoriotyöstä joko työsi tai opintojesi kautta, mutta ennen kaikkea arvostamme innostunutta asennetta ja halua oppia uutta. Arvostamme aktiivista työotetta, halua kehittyä sekä hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Tarjoamme sinulle ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön, toimivat työvälineet sekä laadukkaan perehdytyksen tehtävään. Pääset työskentelemään koulutusmyönteisessä ympäristössä, jossa osaamisen kehittämistä arvostetaan ja tuetaan.

Laboratoriotoimintamme on parhaillaan merkittävässä kehitysvaiheessa ja uudet laboratoriotilat valmistuvat lähivuosina. Tarjoamme sinulle ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden osallistua tulevaisuuden laboratorion ja uusien toimintatapojen kehittämiseen jo nyt.

Työ on päivätyötä, mikä tukee työ- ja vapaa-ajan yhteensovittamista. Työvuorosuunnittelu toteutetaan yhteisöllisesti ja työntekijöiden toiveet huomioidaan mahdollisuuksien mukaan.

Laboratoriohoitajan tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 3 024,27 €/kk, minkä lisäksi maksetaan mahdollinen kokemuslisä. Käytössämme on myös suoritepalkkiojärjestelmä, jonka avulla voit kasvattaa kuukausiansioitasi.

Kiinnostuitko?

Kerromme mielellämme lisää – ole yhteydessä matalalla kynnyksellä.

Lähetäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, viimeistään 26.10.2026. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuajan kuluessa.

Liitäthän hakemukseen kuvauksen osaamisestasi ja työkokemuksesta, motivaatiokirjeen ja päivitetyn CV:n.

Tervetuloa työkaveriksemme tekemään merkityksellistä työtä!

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehdot

Laillistettu laboratoriohoitaja.

Edellytämme asiakas- ja potilastiloissa työskentelevältä tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa, ja terveydenhuollon toimintayksiköissä työskentelevältä terveydentilan selvitystä keuhkotuberkuloosista.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antavat osastonhoitajat

description: Vill du arbeta nära användarna och ha stort utrymme att fatta tekniska beslut? Våra kunder är enbart återförsäljare, både stora och små, främst i Norden men även i Europa.  Captech har många grunder till sin framgång, en av dem är våra interna system och verktyg som får alla processer att lira. Vi bestämde oss tidigt för att vi har bäst förutsättningar att göra ett bra arbete när våra verktyg är anpassade efter våra egna behov, därför har vi utvecklat majoriteten av våra system helt själva, in-house. Därför utökar vi utvecklingsavdelningen, som i dag består av fyra utvecklare och en chef. Du arbetar med både nya och befintliga system som är centrala för verksamheten. Eftersom användarna finns nära får du snabb återkoppling på det du bygger.Här finns ingen särskild hierarki där någon annan redan har bestämt hur lösningarna ska se ut. Vi diskuterar lösningar i teamet och litar på varandras omdömen. Du behöver kunna fatta egna beslut och prova nya vägar. Du vågar fatta beslut och testa nya sätt, även när allt inte är givet från början. Du jobbar strukturerat, säger till när planen inte håller och samarbetar bra med både teamet och andra delar av organisationen.Du är van att arbeta enligt etablerade metoder för planering och uppföljning. Att testa och kvalitetssäkra det du bygger är en naturlig del av ditt arbete.Vi söker dig som har:-    Ingenjörsexamen inom datateknik eller motsvarande utbildning-    Minst fem års professionell erfarenhet av utveckling i C# och .NET-    Gedigen erfarenhet av kvalitet och testning av egenutvecklad mjukvara-    Erfarenhet av SQL-    Erfarenhet av och förståelse för CI/CD-    Erfarenhet av agila arbetsmetoderMeriterande erfarenheter:-    ASP.NET och/eller WPF/XAML-    DevOps och monitorering-    Fullstackutveckling-    AI-assisterad utveckling och AI-verktyg-    Entity FrameworkHar du inte arbetat med desktopapplikationer tidigare kan du lära dig det hos oss.Teknisk miljöVi arbetar främst i Microsoft-miljö. Merparten av våra backendtjänster körs on-prem.Vår tekniska miljö:-    Moderna versioner av .NET (8–10)-    Git-    Azure DevOps-    MS SQL-    ASP.NET-    WPF/XAMLAtt jobba på CaptechPå Captech är vi måna om att våra medarbetare trivs och utvecklas. Som utvecklare hos oss blir du en del av ett team med nära samarbete, korta beslutsvägar och stor möjlighet att påverka. Vi värdesätter nyfikenhet och lärande. Du uppmuntras även att utforska nya tekniker och arbetssätt, dela kunskap med teamet och vara med och påverka hur vi utvecklar våra system framåt.Vi arbetar från vårt kontor i Mölndal tre dagar i veckan, och två dagar i veckan finns möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån. Kontoret har goda förbindelser med kollektivtrafik, såväl som gott om parkeringsplatser inkl. laddplatser för dig som åker bil.Villkor och förmånerDu omfattas av Handelns tjänstemannaavtal.   • Produce clear and rigorous step-by-step solutions
  • Explain assumptions, calculations, and intermediate reasoning explicitly
  • Apply structured physical reasoning to challenging scenarios
  • Present conclusions in a format suitable for evaluation and review

Model Evaluation & Error Analysis

  • Evaluate how language models perform on physics-focused tasks
  • Identify recurring weaknesses in conceptual understanding
  • Analyse errors involving abstraction, symbolic manipulation, and multi-step reasoning
  • Distinguish conceptual mistakes from calculation or interpretation errors
  • Provide structured observations to support model improvement

Benchmark & Evaluation Design

  • Contribute to new physics evaluation benchmarks
  • Align problem design with specific research objectives
  • Develop tasks spanning different levels of technical complexity
  • Refine evaluation criteria based on observed model behaviour
  • Support consistent assessment across advanced physics domains

Research Collaboration & Technical Communication

  • Collaborate remotely with research and technical teams
  • Explain complex physics concepts in clear and accessible language
  • Provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations
  • Communicate analytical findings in a structured format
  • Work independently while maintaining consistent project quality

  • Currently pursuing or holding a Master's, Ph.D., or postdoctoral position in Physics, Applied Physics, or a related field
  • Strong foundation in advanced physics at graduate or doctoral level
  • Expertise may include quantum mechanics and quantum information
  • Background in relativity is relevant
  • Nuclear and particle physics expertise is valuable
  • Astrophysics and cosmology backgrounds are welcome
  • Condensed matter physics expertise is relevant
  • Strong knowledge of classical mechanics
  • Strong understanding of electromagnetism and optics
  • Familiarity with thermodynamics and statistical physics
  • Strong analytical and research capabilities
  • Ability to solve complex physics problems using a structured and logical approach
  • Comfortable with abstraction, symbolic manipulation, and multi-step reasoning
  • Ability to explain physics concepts clearly using simple language, visuals, and physical intuition
  • Strong critical-thinking and creative problem-solving skills
  • Ability to provide detailed annotations and constructive feedback
  • Excellent written English communication
  • Strong remote collaboration skills
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently
  • Reliable desktop or laptop setup with a stable internet connection

Engagement Details

  • Contractor assignment / freelance engagement
  • Fully remote
  • Source materials describe the opportunity as full-time, while the formal engagement type is contractor/freelancer
  • Work will involve physics problem design, solution development, model evaluation, and benchmark creation
  • Projects may span quantum mechanics, relativity, nuclear physics, particle physics, astrophysics, cosmology, condensed matter, classical mechanics, electromagnetism, optics, thermodynamics, and statistical physics

title: Data Engineer - Senior
description:
Job Description:

With a company culture rooted in collaboration, expertise and innovation, we aim to promote progress and inspire our clients, employees, investors and communities to achieve their greatest potential. Our work is the catalyst that helps others achieve their goals. In short, We Enable Possibility.

Arch Investment Management Ltd. (AIML), based in Bermuda, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Arch Capital Group Ltd., a leading insurance and reinsurance company. Arch Capital has investable assets of over $50bn. Arch Investment Management manages Arch Capital and its subsidiaries' portfolios.

The Risk & Quantitative Strategies (RQS) team, responsible for producing the analytics and models that support business decisions, is growing and is hiring a senior data engineer to help own and scale the data platform underpinning our systematic credit strategies.

This is a senior, hands-on role: you will be trusted to architect solutions independently, ingest data reliably from different sources, work directly with quant researchers to translate needs into production data systems, and raise the technical bar across the team.

Tasks/Responsibilities

  • Platform ownership: Architect, build, and own production data pipelines and storage systems ingesting large-scale financial datasets (ICE, Bloomberg, LSEG, BlackRock, Clearwater, external managers etc).
  • Data stewardship & governance: Take ownership of in-house managed data and embed robust data governance and control mechanisms across the pipeline lifecycle, and maintain comprehensive documentation.
  • API & service design: Contribute to production APIs (FastAPI) powering internal applications as scalable and service-based architectures.
  • Quality & reliability: Design and implement rigorous test plans, non-regression testing and data validation frameworks to guarantee the reliability and accuracy of pipelines that directly drive investment decisions.
  • Engineering standards: Champion best practices for code quality, CI/CD (GitHub Actions) and observability/monitoring across the team's data and platform work.
  • Team collaboration: Partner with quant researchers to translate portfolio analytics needs into robust application and with the engineers to build production-grade data architecture.

Required Skills / Experience

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or a closely related discipline, including demonstrated ownership of production-grade data platforms (not solely research or prototype work).
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms.
  • Experience designing and maintaining ETL/data pipeline architecture at scale, including multi-environment (DEV/STAGE/PROD) deployment practices.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) and observability/monitoring practices for production systems.
  • Familiarity building or supporting backend APIs (FastAPI or equivalent).
  • Experience with data quality assurance, including non-regression testing and data validation frameworks.
  • Comfortable tracing data flow and troubleshooting issues under limited time restriction.
  • Strong communicator and collaborator, with the ability to work independently, challenge requirements where needed and align technical solutions to real investment workflows.

Desired Skills / Experience

  • Experience with financial, banking or asset-management companies.
  • Experience with AI (RAG systems, document intelligence or agentic workflows).
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake and Databricks.

Education

  • BS in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Collaborate closely with backend engineers (Java / Kotlin, C#, Node.js) to improve deployment patterns and runtime reliability.
  • Automate operational processes and reduce manual intervention.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tooling (Claude, Codex, automation agents, anomaly detection systems) to improve operational efficiency.
  • Participate in architectural discussions to ensure infrastructure scalability and resilience.

You don’t just maintain infrastructure — you engineer the reliability of the business.

We run workloads on both AWS and Azure. We are looking for solid hands-on experience with IaaS and core managed cloud services on at least one of them — knowing the equivalent on the other cloud is a strong plus. These are the building blocks you’ll work with:

  • Virtual networking — Azure: VNet, NSGs, VNet Integration, Private Endpoints | AWS: VPC, Security Groups, PrivateLink
  • In-memory cache — Azure: Azure Cache for Redis | AWS: Amazon ElastiCache (Redis / Valkey)
  • Managed SQL Server — Azure: Azure SQL / SQL Managed Instance | AWS: Amazon RDS for SQL Server
  • Workload identity (secretless auth) — Azure: Managed Identity + DefaultAzureCredential | AWS: IAM Roles (instance profiles, IRSA) + SDK default credential chain
  • Secrets & keys — Azure: Key Vault | AWS: AWS Secrets Manager / KMS
  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps / Cloud Engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS or Azure — experience with both is a strong plus.
  • Deep understanding of containerization and distributed systems, with production experience in Kubernetes (required).
  • Proven experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitLab CI or similar).
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft SQL Server (administration, performance tuning, backup/restore, high availability).
  • Experience with Redis in production (caching, session storage, pub/sub).
  • Strong knowledge of networking, security, and system architecture.
  • Experience working in high-availability SaaS environments.
  • Solid understanding of observability, monitoring, and incident management, including Grafana dashboards and alerting.
  • Experience collaborating with backend engineering teams.
  • Languages: fluent Spanish and professional English (both required).

We don’t expect you to master every tool listed above, but we do expect solid hands-on experience with at least one technology in each area: cloud provider (AWS / Azure), containers & orchestration, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability, and databases & caching.

Nice-to-Have Superpowers

  • Experience implementing DevSecOps practices.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure requirements.
  • Experience with cost optimization strategies in cloud environments.
  • Knowledge of GitOps workflows.
  • Experience in multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure.
  • French — a huge plus (we can dream!).

title: Senior IT Support Executive
description:
Job Summary

A leading MultinationalCorporation (MNC) headquartered in Taiwan is establishing a new factory inSingapore. We are seeking an experienced IT Support Executive who will be responsiblefor providing day-to-day technical support for the company’s office and factoryoperations. This includes maintaining IT infrastructure, supporting hardwareand software, troubleshooting system and network issues, and ensuring smoothoperation of business and production-related IT systems.

Key Responsibilities

IT Support & Helpdesk

  • Provide first-level technical support to office and factory users.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, printer, and email issues.
  • Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, mobile devices, printers, and scanners.
  • Support Microsoft Office, ERP systems, accounting software, and other business applications.
  • Set up user accounts, passwords, and access permissions.
  • Maintain IT inventory, software licenses, and asset records.
  • Perform regular system updates, antivirus checks, and data backups.
  • Coordinate with external IT vendors and service providers when necessary.
  • Manage, prioritize, track, and close IT service tickets according to SLA requirements through IT Ticket Management
  • Support meeting-room AV equipment, video conferencing, displays, projectors, and presentation systems where applicable.
  • Identify recurring IT issues and propose improvements to support processes, services, and user experience.

Network & Infrastructure

  • Monitor and maintain LAN/Wi-Fi network connectivity for office and factory.
  • Support internet, VPN, firewall, switches, and server operations.
  • Ensure stable connectivity for factory production systems and devices.
  • Assist in troubleshooting network downtime and system failures.

Factory / Production Support

  • Provide IT support for factory operations, including production PCs, barcode scanners, label printers, CCTV, and attendance systems.
  • Assist in supporting manufacturing or warehouse systems where applicable.
  • Coordinate with production teams to minimize operational disruptions caused by IT issues.

Cybersecurity & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with company IT policies and security procedures.
  • Monitor and report potential cybersecurity threats or suspicious activities.
  • Support implementation of backup and disaster recovery procedures.
  • Ensure confidentiality and security of company data and systems.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain proper documentation of IT procedures, configurations, and troubleshooting records.
  • Prepare periodic reports on IT issues, maintenance activities, and asset status.
  • Recommend improvements to enhance IT efficiency and reliability.
Qualifications
  • Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Minimum 1–3 years of relevant IT support experience preferred.
  • Basic knowledge of Windows operating systems, networking, Microsoft 365, and hardware troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting factory/manufacturing environments will be an advantage.
  • Good problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Able to work independently and respond promptly to IT issues.
Preferred Skills
  • Basic knowledge of ERP systems and manufacturing software.
  • Basic knowledge of Palo Alto firewalls, Proxmox virtualization platform, NAS system, HPE Storage and network equipment would be advantage.
  • Basic understanding of cybersecurity practices, Azure Entra ID and Windows Server.
  • Experience with CCTV, biometric attendance systems, or barcode systems is an added advantage.

title: Interim QAQC Packaging Specialist
description:
Are you an expert in quality assurance and packaging, with a passion for the beauty industry? Innovative Beauty Group (IBG) is looking for an Interim QA/QC Packaging Specialist to play a key role in the development of new packaging for innovative cosmetic products.

Quality is at the heart of everything we do. In this interim role, you will help ensure that quality is embedded from the earliest stages of the product-development process through to delivery.

Welcome to IBG!

IBG (Innovative Beauty Group) is a global one-stop beauty shop. By partnering with our clients as an extension of their teams, we bring beauty visions to life. IBG consists of more than 300 colleagues spread over 13 locations worldwide.

Within IBG Netherlands, we specialize in turnkey solutions, private label and packaging in the Beauty and Home Care industry. Together we are concept builders with global opportunities for well-known retailers and brands from your favorite shopping street. There is a good chance that one of our products is already in your home!

What will you do as Interim QA/QC Specialist?

As an Interim QA/QC Packaging Specialist, you will be a driving force behind the quality of our packaging. You will develop and implement quality plans that help raise our packaging standards, ensure that processes comply with applicable EU legislation and regulations, and support internal teams, including Product Development and Project Management, with customer queries relating to quality assurance.

Alongside your Quality Assurance responsibilities, you will play an important role in Quality Control. You will conduct sample inspections to assess the quality and functionality of packaging and report your findings in detail. When defects are identified, you will use your technical knowledge of cosmetic packaging to investigate root causes quickly and propose effective corrective and preventive actions.

This is an interim position. You will join the team for a defined period to provide specialist QA/QC packaging expertise and support business continuity, ongoing projects and quality improvement initiatives.

Key responsibilities:

  • Develop, establish and maintain quality procedures, standards and specifications for EU suppliers;

  • Read and write technical manuals and documentation;

  • Support the preparation of work instructions and procedures;

  • Collaborate with colleagues to identify, develop and implement quality initiatives;

  • Complete documentation in customer portals relating to product specifications and certificates;

  • Proactively build and maintain insight into the quality portfolio of preferred suppliers, supporting customer requests for new projects;

  • Carry out quality and functionality checks on packaging samples;

  • Investigate packaging-related quality issues, identify root causes and propose corrective and preventive actions;

  • Support the registration, follow-up and resolution of quality complaints;

  • As a quality-management specialist within IBG, you will set the standard for quality assurance and help us deliver on our commitments to both internal and external stakeholders.

Your profile

You bring a fresh perspective, a strong vision and a genuine passion for quality. As an Interim QA/QC Packaging Specialist, you have a solid technical foundation and can work independently in a dynamic project environment.

In addition, you:

  • Have higher professional education (HBO) level of working and thinking, with the ability to apply this in day-to-day work;

  • Have experience handling quality complaints, including problem-solving, investigation and reporting;

  • Have technical knowledge of packaging and packaging engineering and can identify and resolve quality issues efficiently;

  • Have preferably worked with PPWR and complaint registration systems/processes;

  • Are familiar with EU legislation and regulations relevant to packaging and cosmetic products;

  • Are fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken. German is an advantage;

  • Are independent, professional and self-motivated, with strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders at different levels;

  • Are available to work in the Netherlands and hold a valid work permit.

Is this your ideal job?
Are you excited to grow with us and contribute to the success of Innovative Beauty Group? We’d love to hear from you!

👉 Apply directly via the application button. We kindly ask you to submit your application through our website, this ensures your details are processed correctly. Applications sent by email cannot be considered.
💬 Questions about the role? Reach out to Ingeborg de Wildt (Senior Corporate Recruiter). She’ll be happy to help!
📧 ingeborg.dewildt@group-ibg.com

Let’s create something beautiful together! 🌸

  • Please note: We will only consider applications from candidates who must reside in the Netherlands and hold a valid work visa for the Netherlands.

title: Senior Engineer, Digital Workplace
description:
About Us

SPH Media’s mission is to be the trusted source of news and lifestyle content in Singapore and Asia.

One of our core purposes is to produce credible, balanced, and objective news and analysis, always with a view to uphold the public good and fostering an informed, engaged citizenry.

We welcome talented individuals to join us and grow a career in a vibrant and collaborative environment built around a culture of respect and inclusivity.

As an employer, we are committed to rewarding our people fairly and developing them in their careers.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and well-rounded Digital Workplace Specialist to join our Digital Workplace Experience Team. You will serve as the primary link between business needs and technical solutions, driving continuous improvement across our core platforms.

As the driver of the continuous improvement loop, you will own each thread from initial sentiment gathering and data collection through to implementation and closure. You will proactively engage business users to translate their feedback into clear technical requirements, guiding these through development to the delivery of effective solutions, while maintaining a constant feedback cycle to refine the user experience.

Another key focus of this role is AI innovation. You will help identify practical AI use cases to address organisational concerns or challenges and must possess a relentless drive to stay current with the fast-evolving AI landscape.

Key Responsibilities

Business Analysis & Strategic Engagement

● End-to-End Ownership: Manage initiatives from initial discovery and sentiment gathering to solution delivery and project closure.

● Stakeholder Engagement: Proactively engage with business units to understand pain points and desired outcomes.

● Requirement Translation: Translate complex business needs into clear, documented technical specifications and actionable user stories.

● Metric Definition: Define and track metrics to measure the value and impact of implemented digital solutions.

AI Integration & Future-Readiness

● AI Use Case Discovery: Identify opportunities within the company to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI (GenAI) to improve current scenarios.

● Solution Proposing: Research and propose innovative solutions and industry best practices to enhance the digital workplace.

● Continuous Learning: Maintain an up-to-date understanding of evolving AI trends to keep the organization at the forefront of technology.

User Enablement, Communication & Engagement

● Continuous Feedback Loop: Manage mechanisms such as surveys and focus groups to identify gaps in the digital employee experience.

● UX Advocacy: Promote modern User Experience (UX) principles to ensure simple, effective user journeys across all digital devices.

● Platform Adoption: Develop and execute strategies, including targeted communications and training materials, to increase user proficiency and adoption.

● Practical User Training: Design and facilitate interactive, non-technical training sessions, to help business users become proficient with new tools/platforms and AI capabilities.

● User Advocacy & Community Engagement: Cultivate an active network of departmental "digital champions" and manage internal discussion channels/forums to gather continuous feedback, address recurring user friction, and share productivity tips.

Required Qualifications

Education: Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

● Business Analysis Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional experience in an IT Business Analyst role, with a proven track record of gathering complex requirements, managing backlogs, and delivering enterprise solutions.

● Technological Literacy: Strong understanding of technology products and platforms (e.g., Google Workspace, Okta, ServiceNow, Workvivo) and how they integrate within an enterprise environment.

● AI Savviness and Future-Focused: Demonstrated enthusiasm and intellectual curiosity for staying current with Digital Workplace automation and AI/GenAI trends, paired with a practical mindset for applying technology to real business problems.

  • Communication Excellence: Excellent written and verbal skills, capable of influencing diverse audiences from technical teams to senior leadership.
  • User Training & Facilitation: Proven ability to explain technical and AI concepts in plain, accessible language and comfortably facilitate interactive walkthroughs, demo sessions, or user training for non-technical audiences.

● Autonomy and Ownership: Highly proactive and self-motivated, with the ability to work autonomously and take full ownership of outcomes.

● Effective Project Management: Proven ability to manage the execution of multiple initiatives, projects, and product increments simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

● Adaptability: A meticulous, analytical fast learner committed to sharing knowledge and fostering a high-performing environment.

● Analytical Problem Solver: Meticulous attention to detail with strong analytical capabilities to evaluate workflows and identify root causes behind user friction.

title: Customer Project Manager (m/f/d) | German Required
description:

About us

title: Verzorgende IG Acute Opname Ouderen
description:
Zo werk jij

Voor wie jij er als verzorgende IG bent? Op de Acute Opname Ouderen (AOO) in Laren bied je specialistische zorg aan patiënten vanaf 65 jaar die zijn opgenomen vanwege een acute psychiatrische crisis. Soms nemen we ook jongere patiënten op wanneer hun zorgvraag past binnen de doelgroep. Je werkt met mensen die naast psychiatrische problematiek ook te maken kunnen hebben met cognitieve stoornissen of andere somatische aandoeningen. Juist de combinatie van lichamelijke en specialistische psychiatrische zorg maakt jouw werk afwisselend en vraagt om goed observeren, aansluiten en handelen. We bieden geen verpleeghuiszorg.

De AOO is een gesloten opnameafdeling op het prachtig groene terrein van Juliana-Oord in Laren. We bieden zowel vrijwillige als verplichte zorg en richten ons op crisisbehandeling, diagnostiek en stabilisatie. Op AOO bieden we ook een tweewekelijkse klinische (bovenregionale) diagnostiekopname aan. Deze opname wordt ingezet wanneer het niet voldoende lukt om in de thuissituatie (ambulant) tot een duidelijke diagnose te komen. Daarnaast bieden wij binnen onze afdeling rTMS-behandelingen aan; een innovatieve en vooruitstrevende behandelvorm binnen de geestelijke gezondheidszorg. Als verzorgende IG lever je vanuit de dagelijkse zorg en begeleiding een belangrijke bijdrage aan het totale behandelproces.

Vanuit jouw expertise en persoonlijke talenten geef jij vorm aan de functie van verzorgende IG. De belangrijkste taken en verantwoordelijkheden zijn voor jou bekend terrein. Je staat dicht bij de patiënt en merkt daardoor vaak als eerste wanneer er iets verandert in gedrag, stemming of lichamelijk functioneren. Je creëert een veilige en voorspelbare omgeving en ondersteunt patiënten bij wat zij nodig hebben, zonder onnodig de regie over te nemen. Wat de functie bij GGz Centraal bijzonder maakt is:

  • medicatie verstrekken en verzorgende en verpleegtechnische handelingen uitvoeren;

  • het voeren van herstelgerichte gesprekken met patiënten en hun naasten én het begeleiden van groepsmomenten;

  • veranderingen in psychisch, cognitief en lichamelijk functioneren signaleren, observeren en deze bevindingen delen met het behandelteam;

Wij werken volgens het principe 'handen op de rug'; je stimuleert eigen regie en ondersteunt waar nodig, zonder taken onnodig over te nemen.

Jouw team
Jouw nieuwe collega’s van de AOO in Laren kijken ernaar uit om je te ontmoeten. Samen met jou als verzorgende IG bieden we patiënten in een acute psychiatrische crisis een veilige omgeving waarin diagnostiek, stabilisatie en herstel centraal staan.

Wat ons team kenmerkt? Warm, stabiel en betrokken. Ons team is een mooie mix van ervaren en startende collega's. Verpleegkundigen, verzorgende IG, social workers en regieverpleegkundigen werken nauw samen met psychiaters, artsen, een geriater en andere disciplines. Iedereen levert vanuit zijn of haar expertise een bijdrage aan de beste zorg voor onze patiënten.

Er is veel aandacht voor begeleiding, kennisdeling en professionele ontwikkeling.

Ervaring binnen de ouderenpsychiatrie is waardevol, maar ook als je vanuit de ouderenzorg of een andere zorgsetting de overstap naar de ggz wilt maken, krijg je de ruimte om je het vak eigen te maken. Collega’s nemen graag de tijd om je wegwijs te maken in de psychiatrie en je verder te ontwikkelen in je vak.

Jouw nieuwe werkplek? De Acute Opname Ouderen (AOO) op het terrein van Juliana-Oord in Laren.

Wij zorgen voor jou

Werk dat er toe doet en waar je van betekenis bent, dat is alvast onze eerste belofte. Omdat we een grote organisatie zijn met verschillende werklocaties kunnen we inspelen op ontwikkelwensen en voorkeuren qua functie-inhoud, type behandelprogramma en woon-werkafstand. We zien wie je bent en wat je kan. Bij GGz Centraal kun je als verzorgende IG in ieder geval rekenen op:

  • een bruto maandsalaris volgens CAO GGZ, FWG 40 (tussen € 2.888,- en € 3.917,- o.b.v. 36 uur​). Bereken hier jouw netto salaris.

  • een contract voor 24-36 uur per week voor onbepaalde tijd. We werken vanuit vertrouwen, dus je krijgt meteen een vast contract.

  • een vakantietoeslag en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%.

  • 166 verlofuren en 35 levensfase-uren o.b.v. 36 uur. Zo willen we bijdragen aan een goede werk-privébalans.

  • een jaarlijks balansbudget van €1.000,- naar rato. Dit budget kun je besteden aan iets waar jij blij van wordt. Denk aan een cursus, extra salaris of verlofuren, aan jou de keuze.

  • ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen, trainingen en verdere specialisatie binnen de ouderenpsychiatrie. Waaronder ook de opleiding tot rTMS technician.

  • een lease fiets via Lease a Bike. Hiermee stimuleren we duurzaam en gezond woon-werkverkeer.

Boven alles bieden we je een uitdagende en afwisselende baan met de ruimte om jezelf professioneel en persoonlijk te ontwikkelen via opleidingen, trainingen en interne scholing.

Onze arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn conform de CAO GGZ. Heb je vragen? Laat het ons weten.

Dit breng je mee

Jij bent een betrokken en daadkrachtige professional die stevig in zijn of haar schoenen staat. Je blijft rustig in complexe situaties, werkt graag samen en denkt actief mee over de verdere ontwikkeling van de afdeling. Ook heb je voor deze baan:

  • een afgeronde mbo niveau 3 opleiding tot Verzorgende IG.

Wie zijn wij?

Elk jaar rekenen zo’n 25.000 patiënten op ons als de specialist in geestelijke gezondheidszorg in midden Nederland. Vanuit verschillende locaties, binnen de thuissetting én online, bieden we specialistische hulp aan mensen met psychische problemen, in alle fasen van hun leven.
Ontdek meer over GGz Centraal als werkgever en over onze visie en missie.

Enthousiast?
Ben jij onze nieuwe collega? Of ken je iemand die perfect bij ons team past?

Je bent van harte welkom om eerst vrijblijvend kennis te maken tijdens onze informatiemiddag op vrijdag 6 november van 14.00 uur tot 16.00 uur op Juliana-Oord in Laren. Tijdens deze middag ontdek je wat werken op de Acute Opname Ouderen zo bijzonder maakt. Je maakt kennis met onze afdeling, het team en de dagelijkse praktijk. Ook ontmoet je de teammanager en de regiecoördinerend verpleegkundigen, die je graag vertellen over het werken binnen onze afdeling. Je bent ook altijd welkom om een dag(deel) mee te lopen.

Nieuwsgierig geworden? Wij ontmoeten je graag. Aanmelden kan door een e-mail te sturen naar a.stevens@ggzcentraal.nl

Wil je liever eerst telefonisch contact? Ook dat kan. Tot 14 september vertelt Angéla Stevens (regie-coördinerend verpleegkundige) je graag meer (tel. 035-5390405 werkdagen: maandag, donderdag en vrijdag). Na 14 september staat Erik van Diermen (teammanager) je graag te woord via 06 823 176 82.

Solliciteren

Wil je meer informatie over de vacature? Neem voor inhoudelijke vragen contact op met Erik van Diermen (teammanager) via 06 823 176 82. Voor overige vragen helpt de recruiter je graag verder op weg.

Kom je graag eerst sfeer proeven? Een dagdeel meelopen is mogelijk als onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure.

Als we dé geschikte kandidaat hebben gevonden, sluiten we de vacature eerder. Hebben we onze match nog niet gevonden? Dan zoeken we nog wat langer door.

Kom je bij ons werken, dan checken we standaard referenties en vragen we je om een actuele Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG). Uiteraard vergoeden wij deze kosten.

title: Callcenter medewerker
description:

title: Senior Security Risk Officer
description:
Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

Mollie is looking for a versatile Senior Security Risk Officer to support our growth. Reporting to the Risk Lead, you'll take ownership of a broad spectrum of risk areas, including IT and security, with clear expectations to support product development and AI enablement.

This is a role for someone who can move between regulation, technology, and business priorities, and bring them together into practical, workable guidance for the teams building Mollie's products.

What you'll be doing:

  • Partner with colleagues to build new or updated products, manage and deploy IT assets and implement risk and security controls while ensuring adherence to relevant regulations (DORA, PSD2, GDPR, AI Act, CRA, NIS2, etc.). Drive efficiencies and adherence to relevant governance and champion them across the organisation,

  • Together with the senior stakeholders of Risk and Compliance set out second line risk priorities and initiatives,

  • Foster a strong risk culture across the entire organisation; support a growing organisation in all relevant areas,

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to achieve successful outcomes in internal/external audits and certifications (PCI-DSS, SOC2, etc.),

  • Translate complex regulations into actionable guidance, championing a risk culture that balances commercial success with compliance.

What you’ll bring:

  • Experience - 7-10 years of relevant experience

  • Technical comfort - at ease with different technology platforms and can dive into technical documentation and system architectures. Working understanding of engineering, security technologies, culture, tools and best practices.

  • Communication skills - excellent written and verbal abilities to explain risk decisions to both technical and business stakeholders;

  • Can do attitude and creative problem solver - the second line needs to be creative in finding solutions to maintaining security in a growing organization

  • Customer focus - always consider customer impact when making security and risk decisions;

  • Inquisitive approach - ready to experiment, always looking for better ways to solve problems. Curiosity towards new technologies (AI included) is highly appreciated.

Strong preference for:

  • Payments/fintech experience - understanding of financial or payments-related technical solutions.

  • Certified CISSP or CISM, and/or cloud certification (GCP), network or other relevant security and technical certification

  • Advanced University Degree in Information Technology, or another relevant technological study

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

title: Operations Leader
description:
Based at our DVP Warehouse, Rotherham.

Shift pattern: Wed/Thur-Sat 0600-1800

The role:

As an Operations Leader, you are the heartbeat of our daily warehouse activity. You’ll be the person who turns high level plans into reality by clarifying tasks, motivating the team, and acting as the first point of contact for any queries on the floor. You’ll make a difference by ensuring our fast paced environment remains organised, safe, and efficient, ensuring every parcel gets to where it needs to go.

To help you hit the ground running, NEXT provides a comprehensive induction and ongoing support from our management team to ensure you feel confident leading your department.

What you’ll take on:

Your day to day will be varied and active, focusing on both people and performance:

  • Leading the Shift: Conduct pre-shift briefs and end of shift handovers to ensure everyone knows exactly what is expected.
  • Driving Performance: Monitor KPIs like UPH (Units Per Hour) and CPU (Cost Per Unit) to achieve our target of 97% OTIF (On Time In Full).
  • People Management: Support your team through weekly performance discussions, Return to Work interviews, and managing absence or disciplinary matters fairly and consistently.
  • Operational Control: Update daily planners and target monitors throughout the shift, accounting for all hours worked in your area.
  • Safety First: Maintain a safe environment by conducting daily floorwalks, safety observations, and leading accident investigations when necessary.
  • Staying Connected: Use tools like Yapster and internal chat to provide real time updates and resolve issues as they arise.

What you’ll bring:

We are looking for a grounded leader who can stay calm when things get busy. To succeed in this role, you’ll need:

  • Supervisory Experience: A background in leading teams, ideally within a distribution or warehouse environment.
  • Communication Skills: The ability to explain tasks clearly to your team and write concise reports.
  • An Analytical Mindset: You should be comfortable with numbers and able to interpret performance data to improve results.
  • Resilience: A flexible approach to work and the ability to lead by example under pressure.
  • Practical Skills: You must be computer literate, hold a valid driving licence, and have a proven track record of solving day to day operational problems.

title: 23047 - Case Administrator - West Midlands Pre-Release Team - Birmingham
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Where applicants provide multiple location preferences, reserve lists will be managed in accordance with location preference/s, as indicated in your application. We will appoint in merit list order for each location outlined in the vacancy and hold a separate locational reserve list for each of these locations. After appointments have been made using this locational appointment process, any remaining candidates who met the benchmark for the role will remain on a locational reserve list in accordance with their preferences for 12 months.

Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other live applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

The post is currently advertised without VISOR Vetting to enable appointment to take place as soon as possible, however, VISOR vetting will be required to be completed post offer.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.
