title: (Ondersteunend) Begeleider Dagbeleving EVB
description:
Jij weet van gewone momenten een fijne beleving te maken. Met jouw creativiteit, rust en aandacht biedt je volwassenen en ouderen met een ernstige verstandelijke beperking een dag die past bij hun behoeften en mogelijkheden.

3 redenen waarom dit jouw baan is

  1. Je bedenkt activiteiten die passen bij wat een cliënt aankan en prettig vindt
    Van bewegen en muziek tot koken, snoezelen of buiten zijn. Jij kijkt steeds opnieuw waar iemand behoefte aan heeft.

  2. Je biedt rust, structuur en persoonlijke aandacht
    Door goed te observeren herken je kleine signalen en sluit je jouw begeleiding daarop aan.

  3. Je combineert creativiteit met goede dagelijkse zorg
    Een activiteit begeleiden en ondersteunen bij persoonlijke verzorging horen voor jou allebei bij een fijne dag.

En ja, dat zorgdiploma niveau 2, 3 of 4 heb jij natuurlijk gewoon in de pocket. Voor de functie van ondersteunend begeleider heb je minimaal niveau 2 nodig. Voor de functie van begeleider is minimaal niveau 3 vereist.

Wat jij verdient

Jij zorgt goed voor anderen, wij zorgen goed voor jou. Zo vinden wij een goede balans in werk en privé heel belangrijk. Daarnaast verdien jij:

  • Direct een vast contract (met twee maanden proeftijd) voor 14-28 uur per week. In overleg is veel mogelijk.

  • Een bruto salaris volgens de cao Gehandicaptenzorg, op basis van 36 uur per week: voor de functie van ondersteunend begeleider € 2.420 tot € 3.453 (m.i.v. 01-11-2026) per maand (FWG 30) en voor de functie van begeleider € 2.649 tot € 3.708 (m.i.v. 01-11-2026) per maand (FWG 35).

  • 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering, 8% vakantiegeld en pensioenopbouw.

  • Flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden. Je kunt een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden naar wens inzetten, bijvoorbeeld voor een laptop, sportabonnement, (lease)fiets of extra verlof (vraag naar de regelingen).

  • Alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen met scholing en coaching via onze eigen Reinaerde Academy.

We hebben nog veel meer interessante arbeidsvoorwaarden, maar die vertellen we graag persoonlijk.

Even voorstellen: jouw nieuwe team of werklocatie

Dagbeleving 156 is onderdeel van De Heygraeff in Woudenberg. Op de carrouselgroep in Wetering begeleid je volwassenen en ouderen met een ernstige verstandelijke beperking.

Geen dag is hetzelfde! Je sluit aan bij het tempo, de behoeften en signalen van de bewoners en ondersteunt waar nodig bij persoonlijke verzorging, eten en drinken. Samen met je collega’s zorg je voor een fijne dag met activiteiten zoals wandelen, bewegen, koken, snoezelen en gezellig koffiedrinken.

Je werkt in een betrokken en lerend team waar ruimte is voor eigen ideeën. De bewoners worden ouder en hebben steeds meer behoefte aan lichamelijke ondersteuning. Daarom combineer je persoonlijke verzorging met aandacht voor gedrag en beleving. Een afwisselende plek waar je écht van betekenis bent en samen met bewoners en collega’s zorgt voor een fijne dag.

Je loopt bij voorkeur mee van 9.00 tot 16.00 uur, eventueel tot 15.00 uur, en draait ook een opstartmoment mee. Zo krijgen we een goed beeld van elkaar en het werk.

Zo ziet jouw werkdag als (ondersteunend) begeleider dagbeleving eruit

Je ontvangt de cliënten en zorgt voor een rustige en duidelijke start van de dag. Samen met je collega’s bekijk je welke activiteiten passen bij de groep en wat iedere cliënt op dat moment nodig heeft. Een kleine greep uit jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Begeleiden van belevingsgerichte, creatieve en bewegingsgerichte activiteiten.

  • Observeren van cliënten en het dagprogramma aanpassen aan hun signalen en behoeften.

  • Ondersteunen bij eten, drinken en persoonlijke verzorging.

  • Zorgen voor rust, structuur en een veilige omgeving.

  • Samenwerken met collega’s van de dagbeleving, woonlocaties en andere betrokkenen.

Met jouw geduld, creativiteit en oplettende houding merk je ook kleine veranderingen bij cliënten op. Je brengt ideeën in, maar kunt een plan ook loslaten wanneer iemand die dag iets anders nodig heeft.

Jouw werkdagen en -tijden zijn

  • Je werkt tussen de 14-28 uur per week. Het precieze aantal uren en de werkdagen spreken we samen af.

  • Werktijden zijn in de basis tussen 9.00 en 16.00 uur en opstart- en ontbijtdiensten vooraf aan 9.00 uur op een woning kunnen onderdeel zijn van je dag.

Ben je er klaar voor?

Reageer dan direct. Liever telefonisch solliciteren of eerst nog een vraag over de functie van (ondersteunend) begeleider dagbesteding? Bel of whatsapp Bram van Meer (recruiter), T 06 51 49 69 18.

Ook belangrijk

Net als wij vind ook jij een veilige en vertrouwde omgeving voor cliënten en collega’s belangrijk. Daarom lever je vóór je eerste werkdag een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) aan.

Wij zoeken graag zelf onze nieuwe collega (ondersteunend) begeleider dagbeleving, daarom hoeven bureaus écht niet mee te helpen zoeken.

title: Site Supervisor
description:
Job Summary:B&P Solutions, LLC is seeking an experienced Site Supervisor to support Army Intelligence and Security Command (INSCOM) Access Control Officer and Escort Support Services.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Overseeing the activities of the Access Control Officers and Escorts, including coordinating a weekly staffing schedule
  • Provide access control services for government facility locations
  • Control access of personnel, equipment, and media going into and out of the INSCOM and/or MSC secure facilities
  • Visually determine, through face-to-face ID checks, that personnel accessing the SCIF have the specific badge required for facility access, and that personnel bringing in or exiting the facility with equipment and media have the Government-issued and approved equipment and media entry/exit authorization forms
  • Issue ESCORT REQUIRED badges to all un-cleared personnel to include official visitors, unofficial visitors, foreign visitors, custodial, maintenance and repair services providers and construction workers
  • Ensure security clearance and SCI access levels of all visitors requesting access to the SCIF are verified in Defense Information System for Security (DISS) or Scattered Castles and cleared visitors, both government and contractors are issued the appropriate visitor badge per the approved Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and notify sponsors of visitor arrival
  • Conduct random entry/exit inspections in accordance with the local Entry/Exit Inspection Program (EEIP)
  • Inspect and ensure personnel bringing in approved equipment and media have the appropriate Government issued and approved and valid equipment/media entry/exit authorization form
  • Utilize Central Monitoring Stations (CMS) to include Lenel, and which are used to process 100% access verification and validation for all cleared and un-cleared individuals utilizing Government facilities
  • Maintain a shift log in accordance with Post and INSCOM Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
  • Maintain sign-in sheets for cleared and un-cleared visitors for the facility
  • Conduct an equipment and log inventory of government furnished equipment within 15 minutes of each shift change and maintain a log of accountability
  • Provide immediate notification of any and all attempts to gain forceful entry, hostage conditions, fire, medical emergency and any other life-threatening situations (i.e. bomb threats) to DA police, (local police as a secondary measure) and or any other applicable emergency team i.e. (fire and rescue)

Basic Qualifications:

  • Security Clearance: Active DoD TS/SCI
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen

title: Lead Geophysicist
description:
Salary: entry level £29,953.56, experienced £31,458.85 - £32,853.44 + generous benefits package
Hours: Full time, 37.5h/week
Locations: Based in Hereford, Silsoe, Cleckheaton or Boxworth. We will also consider candidates based at RSK Group offices, including Romsey, Didcot and Manchester. Regular travel to sites across the UK will be required
Contract Type: Permanent (with 6 month probationary period)
Closing Date: October 19th 2026

Following the creation of a new Geophysics and Exploration section, Headland is expanding its geophysical survey team and recruiting experienced staff to meet its increasing project portfolio.

Do you ever wonder how archaeological sites are located and identified in the first place? Do you want to be at the forefront of the development of geophysical survey techniques in the commercial field? Do you want to join a large team with a range of experience working on nationally important and interesting projects throughout the United Kingdom and the EU?

Why Should You Apply?
We are a privately owned archaeological business, part of the RSK Group, a leader in integrated environmental, engineering, and technical services. We provide heritage services to the development and construction sectors in UK and across the world. With four offices in England and one in Scotland, we offer our employees:
  • Unique knowledge and expertise. For the past 30 years, Headland has provided not only business-focused archaeology but also people-focused business. We are highly respected within our industry for our achievements in innovation, tailor-made development coaching and training, and our expertise in commercial archaeology.
  • Strong pioneering spirit. Our corporate culture is characterised by a healthy appetite for originality and development.
  • Stable company with excellent growth. Over the years, we have demonstrated steady, positive economic development and formed successful partnerships.
  • Good work environment. You will be surrounded by colleagues who are pleasant, professional, and enthusiastic about their work.
  • Opportunity to influence. You get to work in an open climate, close to decision makers and with the possibility of making a difference.
  • Part of RSK group. You will have further opportunities to become involved in nationally and internationally prominent projects with exciting prospects for career development. The group has c.17000 employees and c.230 environmentally lead companies.
We are looking for candidates who are self-driven with a positive outlook and excellent understanding of archaeological geophysics and British archaeology. The Lead Geophysicist role involves being in sole charge of small to medium sized projects covering a range of survey techniques including magnetometer, electromagnetic, earth resistance, GPR. The role also involves working within a wider team structure on larger and more complex projects. You will provide supervision, technical support and mentorship to teams of geophysicists involved with surveying. In addition, the role includes regular rotation on to office-based tasks associated with reporting, processing or other activities relating to your own projects and those of the wider team.

As part of the geophysical survey team you will get involved in several large and exciting projects across the UK and EU. We have many large-scale infrastructure projects throughout 2026, which include landscape wide 1000+ha sites and linear schemes. Working away and travelling in new places is a normal part of this role.

In Headland we are proud of our people. We will support you to your meet your goals and train you in specific archaeological and other skills to feel confident and succeed in your role.
Essential Key Skills
  • a minimum of 6-12 months experience in commercial archaeological geophysics for the entry level position; and at least 12-18 months experience in commercial archaeological geophysics, preferably 6 months Lead Geophysicist experience for the experienced level,
  • Exhibit an aptitude for geophysical survey and willingness to learn and lead others
  • Understand the principles of archaeological geophysics, surveying and leading small teams
  • Understand key policies and laws applicable to role
  • Proficient in use and understanding of MS Office suite,
  • A relevant degree, or proven experience,
  • Full, valid driving licence and willingness to travel,
  • Sound knowledge of safe working practices for typical geophysical survey projects, competent at assessing and managing risk,
  • A willingness to travel, work on projects across the UK and when required stay on site and/or occasionally work weekends on geographically distant projects,
  • Experience in the use of commercially available survey processing and graphics packages such as QGIS.
  • Good time and pressure management skills, ability to use your own initiative within the company structure
  • Good written and oral communication skills

Desirable Skills
  • Membership of the CIfA
  • Ability to motivate and help coordinate teams
  • An ability to carry out prolonged manual work in an outdoor environment
  • Ability to work under pressure and use your own initiative
  • SHEQ Accreditations (First aid, Asbestos Awareness, Lantra Sit Astride)

  • Competitive paid subsistence when applicable
  • Paid accommodation when working away
  • Employee Assistance Programme (advice on finance, mental health etc)
  • Use of cutting edge technology on site, e.g. paperless systems, iPads etc.
  • Ongoing regular training in various areas e.g. Health & Safety, Technical areas and transferable skills
  • Time off in lieu of time worked above standard hours or overtime paid
  • Annual profit discretionary bonus & performance-related bonus schemes, T&Cs apply
  • Annual pay review
  • Monthly clothing allowance
  • 30 days annual leave, rising based on service length
  • Extra annual leave purchase scheme
  • 5%-6% employer contribution to pension scheme
  • Income Protection Policy, after a year with Headland
  • Life Assurance Policy, insuring you 4 times your annual salary, after a year with Headland
  • Regular performance, wellbeing & professional development check-ins

  • A support group of 30+ Mental Health First Aiders
  • Regular offers through RSK Group (e.g. Tastecard, Gym membership discount, Holidays and Entertainment)
  • Paid CIfA membership

How to apply
To apply for this role, please click the Web/Apply button above and submit your application through the Headland Archaeology Applicant Tracking System.

As part of our commitment to fair and inclusive recruitment, our Applicant Tracking System removes certain identifying information from applications during the initial screening stage. This allows hiring managers to focus on candidates’ skills, experience and suitability for the role, helping to reduce the potential for unconscious bias and ensuring a more objective recruitment process.

You must have the right to work in the UK without restrictions. Proof of eligibility will be required prior to your commencement. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and we may fill existing vacancies before the closing date, so you are advised to submit your application as early as possible.

Headland is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Headland Archaeology is committed to creating an inclusive recruitment process. If you have a disability or need any adjustments to enable you to take part in the interview, please contact us at hr@headlandarchaeolgy.com so we can make suitable arrangements.

title: Growth Lead
description:
Zinc's committed contracts sell across SMB, mid-market and enterprise. Alongside them sits a substantial and fast-growing pay-as-you-go (PayG) revenue stream: mostly small organisations signing up to run checks on a credit card, self-serve. We have never tried to optimise this channel for growth or retention. It has succeeded organically regardless, become a meaningful contributor to revenue and customer base, and proven a reliable discovery route into future committed contracts.

This is a single senior owner for the PayG / Consumption Core: responsible for maximising ARR growth from PayG accounts, and acting as the internal champion, operational lead and strategic lead for the revenue stream. Broadly greenfield, with room for real, measurable impact.

You will start hands-on as an individual contributor, with scope to build a team as the channel scales.

What success looks like

  • ARR growth from PayG. Grow revenue from PayG accounts, covering both consumption revenue, conversion into committed contracts, and making sure we’re full utilising pay as you go and self serve as a marketing channel in it’s own right.
  • Retention. PayG accounts that stay and grow. Low churn, healthy expansion within the base.
  • A playbook. A repeatable, testable operating model for the channel that can be iterated and improved.
  • Own the PayG GTM with Marketing, Partnerships and sales: focussing on messaging, channel growth and conversion to improve customer acquisition.
  • Demo conversion of small accounts. Work sales to enable fast follow-up, automating as much of the process as possible to help them handle the
  • Support the product flows, with Tech and Product: helping to feedback to improve self-enablement, and conversion. Small tweaks to wording and positioning might make a huge difference.
  • Pricing strategy, with the CRO and CFO: packaging and price built for a high-volume channel.
  • PayG Retention & committed conversion, with the Customer team and Lifecycle Marketing team. There are two desirable outcomes for the customer team 1) converting suitable PayG accounts into subscriptions 2) Keeping them supported and successful across support and account management in a low touch away. As the overall PAYG owner, you will support and help them optimise these outcomes.
  • Reporting and insight for the channel. Own the numbers end to end.
  • Strong commercial background. You understand GTM fundamentals in a high-volume environment in a B2B context.
  • You have owned a self-serve / PLG funnel end to end: activation, conversion, retention. Not just top of funnel.
  • Highly numerically literate. Comfortable in the data yourself, running A/B tests and using data to optimise conversion systems.
  • Pricing and packaging instinct. You run price and packaging tests, you don't just execute someone else's.
  • Strong instincts for messaging and for building growth and referral loops.
  • Bias to action. This is greenfield. You build the playbook, you don't inherit one. You need to be comfortable with ambiguity, good at imposing not requiring structure and have a strong entrepreneurial streak

title: Technician.Service.I
description:
You will join the Romania service team and learn to safely inspect, service, test and prepare Anderreamer/BHE tools. This is a practical, hands-on role combining workshop activities with occasional field and warehouse support.

You will follow a structured training and competency pathway, working alongside experienced technicians. As your capability develops, you will take on greater responsibility for BHE servicing. The role may involve regional travel, typically for periods of around one to two weeks.

  • Assemble, disassemble, inspect, service and test Anderreamer/BHE tools following NOV procedures and HSE requirements.
  • Learn to identify components, take measurements, assess wear and accurately complete service documentation.
  • Report damage, abnormal wear, test failures and other non-conforming conditions.
  • Support servicing of other RH/DH products when trained and authorized.
  • Assist with warehouse activities, including receiving, storage, picking, packing and inventory.
  • Provide occasional workshop and field support at other NOV or customer locations.
  • Maintain a safe, clean and organized working environment.
  • Complete required product, HSE and competency training and progress toward standalone Service Technician capability.

Must-Have

description:

title: Head of IT & Development
description:
We are looking for an experienced Head IT & Development professional with a strong technical background and an excellent understanding of how technology can be aligned with business needs. You have a solid understanding of software development and experience working closely with developers and technical teams. At the same time, you are able to understand and map business processes, identify what business needs are, and translate those needs into practical technology solutions. You are comfortable taking ownership, making decisions, and setting priorities rather than focusing only on the technical side of IT. Experience in a fast-growing, commercial and/or trading environment would be a strong advantage. Caely is constantly expanding its products and services portfolio as well as its worldwide geographical presence. To support this growth, ongoing agile development of our information systems is key. And our IT infrastructure needs to be scaled up globally.
As Head of IT, you will be responsible for making sure our technology supports the needs of Caely's growth strategy. You will work closely with different teams to understand their challenges and priorities and translate them into clear technical solutions and projects. You will lead and support the software development team, set priorities, and ensure that development work is perfectly aligned with business requirements. In addition, you will ensure seamless integration of information systems of acquired companies.
Alongside development, you will oversee the wider IT function, including internal IT support, external IT providers, cybersecurity, and core business systems. This is a broad leadership role for someone who can combine technical knowledge with strong business understanding and take ownership of the company's IT environment.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in IT & Software Development, engineering, or a similar technical field, with experience leading developers or technical teams.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business & IT, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of software development and the ability to work effectively with developers and technical teams.
  • Strong business understanding, with the ability to understand business processes and translate business requirements into practical technology solutions.
  • Experience managing external IT providers and overseeing areas such as IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and business systems.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of the IT function, and drive projects and priorities forward.
  • Living in or near Amsterdam.
As part of our hiring process, you will be invited to our office to meet the team and your prospective manager.
Caely only publishes job vacancies through our official platforms: LinkedIn (Caely Renewables: Overview | LinkedIn) and website (Home - Caely Renewables). All communication from Caely will be from a @caely.com email address only.
Caely is not affiliated in any way to third party recruiters unless authorized.
Please disregard any written or oral request for a job offer or an interview that you believe is or might be fraudulent or suspicious and immediately get in touch with us via email at recruitment@caely.com upon receiving a suspicious invite or offer or claim.

title: 23054 - Probation Service Officer - West Midlands Pre-Release Team - Birmingham
company: His Majesty's Prison and Probation Service
description:
Where applicants provide multiple location preferences, reserve lists will be managed in accordance with location preference/s, as indicated in your application. We will appoint in merit list order for each location outlined in the vacancy and hold a separate locational reserve list for each of these locations. After appointments have been made using this locational appointment process, any remaining candidates who met the benchmark for the role will remain on a locational reserve list in accordance with their preferences for 12 months.

Please only indicate preferences where you are prepared to work. If you are subsequently offered a role from the reserve list for a location preference indicated in your application and decline it, you will be removed from the reserve list for the vacancy, across all locational preferences.

All offers of employment will be made strictly in merit order, based on your performance throughout the recruitment process. Candidates at the top of the merit list will be offered vacancies as they arise in their chosen locations.

Once you have accepted an offer for a role, you will be withdrawn from any other live applications for the same role and will no longer be considered for those vacancies.

The addresses listed in the job advertisement are not an exhaustive list of potential base locations, they give an indication of some of the potential locations you could be based at.

We will therefore endeavour to offer you a vacancy within a 60-minute commute of your home location.

New entrants to the Civil Service will be expected to join at the entry point salary for the advertised band.

Existing Civil Servants will have their salary calculated in accordance with the Departments pay on transfer / pay on promotion rules.

The post is currently advertised without VISOR Vetting to enable appointment to take place as soon as possible, however, VISOR vetting will be required to be completed in post offer.

Some PSO roles require the completion of an apprenticeship as part of the required learning and development. You will be advised on commencement in role if you are required to complete it.

Working Arrangements & Further Information

The MoJ offers Hybrid Working arrangements where business need allows. This is an informal, non-contractual form of flexible working that blends working from your base location, different MoJ sites and / or from home (please be aware that this role can only be worked in the UK and not overseas). Some roles will not be suitable for Hybrid Working. Similarly, Hybrid Working will not suit everyone’s circumstances. Arrangements will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate(s) and subject to regular review.

For nationally advertised roles, the successful candidate(s) will be appointed to a MoJ office location, which may include their nearest Justice Collaboration Centre or Justice Satellite Office. This will be discussed and agreed on the completion of pre-employment checks.

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Implementation Project Lead, Supply Chain Planning
description:
About the role

At Bluecrux, we help organizations turn complex supply chains into smart, efficient, fully integrated value chains. In this role, you will lead client-facing supply chain planning transformation and software implementation projects from discovery and process design through build, testing, go-live, and hyper-care. You will bring structure to complex projects, guide Bluecrux consultants and client stakeholders, and make sure business requirements become practical, scalable solutions.

Anaplan is an important part of the work, but the role is broader than one platform. You will combine supply chain planning expertise, project leadership, client steering, and enough technical understanding to work effectively with Solution Architects and delivery teams.

What you will do:

  • Oversee Anaplan projects from initial design to implementation.

  • Lead a team of Bluecrux consultants and key client stakeholders.

  • Collaborate closely with clients to redesign planning processes.

  • Develop end-to-end integrated planning concepts.

  • Elevate demand planning, supply planning, S&OP/IBP, network planning, and inventory tactics to higher maturity levels for clients.

  • Work with Bluecrux solution architects to define Anaplan requirements.

  • Act as the critical link between business needs and technical solutions.

  • Organize and support the team to ensure the build process progresses in an agile manner.

  • Focus on user experience and engagement to maximize client adoption.

  • Collaborate with clients to plan and oversee user acceptance testing, user training, go-live, and hyper-care of the newly developed solution.

  • Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure successful Anaplan model implementation.

  • Identify opportunities for future projects on the client’s connected planning roadmap.

  • Assist with pre-sales activities as needed.

  • Play a key role in driving digital transformation for Bluecrux’s clients.

  • Help clients achieve better supply chain planning and operational efficiencies.

#LI-KC1

About you

Educational background

  • You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, supply chain management, economics, or a related field, with strong knowledge of supply chain planning, including demand planning, supply planning, S&OP/IBP, and inventory tactics.

Supply chain planning expertise

  • Proven expertise in developing and optimizing end-to-end supply chain processes, including demand planning, supply planning, S&OP/IBP, network planning, and inventory management. Experience in transforming planning processes and elevating their maturity level.

Technical proficiency

  • Hands-on experience with supply chain planning software such as Anaplan, OMP, SAP IBP, or Kinaxis. Experience in defining technical requirements, designing dashboards, and ensuring data integrity. Certification in Anaplan or similar software is highly desirable.

Project management experience

  • 5+ years of experience managing complex software implementation projects for clients, preferably in supply chain solutions such as Anaplan, OMP, SAP IBP, or Kinaxis. Experience leading projects from initial design through successful implementation and go-live.

Demonstrated success in leading client projects that involved:

  • Collaborating with cross-functional client teams and stakeholders to develop integrated supply chain planning concepts.

  • Enhancing demand and supply planning capabilities for client organizations, including leading design workshops, mapping processes, and supporting process builds.

  • Implementing advanced supply chain software solutions.

  • Executing user acceptance testing and training programs to ensure smooth transitions.

Analytical skills

  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to think in structures and systems and translate client requirements into effective solutions.

Leadership and team management

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage a team of consultants and client stakeholders, with a focus on collaboration and achieving project goals. Proven experience in guiding teams through agile project planning and execution.

Client relationship management

  • Experience in maintaining and nurturing client relationships, ensuring customer satisfaction, and identifying opportunities for future projects. Skilled in driving customer success and post-implementation support.

Agile methodology

  • Familiarity with agile project management methodologies and practices. Experience in planning and executing agile project plans is a plus.

Communication skills

  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences. Ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical client stakeholders.

Industry affinity

  • Experience and affinity with industries such as life sciences, food and beverage, manufacturing, service logistics and parts, and project business. Understanding of industry-specific challenges and regulatory environments.

Language proficiency

  • Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in additional languages is a plus.

Values fit and working model

  • You are willing and able to travel globally and to work in a hybrid working model. Above all, you feel connected with and are ready to represent our company values: dig deep, own it, come together, move fast, and be kind.

Why join us?

At Bluecrux, we’re proud to be a frontrunner in the Anaplan ecosystem, leading supply chain transformations with a highly motivated team of hands-on professionals. Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and living our values every day.

  • Solid understanding of reliability engineering concepts, including monitoring, alerting, service health, and recovery

Some of MoJ’s terms and conditions of service are changing as part of Civil Service reform. The changes will apply to staff joining MoJ who are new to the Civil Service. Staff joining MoJ from other civil service employers will transfer onto the new MoJ terms if they are already on 'modernised' terms in their current post or onto 'unmodernised' MoJ terms if they are on 'unmodernised' terms at their current post. Details will be available if an offer is made.

Standard full time working hours are 37 hours per week excluding breaks which are unpaid. HMPPS welcomes part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns, where they meet the demands of the role and business needs. All applications for part-time, flexible and job-sharing working patterns will be considered in accordance with the HMPPS’ Flexible Working policy.

Benefits

The MoJ offers a range of benefits:

Annual Leave

Annual leave is 25 days on appointment and will increase to 30 days after five years’ service, plus public holidays. Leave for part-time and job share posts will be calculated on a pro-rata basis

Pension

The National Probation Service is covered by the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS) run through the Greater Manchester Pension Fund (GMPF). Please visit www.gmpf.org.uk for further information.

Please note: Any current Civil Servant who is a member of the PCSPS, by accepting an offer of employment to the National Probation Services will be opted out of the PCSPS and auto enrolled into the Local Government Pension Scheme.

Training

The Ministry of Justice is committed to staff development and offers an extensive range of training and development opportunities.

Networks

The opportunity to join employee-run networks that have been established to provide advice and support and to enable the views of employees from minority groups to be expressed direct to senior management. There are currently networks for employees of minority ethnic origin, employees with disabilities, employees with caring responsibilities, women employees, and lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender.

Eligibility

All candidates are subject to security and identity checks prior to taking up post

Support

  • A range of ‘Family Friendly’ policies such as opportunities to work reduced hours or job share.
  • Access to flexible benefits such as voluntary benefits, retail vouchers and discounts on a range of goods and services.
  • For moves to or from another employer or moves across the Civil Service this can have implications on your eligibility to carry on claiming childcare vouchers. You may however be eligible for alternative government childcare support schemes, including Tax Free Childcare. More information can be found on or Childcare Choices. You can determine your eligibility at .
  • Paid paternity, adoption and maternity leave.
  • Free annual sight tests for employees who use computer screens.

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles. Should you feel that the recruitment process has breached the recruitment principles you are able to raise a formal complaint in the following order

  • To Transformative Business Services (0345 241 5358 (Monday to Friday 8am - 6pm) or e mail moj-recruitment-vetting-enquiries@resourcing.soprasteria.co.uk);
  • To Ministry of Justice Resourcing team (resourcing-management-office@justice.gov.uk);
  • To the Civil Service Commission (details available here)

As a Disability Confident employer, MoJ are committed to providing everyone with the opportunity to demonstrate their skills, talent and abilities, by making adjustments throughout all elements of the recruitment process and in the workplace. MoJ are able to offer an interview to disabled candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns.

You will be able to request reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process within the application form. If you need additional help completing the application form, please contact the TBS Recruitment Enquiries Team.

For more information on applying for a role as a candidate with a disability or long-term condition, please watch our animated videos.

Diversity & Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The "Making the Civil Service a Great Place to work for veterans" initiative includes a guaranteed interview scheme to those who meet the minimum criteria to provide eligible former members of the Armed Forces with opportunities to secure rewarding jobs. Allowing veterans to continue to serve their country, and to bring highly skilled individuals with a broad range of experience into the Civil Service in an environment, which recognises and values your previous service in the Armed Forces.
For further details about the initiative and eligibility requirements visit:

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service departments are expected to explore redeployment opportunities before making an individual redundant. The MoJ is committed, as part of the Redeployment Interview Scheme, to providing opportunities to those who are 'at risk of redundancy'.

MoJ is able to offer an interview to eligible candidates who meet the minimum selection criteria, except in a limited number of campaigns. Candidates will not be eligible for the Redeployment Interview Scheme if they are applying on promotion.

Civil Service Nationality Rules

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS) (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/settled-status-eu-citizens-families
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre-settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Further information on nationality requirements (opens in a new window) https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules

Reserve list

A reserve list may be held for up to 12 months from which further appointments may be made for the same or similar roles.

title: Data Engineering Consultant
description:
At AIA we’ve started an exciting movement to create a healthier, more sustainable future for everyone. As pioneering innovators for over 100 years, we’re now transforming our organisation to be faster, simpler and more connected. Because we want to be even better equipped to develop digital solutions and experiences that help more people live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives. To get there, we need people with tech/digital/analytics expertise and passion to help develop positive, sustainable change through digitally enhanced experiences that will impact the lives of millions of people and create a healthier future for everyone. If you believe in developing a better tomorrow, read on.

About the Role

Acts as a technical lead and subject matter expert for the team on data engineering technical stack and integration tools and standard processes used in analytics data management.

Roles and Responsibilities

Understandls, designs, develops, and expands data engineering technical stacks: ETLs, Data Stores, Data Warehouse, Data Lakes, Data Hubs, Data Governance, Visualization, Performance, Infrastructure, and Governance in either enterprise/ open source/ customized solutions or platforms. Expertise in tools and solutions related to data governance which includes but not limited to analyzing and visualizing diverse sources of data, discovering data sources, and making them available through ETL as part of the data democratization initiative. Applies data mining and wrangling on data. Finds opportunities to optimize the ETL environment, implements monitoring, quality, and validation processes to ensure data accuracy and integrity. Provides inputs in data governance to drive data governance charter. o Implements data pipelines to bring data at reach to platforms or tools used by various business units. Maintains development roadmap aligned with product and infrastructure objectives to support advanced data solutions. Analyzes source data and data flows and building APIs or solutions for data consumption or integration to different tools. Provides domain expertise or support to data engineering technical stack post-production. Designs and implements solutions for integration, streaming, processing, and storage of data. This also includes data in data warehouses, data lakes, and/or data hubs and handling of structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data. Works with architects in contributing to the Data Analytics team on standard processes in backend infrastructure, cloud transformation, and distributed computing topics. Handles monitoring of all data cleansing/quality activities including support and mentorship to business users to support all reporting needs, data profiles. Develops team’s data capabilities with sharing, implementing standard processes, and building a data-driven organization.

Minimum Job Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or Engineering courses

Fields of Study: N/A

Industry: N/A

Years of Experience: at least 10 years demonstrated ability in designing, building data warehouses or data lakes.

General Qualifications

Innovative, proactive, creative, well-organized, and able to easily adapt to various technologies. Great interpersonal skills and excellent oral and written communication skills. Able to manage work with internal partners and vendors. Willingness and desire to learn new environment and tools and advance your knowledge. Keeps up to date with new research and integrated applications in data science field. Able to work with loosely defined requirements and exercise analytical skills to clarify questions, share methodology/approach, and build/test solutions.

Technical Qualifications

Demonstrates extensive experience in IT Transformation in Technology including cloud, dev sec ops, and integration. Demonstrates experience in ability to lead the building and maintenance of application lifecycle roadmaps aligned with the Enterprise Technology Roadmap and Enterprise Architecture. Experience in monitoring and managing IT risks mitigation plans, and strategies related to application domains and corresponding systems.

Certifications / Licenses: N/A

Equal Opportunity

At AIA, we strive to attract, develop and retain a workforce that is as diverse as the customers we serve and to cultivate an inclusive work environment that accepts the strength of heritage and individuals.

"Better" starts with people who reimagine what is possible and turn ideas into meaningful action. At AIA, you will contribute in your own way, help shape outcomes that matter and collaborate with colleagues across disciplines, teams, markets and levels. We will support you to broaden your perspective, strengthen your capabilities and grow your impact. Together, we challenge assumptions, learn from one another and find better ways forward. Bring your ambition, experience and ideas to AIA, and help shape what “better” looks like. View our AIA LinkedIn page Bring your difference to AIA

title: Cloud IT Architect
description:
Meer dan 2000 professionals omarmen bij Smals elke dag de toekomst door zich in te zetten voor ICT for Society. Hoogtechnologische ICT-systemen zorgen voor meer efficiëntie in de belangrijke sociale verantwoordelijkheidsdomeinen van onze klanten zoals werk, gezin en gezondheid. Het eHealthplatform, een beveiligd uitwisselingsplatform voor medische informatie, zal papieren doktersbriefjes en doktersvoorschriften op termijn overbodig maken. Daarnaast zorgt de ICT-service Dimona er voor dat de RSZ de sociale bescherming van 4 miljoen werknemers snel kan laten evolueren, ongeacht hoe snel ze van job veranderen. Handig? Jazeker, en uitdagend ook.


Jobomschrijving

Als Cloud IT-architect werk je aan een samenhangende en veilige herziening van de IT-architecturen om de groei en de NIS2-conformiteit van de instelling te ondersteunen.

Concrete taken:

• Samenhangende en schaalbare cloud-/hybride architecturen ontwerpen of herzien op basis van een grondig inzicht in de behoeften en beperkingen.
• De geschikte clouddiensten (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) evalueren en selecteren en ervoor zorgen dat elke architecturale beslissing de bedrijfsdoelstellingen ondersteunt.
• Beveiliging integreren vanaf het ontwerp (security by design) en de NIS2-vereisten vertalen naar concrete architecturale keuzes (veerkracht, monitoring, toegangscontrole).
• Een robuuste netwerksegmentatie en IAM-architectuur ontwerpen.
• De traceerbaarheid en controleerbaarheid van kritieke data waarborgen.
• Toepassings- en data-architecturen op elkaar afstemmen en databases integreren in het technologische ecosysteem.
• Anticiperen op prestatie- en schaalbaarheidsproblemen.
• Architecturen duidelijk en bruikbaar documenteren.
• Architectuurstandaarden vaststellen en handhaven.
• Effectief samenwerken met de teams op het gebied van beveiliging, infrastructuur, ontwikkeling en management, en de teams begeleiden bij de overgang naar een nieuw IT-architectuurontwerp.
• Bedrijfsbehoeften vertalen naar technische taal en omgekeerd.

Je hebt een master in informatica of gelijkwaardige ervaring en beschikt over minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in het ontwerpen van complexe IT-architecturen.
Je hebt praktische ervaring met cloudarchitectuur (GCloud, Azure, AWS) en met het end-to-end begeleiden van projecten, evenals een operationeel inzicht in de uitdagingen van migratie en transformatie.

Een cloudcertificering of een certificering als IT-architect is een pluspunt.

Je beschikt over aantoonbare beheersing van cloudomgevingen en architecturale patronen en hebt een uitstekend begrip van netwerken, beveiliging, IAM en encryptie.

Je beschikt over gedegen kennis van veerkrachtige en hoogbeschikbare architecturen en bent vertrouwd met NIS2 en/of ISO 27001.

Dankzij jouw vermogen tot nauwkeurige analyse en synthese in complexe situaties ben je in staat om kritieke technologieën en oplossingen te beoordelen.

Door je vermogen om het totaalbeeld te behouden, verlies je de zakelijke uitdagingen niet uit het oog.

Je uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden zorgen ervoor dat je technische zaken zonder jargon kunt uitleggen.

Je beschikt over een goed verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel en zorgt ervoor dat je samen met anderen tot een oplossing komt in plaats van alleen te beslissen.

Je hebt een goede kennis van het Frans.

title: LDAR Operator (Saudi National)
description:
About us:

At Aellia (formerly Intero - The Sniffers), we support our customers in understanding, managing, and improving their environmental emissions. We combine precise, real‑world emissions measurement with deep regulatory and operational expertise, turning field data into decision‑ready insight.

With more than 30 years of international field experience and operations across 40+ countries worldwide, our work is grounded in accredited methodologies, advanced analytics, and recognised standards, with hands‑on operational delivery. Our solutions include Advisory, Emissions Management and Pipeline Management, covering everything from emerging requirements to regulated environments.

We believe that lasting impact starts with strong values — and that’s what makes us EPIC. Therefore we:

  • Strive for Excellence

  • Put People First

  • Act with Integrity

  • Champion the Customer

These values form the backbone of our international projects and guide how we collaborate, communicate, and innovate within Aellia.

Aellia is hiring LDAR Operators now for projects across Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC. If you have experience in fugitive emissions monitoring, or want to start a career in the environmental and emissions field, we want to hear from you.

Your role:

  • Monitor fugitive emission components (valves, pumps, flanges, connectors) at refineries, gas plants and petrochemical facilities

  • Carry out leak detection using a TVA (EPA Method 21) and OGI cameras

  • Record and tag data accurately on handheld devices, following project procedures

  • Work safely in live plant environments and follow site HSE rules

Who are we looking for?

  • Saudi national

  • Diploma or above in a technical, mechanical, chemical or environmental field

  • At least 1 year of LDAR experience preferred. We will train candidates who have strong mechanical aptitude.

  • Familiarity with a TVA (Toxic Vapor Analyzer) and OGI cameras is an advantage

  • Able to walk long distances, climb ladders and work outdoors in hot industrial conditions

  • Able to lift up to 23 kg

  • Valid Saudi driver's license

  • Basic English for field records and communication

  • H2S or other safety certifications are a plus

What we offer you:

  • Full training on Aellia methods, equipment and our emissions platform

  • Work on major oil and gas projects in the region

  • A clear path to grow within an international emissions specialist

Why choose us?

At Aellia (Formerly Intero - The Sniffers) you will find yourself with an international market leader in environmental services and integrity solutions.

You will work with cutting-edge technologies, surrounded by passionate colleagues, and visibly contribute to supporting customers in their growth towards more sustainable and efficient business operations.

title: Software Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Spain.

Pay: $50–$100/hr

Role Title: Senior Software Engineer

Role Type: Contractor (~15 hrs a week)

Location: Remote

the company is selecting Software Engineers to support a customer’s innovative project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

As an expert you will be creating Reinforcement Learning Environments which test and AI model's ability to solve complex software engineering problems related to fixing code, creating features, refactoring code and optimizing performance. You will be tasked with creating a reproducible environment and golden reference solution for the problem.

Scope of Work

  • On this project, you will create realistic, interesting, and extremely challenging coding tasks for frontier AI models using your favourite repositories!
  • You will design problems that require strong software engineering skills, such as tracking down subtle bugs, building non-trivial features, or improving performance.
  • For each task, you will define the problem, build a reproducible environment, and write deterministic verifiers that accept correct solutions across different valid implementations while rejecting incorrect, incomplete, or hard-coded approaches. You will also provide a reference solution showing how the task can be solved.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Significant hands‑on expertise in at least one of the following: Python3, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript.
  • Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software engineering principles.
  • Proven ability to debug complex systems, resolve bugs, and deliver effective optimizations.
  • Experience with large codebase refactoring and legacy system modernization.
  • Track record of delivering high-impact features from conception through delivery within cross-functional projects.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills to articulate technical concepts clearly.
  • Interest in or curiosity about AI and its technical challenges (previous AI experience not required).

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

title: STUDENT- Graduate Assistant at Wellness Clinic
description:
Graduate Assistant at Wellness Clinic

The Ithaca College Wellness Clinic is a membership-based fitness center located in the Center for Health Sciences. Its mission is to provide quality health and fitness services to the Ithaca College community—including faculty, staff, retirees, graduate students, and spouse/partners—while enhancing the practical experiences of Exercise Science students in Human Science and Human Performance through guided clinical training.

As part of this mission, the Graduate Assistant plays a key role in supporting the operations and programming of the Wellness Clinic. This position requires advanced knowledge in exercise science and wellness practices, strong leadership skills, and the ability to work independently on projects and initiatives. The Graduate Assistant serves as a liaison between professional staff and student employees, taking a leadership role in team coordination, communication, and operational excellence.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and current or previous Graduate Assistantship in Exercise Science.
  • Must be enrolled in the Exercise Science Master’s program (Human Performance or Mental Performance track).
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise professional judgment, maintain confidentiality, and provide exceptional customer service.
  • Previous work experience and/or training relevant to the operations of The Wellness Clinic including experience in at least one of the following areas: exercise science, fitness programming, administrative tasks, scheduling, team leadership, marketing/advertising, or professional communication.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision, use professional judgment, maintain confidentiality, and provide exceptional customer service.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience, including team coordination or mentoring roles.

Key Competencies:

  • Leadership and mentoring skills
  • Advanced technical and industry knowledge
  • Strong communication and presentation abilities
  • Problem-solving and decision-making
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities

Core Responsibilities:

  • Operational Leadership & Communication: Assist in managing day-to-day operations of the Wellness Clinic, ensuring adherence to policies and procedures. Serve as a key liaison between professional staff and student employees by facilitating clear communication, promoting alignment with clinic goals, and supporting smooth operations.

title: C Lineman - Transmission
description:
Position Summary

The Class C Lineman is an entry level line worker position to construct and repair electrical transmission systems. You will work on energized and de‑energized powerlines and may be required to travel to different job sites, including out‑of‑state locations, as operational and customer needs dictate. You will report to the Foreman.

Essential Functions

  • Perform new construction, maintain and repair energized and de‑energized transmission systems while putting safety first.

  • Help install and repair overhead transmission lines, poles, insulators, conductors and related hardware.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of switching and tagging procedures, EPZ -grounding and understanding induced voltage on de-energized lines using the proper tools and test equipment.

  • Climb different structures (wood, steel, concrete) using approved climbing methods and equipment.

  • Work at heights and in proximity to energized equipment.

  • Proficient in all aspects of heavy lifting and rigging.

  • Operate and maintain bucket trucks, digger derricks, tensioners and pullers and other pieces of transmission line equipment.

  • Work outdoors in varying environmental conditions, including extreme heat, cold, rain, wind, and inclement weather.

  • Available to work outages, storms, emergencies including on call rotation.

  • Follow all safety protocols including PPE use and possess a comprehensive understanding of insulated protective cover to isolate differences of potential on energized lines.

Minimum Requirements

  • Two (2) years of recent transmission line experience.

  • Valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL).

  • Willing to travel long distances on short notice.

  • Lift, carry, push, or pull materials and equipment weighing up to 50 pounds.

  • Work for extended periods at different job locations, including out‑of‑state assignments.

  • Willing to work outside of normal business hours, including weekends, holidays, emergency callouts, and overtime.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you will be required to talk, listen and use hand signals to communicate. The job frequently requires you to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle objects, operate tools or controls; reach with hands and arms.

Work Environment

While performing the responsibilities of this job, you are frequently exposed to fumes or airborne particles, moving mechanical parts and vibration. You are occasionally exposed to a variety of extreme conditions at constructions job sites. The noise level in the work environment and job sites can be loud. You will perform job responsibilities in extreme heat, cold, wet, windy, and storm conditions.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • HSA, dependent care and medical flexible spending accounts

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Life insurance, and short-term and long-term disability

  • Paid time off, paid holidays, and family and medical leave

If this sounds like you, come join the PIKEfamily.

About Us

Founded in 1945, Pike is a leading provider of construction, repair and engineering services for electric and gas utilities, as well as telecommunications companies with a growing portfolio of turnkey renewable projects. We work with hundreds of utility clients across the country, and we continuously expand our offerings to supply our customers with the ideas, technology, experience, workforce and equipment to perform any job.

"Essential" is the one word that sums up who we are, the work we do and what our people mean to us. Each of our employees plays a critical role in ensuring that infrastructure systems are up and running when people and businesses need them.

Pike is a family-oriented workplace with a strong culture of safety, collaboration, innovation and exceptional customer service.

Pike Electric, LLC, is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Group CTO
description:
Anchr is een Belgische buy-and-build softwaregroep, georganiseerd als een slanke holding: een klein centraal team en softwarebedrijven die eigenaar blijven van hun eigen producten, technologie en strategie. De groep brengt momenteel 9 softwarebedrijven samen in 6 domeinen, met meer dan 300 medewerkers in België en Nederland, meer dan 3.000 klanten en een omzet van meer dan €50 miljoen.

Hoe ziet jouw dag er precies uit?

Dit is een technologische rol in het hart van Anchr. Vandaag wordt deze rol ingevuld door externe adviseurs — we willen dit intern brengen. De CTO bepaalt de technologiestrategie, begeleidt de bedrijven bij de adoptie van AI en ondersteunt hen doorheen veranderingstrajecten.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Competitief verloningspakket

  • Standplaats Mechelen (hoofdkantoor Anchr), minstens twee kantoordagen per week, met regelmatige verplaatsingen naar de Belgische en Nederlandse portfoliobedrijven.

  • Portfoliobedrijven hebben hulp nodig bij hun transformatie. Verschillende van de negen bedrijven draaien op oude codebases — vaak slechts grondig gekend door een handvol mensen. Deze rol helpt hen veilig te moderniseren en AI-native processen op te zetten die legacy-systemen makkelijker overdraagbaar maken.

  • Een kans om een leemte in technisch leiderschap in te vullen. Sommige bedrijven hebben nog geen sterk technisch leiderschap. Deze rol helpt die leemte te dichten — door de interne kandidaat verder te ontwikkelen of, indien nodig, door aan te werven.

  • De waarde van AI is nog niet zichtbaar in de cijfers. Er bestaan al echte AI-toepassingen binnen de groep, maar die vertalen zich nog niet in resultaten, terwijl concurrenten er al op prijzen en mee verkopen.

  • Negen bedrijven lossen dezelfde problemen elk apart op. Deze rol maakt delen de moeite waard — een platform dat niemand gebruikt, is erger dan helemaal geen platform.

Wat zoeken wij?

Je technische skills

  • Je gebruikt AI zelf, dagelijks — je raadt het niet enkel aan. Je gebruikt persoonlijk AI-tools voor coderen, reviewen, testen en migreren in je eigen werk, zodat je uit eigen ervaring weet wat echt tijd bespaart.

  • Je kunt een AI-native architectuur en processen opzetten om legacy codebases te helpen overdragen.

  • Je zet processen en opvolging op en verbetert continu.

  • Je voert technische due diligence uit bij nieuwe overnames.

  • Je herkent de senior engineer die eigenlijk al tech lead zou moeten zijn en helpt hem of haar die stap te zetten. Je werft enkel extern aan als er intern niemand is, en je kent de Benelux-talentmarkt.

Je soft skills

  • Je kunt leidinggeven zonder formeel gezag. Technisch genoeg om aan te schuiven bij een code review, diplomatisch genoeg om een founder-CEO uit te dagen die zijn bedrijf al van bij de start leidt.

  • Je zorgt dat kennis tussen teams stroomt. Je zet praktische manieren op waarmee teams oplossingen delen — met een echte eigenaar en echt vrijgemaakte tijd.

  • Je spreekt de taal van de business. Je kunt een business case opbouwen en die in commerciële termen verdedigen.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de holding en alle Anchr-bedrijven een AI-first aanpak hanteren in elk aspect van de business, of het nu gaat om finance, HR, legal, sales of eender welke andere afdeling.

  • Je rapporteert aan de leiding van Anchr, met zichtbaarheid naar onze investeerders.

Je diploma

  • Master

Je taalvaardigheid

  • Nederlands

  • Engels

title: Data Analytics Engineering
description:
At Globe, our goal is to create a wonderful world for our people, business, and nation. By uniting people of passion who believe they can make a difference, we are confident that we can achieve this goal.

Job Description

Are you driven by a passion for creating robust, scalable data solutions that can handle the ever‑increasing volume, velocity, and variety of data spanning a wide range of areas? Are you excited about designing real‑time data processing systems that can handle millions of transactions per second? Do you aspire to build fault‑tolerant, highly available data pipelines that ensure business continuity and support critical operations? Do you dream of putting together data solutions that bring data together while allowing for fast, complex queries that can influence and drive business decisions? As a data engineer, you’re at the forefront of the data movement, bridging the gap between raw information and actionable insights. Your role is crucial in refining and maintaining the data backbone of Globe, supporting both operational efficiency and analytical workloads. Your aspirations might include:

  • Architecting data platforms that seamlessly integrates both operational and analytical workloads, providing trusted sources of data for the entire organization.
  • Designing and implementing scalable, reusable data pipelines, defining frameworks, and leading data‑related projects to support the company's needs.
  • Implementing cutting‑edge data governance and security measures to ensure compliance with regulations like DPA or GDPR while maintaining data accessibility.
  • Exploring the potential of cloud‑native data solutions and multi‑cloud strategies to optimize cost and performance.
  • Advocating for and implementing DataOps practices to increase collaboration between data practitioners, and other stakeholders.

As a data engineer, you're not just building systems; you're shaping how Globe interacts with and derives value from its data. Your work has the potential to unlock new business opportunities, drive innovation, and inform strategic decisions at the highest levels.

Your daily grind:

  • Build and maintain robust data platforms for operational use cases.
  • Design and implement scalable, reusable data pipelines, defining frameworks, and leading data‑related projects to support the company's operational needs.
  • Develop Data Platform by leading the design, development, and maintenance of a scalable data platform to support various operational data use cases.
  • Define and establish frameworks governance and best practices for data pipeline design, development, and deployment, ensuring efficiency and scalability.
  • Create architecture, design, and implement reusable and efficient data pipelines for ingesting, processing, and transforming data from diverse sources into formats ready for operational use, while adhering to best practices in automation and optimization.
  • Provide accurate level‑of‑effort estimates for new initiatives and change requests, facilitating effective project evaluation, budgeting, and tracking for success.
  • Develop proofs‑of‑concept, minimum viable products (MVPs), prototypes, and product demos to showcase the feasibility and potential of new data solutions.
  • Utilize project management methodologies and tools to plan, execute, and monitor data projects, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business objectives.
  • Stay up‑to‑date with emerging data technologies, frameworks, and tools, and assess their potential impact on the organization’s data strategy and operations.
  • Ensure that data security best practices are integrated into all aspects of data platform development and pipeline management.
  • Support in designing data pipelines, data lakes, warehouses, and machine learning solutions to power other business units with data.
  • Build, and produce scaled data pipelines, lakehouses, and machine learning infrastructure on AWS or GCP.
  • Maintain efficient, accurate and safe data storage and flow, and right‑size data infrastructure resources based on usage analytics and workload profiling.
  • Assess operationalization of technologies like distributed computing, streaming analytics, and cloud‑native data patterns in ISG’s environment.
  • Collaborate with Cloud & Infra Engineers to implement automation and policies to eliminate waste, stop unused resources, increase efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve data‑related issues

Throughout your day, you’ve tackled challenges in data integration, optimization, and architecture, all while ensuring that your Globe’s data remains accurate, accessible, and secure. Your work forms the backbone of our data‑centric processes.

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Technical Expertise: Strong background in programming languages like Python, SQL and Java In-depth knowledge of Data Engineering tools is preferred (Airflow, NiFi, Dataflow, AWS Glue) Experience in ETL development and management Experience in Data warehousing solutions (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) Experience with Cloud Platforms (AWS and GCP) In‑depth experience in automated data pipeline design, implementation and support Experience in Data Processing, Data Tools, Data modeling Familiarity with GitOps Principles Experience in DevSecOps Processes Understanding of data engineering design and development best practices Understanding of data management best practices Experience: 5+ years of hands‑on experience as a Data Engineer, in designing and implementing data solutions and data pipelines.
  • Problem‑Solving Mindset: Analytical, with the ability to take on abstract business challenges, and design practical and scalable solutions.
  • Strong Communication Skills: Comfortable in translating technical requirements into clear, concise business objectives.
  • Team Leadership: Experienced in guiding cross‑functional teams to success in a fast‑paced, agile environment.

Make Your Passion Part of Your Profession

Attracting the best and brightest Talents is pivotal to our success. If you are ready to share our purpose of Creating a Globe of Good, explore opportunities with us.

Globe Telecom, Inc. (Globe) is the leading Telecommunications company in the Philippines and the purveyor of the Filipino digital lifestyle. We provide cellular, broadband and mobile data services by focusing on enriching our content offerings amid customers' growing preference for multimedia platforms across multiple screens and devices. We want to enrich lives through communications by simplifying technology, so that we bring customers closer to what matters most. Globe was also recognized as one of the Top companies to work for in Asia by Asia Corporate Excellence & Sustainability (ACES) Awards and Best Employer in the Telco category by Stevie’s New York. Our principal shareholders are Ayala Corp. and Singtel, both industry leaders in their respective countries and in the region. We are also a member of Bridge Alliance, Asia Pacific's leading mobile alliance of 36 mobile carriers.

Purpose

Vision

We see a Philippines where families' dreams come true, businesses flourish, and the nation is admired.

Mission
