title: Azure DevOps Engineer (.Net)
description:
Uw rol
Als Azure DevOps Engineer (.Net) ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en onderhouden van robuuste en schaalbare .NET-toepassingen in een Azure-omgeving. Je werkt nauw samen met andere medewerkers van de IT-afdeling om iteratief en incrementeel software te leveren. Je neemt deel aan PI (Program Increment) Planning en andere Agile ceremonies. Je speelt eveneens een sleutelrol in het waarborgen van de kwaliteit en prestaties van de software.

Jouw taken:
- Ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en onderhouden van herbruikbare .NET-componenten. Deze componenten worden hergebruikt door de andere development teams en je biedt hiervoor ondersteuning en documentatie aan.
- Ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en onderhouden van herbruikbare Azure DevOps CI/CD componenten.
- Samenwerken met cross-functionele, agile teams binnen een SAFe-omgeving: je werkt nauw samen met andere ontwikkelaars, testers, architecten, product owner en scrum masters om iteratief en incrementeel software te leveren.
- Deelnemen aan PI Planning en andere Agile ceremonies.
- Technische problemen analyseren en oplossen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het oplossen van bugs en biedt technische ondersteuning aan minder ervaren collega's binnen en buiten je development team.
- Kwaliteitsborging en code reviews. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het uitvoeren van code reviews en het waarborgen van de kwaliteit van de code door middel van unit tests, integratietests en andere QA-methoden.
- Bijdragen aan technische documentatie en kennisdeling binnen en buiten het team. Je maakt de technische documentatie op, controleert de opgestelde documentatie van minder ervaren collega's binnen het development team.
- Technisch leiderschap bieden en minder ervaren teamleden begeleiden.
- Continu verbeteren van ontwikkelingsprocessen en softwarekwaliteit. Daarbij volg je de trends en evoluties op wat technologieën en methodologieën in je domein betreft.


Uw profiel

- Je beschikt over een Bachelor in de Informatica of je kan gelijkwaardige ervaring aantonen en je hebt minimum 3 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie.
- Je beschikt over een sterke kennis van .NET, met name C# en ASP.NET Core. Daarnaast kan je een grondige ervaring aantonen met Azure DevOps, specifiek in het opzetten en beheren van CI/CD-pipelines. Ervaring met Azure en Bicep is eveneens essentieel, aangevuld met een basiskennis van SQL en een goede beheersing van Git.
- Bijkomende ervaring met WCF, Blazor, Aspire, gRPC (gRPC Remote Procedure Calls) en GitHub Enterprise wordt beschouwd als een meerwaarde.
- Je communiceert helder en overtuigend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Je weet technische concepten duidelijk over te brengen aan stakeholders. Met je sterke analytische en probleemoplossende vaardigheden pak je complexe uitdagingen doelgericht aan.
- Je blijft jezelf continu ontwikkelen in nieuwe technologieën en methodologieën. Je bent een echte teamspeler, schakelt vlot tussen verschillende taken en prioriteiten en blijft flexibel bij verandering.
- Daarnaast neem je een coachende rol op en help je collega's om technisch verder te groeien.
- Je begrijpt het Frans en weet je ook schriftelijk op een elementair niveau uit te drukken. Tot slot heb je ook wat het Engels betreft een goede lees- en luistervaardigheid.


Ons aanbod

- Je krijgt een gevarieerde, uitdagende en maatschappelijk relevante job waarbij je bijdraagt aan IT-oplossingen die een belangrijke rol spelen in de samenleving. Onze slogan 'ICT for society' weerspiegelt dit perfect.

Daarnaast coördineer je diverse projecten, zoals G-Cloud initiatieven (IaaS en PaaS), NIS2 compliance, security initiatieven zoals phishingcampagnes en disaster recovery. Je stelt een IT-roadmap op voor de volledige infrastructuur en vertaalt businessbehoeften naar concrete technische oplossingen, bijvoorbeeld op het vlak van Microsoft Copilot/AI, SharePoint en cloudmigraties.

De functie omvat ook het onderhouden van relaties met externe partners en leveranciers, evenals actieve deelname aan Service Level Meetings, de opvolging van KPI's en het beheer van certificaten. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen, opvolgen en bewaken van het INFRA IT-budget, met bijzondere aandacht voor kostenbeheersing.

Tot slot wordt de performantie en betrouwbaarheid van systemen en netwerken continu opgevolgd via automatisatie en monitoringtools zoals XDR Vision One, SOC, SIEM en Nagios. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met andere IT-afdelingen en de DPO om te verzekeren dat alle veiligheids- en compliancevereisten correct worden nageleefd.

title: Verzorgende IG Gehandicaptenzorg
description:
Jij ziet aan iemands gezicht of het een goede dag is, nog voor diegene zelf iets zegt. Bij De Drie Ringen in Utrecht Leidsche Rijn wissel je verzorging af met begeleiding, een luisterend oor en samen de dag vormgeven. Je werkt met ouder wordende bewoners met een verstandelijke beperking die naast zorg vooral behoefte hebben aan aandacht, structuur en een vertrouwd gezicht.

3 redenen waarom dit jouw baan is

  1. Je combineert zorg en contact.
    Je helpt bij de ochtendroutine, maar loopt ook even binnen om te kijken hoe iemand erbij zit. Verpleegtechnische handelingen zijn een dagelijks onderdeel van je werk, en je bent er ook voor het praatje aan tafel.

  2. Je leert je bewoners écht kennen.
    Bij ons wonen 28 bewoners, verdeeld over twee afdelingen. Elke afdeling heeft een eigen team van circa 10 collega's. Na een tijdje weet jij precies wat iemand nodig heeft. Dat maakt je werk overzichtelijk én betekenisvol.

  3. Je kunt hier doorgroeien.
    Er zijn mogelijkheden voor vakinhoudelijke verdieping. Als je dat wilt, kun je een betaalde opleiding volgen richting verpleegkundige, waarbij je werken en leren combineert.

En ja, dat verzorgende‑IG diploma niveau 3 heb jij natuurlijk gewoon in de pocket.

Wat jij verdient

Jij zorgt goed voor anderen, wij zorgen goed voor jou. Zo vinden wij een goede balans in werk‑privé heel belangrijk. Daarnaast verdien jij:

  • Direct een vast contract (met twee maanden proeftijd) voor 16-36 uur per week.

  • Een bruto salaris tussen € 2.649 en € 3.708 (m.i.v. 01-11-2026) per maand (cao Gehandicaptenzorg, FWG 35, o.b.v. 36 uur per week).

  • 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering, 8% vakantiegeld en pensioenopbouw.

  • Flexibele arbeidsvoorwaarden. Je kunt een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden naar wens inzetten, bijvoorbeeld voor een laptop, sportabonnement, (lease)fiets of extra verlof (vraag naar de regelingen).

  • We hebben nog veel meer interessante arbeidsvoorwaarden, maar die vertellen we graag persoonlijk.

Wil je verder groeien? Dan zijn er doorgroeimogelijkheden, waaronder een betaalde opleiding tot verpleegkundige, waarbij werken en leren worden gecombineerd.

Even voorstellen: jouw nieuwe team en werklocatie

De Drie Ringen is een kleinschalige woonlocatie in Utrecht Leidsche Rijn voor 28 ouder wordende bewoners met een verstandelijke beperking. Sommigen hebben ook lichamelijke beperkingen of niet-aangeboren hersenletsel, waardoor zorg en begeleiding nauw met elkaar verweven zijn. De één is eigenwijs en zelfstandig, de ander heeft juist meer nabijheid of duidelijkheid nodig.

We werken in kleine teams: twee woonteams van circa 10 collega's, één per afdeling, en een eigen team dagbesteding waar je nauw mee samenwerkt. Collega's hebben oog voor elkaar. Heb jij een idee om iets beter te doen? Dan denk je mee over hoe wij het hier doen.

Zo ziet jouw werkdag eruit

  • Je start met de overdracht en een ronde langs de bewoners

  • Je ondersteunt bij opstaan, aankleden, eten en de dagelijkse verzorging

  • Verpleegtechnische handelingen horen er dagelijks bij, zoals medicatie en controles

  • Je maakt tijd voor de momenten tussendoor: een praatje aan tafel, een activiteit, samen op gang komen

  • Je signaleert veranderingen in gedrag of welzijn en bespreekt die met je collega's

  • Samen zorg je voor een rustige, voorspelbare dagstructuur

Jouw werkdagen en -tijden zijn

  • Een vaste vrije dag.

  • Wisselende dag-, avond- en weekenddiensten.

Ben je er klaar voor?

Reageer dan direct. Liever telefonisch solliciteren of eerst nog een vraag over de functie Verzorgende IG? Bel of whatsapp Marc Brugman (recruiter), T 06 – 57769919.

Ook belangrijk

Net als wij vind ook jij een veilige en vertrouwde omgeving voor cliënten en collega’s belangrijk. Daarom lever je vóór je eerste werkdag een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) aan.

Wij zoeken graag zelf onze nieuwe collega Verzorgende IG, daarom hoeven bureaus écht niet mee te helpen zoeken.

description:

At Rampart, we value unrelenting curiosity and pushing the bounds of human knowledge through science. Driven by a vision to make the connected world safer and more secure, we have advanced information theory and secured fundamental patents that are revolutionizing digital communications.

Our innovative RF technology sits at the intersection of Cryptography, Information Security, and Digital Signal Processing (DSP). We are building a high-performance, high-trust culture for self-motivated engineers who thrive on solving complex, foundational challenges in science and systems.

title: Technical Writer - Senior
description:

This combination enables the writer to understand complex products, systems, drawings, specifications, and processes, then translate that information into clear, accurate, user-focused documentation for technical and non-technical audiences. The role partners closely with developers, engineers, product teams, field personnel, and other subject matter experts to create documentation for software, hardware, robotics, industrial equipment, operations, maintenance, integration, and product knowledge transfer.

title: Service Delivery Lead
description:
Holland America Line has been exploring the world since 1873. Our ships offer innovative features and enriching experiences focused on destination exploration and personalized travel, inviting guests to savor the journey.

The IT Service Delivery Lead, Commercial Systems is responsible for ensuring the efficient and effective delivery of IT services that support the Contact Center operations for Holland America Line and Seabourn. This role involves leading incident and problem management processes, monitoring service performance, analyzing service level agreements (SLAs), and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The position also includes managing stakeholder communications, generating performance reports, and maintaining documentation to support service delivery excellence. The IT Service Delivery Lead will work closely with cross-functional IT support teams, Contact Center stakeholders, and vendors to ensure timely resolution of issues, maintain service stability, and align IT services with business objectives. The ideal candidate will have strong analytical and communication skills, experience with IT service management tools (such as ServiceNow), and a solid understanding of technologies including end-user computing, cloud services, networking, and enterprise applications.

Here’s a summary of what Holland America Line is looking for. Is this you?

Responsibilities:

  • Incident and Problem Management: Lead the resolution of IT incidents and problems affecting Contact Center operations. Monitor ServiceNow queues, escalate complex issues, and coordinate with technical teams to ensure timely service restoration. Identify root causes and drive long-term remediation efforts.

  • Service Performance Monitoring and Reporting: Analyze service level agreements (SLAs), generate performance metrics, and identify trends. Create dashboards and reports to support data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement.

  • Stakeholder Engagement, Change Readiness, and Initiative Coordination: Serve as the primary liaison between Contact Center leadership, business stakeholders, project teams, IT support teams, vendors, and technology owners. This role is accountable for ensuring stakeholders remain informed, engaged, and prepared throughout the lifecycle of technology initiatives, service changes, and operational improvements. The IT Service Delivery Lead facilitates alignment between business and technology teams, drives effective communication strategies, oversees business readiness activities, and ensures operational impacts, risks, dependencies, and adoption considerations are identified and addressed. Acting as a trusted advisor and communication leader, the role maintains visibility into initiatives affecting Contact Center operations and promotes shared accountability for successful outcomes while ensuring business objectives remain aligned with technology delivery efforts.

  • Technology Initiative Governance and Delivery Oversight: Provide operational ownership and governance for technology initiatives that impact Contact Center operations and supporting Commercial Systems. The IT Service Delivery Lead is responsible for ensuring projects, enhancements, and service improvements are delivered in alignment with business objectives, operational requirements, support readiness expectations, and established service delivery standards. This role maintains visibility into initiative progress, facilitates governance reviews, monitors risks and dependencies, and escalates concerns when delivery commitments, operational readiness, or business outcomes are at risk. While not serving as a formal project manager, the position assumes a leadership role in coordinating activities, driving accountability across stakeholder groups, facilitating decision-making, and filling delivery gaps when dedicated project management resources are not assigned or required. The role ensures that operational support models, documentation, training, communications, and transition activities are sufficiently developed to support successful implementation and long-term service sustainability.

  • Process Optimization and Compliance: Review and enhance IT service delivery processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness. Ensure adherence to compliance standards and maintain documentation, including knowledge articles and training materials.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Governance: Lead collaboration efforts across technical teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and support organizations to ensure the successful delivery, support, and continual improvement of Contact Center technologies and services. The IT Service Delivery Lead facilitates governance activities, drives resolution of operational challenges, and promotes accountability for commitments, action items, and service outcomes across participating teams. Through active engagement in governance forums, planning activities, and strategic initiatives, the role helps align technology priorities with business objectives, identifies opportunities for service improvement, and fosters a culture of partnership, transparency, and shared ownership. The position serves as a key connector between operational teams and business leadership, ensuring that decisions are informed by both service performance data and business priorities.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Scope: The IT Service Delivery Lead operates within the IT Service Delivery team and serves as the primary operational liaison between Contact Center stakeholders, IT support organizations, project teams, technology owners, and external vendors. The role has broad influence across operational service delivery, continuous improvement initiatives, and technology implementations affecting Contact Center operations for Holland America Line and Seabourn. While the position does not typically own technical solutions directly, it is accountable for driving cross-functional alignment, ensuring operational readiness, facilitating stakeholder engagement, and promoting successful business outcomes. The role's influence spans infrastructure, applications, cloud services, networking, security, telephony, and end-user computing environments, requiring a holistic understanding of how technology services collectively support business operations and customer experience.

  • Problem Solving: This role requires advanced analytical, organizational, and facilitation skills to address complex operational and business challenges. The IT Service Delivery Lead is expected to lead major incident and problem management activities, evaluate service performance trends, identify systemic risks, and coordinate long-term remediation efforts. In addition, the role must assess the operational impact of technology initiatives, anticipate adoption and readiness challenges, manage competing stakeholder priorities, and drive alignment across multiple teams with differing objectives. Success requires the ability to navigate ambiguity, facilitate difficult discussions, remove roadblocks, and balance business, operational, and technical considerations while maintaining focus on service quality, customer experience, and organizational goals..

  • Impact: The IT Service Delivery Lead has a significant impact on the reliability, effectiveness, and continual improvement of technology services supporting Contact Center operations. The role directly influences service quality, stakeholder satisfaction, operational readiness, and the successful adoption of new technologies and service enhancements. Through governance, communication, coordination, and accountability activities, the position helps ensure that technology investments deliver intended business value while minimizing operational risk and disruption. The role also contributes to organizational maturity by promoting process discipline, improving cross-functional collaboration, enhancing service transparency, and strengthening alignment between business priorities and technology capabilities.

  • Leadership: Although the position does not typically include direct management responsibility, it requires a high degree of leadership through influence. The IT Service Delivery Lead is expected to drive accountability across technical teams, vendors, project resources, and business stakeholders while fostering collaborative working relationships and a shared commitment to service excellence. The role leads incident response efforts, facilitates governance and decision-making forums, manages stakeholder communications, and serves as an advocate for operational readiness and business success. In situations where formal project management resources are limited or unavailable, the position provides facilitation, coordination, and delivery leadership to help ensure initiatives remain aligned, risks are addressed, and commitments are fulfilled. Success in this role requires the ability to influence outcomes, build consensus, and maintain ownership of service delivery objectives in complex and rapidly changing environments.

Essential/Minimal Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in IT service delivery, IT operations, or technical support roles. ITIL Foundation certification (or higher) in IT Service Management. Demonstrated experience with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and familiarity with incident, problem, and change management processes. Proven ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Must be legally authorized to work in the country of employment.]

Essential Experience Required:

  • Proven Experience in IT Service Delivery and Operations: Demonstrated ability to manage and improve IT service delivery processes in a complex, multi-system environment. Hands-on experience with incident, problem, and request management frameworks, particularly using ITSM platforms like ServiceNow.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Experience working across multiple IT domains (e.g., infrastructure, applications, networking, security) to coordinate service restoration and improvement efforts. Ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams without direct authority, especially during high-impact incidents.

  • Stakeholder and Vendor Management: Experience maintaining effective communication with internal business stakeholders and external vendors during service disruptions and improvement initiatives. Skilled in translating technical issues into business-relevant updates and managing expectations.

  • Analytical and Reporting Skills: Experience analyzing service performance data, identifying trends, and using insights to drive continuous improvement. Proficiency in creating and maintaining dashboards, reports, and documentation to support service governance.

  • Technical Breadth Across IT Systems: Working knowledge of a broad range of technologies including end-user computing, M365, remote access, identity and access management (IAM), networking (LAN/WAN/WiFi), telephony, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications. Ability to understand and troubleshoot issues across these systems in collaboration with technical teams.

  • Technology Initiative Leadership and Operational Readiness: Demonstrated experience coordinating technology implementations, service improvements, operational readiness activities, or business transformation initiatives in a complex IT environment. Proven ability to facilitate cross-functional teams, drive accountability for deliverables, manage risks and dependencies, coordinate stakeholder communications, and successfully guide initiatives from planning through operational transition, particularly in environments where formal project management resources may not be dedicated to every effort.

Travel: No or very little travel likely

Work Conditions: Work primarily in a climate-controlled environment with minimal safety/health hazard potential..

description:

What You Bring

  • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills across commercial HVAC systems

  • Experience servicing several of the following:

    • Chillers

    • Cooling towers

    • Pumps

    • Water-side HVAC systems

  • Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation

  • Ability to work independently and make effective troubleshooting decisions in the field

  • Strong customer service and communication skills

  • Ability to safely perform the physical requirements of commercial HVAC service work

  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record

Preferred Experience

  • Manufacturer certifications or factory training on commercial HVAC equipment

  • Experience with Building Automation Systems (BAS) and controls

  • Experience troubleshooting and servicing multiple brands of commercial HVAC equipment

  • Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to other Service Technicians

What We Offer

  • $50–$60 per hour based on experience and qualifications

  • Four-day, 10-hour (4/10) workweek with a guaranteed 40 hours

  • Commission opportunities on sold repair and replacement quotes

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid time off and company holidays

  • Ongoing technical training and professional development opportunities

  • Opportunities for continued career advancement within a growing mechanical organization

Why Anderson Mechanical Services?

At Anderson Mechanical Services, our Service Technicians are essential to the relationships we build with our customers. Our team works on a wide range of commercial HVAC and mechanical systems, providing technicians with opportunities to solve challenging problems, expand their technical expertise, and build long-term careers.

If you're an experienced commercial HVAC professional who knows how to diagnose complex systems, solve problems, and deliver exceptional service, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply today and continue building your career with Anderson Mechanical Services, a VMG Company.

title: Freelance Cloud Strategy Architect (Freelance kan)
description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Dienst: Digital Transformation Office (DTO) – cloud- en hostingarchitectuur

Voorstelling

Het Digital Transformation Office stuurt de digitale transformatie aan. De cloud-, server- en infrastructuuromgeving wordt verder geprofessionaliseerd en beveiligd, met een sterke focus op hybride infrastructuur, security by design en integratie met on-premise platformen.

In deze rol ondersteun je de organisatie en DTO specifiek op het vlak van cloud en hosting. Je werkt nauw samen met de IT-dienst, platform- en engineeringteams en stemt af met onder meer data-, security- en enterprise-architectuur, evenals met business stakeholders.

Missie

Als Cloud Architect ontwikkel je de cloud- en hostingstrategie. Samen met de betrokken stakeholders bepaal je hoe cloud- en hostingtechnologie veilig, financieel beheersbaar, juridisch verantwoord en duurzaam wordt ingezet. Je maakt afwegingen over dataplaatsing tussen on-premise, private cloud, IaaS/PaaS en SaaS, en vertaalt strategische doelstellingen naar een meerjarige roadmap, een cloud operating model, architectuurprincipes en governancekaders.

Daarnaast adviseer je de bevoegde beslissingsorganen via heldere, niet-technische nota’s over investeringen, sourcing, datasoevereiniteit, leveranciersafhankelijkheid, risico’s en prioriteiten. De concrete solutionarchitectuur en technische implementatie liggen bij de betrokken architectuur-, platform- en engineeringteams. Deze functie is daarom uitgesproken strategisch en adviserend van aard.

Op te leveren (deliverables)

  • Een meerjarige cloud- en hostingroadmap en een cloud operating model
  • Architectuurprincipes, referentiearchitecturen en governancekaders op hoog én gedetailleerd niveau
  • Een kader voor hosting en dataplaatsing (on-premise, private cloud, IaaS/PaaS, SaaS)
  • Minimale eisen voor logging, auditability, encryptie, sleutelbeheer en dataresidentie
  • Een KPI-set en rapportering over kosten, veiligheid, beschikbaarheid en migratie
  • Begrijpelijke, niet-technische adviesnota’s voor beslissingsorganen

Voornaamste taken

  • De bestaande situatie analyseren en een doelarchitectuur met migratiepaden uitwerken
  • Wetgeving, operationele vereisten en dataclassificatie vertalen naar concrete guardrails
  • Per type gegevens de meest geschikte hostingopties beoordelen, inclusief SaaS
  • Kosten opvolgen volgens FinOps-principes en KPI’s monitoren
  • Risicoacceptatie voorbereiden en onderbouwen voor de bevoegde beslissingsorganen
  • Afstemmen met IT over veiligheidsmaatregelen en technische noden vertalen naar architectuurkeuzes
  • Architectuurvoorstellen onderbouwen en verdedigen tegenover zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders
  • Proactief partners en stakeholders betrekken en de brug vormen met andere architectuurdisciplines

Kennisdomeinen

  • Cloud- en hostingarchitectuur: Azure (IaaS/PaaS, landing zones, subscriptions, management groups, resource governance), hybride infrastructuur (ExpressRoute/VPN, WAN), networking en on-premise datacenters
  • SaaS en servicemodellen: shared responsibility per servicemodel, dataresidentie, toegangsbeheer, contractuele aandachtspunten en exitmogelijkheden
  • Security en operationele basis: Zero Trust, security by design, IAM (Entra ID, RBAC, PIM), encryptie en sleutelbeheer, logging en auditability
  • FinOps, IaC en automatisering, monitoring, containers en BC/DR
  • Datasoevereiniteit, leveranciersafhankelijkheid, exitstrategie, dataclassificatie, wetgeving en GRC, inclusief NIS2 en GDPR in hoofdlijnen

Communicatie en samenwerking

  • Je communiceert helder, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, op strategisch, tactisch en technisch niveau
  • Je slaagt erin complexe materie te vertalen naar begrijpelijke adviesnota’s voor niet-technische doelgroepen
  • Je werkt verbindend, bouwt vertrouwen op met uitvoerende teams en verzoent infrastructuur-, security- en operationele belangen
  • Nederlands of Frans is vereist; tweetaligheid is een sterke meerwaarde; Engels is vereist

In de praktijk

  • Standplaats: Brussel
  • Minstens twee dagen per week op kantoor, in overleg met het team
  • Telewerk is mogelijk vanuit België
  • Je werkt in een multidisciplinair team met interne en externe medewerkers

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt een senior profiel met een strategische en adviserende ingesteldheid; dit is uitdrukkelijk geen junior functie
  • Je bent ervaren en matuur, met een sterke basis in cloud én security
  • Je denkt strategisch en zet een cloud- en hostingstrategie om in een haalbare roadmap
  • Je kan architectuur uittekenen op hoog én gedetailleerd niveau en die overtuigend verdedigen
  • Je maakt doordachte hostingkeuzes, inclusief SaaS, op basis van dataclassificatie, soevereiniteit, kost en risico
  • Je verbindt stakeholders, werkt autonoom en neemt initiatief
  • Je beschikt over een masterdiploma of gelijkwaardige ervaring
  • Certificeringen zijn een troef, zoals Azure Solutions Architect Expert, TOGAF, SABSA, FinOps- of cloud security-certificeringen

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).
(Freelance is ook mogelijk)

title: Finance Data Engineer (Senior Manager)
description:
Job Description

UKI Finance RP

Finance Data Engineer

The practice

Finance is one of the most demanding and valuable environments in which to apply modern technology. You will work with complex enterprise data, mission-critical processes and high-impact decisions, using AI, data and engineering to reshape how organisations plan, control performance and allocate resources. The opportunity goes beyond building technically strong solutions: you will see how those solutions influence cash, profitability, risk and business growth, and take them from experimentation into trusted, production-ready capabilities. Working in Finance Reinvention allows you to remain close to leading-edge technology while developing an understanding of the CFO agenda, gaining exposure to senior decision-makers and building the commercial judgement needed to solve enterprise-wide challenges. This combination of deep technical capability, finance-domain expertise and measurable business impact creates a differentiated career path that is difficult to develop in a purely technology-focused role.

Purpose of the role

Responsible for the finance data and ontology layer on which agentic solutions depend. Builds the entities, relationships, definitions, lineage and data contracts sourced from live ERP and EPM systems to a standard that supports controlled and auditable agent behaviour. The role owns governed finance data products, semantic models and retrieval-ready data services that are secure, permission-aware, observable and suitable for AI, analytics and decision intelligence.

Responsibilities

  • Build and extend the finance ontology covering supplier, invoice, customer, receivable, journal, account, cost centre and forecast line, and the relationships between them, including controlled vocabularies, business glossaries, hierarchy history, ownership and lifecycle versioning.
  • Engineer pipelines from SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM platforms into governed data products, supporting structured and unstructured sources, batch and incremental ingestion, APIs, files and change-data-capture patterns as appropriate.
  • Build entity-resolution and master or reference-data capabilities that reconcile identifiers, definitions and hierarchies across source systems and preserve source-to-target mappings.
  • Establish lineage and evidence sufficient for audit, so that agent output can be traced to source, with automated data-quality checks, finance reconciliations, completeness and freshness measures, observability, alerts and recoverable operations.
  • Define data contracts between delivery pods, and between Accenture delivery and client platform teams, including schemas, quality thresholds, access rules, service levels, versioning and change-control expectations.
  • Experience deploying software or data products on Azure, AWS or GCP, DataBricks, Snowflake, Palantir etc using relevant cloud services and at least one of containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns.
  • Work with AI Engineers on retrieval and grounding, ensuring models receive appropriately scoped context, including chunking and embedding strategies, hybrid or graph retrieval, permission-aware filtering, provenance and retrieval evaluation.
  • Implement security and privacy controls across the data lifecycle, including role-or-attribute-based access, row or document-level permissions, masking or tokenisation, retention, tenant isolation and audit logging.
  • Apply software and DataOps practices including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure as code where relevant, performance tuning, cost optimisation and production support.
  • Collaborate with finance SMEs, data owners, architects and governance teams to agree definitions, resolve data issues and embed sustainable stewardship and operating ownership.
  • Data engineering

Essential experience

  • Production data engineering, including SQL, Python, a modern data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake or Fabric, and orchestration tooling, with practical experience of ETL/ELT, data testing, Git and CI/CD; PySpark or dbt experience is beneficial.
  • Working knowledge of finance data structures, including chart of accounts, entity hierarchy, sub-ledger to ledger relationships, intercompany and period close, together with actual, budget and forecast data, currencies, consolidation and management hierarchies.
  • Strong data modelling discipline and the ability to justify and maintain definitional standards, including canonical or semantic models, data contracts, schema evolution, metadata, lineage and data-quality controls.
  • Experience extracting and reconciling data from enterprise applications or complex operational systems using APIs, files, database interfaces or change-data-capture patterns.
  • Experience deploying software or data products on Azure, AWS or GCP, DataBricks, Snowflake, Palantir etc. using relevant cloud services and at least one of containers, Kubernetes or serverless patterns. (AI engineer - desirable)
  • Understanding of secure data engineering, including access control, encryption, secrets, privacy, retention and the handling of sensitive or regulated data.
  • Ability to work with finance SMEs and technical teams to translate business definitions and controls into implementable data products and acceptance criteria.
  • At least 10 years’ relevant professional experience

Desirable

  • Knowledge graph, semantic layer or ontology engineering experience, including technologies or standards such as Neo4j, RDF/OWL, SKOS, SPARQL or GraphRAG.
  • Data quality, master data management or lineage tooling experience, including entity resolution, business glossaries, catalogues or platforms such as Collibra, Purview or Unity Catalog.
  • Exposure to SOX or external audit requirements, GDPR, model-risk controls or regulated-data environments.
  • Detailed knowledge of one or more finance-platform data models, such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, Workday Financials, Anaplan, OneStream or SAP Analytics Cloud.
  • Experience evaluating retrieval quality for AI workloads, including embeddings, vector stores, hybrid search or reranking.

Qualification

N/A

  • London
  • Manchester

title: Journeyman Software Engineer (Full Stack)
description:
Job description

About the role

The Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) combines advanced TypeScript and React development with strong user-interface architecture, automated testing, accessibility, visualization, and API-integration skills. You will independently execute complex assignments, build configuration-driven and AI-enabled user experiences, review code, mentor less-experienced engineers, resolve integration issues, and prepare complete, well-tested software for review and promotion. You will succeed in this role by advocating for accessible and intuitive user experiences while maintaining rigorous technical, security, and engineering-quality standards.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain user-interface capabilities using TypeScript, React 18, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Integrate applications with approved REST and JSON interface contracts and collaborate with back-end engineers to resolve integration issues.
  • Build reusable interfaces that render agents, features, navigation, and application behavior from approved configuration manifests. Develop AI-enabled experiences for agent interaction, tool activity, approval requests, markdown context authoring, response presentation, and execution history.
  • Develop operational and analytical dashboards using React and legacy technologies such as Jinja2, HTML, and CSS. Create responsive and accessible charts and visualizations using Chart.js, D3, or comparable technologies.
  • Incorporate accessibility throughout design and development. Ensure applications meet applicable Section 508 and WCAG requirements through semantic structure, keyboard navigation, screen-reader compatibility, accessible forms, focus management, and appropriate visual treatments.
  • Implement secure session authentication and role-based access controls. Ensure navigation, actions, data visibility, and application behavior reflect approved user permissions.
  • Develop automated tests using Vitest, Testing Library, and related technologies, including unit, component, integration, behavior-driven, end-to-end, regression, accessibility, and performance testing. Apply secure-development and front-end quality practices.
  • Diagnose complex user-interface, API-contract, state-management, authentication, authorization, accessibility, visualization, performance, and browser-compatibility issues.
  • Participate in design and merge-request reviews, developer pairing, and demonstrations. Mentor less-experienced engineers, evaluate emerging technologies, develop assigned prototypes, and present recommendations that may improve usability, accessibility, performance, maintainability, security, or mission value.
  • Follow established technical, security, review, and promotion controls. Promptly elevate unclear requirements, unresolved decisions, security concerns, access limitations, and proposed deviations from approved direction.
  • Maintain component documentation, interface notes, implementation diagrams, accessibility evidence, test results, and configuration guidance. Collaborate regularly with GCC and U.S.-based ASCENT team members and perform all work within approved systems, repositories, datasets, and development environments.

About you

  • Five or more years of progressive full stack software-engineering experience developing, integrating, testing, and delivering production web applications.
  • Advanced production-level TypeScript, JavaScript, and React 18 experience, including component architecture, application state, hooks, routing, asynchronous data handling, error handling, and maintainable front-end design.
  • Experience with Vite or a comparable build tool, Tailwind CSS or a comparable styling framework, and contract-based integration with REST and JSON services.
  • Advanced experience with Vitest, Testing Library, or comparable technologies, including unit, component, integration, behavior-driven, end-to-end, regression, accessibility, or performance testing.
  • Demonstrated experience developing accessible applications that meet Section 508 or WCAG requirements, including semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, screen-reader compatibility, focus management, accessible forms, and appropriate ARIA use.
  • Experience developing dashboards and data visualizations using React, Chart.js, D3, or comparable technologies, with the ability to maintain legacy Jinja2, HTML, and CSS applications.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About PointFive

PointFive finds the cost buried inside enterprise infrastructure, from the cloud to coding agents. We pioneered DeepWaste across cloud and data platforms, and we are now doing the same for AI token spend with TokenShift.
Fanatics, H&M, Hertz, Nubank, Citizens Bank and other Fortune 500 companies use PointFive to see and cut what their infrastructure and AI actually cost.

We have raised $96 million, most recently a $60 million Series B led by Accel. Engineering sits in Tel Aviv and our go-to-market team is focused on North America. PointFive Labs, our research arm, publishes original work on how infrastructure and AI actually get paid for.

CRN named us one of the 10 hottest cloud computing startups of 2026, Forbes Israel put us on its Next Billion Dollar Startups list, and Redpoint selected us for its InfraRed 100, its ranking of the private companies shaping the future of cloud infrastructure.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own TokenShift, PointFive's product for finding and cutting wasted AI token spend. This is a chance to define product strategy for a brand-new category, working hands-on with R&D on how AI agents and LLM models actually run, get monitored, and get paid for in production. You'll take TokenShift from early adoption to a core pillar of PointFive's platform, alongside our flagship DeepWaste product.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for TokenShift, from discovery through GA and beyond.

  • Translate a deep technical understanding of how AI agents and LLM workloads run — inference calls, endpoints, agent harnesses and orchestration — into requirements R&D can build against.

  • Partner with R&D, design, and data science to scope, prioritize, and ship features that surface and reduce AI token waste.

  • Work directly with enterprise customers and prospects to understand how they deploy AI agents in production and where their cost and visibility gaps are.

  • Define and track success metrics — adoption, cost savings, detection accuracy — and use them to drive roadmap decisions.

  • Collaborate with go-to-market teams on positioning, messaging, and launch plans for new capabilities.

  • Stay current on the landscape: coding agents and harnesses, LLM gateways and routers, AI observability, and endpoint management.

  • Represent the voice of the customer internally, balancing technical depth with business impact.

What We're Looking For

Must-have

  • Technical background, e.g. former software engineer or technical PM with hands-on coding or systems experience. You use AI coding agents daily and understand them from the inside.

  • Experience with products deployed as an agent on endpoints, such as EDR/XDR, AI agent security, or visibility and compliance tools: agents running on endpoints, telemetry collection, detection and policy logic.

  • Working knowledge of AI agent harnesses and frameworks — how agentic AI systems are built, evaluated, and deployed in production.

  • 4+ years of product management experience shipping complex technical B2B products, ideally developer tools or infrastructure.

  • Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with usage and cost data at scale.

Nice to have

  • Experience with cloud cost management, FinOps, or infrastructure observability products.

  • Background in cybersecurity or threat-detection products.

  • Hands-on experience with LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) or token-based pricing models.

  • Hands-on experience with LLM routing, AI gateways, or model evaluation and benchmarking.

Why PointFive

  • Founders with a track record

Built and sold IntSights to Rapid7. Backed by top-tier investors with deep conviction in this category.

  • Category-defining product

DeepWaste detection and agentic remediation with clear, measurable ROI for both engineering and finance teams.

  • Early-stage leverage

Your work directly shapes the product, the culture, and the go-to-market playbook.

  • Ground floor of a new category

You'll help define AI token cost management as a product category from near-zero, with direct access to founders and R&D leadership on where TokenShift goes next.

title: Quality Technician
description:
Company Overview:

Diversified Manufacturing has been a premier provider of heat transfer technology, weldments, and fabricated metal components since 1955.​ Our talented team provides engineering, metal fabrication, machining, and integration services to businesses globally.

Position Summary:

The Quality Technician is responsible for ensuring that heat exchangers, pressure vessels, and related components meet all applicable quality standards, engineering specifications, and regulatory requirements. This role supports inspection, testing, and documentation processes in accordance with ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code (BPVC), customer specifications, and internal quality systems.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Performs dimensional, visual, and functional inspections on raw materials, fabricated components, weldments, and finished assemblies.
  • Verifies compliance with ASME BPVC, customer specifications, and internal quality standards.
  • Inspects welds for conformance using visual inspection techniques and assist with non-destructive testing (NDT) methods such as PT, MT, UT, and RT.
  • Reviews material certifications (MTRs) and ensure proper traceability of materials throughout the manufacturing process.
  • Conducts in-process inspections during fabrication stages including cutting, forming, welding, machining, and assembly.
  • Maintains inspection and test records, including inspection reports, logs, and documentation required for data books and customer turnover packages.
  • Identifies nonconformances and assist in root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Supports pressure testing activities (hydrostatic and pneumatic) and verify results meet code and project requirements.
  • Performs internal audits and support external audits from customers or regulatory bodies.
  • Collaborates with engineering, welding supervisors, and production teams to resolve quality issues and improve processes.
  • Ensures compliance with safety requirements and quality procedures on the shop floor.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or technical certification in welding, manufacturing, or quality preferred.
  • 2–5 years of experience in a fabrication or manufacturing environment, preferably involving pressure vessels, heat exchangers, or heavy industrial equipment.
  • Working knowledge of ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code (Section VIII preferred).
  • Familiarity with welding processes (GMAW, GTAW, SMAW, SAW) and weld inspection requirements.

title: Platform Engineer (32 - 40 uur)
description:
Bij HBM Machines bedienen we meer dan een miljoen bezoekers per maand in zeven landen, draaiend op Google Cloud en Cloudflare. Ons Platform Team bouwt het platform en de developer tooling waar alle development teams op werken. We zoeken een Platform Engineer die ons landschap verder brengt, met security als het zwaartepunt waar we het liefst diepgang op binnenhalen.

Als Platform Engineer werk je aan de volle breedte van onze infrastructuur: de GCP- en Cloudflare-omgeving, de infra-monorepo in Terraform, en de developer tooling waar onze teams dagelijks op bouwen, waaronder GitHub Enterprise, Grafana, Sentry en ons AI-platform. Daarnaast verdiep je je in een van onze twee specialisaties: security & governance of observability & monitoring. Meer eigen capaciteit & diepgang op security is een van de redenen voor deze uitbreiding, dus daar ligt onze eerste interesse.

Je komt terecht in een klein platform team in opbouw. Je werkt samen met één interne collega en met onze externe infrastructuurpartner, die capaciteit aanvult waar nodig en expertise inbrengt op de cloudomgeving. Jij bent daarbij de inhoudelijke gesprekspartner: je reviewt hun werk en bewaakt de kwaliteit. Het team levert diensten aan de andere teams, ondersteunend en niet blokkerend. Je zoekt de samenwerking dus actief op.

Concreet betekent dat:

  • Eigenaarschap over developer tooling: GitHub Enterprise, Grafana, Sentry en SSO via Entra.

  • Samen met onze infrastructuurpartner beheren en doorontwikkelen van de GCP- en Cloudflare-omgeving.

  • Oppakken van de securitybacklog: IAM-verbeteringen, opvolging van aanbevelingen en periodieke pentests.

  • DevSecOps inbouwen in de IaC-pipeline: CI/CD voor Terraform met validatie en security scanning.

  • Kosten bewaken en optimaliseren op GCP, waaronder Committed Use Discounts.

  • Documenteren in Confluence en keuzes vastleggen als ADR's.

Wat neem je mee?

Je hebt een sterke achtergrond in cloudinfrastructuur en platformwerk. Je werkt op HBO/WO-niveau en hebt minimaal 4 jaar relevante ervaring (medior-plus tot senior). Daarnaast verwachten we:

  • Ervaring met GCP, AWS en/of Azure (compute, netwerk, load balancing) en Terraform;

  • Ervaring met CI/CD via GitHub en het werken in een monorepo;

  • Kennis van Cloudflare: DNS, WAF en Workers;

  • Ervaring met het beheren van developer tooling, zoals GitHub Enterprise met Entra/SSO en Sentry;

  • Sterke pre: aantoonbare diepgang in cloud security, zoals IAM en least-privilege, kwetsbaarhedenbeheer, threat detection en security-gates in CI/CD;

  • Sterke pre: aantoonbare diepgang in observability: Grafana Cloud, OTEL Collector, Prometheus, alerting en log retentie.

Wat krijg jij?

Een afwisselende baan bij een snel groeiend, internationaal e-commerce bedrijf waar je een echte bijdrage levert aan de verdere professionalisering, daarnaast:

  • Een contract voor (in eerste instantie) 12 maanden met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.

  • Een competitief salaris tussen de € 3.302,- en € 6.427,- bruto per maand (o.b.v. fulltime), afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en vaardigheden.

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder een bonusregeling tot 1,5 maandsalaris, een goede pensioenregeling en personeelskortingen.

  • Hybride werken: minimaal 2 dagen per week op kantoor, de rest bepaal je zelf.

  • Opleidingsbudget en ruimte voor certificering, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van cloud security of Terraform.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding, fietsleaseplan, laptop, thuiswerkvergoeding en een gezellige werksfeer op kantoor en op uitjes.

Interesse?

Ben jij klaar om bij te dragen aan dit snelgroeiende e-commerce bedrijf? Wij ontvangen graag jouw cv en motivatie via de button 'solliciteren'.

Wij ontvangen graag jouw cv en motivatie via de button 'solliciteren’. Vooraf vragen? Dan kun je contact opnemen met Alexandra, onze Recruiter, via solliciteren@hbm-machines.com of 06 86 84 95 75. De vacature wordt gesloten wanneer de juiste kandidaat is gevonden. Wij streven ernaar om binnen 5 werkdagen reactie te geven op jouw sollicitatie.

Over HBM

HBM Machines is al meer dan 50 jaar een bekende naam voor iedereen met een passie voor techniek en vakmanschap. Wat begon als een gereedschapswinkel in Gouda, is uitgegroeid tot een van de grootste online spelers in machines en gereedschap van Europa, actief in zeven landen. En we blijven groeien.

Bij HBM combineren we de ambitie en snelheid van een groeiende organisatie met nuchterheid. We pakken aan, werken samen en kijken altijd hoe het beter kan. Dat zie je overal terug: van onze winkel en ons 40.000 m² grote distributiecentrum tot onze internationale webshops en het gebruik van slimme software, automatisering en AI.

Onze cultuurwaarden laten zien hoe we bij HBM werken: wij groeien, wij tonen vakmanschap en wij maken het leuk. We willen vooruit, zijn trots op wat we doen en vinden het belangrijk dat we dat met plezier en samen met anderen doen.

Wat je rol ook is, bij HBM draag je bij aan onze volgende stap. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, ideeën in te brengen en samen met je collega’s HBM iedere dag een beetje beter te maken.

title: Lead DevOps & Platform Engineer
description:
About Us

At Nurix AI, we envision a world powered by super-intelligent AI agents that transform how businesses engage with customers. Our cutting-edge AI agents do more than just solve problems—they create opportunities. From suggesting next purchases to boosting revenue while maintaining customer satisfaction, to analyzing vast datasets for actionable insights, our technologies shape business and product strategies. is at the forefront of AI innovation, developing cutting-edge AI and LLM solutions to enhance productivity and automation. Backed by $27.5M in seed funding, we are building next-gen AI-driven applications that redefine human-machine collaboration as India’s first scaled AI services company. Backed by robust funding, we are a vibrant, high-ownership team set on redefining technological boundaries.

Join us in building the future, where every interaction is smarter, faster, and more impactful.

Role Overview

We are seeking a versatile Lead DevOps & Platform Engineer who brings a strong blend of core application engineering and cloud/infrastructure platform leadership.

This role requires someone who has built and shipped software as a core application developer (in runtimes like Python, Java, Go, or Node.js) and later transitioned into or spearheaded a DevOps/Infrastructure charter. You will bridge the gap between application development and cloud operations—ensuring our AI agents and SaaS platform are architected for extreme scale, resiliency, and speed of delivery.

If you are a hands-on leader who can "lead by example," write clean code, and design high-availability infrastructure from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

1. Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Architecture (MUST)

  • Design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure primarily on AWS (with exposure to GCP/Azure).

  • Build ground-up multi-region network architectures for enterprise workloads, securing networks into layered trust zones (subnets, VPC peering/privatelinks, NAT gateways at scale).

  • Architect high-availability (HA) and disaster recovery (DR) setups aligned with strict RPOs and RTOs.

  • Design compute, storage, and networking layers for complex, high-throughput systems (microservices, data pipelines, LLM inference endpoints, and vector databases).

  • Automate infrastructure management end-to-end using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation).

2. Containerization & Orchestration (MUST)

  • Set up, monitor, and manage large-scale Kubernetes (EKS/GKE) clusters for seamless deployment of microservices and AI workloads.

  • Manage persistent volume configurations for dynamic pods at scale.

  • Implement best practices for networking policies, service meshes, and ingress control within Kubernetes.

3. Engineering & Technical Leadership (MUST)

  • Leverage your application engineering background (Python, Java, Node.js, Go, etc.) to review developer architectures, optimize backend performance, and build internal platform tooling.

  • Act as a bridge between core product engineering and infrastructure, ensuring applications are designed natively for auto-scaling and cloud reliability.

  • Provide technical mentorship to engineers on deployment strategies, distributed debugging, and cloud-native development practices.

4. Performance Monitoring & Troubleshooting

  • Implement robust observability and telemetry frameworks (APM, distributed tracing, metrics, logging) to track system health and AI model runtime performance.

  • Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) for critical incidents and drive proactive system fixes to eliminate downtime.

5. CI/CD & Security (Good to Have)

  • Oversee and optimize existing CI/CD automation and deployment workflows to maintain high developer velocity.

  • Integrate basic security scanning (SAST/DAST) and ensure general alignment with security and compliance standards.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience: 8–12+ years total experience in software engineering and infrastructure management, ideally within early-stage to growth-stage startups or AI/SaaS companies.

  • Dual Engineering Background: Proven track record having spent time as a Lead Backend/Software Engineer (Python, Java, Node.js, Go) before leading a DevOps / Infrastructure / Platform Engineering charter.

  • Cloud & K8s Mastery: Heavy hands-on experience designing HA/DR cloud architectures on AWS/GCP and orchestrating Kubernetes clusters at scale (CKA certification is a plus).

  • Startup Mindset: Comfortable wearing multiple hats, working in fast-paced environments, and driving systems from 0 to 1 and 1 to 10.

  • Leadership: Strong hands-on technical leader who "leads by example"—capable of diving deep into code, network configs, and architectural whiteboarding.

title: Developer (Graduate)
description:
About Native
Native designs products that get made. Since 1997 we've worked across the US, Europe and Asia for the companies that take the object seriously: Bowers & Wilkins, Bang & Olufsen, Audi, Coloplast, Baxter, Bentley, HP and others we can't name yet. Along the way we've collected more international design awards than any independent studio in Europe.

Job Description
We are seeking a recent graduate to join us on a 6-month full-time contract, with a view to extending or making the role permanent, to help us build ambitious physical-digital products, explore and prototype emerging technologies, and integrate AI into a wide range of experiences. We build right across the stack - from front-end and back-end development to connected devices and embedded platforms. We’re not expecting you to know everything from day one, but you’ll need to be flexible, learn quickly and be extremely comfortable leaping across frameworks, languages and platforms.

You’ll work closely with designers, design engineers, researchers, and clients to translate compelling concepts into working prototypes and production-ready software, creating rich product experiences for brands across consumer tech, healthcare, life sciences, wellness, automotive, and more.

You’ll have the freedom to learn constantly and solve problems that break new ground, while delivering to a high standard of quality. Expect rapid iteration, thoughtful engineering trade-offs, and support from a multidisciplinary team as you grow your craft and help us push ideas from demo to deployment.

Oh, and you'll make work that pushes boundaries and challenges perceptions - always aiming to make a real impact.

Key Responsibilities

Creative Delivery
  • Contribute to the evolution of our AI-centric and collaborative approach
  • Translate designs into well-structured, high-quality software
  • Ensure high-quality, adaptable solutions - comfortable with rapid iteration and change
  • Work across multiple projects for timely, high-quality delivery
Advanced Technology
  • Explore, prototype, and validate new concepts - combining software, electronics, and embedded platforms
  • Support the integration of AI/ML into prototypes and products (with guidance as needed)
  • Support software development for hardware, including custom electronics, sensor data, and connectivity
  • Work with the team to meet Native and (relevant) regulatory expectations for quality, safety, scalability, and security
What You Bring
  • Computer Science or other significant programming based education
  • Any professional or hobbyist experience highly desirable
  • Flexible across languages, environments, and frameworks - for instance, including Angular/React, HTML5, CSS, Node.js, Python, JavaScript, Rust, and SQL
  • Desirable to have experience with C++, C#
  • Experience integrating and implementing AI/ML models and platforms
  • A portfolio demonstrating the successful delivery of highly rich, integrated physical-digital product experiences
  • Strong communication and collaborative skills, comfortable in a fast-paced, creative design environment
  • Must be ready to work on-site at our Shoreditch studio.

Here’s an idea of the sort of Developer we hope is reading this:
  • Full stack: You’re comfortable working across front end and back end, and you can integrate the two with support from the team
  • Innovative: You enjoy building across platforms, experimenting with AI, integrating third-party services, and learning what it takes to connect hardware and cloud services
  • Curious: You see opportunities where others don't. If you open doors, push buttons, and hop over gates for adventure's sake, you're our kind of developer.
  • Collaborative: Our in-house digital teams work closely with our researchers, design engineers, and industrial designers, so you'll need to be London-based and ready to bring your magic to our Shoreditch studio where the real alchemy happens.
  • Practical: You’re comfortable with standard digital platforms and can deliver high quality under pressure and to tight timescales.
  • Adaptable: We're not afraid to kill an idea. Sometimes, we build it, test it, and start again. If this dynamism excites you, you'll make the work of your life at Native.
  • Fun: We're not asking for stand-up comedy routines, but a passion for what you do is essential. We believe the best creatives genuinely enjoy their work.
Here's what you can expect from us:
  • Annual Leave: 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays (pro rata). We actively encourage you to take your leave.
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity and paternity pay.
  • Private Healthcare: Bupa private medical insurance, including 24/7 GP access, mental health support, and specialist care. A health and wellness cashback plan.
  • Wellbeing & Fitness :40% discount across the Hussle Gym network. Access to YuLife wellbeing and fitness benefits, including mindfulness resources, company-wide challenges and cash rewards.
  • Professional Development: Opportunities for learning and development, access to industry talks, exhibitions, and visiting speakers.
  • Studio Culture: Regular company events and studio activities throughout the year.
  • Location: Our Shoreditch studio is well connected and surrounded by a vibrant design and technology community.
  • Independent Studio: Native has operated independently in East London for over twenty years. We are committed to long-term thinking, craft, and delivering thoughtful innovation without compromise.

title: Klinisch psycholoog kind en jeugd
description:
Forta Jeugd is op zoek naar een enthousiaste klinisch psycholoog om het team in Rotterdam of Schiedam te versterken. Vanuit onze locaties bieden we specialistische GGZ in de vorm van diagnostiek en (ambulante) behandeling, aangevuld met passende e-healthprogramma’s. De functie van klinisch psycholoog kan desgewenst worden gecombineerd met de rol van praktijkopleider.

Over Forta Jeugd

Forta Jeugd werkt vanuit een handelings- en systeemgerichte visie. Dat wil zeggen dat we de klachten altijd plaatsen binnen de context van het kind of de adolescent: vrienden, gezin en school. Onze behandelingen zijn gevarieerd, uiteenlopend van cognitieve gedragstherapie (CGT), ACT, schematherapie en traumagerichte behandelingen waaronder EMDR. We bieden individuele begeleiding, ouderbegeleidingen, groepsbehandelingen en systeemtherapie. De behandelingen worden face-to-face op locatie of blended aangeboden. Er zijn zeer goede faciliteiten om online te werken.

Hoewel de casuïstiek complexer is geworden, werken we vrij generalistisch. We behandelen kinderen en jongeren van vier tot en met zeventien jaar met emotionele klachten, gedragsproblemen en/of schoolproblematiek. De aanpak varieert. Er is oog voor hechting bij jonge kinderen en hun ouders. Ruimte voor diagnostiek en behandeling bij basisschoolkinderen en pubers, waarbij bij de pubers beginnende persoonlijkheidsproblematiek niet uitgesloten is.

Over de functie

We kenmerken ons door onze gezamenlijke betrokkenheid waarbij we elkaar inspireren. We creëren een omgeving waarin we elkaar ondersteunen, vertrouwen en gelijkwaardig behandelen. Openheid staat bij ons centraal. We zijn gewend om gezamenlijk verantwoordelijkheid te dragen en zijn altijd op zoek naar innovatieve oplossingen. Onze behandelaren hebben ieder een eigen affiniteit en spelen een actieve rol in het team. Als klinisch psycholoog voer je samen met een collega behandelaar intakes uit en bied je ondersteuning (werkbegeleiding) bij het vervolgtraject op het gebied van (psycho)diagnostiek en behandeling. Als behandelaar voer je daarnaast zelf de complexere (SGGZ) behandelingen, groepsbehandeling, ouderbegeleiding en gezinsgesprekken uit. Je participeert in overleg en intervisie, fungeert als aanspreekpunt bij spoed of specialistische vragen, zowel op inhoudelijk gebied, teamniveau als in de werkprocessen. Je bundelt de krachten, niet alleen binnen het gezin maar ook tussen collega's en de samenwerkingspartners. Het begeleiden, superviseren en enthousiasmeren van de collega's is voor jou ook een logische toevoeging van je functie.

Wat mag je van ons verwachten?

Wij werken vanuit een hecht team waarbij werkplezier voorop staat en ruimte is voor jouw initiatieven. Vanzelfsprekend houden wij rekening met de cao GGZ (FWG 75). Wij zijn een relatief kleine organisatie, met korte lijnen en een informele sfeer. Het is uitstekend georganiseerd met een duidelijk verwachtingsmanagement. Daarvoor gaan wij graag met je in gesprek. De verwachtingen stemmen we graag in een vroeg stadium met elkaar af.

  • Een ongekend leuke organisatie waarin snel geschakeld wordt;

  • Er is volop ruimte om actief mee te denken en eigen initiatieven te ontplooien;

  • De mogelijkheid om de werkzaamheden te combineren met de taken van een praktijkopleider;

  • In overleg zijn er mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en congressen;

  • De uren en werkdagen zijn bespreekbaar, de functie is te vervullen vanaf 24 uur per week;

Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. Collectiviteitskorting bij je ziektekostenverzekering, pensioenopbouw bij Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn, 166 vakantie-uren bij een fulltime dienstverband, 35 uur aan levensfasebudget (LFB) naast je (bovenwettelijke) vakantie-uren bij een fulltime dienstverband, een jaarlijkse 8,33% vakantietoeslag, 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering en tot slot is er een balansbudget. Het balansbudget kan je inzetten voor persoonlijke scholing, vrije dagen of laten uitbetalen.

Wat verwachten wij van jou?

  • Een BIG-registratie en afgeronde opleiding als klinisch psycholoog;

  • Een AGB registratie;

  • Affiniteit en/of ervaring met systemisch werken;

  • Interesse in een brede (en multicomplexe) doelgroep, affiniteit en ervaring met behandeling van jongeren.

Hebben wij je interesse gewekt?

Wij maken het solliciteren niet ingewikkeld. Via de 'solliciteer' knop kun je eenvoudig je persoonlijke gegevens achterlaten, zodat Nora contact met je kan opnemen. Wij kijken uit naar jouw interesse! Nora is bereikbaar via ouwerkerk@forta.nl en 06-43265086.

title: Patient Encounter Specialist
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: The job of the Patient Encounter Specialist is to greet patients and welcome them into the office, schedule appointments by phone and schedule follow up appointments in a face to face setting.


PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Duties and responsibilities of the office assistant are:

• Check patients out.

• Be ready to type letters or send faxes for the provider or nurse if asked.

title: Senior System Administrator
description:
About Univrses

Univrses is a Stockholm-based 3D Computer Vision and AI company. We provide the perception and spatial awareness necessary for an increasingly autonomous world. While our roots are in the automotive sector, we have pioneered a new category: Infrastructure Intelligence. Our 3DAI™ system transforms ordinary vehicles into sophisticated mobile sensors, providing road authorities across Europe (Sweden, UK, Italy, and beyond) with real-time, actionable insights. We are shifting city management from reactive repairs to proactive, data-driven maintenance—saving costs, reducing CO2 emissions, and improving public safety.

The Role

As a Senior Sysadmin at Univrses, you will be the backbone of our technical operations, ensuring that our entire engineering organization has the stable, secure, and scalable infrastructure it needs to thrive.

In this role, you will work closely with the CTO to design and maintain a company-wide infrastructure that is both resilient and secure. You will oversee the cross-functional systems that support all our research, development, and production environments. We are looking for a proactive professional to manage our cloud footprint and on-premise resources, ensuring our team of world-class engineers can work without friction.

This is a on-site position since you will be responsible of our on premise infrastructure.

Responsibilities



Strategic Infrastructure Support: implement long-term infrastructure roadmaps that prioritize company-wide stability and data security.



Core Systems Oversight: Design, deploy, and maintain robust server environments (both AWS and on-premise) that support multiple project teams.



System Reliability & Uptime: Proactively monitor system health and performance across the organization to ensure high availability for all internal and external services.



Resource Governance: Manage global resource allocation (databases, storage, compute).



Security & Access Control: Implement and enforce company-wide security.



Disaster Recovery: Develop and maintain rigorous backup strategies and recovery procedures to protect company data and intellectual property.

Who you are



Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.



Experience: 5+ years of experience in Systems Administration, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.



Maintenance Pro: Proven track record in patch management, software distribution, and maintaining system integrity across a fleet of machines.



Linux Expertise: Deep proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).



Networking Specialist: Strong understanding of networking architecture.



Cloud & Containers: Proven experience managing AWS environments and containerized applications using Docker.



Reliability Mindset: A "security-first" and "stability-first" approach to managing infrastructure, with the communication skills to report directly to technical leadership.



Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Familiarity with Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.



Monitoring Stacks: Experience setting up company-wide monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK.



Storage Solutions: Experience managing large-scale data storage (S3, NAS, Artifactory).

What’s in it for You?

We provide the environment and the tools for you to do the best work of your career.



Responsibility: Become a true stakeholder in a small team where your work actually matters.



Professional Evolution: You will be working on exciting projects involving game-changing technology with an opportunity to improve the world through autonomy and intelligence



The "Work-Life" Blend: Enjoy flexible work hours and a culture that values output over "desk time".



Upsides: A secure Pension Plan and Wellness activities for up to 5 000 SEK per year paid by the company.



The Univrses Culture:



Monday Momentum: Kick off the week with team breakfast.



Thursday Knowledge: Weekly Lunch & Learns where internal or external speakers present interesting topics, while the company pays for and caters the lunch to keep your technical and commercial skills sharp.



Friday Wind-down: Celebrate the week’s wins with our Friday After Work sessions (free beer from our well-curated beer fridge!)



The Workspace: A bright, collaborative office in Stockholm equipped with the essentials (yes, including the mandatory startup ping-pong table).

Next Steps

If you are a systems-oriented thinker who enjoys building stable environments and working at a strategic level to support a high-performing engineering culture, please submit your resume and a cover letter in English!

title: Deputy Country Director- PDQI
description:
KEY AREAS OF ACCOUNTABILITY:

As a member of the Senior Management Team, contribute to:

  • Leadership of the Sudan Country Office
  • Support the development of an organisational culture that reflects SC mandate and values; our full spectrum work from Humanitarian to Development; promotes accountability and high performance; encourages a team culture of learning, creativity and innovation; and, frees up our people to deliver outstanding results for children and excellent customer service for our members and donors
  • Help design and implement a coherent organizational structure that is consistent with agency practices and appropriate to programme needs
  • Help establish, maintain, and improve active and regular working relationships with: government authorities, partner agencies including humanitarian and development donors, and local and international NGOs
  • Ensure the Sudan Country Office complies with all Save the Children Management Operating Standards, Standard Operating Procedures and Child Safeguarding and antiharassment policies
  • Ensure that all required support is provided promptly, at scale and in line with the rules and principles by working closely with the Regional Management and technical advisers.

Strategic Planning + Strategic Reporting

  • Take a lead role in developing program strategies and annual plans ensuring coordination of all technical input to country strategy, proposals and country annual and strategic reports
  • Participate in conceptualizing and designing cost effective, innovative and high quality programs to serve difficult to reach children
  • Ensure that programs are relevant to children in Sudan and to the global program and advocacy objectives of the Save the Children members

Program Development

  • Ensure the design and development of child focused humanitarian and development programs of a high quality that contribute to the Country Office’s strategies and plans, informed by child participation where possible
  • Oversee proposal development process, ensuring that technical directors and advisors provide input into proposals and proactively and regularly communicate planned requirements for program design and implementation to relevant CO departments/functions
  • Support the DCD of Program Operations in ensuring adequate resources are secured for program activities from both grants and the private funds of Save the Children members, including identifying strategic leads and concepts

Quality and Technical Excellence

  • Attain and maintain Green Status for all programme quality KPIs
  • Ensure that the Sudan Country Office has a first class, multi-sectoral and dual mandate program reflecting all priority technical and sector aspects of the Save the Children global strategy
  • Support the DCD Program Operations in the implementation and monitoring of all longer-term technical goals, objectives and policies
  • Ensure that the different technical sectors of the Country Office are coordinated, integrated and support each other to optimize programs and projects
  • Ensure that all sectors apply a risk lens to program design and implementation in line with the Save the Children policy on Disaster Risk Reduction and Child Safeguarding
  • Ensure appropriate levels of technical assistance and capacity building is provided to Programme Operations team and partners
  • Work with Members and Regional Office to seek the involvement of member and regional technical assistance
  • Ensure excellent coordination and cooperation with incoming technical advisors as well as surge teams during emergencies
  • Oversee technical competency in cross cutting themes including Gender, Disability and Resilience

Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL)

  • Ensure a robust Monitoring, Accountability and Learning system to measure progress and achievement toward program goals and results is developed and implemented
  • Ensure the regular improvement and roll out Quality Benchmarks and Tools for regularly measure progress and achievements across all sectors of the Country Office
  • Ensure that Monitoring Accountability and Learning findings/results are regularly produced systematically, disseminated and actions are taken to improve programme quality
  • Ensure that programme development actions are informed by lessons generated from programme monitoring and accountability results.
  • Ensure the research, evaluation and policy work of the country office contributes to generation of evidences for sound decision making and policy influencing within and outside the Country Office and development and implementation of impactful and innovative programmes for children
  • Lead on the application of SCI Theory of Changes with particular reference to innovations through development and provision of evidence-based, replicable breakthrough solutions to the problems facing children in general and three breakthroughs of Save the children: No child dies from preventable causes before the age of fifth birth day, All children learn from a quality basic education and Violence against children is no longer tolerated.

Knowledge Management

  • Ensure timely utilisation of online systems that enable SC staff to access a centralized data and information system
  • Ensure that findings, lessons and good practices generated through evaluations are effectively disseminated and utilised to programme development, implementation and advocacy actions of the Country Office.

Strategic Partnerships & Cross Cutting themes

  • Engage in relevant national and global networks
  • Oversee the work of the CO on Gender, Migration, Disability and other cross cutting themes

Staff Management, Mentorship, and Development
