title: Assistant Director of Front Office
description:
About Dream Downtown

Dream Downtown pays homage to its storied past as the former National Maritime Union headquarters while embodying the vibrant energy of modern New York City. From the moment guests enter the hotel, they are immersed in an atmosphere unlike any other. A glass-bottom pool suspended above the lobby, dynamic social spaces, buzzing nightlife, innovative dining concepts, and 314 loft-style guest rooms and suites create an experience that is both unexpected and unforgettable.

As much a place to play as it is to stay, Dream Downtown attracts travelers seeking the best of New York City. Our guests expect exceptional service, authentic experiences, and genuine connections. Our colleagues deliver all of that while having fun, embracing creativity, and bringing energy to every interaction.

If you are a hospitality leader who thrives in a fast-paced luxury lifestyle environment, enjoys developing talent, driving operational excellence, and creating unforgettable guest experiences, this is the opportunity for you.

Position Overview

The Assistant Director of Front Office supports the Director of Front Office in leading all aspects of the Front Office operation, including Front Desk, Guest Services, Uniformed Services, Concierge, Reservations, and Pool Attendant operations.

As the second-in-command of the department, this role is responsible for ensuring exceptional execution of the guest arrival, stay, and departure experience while maintaining the highest levels of service, colleague engagement, and operational performance. The Assistant Director serves as a visible and approachable leader who inspires teams, resolves complex guest situations, drives accountability, and cultivates a culture where personalized hospitality, teamwork, and creativity thrive.

This position plays a critical role in developing front-line leaders and colleagues while ensuring Dream Downtown delivers a guest experience that is authentic, memorable, and uniquely New York City.

The Assistant Director of Front Office serves as a brand ambassador for Dream Downtown, ensuring every guest interaction reflects the hotel's energetic, creative, and distinctly New York personality. Through visible leadership, operational excellence, and a passion for hospitality, this role helps create memorable guest experiences while supporting the hotel's service culture, reputation, financial performance, and overall operational success.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Operations

  • Support the Director of Front Office in the day-to-day management of all Front Office departments.
  • Lead departmental operations in the Director's absence and ensure seamless operational performance.
  • Maintain a highly visible presence throughout the hotel, serving as a resource for guests, colleagues, and leaders.
  • Drive execution of service standards, operational procedures, and guest experience initiatives.
  • Monitor departmental performance and implement solutions to improve efficiency, productivity, and service delivery.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Act as a brand ambassador for Dream Downtown, ensuring service delivery aligns with the hotel's lifestyle positioning, culture, and service philosophy.
  • Partner with Human Resources and Labor Relations to address colleague relations matters, performance management, investigations, corrective action, and workforce planning initiatives.
  • Lead departmental operations in accordance with hotel policies, service standards, and applicable collective bargaining agreements.
  • Foster positive labor relations and maintain compliance with all union contract provisions affecting hotel operations.

Guest Experience

  • Champion a guest-first culture focused on delivering personalized, memorable, and effortless experiences.
  • Handle VIP arrivals, guest recovery situations, and escalated service concerns with professionalism, urgency, and discretion.
  • Ensure all guests receive exceptional arrival, stay, and departure experiences.
  • Partner with Guest Services and Front Desk teams to curate unique micro-local experiences that connect guests with New York City's neighborhoods, dining, nightlife, arts, culture, and wellness offerings.
  • Monitor guest feedback, online reviews, and service metrics to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.
  • Ensure all Front Office colleagues consistently deliver service reflective of Dream Downtown's lifestyle standards.

Talent Development

  • Recruit, coach, train, and develop Front Office colleagues.
  • Conduct regular coaching conversations, performance reviews, and development discussions.
  • Support succession planning and leadership development initiatives.
  • Promote colleague engagement through recognition, communication, and career growth opportunities.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, standards, and applicable labor agreements.
  • Foster a workplace culture rooted in Hyatt's Culture of Care, where colleagues feel valued, supported, and empowered to succeed.
  • Build a culture of accountability, inclusion, recognition, and continuous learning.

Financial & Business Performance

  • Support room revenue optimization efforts through upselling, inventory management, and operational execution.
  • Collaborate with Revenue Management to maximize occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, and room revenue opportunities.
  • Assist with labor management, scheduling, payroll accuracy, and productivity initiatives.
  • Monitor departmental expenses and identify opportunities to improve efficiency while maintaining service excellence.
  • Ensure accurate forecasting, reporting, and operational controls.
  • Assist with the development and execution of departmental budgets and productivity goals.

Performance & KPI Accountability

Success in this role will be measured by achieving and exceeding key operational and financial performance indicators, including\:

  • Guest Satisfaction Scores (GSS)
  • ReviewPro and online reputation performance
  • Front Office upsell revenue production
  • Labor productivity and scheduling efficiency
  • Front Office audit compliance
  • Service recovery effectiveness and guest loyalty metrics
  • Colleague engagement and retention
  • Departmental financial and operational performance

The Assistant Director is expected to analyze operational data, identify trends, develop action plans, and drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance both the guest experience and business results.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner closely with Housekeeping, Engineering, Security, Food & Beverage, Sales, Revenue Management, Accounting, Human Resources, and Labor Relations teams.
  • Participate in daily operations meetings and communicate key guest and operational priorities.
  • Ensure proper room readiness, inventory management, and execution of sell-out strategies.
  • Support department-wide initiatives that enhance guest satisfaction, operational efficiency, and financial performance.
  • Maintain strong interdepartmental communication to ensure seamless execution of the guest journey from arrival through departure.

Who You Are

As our ideal candidate, you understand the power and purpose of Hyatt's Culture of Care and embody our core values of Empathy, Inclusion, Integrity, Experimentation, Respect, and Well-being.

You are a collaborative, relationship-focused leader who thrives in a fast-paced hospitality environment. You are energized by developing people, building partnerships, elevating the guest experience, and driving results through teamwork and accountability. You understand that success comes from maintaining a visible presence, fostering strong relationships across departments, supporting colleagues, and creating exceptional experiences for guests.

You Are Someone Who\:

  • Leads with integrity, professionalism, and accountability.
  • Builds trust and strong partnerships with colleagues, guests, union representatives, and hotel leadership.
  • Enjoys mentoring, coaching, and developing high-performing teams.
  • Embraces cross-functional collaboration and a "One Hotel, One Team" mindset.
  • Balances strategic thinking with hands-on operational leadership.
  • Demonstrates strong business acumen and an understanding of guest satisfaction, labor productivity, revenue optimization, and operational performance.
  • Thrives in a highly visible leadership role, engaging daily with colleagues, guests, and operational partners.
  • Is comfortable working within a unionized hotel environment and fostering positive labor relations.
  • Uses data and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement and accountability.
  • Is committed to continuous learning, innovation, and professional growth.

Why Join Dream Downtown?

At Dream Downtown, we believe exceptional guest experiences start with exceptional leaders. As Assistant Director of Front Office, you'll have the opportunity to help shape every stage of the guest journey, develop top hospitality talent, drive operational excellence, and create a culture where service excellence and fun coexist.

Working alongside the Director of Front Office, you will play an integral role in leading one of New York City's most dynamic lifestyle hotel front office teams. From overseeing arrivals and departures to enhancing guest satisfaction, revenue performance, colleague engagement, and operational execution, you'll help deliver the unique experiences that define Dream Downtown.

If you're ready to advance your hospitality leadership career in a fast-paced luxury lifestyle environment while creating unforgettable experiences for travelers from around the world, we'd love to meet you.

Salary Range

  • $75,300 - $84,000 annually

How We Care for Our People

Our purpose sets us apart\: to care for people so they can be their best. Every business decision is made through the lens of our purpose, and it guides how we support one another as members of the Hyatt family. Our care for our colleagues is the foundation of our success.

We're proud to have earned a place on Fortune's prestigious 100 Best Companies to Work For® list. This recognition reflects our commitment to creating an environment rooted in inclusivity, empathy, respect, and belonging, where every colleague feels valued and empowered to grow.

As a leader within Dream Downtown, the Assistant Director of Front Office plays an important role in fostering this culture by developing talent, building meaningful relationships, promoting collaboration across departments, and helping create an environment where colleagues can thrive both personally and professionally.

Benefits Include

  • Medical insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Parental leave
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Career development opportunities
  • Hyatt colleague travel and hotel discount programs

Equal Opportunity Employer

Dream Downtown and Hyatt are committed to creating a workplace where colleagues feel valued, respected, and empowered to succeed. We believe that diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives strengthen our teams and enrich the experiences we create for our guests.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: SEO & AI Search Hero
description:
Wil jij dé expert worden in SEO & AI Search? Groei mee als SEO & AI Search Hero bij Webhero!

Stel je voor: een job waarin je niet alleen het maximale uit Google haalt, maar ook vooroploopt in de nieuwste AI-revolutie met ChatGPT, Gemini en Claude. Een plek waar je direct de impact van jouw werk ziet bij échte ondernemers.

Bij Webhero ondersteun je kmo’s en zelfstandigen in heel Vlaanderen om online bovenaan te staan. Ons Growth team heeft de weg al voor je uitgestippeld met bewezen trajecten en slimme tools. Jij krijgt de vrijheid en de verantwoordelijkheid om klanten te laten groeien — én tegelijk jezelf razendsnel te ontwikkelen.

Wat ga je concreet doen?

In deze rol combineer je data, slimme AI-tools en klantcontact om écht verschil te maken:

  • Trajecten van A tot Z: Je neemt een twintigtal klanten onder je hoede via onze SEO-trajecten en AI Search-trajecten.
  • Analyseren en optimaliseren: Je duikt in Google Analytics en Google Search Console, ontdekt waar de kansen liggen en optimaliseert vervolgens teksten, structuur en content direct op ons platform.
  • AI slim inzetten: Je zet ChatGPT, Claude en Gemini slim in om sneller en effectiever te werken, en zorgt dat onze klanten genoemd worden in AI-antwoorden.
  • Resultaten vertalen naar ondernemerstaal: Onze klanten zijn bakkers, dakwerkers en boekhouders, geen marketeers. Jij legt in gewone mensentaal uit wat je gedaan hebt en wat het hen oplevert: meer aanvragen, betere vindbaarheid, minder zorgen.

Is dit jouw ideale match?

  • Digitale gedrevenheid: SEO, Google Analytics en AI-tools hebben voor jou weinig geheimen (of je leert er met veel enthousiasme alles over).
  • Gepassioneerd: Je volgt de evoluties in SEO en AI Search op omdat je het zelf boeiend vindt, niet omdat het moet.
  • Ondernemersgericht: Je beseft dat achter elke website een gedreven ondernemer zit die die bouwt aan zijn/haar droom.
  • Gestructureerd: Je kan meerdere klanten tegelijk opvolgen, houdt je planning in de gaten en werkt graag volgens een bewezen aanpak.
  • Teamspeler: Je haalt energie uit samenwerken met collega's.

title: Ophthalmologist, Cornea Surgeon - Lubbock, TX
description:
Are you a Cornea Surgeon seeking your next big adventure? Step into a thriving, energetic ophthalmology practice where you'll collaborate with world-class surgeons and dedicated support staff, all united by a shared mission to transform lives through exceptional eye care.

As an ophthalmologist specializing in cornea and anterior segment surgery, you will:

  • Restore vision and improve the quality of life for patients with corneal disorders and anterior segment disease
  • Evaluate and diagnose a wide range of corneal and anterior segment conditions, determining when surgical intervention is needed
  • Utilize advanced surgical techniques including corneal transplantation (PK, DSAEK, DMEK), pterygium excision, and anterior segment reconstruction
  • Perform comprehensive pre-operative and post-operative assessments to ensure optimal outcomes for corneal and refractive procedures
  • Conduct precise, minimally invasive corneal and anterior segment surgical procedures
  • Provide attentive post-operative care, monitoring corneal healing and vision recovery
  • Collaborate with a dynamic team of surgeons, optometrists, technicians, scribes, and front office staff to deliver comprehensive corneal and anterior segment care
  • Treat a wide range of ophthalmic cases, with emphasis on corneal disorders, ocular surface disease, complex anterior segment pathology, and refractive surgeries such as LASIK and PRK

This is more than a job—it's a chance to make a real impact in a vibrant community while advancing your professional journey. Imagine collaborating with seven accomplished surgeons, an experienced optometrist, and a skilled team of technicians, scribes, and front-office pros.

Why You'll Love This Opportunity:

  • High patient volume from day one—build your productivity bonus quickly with robust referral streams
  • Cutting-edge technology at your fingertips
  • Dynamic, supportive team—never work alone, always have backup
  • Comprehensive benefits: Medical, dental, vision, legal, pet, and childcare coverage
  • Retirement plans: Traditional & Roth 401(k) with company match, plus equity buy-in possibilities
  • Financial perks: Competitive productivity incentives, starting bonus, and relocation assistance
  • Professional growth: Continuing education support, licensure reimbursement, malpractice coverage

Requirements:

  • Board-certified or board-eligible in Ophthalmology.
  • A proven history of successful surgical outcomes.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

title: Ambulancechauffeur (Hoogcomplexe Ambulancezorg) met opleidingsplaats
description:
Het beste van twee werelden: in een ambulance rijden én door het altijd dynamische Rotterdam-Rijnmond. Altijd al gedroomd om te werken als Ambulancechauffeur, of nieuwsgierig naar de mogelijkheden? Als ervaren chauffeur met groot rijbewijs ben je van harte welkom. Dit is je kans! Geen dag is hetzelfde, dat maakt werken bij Ambulance Rotterdam-Rijnmond (ARR) onder andere zo uniek.

Jouw werk

Als Ambulancechauffeur ben je verantwoordelijk voor het veilig vervoeren van de patiënt, verpleegkundige en eventueel anderen die meerijden, soms in geval van spoed. De hoogcomplexe ambulance wordt ingezet voor situaties waar (dringend) medische hulp vereist is. Jij zorgt ervoor dat de patiënt indien nodig tijdig en veilig op plaats van bestemming komt. Voordat je op pad gaat, zorg je ervoor dat jouw ambulance van die dag schoon en rijklaar is. Met de ambulanceverpleegkundige controleer je de inventaris, zodat jullie goed voorbereid zijn. In geval van een inzet, verleen je samen hulp aan de patiënt. De ambulanceverpleegkundige draagt de medische eindverantwoordelijkheid over de patiënt, jij assisteert de verpleegkundige proactief met bijvoorbeeld materialen of door de apparatuur op te starten.

Je kent de wegen in ons werkgebied goed en kiest daarom snel en vakkundig de juiste en veiligste route. Tijdens de rit verzorg jij de communicatie met de meldkamer. Na diverse ritten kom je aan het einde van je dienst weer terug op de post en zorg je ervoor dat alles weer op orde is in de ambulance.

Kom werken in Rotterdam-Rijnmond als Ambulancechauffeur, wij leiden jou op!

Voordat je dit werk goed kan uitoefenen, volg je de CZO-opleiding tot Ambulancechauffeur. De opleiding bestaat uit scholingsdagen bij de Academie voor Ambulancezorg en werken in de praktijk, waarbij je begeleid en opgeleid wordt door een praktijkopleider. De opleiding tot Ambulancechauffeur duurt ongeveer negen maanden. Jouw praktijklocatie is afhankelijk van de opleidingscapaciteit, jouw standplaats na de opleiding is afhankelijk van de formatie beschikbaarheid. Het kan dus voorkomen dat je bij de Academie voor Ambulancezorg het theoretische gedeelte volgt, bijvoorbeeld in Schiedam opgeleid wordt voor het praktijkgedeelte en uiteindelijk in Brielle komt te werken. We proberen zoveel mogelijk rekening te houden met persoonlijke voorkeuren voor de praktijklocatie en standplaats.


Nadat je deze periode succesvol hebt afgerond ga je aan het werk als gediplomeerd Ambulancechauffeur binnen de mooiste en meest uitdagende regio die er is: Rotterdam-Rijnmond.

Jij...

...beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden en kan goed samenwerken. In dit beroep krijg je te maken met stressvolle situaties. Het is belangrijk dat jij ook dan de rust bewaart en in staat bent de juiste beslissingen te nemen. Je moet snel kunnen handelen wanneer nodig. Het belang van de patiënt staat voorop het is daarom belangrijk dat je een resultaat- en patiëntgerichte houding hebt en beschikt over empathisch vermogen. Werken bij de ambulance betekent ook dat je te maken hebt met onregelmatige diensten (dag, avond , nacht, weekenden en feestdagen). Daarom is het belangrijk dat je flexibel bent.

Verder:

  • Beschik je tenminste over aantoonbaar mbo niveau 3 werk- en denkniveau (bij voorkeur op basis van diploma). Indien je geen diploma hebt, kun je de capaciteitentest van Bureau Sterk doen en (indien geslaagd) de uitslag bij ons aanleveren. Let op: dit is op eigen kosten. De link vind je hier: OPLEIDING AMBULANCECHAUFFEUR

  • Ben je in het bezit van een geldig BLS/AED certificaat, of een geldig EHBO certificaat;

  • Ben je in het bezit van een geldig rijbewijs C of C1;

  • Heb je een goede lichamelijke conditie in verband met de fysieke belasting zoals (zwaar) tillen;

  • Je beschikt over uitstekende regio kennis van de regio Rotterdam-Rijnmond, zodat je in alle situaties snel en veilig op de juiste locaties weet te komen.

Je team

Werken bij Ambulance Rotterdam-Rijnmond (ARR) binnen de discipline Hoogcomplexe Ambulancezorg betekent dat jij je samen met bijna 500 collega's inzet voor het leveren van acute- en niet-acute essentiële medische zorg binnen de meest dynamische regio van Nederland. Geen werkdag is hetzelfde vanwege de grote diversiteit aan patiënten, werksituaties en de verschillende collega’s met wie je samenwerkt. Samen met jouw collega’s en in samenwerking met de zorgverleners binnen de regio Rotterdam-Rijnmond, voorzien we jaarlijks meer dan 113.000 patiënten van Ambulancezorg.

Ons hoofddoel is ervoor zorgen dat de ruim 1,3 miljoen inwoners van de regio Rotterdam-Rijnmond veilig en zonder angst kunnen leven, wonen en werken, want als het erop aankomt, staan wij voor hen klaar!

Wat bieden wij?

  • Je start meteen met de opleiding tot Ambulancechauffeur, die betaald wordt door Ambulance Rotterdam-Rijnmond (ARR).

  • Gedurende de opleidingsperiode word je ingeschaald in schaal 40 met een salaris van € 2.696 tot maximaal € 3.882 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 36 uur).

  • Na diplomering word je ingeschaald in schaal 45 met een salaris van € 3.164 tot maximaal € 4.261 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 36 uur).

  • Je hebt 144 wettelijke vakantie-uren en 28 bovenwettelijke vakantie-uren per kalenderjaar.

  • Je hebt 35 PLB-uren (Persoonlijk levensfase budget) per jaar.

  • Je ontvangt 8,33% vakantietoeslag en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Er zijn fiscale uitruil arbeidsvoorwaarden.

  • Vitaliteit en gezondheid vinden wij belangrijk, daarom bieden we een fitnessregeling van maximaal € 20,- netto per maand. Ook is er vers fruit op de opkomstlocaties.

  • De Veiligheidsregio Rotterdam-Rijnmond hanteert een zeer gunstige pensioenregeling bij het ABP. Zo betalen wij twee-derde van jouw pensioenpremie.

  • Er is ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling en groei.

  • De arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn conform de cao Ambulancezorg.

Sollicitatieproces

Voor deze vacature geldt het volgende:

  • Om bij de Veiligheidsregio Rotterdam-Rijnmond te kunnen werken, dien je in het bezit te zijn van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG). Deze zal aan het einde van het sollicitatieproces worden aangevraagd.

  • Wij werken zonder tussenkomst of hulp van werving- en selectiebureaus.

  • Na indiensttreding word je gevraagd de ambtseed af te leggen.

  • Een medische keuring (incl. vaccinatie) is verplicht.

De sollicitatieprocedure:

  • De briefselectie vindt plaats op 2 november 2026. Na deze datum hoor je of je wordt uitgenodigd door ons op de selectiedag.

  • De Meet & Greet dagen vinden plaats op 11 en 12 november 2026

  • De rijvaardigheidstest zal plaatsvinden op 18, 19, 23, 24, 26 november en 1 december. Je wordt in overleg ingepland op een van deze dagen.

  • De meerijddag vindt plaats in de periode 20 november t/m 8 december 2026. Je wordt in overleg ingepland op een van deze dagen.

  • Je voert een sollicitatiegesprek wat plaats zal vinden op 14, 15, 16, 17 december.

  • Een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek wordt na een positief sollicitatiegesprek gepland.

Meer weten?

Neem gerust contact met ons op!

  • Voor vragen over de procedure kun je contact opnemen door een e-mail te sturen naar recruitment@vr-rr.nl.

title: DevOps- och DevSecOps-ingenjörer

Urval sker löpande. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!





Kom och gör skillnad

Vi tror att man gör ett bättre jobb om man kan fokusera på rätt saker, därför gör vi det lätt att kombinera jobbet med vardagen. Vi satsar på våra medarbetare, de utgör kärnan, hjärnan och hjärtat i vår verksamhet. Dessutom står vi på en stadig grund av högteknologi, forskning och anställningstrygghet med försvars- och säkerhetskoncernen Saab som ägare.

title: Compliance Investigation Analyst - fixed term contract
description:
About the role
The Compliance Investigation Analyst ensures the business operates in accordance with all legal and regulatory requirements and all group standards relating to anti-money laundering, counter financing of terrorism (AML), and fraud prevention. The incumbent is responsible for advanced investigations that detect and report suspicious activity to government authorities and enable MoneyGram to form sound judgements concerning reputational and other risks while meeting expectations of regulators and other compliance stakeholders.
What you will be expected to do

Review and analyze leads for potential suspicious activity, including those generated from an alert detection processes, subpoenas and warrants, negative media reports, as well as other sources to include (but not limited to):

Identifying, researching and reporting suspicious activity.
Managing the investigative process from initial detection to disposition.
Thoroughly and timely reviewing reports and other investigative leads that potentially identify suspicious activity.
Formulating and recommending responses to potentially suspicious findings, reporting such activity to the appropriate regulatory authorities, and support MoneyGram's forward-looking risk-mitigation response.

Support managers, supervisors, and sr analysts in conducting moderately complex AML/Fraud investigations.
Work with team members to determine whether to close cases, escalate findings and/or file a Suspicious Activity Report with the various global regulatory, law enforcement or, Financial Intelligence Units globally.
Write and file Suspicious Activity Reports and recommend relationship retention or termination.
Liaise with various Compliance, Advisory, or Business teams, Legal, Security and Law Enforcement, or other internal departments as necessary.
Perform other duties as assigned.

What are we looking for
Education:

BA/BS in business, finance, law enforcement, legal studies or a related field; may be substituted with equivalent work experience in Financial Services, Law, Banking or a related field.

Experience:

3-5 years of compliance financial investigations, experience in money service business or banking.
CAMS of CFE certification preferred.
1 year of experience in writing and preparing Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) or similar in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements preferred.

Essential Skills:

Intermediate knowledge of laws applicable to money laundering, including the BSA, USA Patriot act, US Treasury AML guidelines, OFAC requirements, and Suspicious Activity Reporting requirements; and/or global AML/CFT/Fraud laws and regulations.
Excellent organization, strong time management skills, including the ability to effectively prioritize work assignments with changing priorities.
Should be a self-starter, capable of working under minimum supervision.
Results oriented team player.
Able to multi-task and complete projects on time.
Exceptional research and analytical, cross-referencing, and deductive reasoning skills.
Strong writing, analytical and communication skills.
Strong verbal communication skills; able to effectively communicate investigative findings and recommendations with senior leadership & law enforcement.
Ability to communicate effectively with a culturally diverse agent and consumer base.
Demonstrated ability to work successfully in a fast pace, highly structured, deadline driven culture.
Experience working with highly confidential information.
Capable of sharing knowledge, mentoring, and training other team members.
Established solid business knowledge and comprehension of MoneyGram products and services globally.
Knowledge of domestic and international higher risk countries, jurisdictions and corridors of AML/CTF concern, preferred.
Fluent/bilingual communication skills, preferred.

title: Architect
description:
Job Summary

Architect role in a multinational organization focusing on designing and governing enterprise grade solutions built on MS Power Automate and Power Apps. The role spans end to end solution architecture platform standards and reusable asset strategy for complex business workflows in a hybrid work model. The architect will collaborate across product operations and technology teams to ensure scalable secure and high quality automation delivery while mentoring teams and influencing platform ad


Responsibilities

  • Design comprehensive automation architectures that integrate MS Power Automate and Power Apps to address complex business workflow needs across multiple functions and geographies in a scalable manner.
  • Drive solution blueprint creation that covers process mapping data flows environment strategy and integration patterns to ensure robust and maintainable implementations on the Power platform.
  • Guide project teams in translating business requirements into secure and compliant automation solutions by defining standards for connectors triggers data protection and application lifecycle management.
  • Collaborate with product owners business analysts and developers to validate functional and non functional requirements and to ensure that implemented solutions align with enterprise goals and long term platform roadmap.
  • Review technical designs and configuration decisions for MS Power Automate flows and Power Apps applications to identify risks performance bottlenecks and improvements that enhance reliability and usability.
  • Establish and evolve governance models for environments solution deployment and change control to maintain platform hygiene and predictable release cycles in a hybrid work arrangement.
  • Create reference architectures reusable components and templates that accelerate solution delivery and promote consistency across different business units and project teams using the Power platform.
  • Coordinate with security and compliance stakeholders to embed data access controls monitoring and auditing capabilities into all workflow and application designs to protect organizational and customer information.
  • Provide technical guidance during incident analysis and problem resolution by assessing flow dependencies app configurations and external system integrations to restore service quickly and prevent recurrences.
  • Optimize existing automations and applications by assessing telemetry user feedback and performance metrics to refine workflows reduce manual effort and increase adoption and business satisfaction.
  • Document architecture decisions solution rationale and platform standards in clear artifacts that support onboarding knowledge transfer and sustainable operation of Power Automate and Power Apps solutions.
  • Mentor experienced professionals in best practices for automation design configuration management and testing so that teams can deliver high quality outcomes consistently within day shift schedules.
  • Align solution strategies with organizational purpose by focusing on workflows that increase efficiency reduce repetitive tasks and create better experiences for customers and communities that rely on company services.

Qualifications

  • Bring deep hands on experience in designing and implementing complex enterprise solutions using MS Power Automate and Power Apps including canvas apps model driven apps and advanced flow scenarios.
  • Demonstrate strong understanding of data modeling connectors and integration concepts needed to connect Power platform solutions with core business systems and modern collaboration tools.
  • Apply solid knowledge of automation governance deployment strategies and environment management to sustain large scale usage without compromising stability or compliance.
  • Show proficiency in analyzing existing business processes and converting them into optimized digital workflows that measurably reduce manual work and operational risk.
  • Utilize strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills to explain architecture choices benefits and tradeoffs to both technical and non technical audiences in a clear and respectful manner.
  • Exhibit experience with hybrid work practices and remote collaboration tools to coordinate solution design reviews knowledge sharing and issue resolution across distributed teams in day shift settings.
  • Display capability to work independently within a defined architecture framework while collaborating effectively with cross functional teams to deliver impactful automation solutions without travel obligations.

title: Designated Safeguarding Officer (Term Time Only)
description:
Are you an experienced safeguarding professional who wants to make a real difference for the most vulnerable young people in your community? Do you want to work alongside a committed, values-driven team who go above and beyond for students in often difficult circumstances and take genuine pride in seeing them achieve against the odds? If so, we would love to hear from you.

As our Designated Safeguarding Officer, you will act as a key source of safeguarding expertise and advocacy across the College, working closely with the Designated Safeguarding and Prevent Lead, Student Services and wider teams to protect and promote the welfare of vulnerable students. You will lead on referrals and casework, develop and deliver staff training, build effective partnerships with external agencies and lead on a specialist safeguarding area, bringing both knowledge and leadership to a function that sits at the heart of college life.

This is a term-time post (38 weeks per year), based at our Borehamwood Campus with travel to other College sites as required.

About Barnet and Southgate College
We change lives, empower individuals and connect communities.

We are an ambitious, forward-thinking further education college in North London, proud to serve diverse communities across Barnet, Southgate and beyond. Our 2030 Vision is bold: to be a leading provider of learning and skills development, fostering exceptional educational experiences, driven by innovation, collaboration and excellence.

Our safeguarding and Student Services team is made up of people who are genuinely passionate about protecting and supporting the most vulnerable learners. Partnership working is central to everything they do, and the team has built strong, trusted relationships with a wide range of external agencies. You will be joining a group of professionals who take their responsibilities seriously, support each other without hesitation and find real meaning in the work they do.
What You'll Be Doing
  • Safeguarding expertise and advocacy: Act as a key source of safeguarding knowledge across the College, advocating for students identified as vulnerable or at risk and demonstrating sound understanding of procedures and the complex issues they face.
  • Referrals and casework: Lead on referrals, action queries appropriately and in line with KCSIE, GDPR and Working Together to Safeguard Children 2023, and lead on collaborative strategy meetings involving relevant professionals.
  • Records and quality assurance: Maintain accurate, up-to-date safeguarding records that evidence how risks are identified and mitigated, supporting compliance, quality assurance and inspection readiness.
  • Specialist area lead: Take ownership of a specialist safeguarding area such as CCE, CSE, VAWG, misogyny/misandry or online safety, developing expertise and sharing best practice across the College.
  • Training and awareness: Lead on the planning and delivery of safeguarding training for staff and promote key safeguarding updates to staff and students across all campuses using College platforms.
  • Partnership working: Develop and sustain effective relationships with internal teams and external agencies including social care, the police, health services and other statutory partners to ensure joined-up, effective safeguarding responses.
  • Statutory compliance: Support the Designated Safeguarding and Prevent Lead to ensure Governors, Senior Management and staff fulfil their statutory obligations under relevant legislation and guidance.
What You'll Bring

Essential
  • A relevant Level 3 qualification
  • English and Maths at Grade 5-9 or equivalent
  • Designated Safeguarding Officer training completed within the last 3 years
  • Proven experience and understanding of child protection procedures, referral processes and legislation
  • Proven experience of adult safeguarding and referral processes
  • Proven experience of multi-agency working
  • Experience of supporting and working with vulnerable students in mainstream and more complex needs settings (e.g. EHCP, LAC, YOT, CP, CiN)
  • Experience of Serious Safeguarding Reviews
  • Excellent report writing and record keeping skills with high attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trusted relationships with young people, families, staff and external professionals
  • Ability to negotiate, manage conflict and work effectively under pressure
  • High level of integrity, confidentiality and understanding of GDPR and information-sharing protocols
  • IT literate with working knowledge of Microsoft Office and safeguarding-related systems
    Willingness to travel and work across all main College campuses
  • Commitment to equality, diversity, inclusion and safeguarding
Even Better If You Have...
  • A higher-level qualification in safeguarding, social work, education or a related field
  • Experience delivering safeguarding training to staff
  • Experience working in a further education or post-16 setting
  • Specialist knowledge in areas such as CCE, CSE, VAWG, online safety or Prevent

Barnet and Southgate College is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults. In line with Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), online searches of publicly available information may be undertaken on shortlisted candidates as part of our safer recruitment process

title: Data Engineer - Knowledge Graphs & AI
description:
Accenture, recognized as a Great Place To Work®, is a leading global professional services company that helps major businesses, public administrations, and other organizations around the world develop their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth, and improve services for citizens, creating tangible value at speed and scale.

We are looking for experienced Knowledge Graph Engineers to join our Data & AI practice in Spain.

This role is available in Barcelona or Madrid, and follows a hybrid working model, combining remote work with in-office collaboration to foster innovation, knowledge sharing, and close teamwork.

Candidates must reside in Spain and hold a valid permit to work in Spain.

YOU ARE

You lead a significant knowledge engineering scope and function within a large program; actively contribute to thought leadership. You shape how a substantial body of work formulates real-world problems into scalable AI and KG solutions, and set the technical direction for that scope. You lead a team and guide exploration and implementation of new methodologies, model building techniques, and cutting-edge algorithms. You remain at the forefront and drive innovation by applying these techniques to new business problems, use cases, and scenarios. You design, evaluate, and maintain ontologies, and establish the standards others follow. You justify the value to business and technology stakeholders, and construct the methodologies and data architectures that demonstrate it. You publish or present perspective beyond the immediate project. You work across business and technical teams to drive end-to-end delivery for their scope.

THE WORK

  • Leads the build of Knowledge Graph solutions that transform a client's data architecture within program scope.
  • Directs the design, development, and implementation of AI and semantic solutions, ensuring all the pieces work together seamlessly.
  • Works with project leaders, delivery leads, and client stakeholders to create stand-out, graph-powered Data & AI offerings.
  • Develops strong client relationships and earns the trust of key advisors.
  • Makes the business case for the semantic layer solution recommended to the client.
  • Contributes meaningfully to Accenture sales and pre-sales efforts.
  • Provides thought leadership on technology trends, new opportunities, innovations, and foreseeable limitations, risks, and concerns.

EDUCATION

  • MSc or BSc in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a related field.

Basic (required) Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent, plus at least 4 of the following:
  • Experience with Knowledge Graph technologies (RDF, SPARQL, LPG, SHACL).
  • Hands on experience in schema design, ontology management, and Knowledge Graph curation.
  • Experience designing and developing Knowledge Graphs solutions and graph-based ML models (functional technical).
  • Proven experience with end-to-end data pipeline implementations for AI applications (esp. LLMs), with hands-on design and configuration.
  • Ample experience with strong knowledge of relational databases, object stores, graph databases (Stardog, Neo4J, Amazon Neptune), and vector databases.
  • Experience in leading a team or workstream within a larger program
  • Fluent in Spanish and high level of understanding and communicating in English (B2 - C1).

Preferred Qualification

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience in Python, with experience in frameworks like Tensorflow, PyTorch, and tools for building ETL pipelines (e.g. Apache NiFi, Airflow).
  • Practical experience with NLP and/or Search techniques.
  • Prompt engineering, and LLMs for enterprise-scale applications.
  • You have team lead experience.
  • Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work across engineering, research, and product teams across multiple time zones.
  • You have external client-facing consulting experience.
  • Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer or Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Broad experience in diverse ML techniques and agentic systems.

At Accenture, recognized as a Great Place To Work®, we are committed to a hybrid work model that, supported by technology and our office spaces, enables us to maintain the essential human connection needed to collaborate effectively with our teams and clients. This connection helps us foster our culture of inclusion and diversity and has contributed to being recognized by Refinitiv as one of the world's most diverse companies.

  • Strong full‑stack development and testing experience, including hands‑on work with Angular, React Native, Android Native, iOS Native, REST APIs (with Apigee), SpringBoot, and event‑driven systems like Confluent Kafka.
  • Deep knowledge of Performance Monitoring, Debugging, and Observability, actively using tools like Splunk, Splunk Observability, New Relic, and Log Rocket for root cause analysis.

  • Experience testing and monitoring in a secure public cloud environment, preferably AWS, including the use of AWS Monitoring tools like CloudWatch and Performance Insights.

title: Senior Back End Engineer
description:
About Us:

Ground News is a platform that makes it easy to compare news sources, read between the lines of media bias and break free from algorithms.

In a world where political polarization and media distrust are at an all-time high, Ground News offers people a better way to stay informed and see every side of the story. Our mobile app, web app, and browser extension are home to a community of mindful readers who use our news comparison platform to engage with news beyond their filter bubble.

Unlike most news companies, our values do not align with any specific political ideology. Unlike most tech platforms, we don’t rely on algorithms to keep users on our platform to sell more ads. We are supported by our readers who pay for a subscription to build a more nuanced understanding of the news, the world, and themselves.

The Opportunity: Senior Software Engineer

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll be working on the core systems that make Ground News tick and ready to serve millions of readers. You'll sit with our backend chapter and work with out of the Core Experience pod. Reporting to the Head of Engineering, you will work closely with the engineering team to design, build, and operate the services that empower our users to see every side of the story. Our development team is fairly small, so you will represent a significant portion of the developing power behind the product. Your ideas and work will quickly and frequently become part of the product.

This is a hands-on role where you’ll bring fresh ideas to a fast-growing consumer platform, balancing technical excellence with operational rigor. From designing and shipping backend services to improving observability, reliability, and performance, your work will directly impact how dependably people engage with the world’s news.


What You’ll Do:

  • Rapid Ownership and Delivery: Quickly take ownership of customer-facing features and products, with an expectation to roll out new developments within weeks of joining.

  • End-to-End Project Involvement: Engage in projects from conception and design to implementation and delivery, collaborating with stakeholders to refine solutions.

  • Flexible Development Approach: Operate in an environment that values lean and agile methodologies, though not strictly adhering to any one framework.

  • Cross-Department Collaboration: Work closely with team members from various departments, effectively communicating technical aspects to non-technical stakeholders and translating their needs into implementable solutions.

What You’ll Bring:

  • At least 5 years of experience with TypeScript, including Async/Await syntax

  • At least 3 years of experience with NodeJs

  • At least 3 years of experience with Relational Databases (MySQL/Postgres ideally, but other RDs also good)

  • Strong desire to learn and progress as a developer

  • Ability to think critically and make informed decisions

  • Knack for writing efficient and scalable code, and for recognizing bad patterns to avoid

  • At least some of experience with ElasticSearch, Redis/Valkey or similar caching system

  • A track record of shipping and scaling reliable services for a successful consumer product.

  • Experience planning and executing rollouts safely, including monitoring stability and mitigating risk.

Why Work at Ground?

Co-founded by a former NASA engineer and Bain consultant, a position with Ground News provides an unparalleled learning experience both personally and professionally. At Ground, we prioritize growth: both for our business and team members. You’ll have the freedom to work remotely and play a key role in the development of Ground News products.

This is an opportunity to work with a growing and mighty team that is fighting every day to build a world where cooperative, civil debate is the norm, media is accountable, and critical thought is the baseline of our information consumption. Ground is based in Kitchener, Ontario, Canada, but this role is remote.

Our culture is one of collaboration, creativity, and diverse perspectives. If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding accessibility needs, please contact talent@ground.news, and a member of our team will be happy to help.

title: Global MLRO
description:
About Aspora

People on the move deserve a bank that moves with them. Since 2022, Aspora has been building a borderless financial operating system that makes money as mobile and transparent as its users.

Backed by influential venture capitalists like Sequoia Capital, Greylock Partners, Hummingbird Ventures, Y Combinator & Global Founders Capital. We're a team of 150+ across India, the UK, the UAE, EU and the US, working with extreme ownership, radical candour, and an obsession with customer impact.

We celebrate builders who question assumptions, ship fast, and turn regulatory complexity into elegant solutions. If you’re driven to redefine what global banking can be, we’d love to build the future with you.

About the Role

People build lives across borders, and Aspora moves their money with them, starting with Indians abroad. Every new corridor and product surface carries money laundering risk. This role exists to turn that risk into an advantage: one global AML policy embedded in products and operations, so sound decisions happen by design instead of case-by-case escalation.

As Global MLRO, you will lead our global fincrime team's compliance backbone, working closely with our Head of Fincrime, and reporting to our COO. You will decide where the business can move fast and where it must hold the line. You will own the judgement calls that shape how Aspora scales into new markets.

Who You Are

You’re not someone who sees AML as a function that sits behind the business. You see it as part of how a great financial product gets built.

You’ve navigated AML and financial crime across payments, remittance, banking or fintech, ideally across multiple markets. You know the regulations inside out — but more importantly, you know how to turn them into decisions that work in the real world.

  • You turn complexity into clarity. You can take a regulatory requirement and turn it into a customer journey, a product control, or a decision framework that teams can actually use.

  • You think globally. You’ve shaped AML standards across multiple markets and know how to build consistency without pretending every market works the same way.

  • You build, not just maintain. You’ve built strong AML frameworks, automated controls or high-performing teams — or taken on a genuinely difficult financial crime problem and solved it.

  • You’ve been tested. You’ve led through a serious incident, regulatory challenge or remediation, made difficult calls under pressure, and stayed accountable until the job was done.

  • You have strong judgement. You know when to move fast, when to push back, and when a risk genuinely needs escalation.

  • You raise the bar around you. You don’t want every decision to depend on you. You build teams, playbooks and systems that make everyone better at managing risk.

  • You have high ownership. You’re self-critical, decisive and comfortable saying “I got that wrong” — then fixing it quickly.

Most importantly, you’re excited by the opportunity to build something that doesn’t exist yet. You want to help define what practical, intelligent global AML looks like — not inherit a rulebook and keep it running.

What You'll Own

This is a role with a genuinely global mandate. You’ll have the autonomy to shape how Aspora manages financial crime risk as we enter new markets, launch new products and scale rapidly.

  • Set the global AML standard. Build one practical approach across markets and products, so good risk decisions happen by design rather than through constant escalation.

  • Make risk decisions visible. Create frameworks that make trade-offs clear — what the options are, who owns the decision, and what would trigger a rethink.

  • Be the voice of AML with regulators. Own Aspora’s regulatory relationships and lead the business through independent audits and regulatory scrutiny.

  • Turn judgement into leverage. Build the playbooks, training and decision frameworks that allow teams to confidently handle the calls that would otherwise land on your desk.

  • Stay ahead of the threats. Identify emerging financial crime patterns and evolve our controls before they become problems — protecting customers without adding friction for the sake of it.

  • Build the team. Lead, develop and grow a global Fincrime team capable of operating at the pace and scale Aspora is heading towards.

  • Shape the business. Partner directly with Product, Engineering, Operations and leadership to make financial crime controls part of the product — not something bolted on afterwards.

This is a chance to take ownership of a function that will directly influence where Aspora can go, how quickly we can get there, and how confidently we can scale.

Why Aspora

  • Define what practical, global AML looks like at a fintech built for the diaspora, from the ground up

  • Work directly with our Head of Fincrime, COO and founding team on a problem core to Aspora's ability to grow

  • Build the risk frameworks and playbooks other fintechs will benchmark against as we scale into new markets

  • Own a global mandate from day one, across every market Aspora operates in

  • Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and ESOPs aligned with Aspora's long-term vision

description:

Do you have experience in microsurgery and inflammatory bowel disease models, and would you like to apply your expertise in a department with a strong focus on translational research, interdisciplinary collaboration, and the development of innovative approaches to understanding and treating human disease? Then you might be the colleague we are looking for.

Responsibilities

  • Supporting researchers in performing microsurgery on diseased animals
  • Organizing the surgical team
  • Organizing and executing endpoint analysis

Qualifications

  • Has documented microsurgical experience
  • Has extensive animal experiment experience and relevant licenses to perform the work

In addition, you have an understanding of and a desire to work with digitalization and artificial intelligence (AI) in relation to optimizing processes and creating value within the organization.

The working language is both Danish and English; you must be proficient in both written and spoken forms.

About Institute of Molecular Medicine and the Faculty of Health Sciences

The Institute of Molecular Medicine (IMM) is part of the Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark and hosts a broad range of research within molecular medicine, including inflammation, cancer, cardiovascular and renal disease, neurobiology, and genome biology. The institute provides an interdisciplinary research environment with modern laboratory facilities and strong links to Odense University Hospital and other clinical and research partners. The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top class research, and a broad range of health related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

Read more about the Faculty of Health Sciences here.

Contact

If you would like more information about the position, you are welcome to contact Prof. Grith Lykke Sørensen on glsorensen@health.sdu.dk

Application Process

The application deadline is October 20 at 11:59 PM.

Employment starts on 01.01.2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

If you are interested in the position, you must submit an application that includes a cover letter, CV indicating months and years (without photo), and diploma. All documents related to the application should not contain photos or CPR numbers – if so, the CPR number must be redacted.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. The cover letter and CV must not exceed 5 MB.

Guidance on the application process can be found here.

Salary and Terms of Employment
Your place of employment will be the University of Southern Denmark in Odense, Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Employment will take place in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC).

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range of the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.
SDU does not collect information on applicants' previous salary.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified applicants, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark exists to create value for and with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we aim to make a positive difference for society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talent. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. It is the university’s researchers, teachers, students, leaders, and technical-administrative staff who form the foundation of our success.

description:
Deze innovatieve Belgische productieonderneming ontwikkelt en assembleert hoogwaardige technische oplossingen voor industriële toepassingen. Achter de schermen zorgt een intern IT-team voor de verdere digitalisering van de organisatie, met een sterke focus op applicaties, integraties, data en procesoptimalisatie.
Het IT Team ondersteunt alle bedrijfsdomeinen: van productie en logistiek tot aankoop, finance en engineering. Door de verdere groei en digitalisering van de organisatie zijn ze op zoek naar een ervaren .NET Application & Integration Developer die op lange termijn wil meebouwen aan hun applicatielandschap.


Jobomschrijving

Je neemt een centrale rol op binnen de verdere ontwikkeling en modernisering van de interne applicaties. Je bouwt nieuwe functionaliteiten, optimaliseert bestaande toepassingen en zorgt voor betrouwbare integraties tussen het ERP-systeem, databases en andere bedrijfskritische applicaties.
Daarnaast analyseer je samen met je collega's de vragen vanuit de business en vertaal je deze naar duurzame technische oplossingen. Je werkt nauw samen met eindgebruikers en collega's om bedrijfsprocessen beter te ondersteunen en verder te automatiseren. Naast development denk je actief mee over datamodellen, rapportering, procesverbeteringen en opportuniteiten rond automatisatie en AI.
Je krijgt veel autonomie en ownership over jouw applicaties en bent betrokken bij het volledige traject: van analyse en ontwerp tot ontwikkeling, testing, documentatie en verdere optimalisatie.

  • Graduaat, Bachelor of Master in IT
  • Sterke kennis en ervaring .NET
  • Je werkt graag in team, je ben pragmatisch en neemt ownership
  • Je werkt vlot in het Nederlands

title: Full-stack Engineer (BG)
description:
Praven Intelekt is an innovative AI platform designed to streamline legal research, case law analysis, and document drafting. As part of the Lexroom group, Praven combines high-precision local legal intelligence with a fast-scaling European AI infrastructure.

Together, we are building the next generation of legaltech tools for professionals across Europe.

Lexroom, is building the AI platform where legal work gets done. In just over two years, we've grown from zero to €25M ARR, and today more than 20,000 legal professionals across Italy, Spain, Germany, France, and Bulgaria rely on Lexroom.
We're backed by $73M from Left Lane Capital, Base10 Partners, and Eurazeo, and we're a team of around 300 builders who move fast, say things straight, and own each outcome.
Our next goal? Become Europe's most-used legal product.

Our mission is clear: make the law faster, clearer, and more reliable, giving legal experts the time and confidence to focus on what truly matters. We are scaling rapidly across CEE and Western Europe, backed by top-tier investors and a world-class team dedicated to rigor, clarity, and real-world impact.

Why Join Us?

  • Shape the Standard: Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.

  • Work with the Best: Collaborate with exceptional colleagues in a culture that values technical competence, curiosity, and ambition.

  • Deliver Meaningful Impact: Your work will directly transform how legal professionals operate—bringing unprecedented speed and clarity to their daily workflows.

At Lexroom and Praven, we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you’ll build something that lasts: a trusted platform, a strong reputation, and a new standard for the legal world.

THE ROLE: Full Stack developer

This is not a role where you simply maintain existing code. You’ll be building new things, shipping them quickly, seeing how they perform with real users, and taking ownership of the outcome.

You’ll work across the product, backend systems, user interfaces, data processing, legal information search and retrieval, infrastructure, and AI workflows. The goal is simple: to make difficult product problems solvable and get solutions into users’ hands quickly and reliably.

  • You’ll design and build parts of the product end to end — backend, user interface, and infrastructure.

  • You’ll own new systems from the first version through real-world usage and subsequent scaling.

  • You’ll work closely with the people making product decisions so we can ship quickly, gather feedback, and improve immediately.

  • You’ll identify problems yourself and solve them rather than waiting for a detailed specification for every step.

  • You’ll improve the architecture, performance, and reliability of the systems whenever you see an opportunity to make them better.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Google Cloud, or similar platforms.

  • Good familiarity with modern AI tools and development environments such as Cursor and Claude Code.

  • Experience processing large volumes of data, particularly unstructured text.

  • Understanding of search and information retrieval systems, including vector databases, embeddings, RAG, and indexing.

  • Ability to build from scratch and work comfortably in an environment where not everything is predefined or documented.

  • Strong attention to detail and a habit of catching edge cases, bugs, and inconsistencies before they reach users.

  • Strong systems and architectural thinking, without adding unnecessary complexity where the right approach is simply to move fast and get things done.

Benefits That Matter

  • Hybrid Work: Flexibility to balance remote work with in-person collaboration at our Sofia Office.

  • Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to ensure peace of mind.

  • Meal Vouchers: 100€ support to make your lunch breaks easier.

  • Performance Bonuses: Rewards tied directly to measurable results.

  • Team Retreats & Off-sites: Dedicated time to connect, collaborate, and spark bold ideas.

  • 25 days paid vacation annually

At , ambition meets discipline and purpose. We’re not just building a product—we’re setting a new standard for the legal world. If you’re ready to contribute to something lasting and meaningful, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Scheduling Coordinator
location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
description:
Scheduling Coordinator

Location: Remote – South Africa
Working Hours: US Working Hours
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organised and detail-oriented Scheduling Coordinator to manage staff and client schedules and ensure smooth day-to-day scheduling operations. This role requires excellent communication, strong administrative skills, and the ability to manage multiple scheduling changes while maintaining continuity of client care.

Key Responsibilities

  • Audit staff availability, session hours, and scheduling consistency on a daily basis.
  • Coordinate new technician orientations and supervised overlap schedules with clinical and operations teams, technicians, and client families.
  • Confirm attendance, communicate scheduling details, and ensure all parties are aligned.
  • Monitor cancellations and promptly notify affected staff, families, and relevant teams.
  • Request coverage and coordinate make-up sessions to support continuity of client care.
  • Update appointments and billable/non-billable status for holidays, weather closures, and other schedule changes.
  • Maintain accurate scheduling logs, staff communication channels, and onboarding records.
  • Identify and escalate scheduling discrepancies to operations leadership.
  • Handle confidential client and staff information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Support incoming scheduling-line calls and ensure timely communication with families, technicians, BCBAs, and leadership.
  • Assist with general scheduling administration and coordination as required.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in scheduling, coordination, administration, healthcare, staffing, or a similar role.
  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable communicating with multiple stakeholders, including clients, families, staff, and management.
  • Ability to manage changing priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong computer skills and confidence working with scheduling systems and spreadsheets.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive client and employee information.
  • Reliable, proactive, and able to work independently.

title: Access Control Officer
description:
Job Summary: B&P Solutions, LLC is seeking an experienced Access Control Officer to support Army Intelligence and Security Command (INSCOM) Access Control Officer and Escort Support Services.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Provide access control services for government facility locations
  • Control access of personnel, equipment, and media going into and out of the INSCOM and/or MSC secure facilities
  • Visually determine, through face-to-face ID checks, that personnel accessing the SCIF have the specific badge required for facility access, and that personnel bringing in or exiting the facility with equipment and media have the Government-issued and approved equipment and media entry/exit authorization forms
  • Issue ESCORT REQUIRED badges to all un-cleared personnel to include official visitors, unofficial visitors, foreign visitors, custodial, maintenance and repair services providers and construction workers
  • Ensure security clearance and SCI access levels of all visitors requesting access to the SCIF are verified in Defense Information System for Security (DISS) or Scattered Castles and cleared visitors, both government and contractors are issued the appropriate visitor badge per the approved Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and notify sponsors of visitor arrival
  • Conduct random entry/exit inspections in accordance with the local Entry/Exit Inspection Program (EEIP)
  • Inspect and ensure personnel bringing in approved equipment and media have the appropriate Government issued and approved and valid equipment/media entry/exit authorization form
  • Utilize Central Monitoring Stations (CMS) to include Lenel, and which are used to process 100% access verification and validation for all cleared and un-cleared individuals utilizing Government facilities
  • Maintain a shift log in accordance with Post and INSCOM Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
  • Maintain sign-in sheets for cleared and un-cleared visitors for the facility
  • Conduct an equipment and log inventory of government furnished equipment within 15 minutes of each shift change and maintain a log of accountability
  • Provide immediate notification of any and all attempts to gain forceful entry, hostage conditions, fire, medical emergency and any other life-threatening situations (i.e. bomb threats) to DA police, (local police as a secondary measure) and or any other applicable emergency team i.e. (fire and rescue)

Basic Qualifications:

  • Security Clearance: Active DoD TS/SCI
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen
  • Minimum of 21 years of age
  • Must have a high school diploma or equivalent
  • Minimum of 2 years' experience utilizing security systems such as DISS or Scattered Castles
  • Ability to obtain and maintain First Aid, Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR) and Automated External Defibrillator (AED) certifications
  • Individuals shall be able to perform prolonged walking, standing, sitting and stooping for up to 12 hours, and shall be able to read, write, fluently speak and understand the English language, understand and apply printed rules, detailed orders/instructions and training materials

title: Teknikspecialist  säkerhetssystem & fysiskt skydd
description:

Områdesövervakning
Kameraövervakningssystem

Inbrottslarm

Genomföra driftsättning av säkerhetssystem på olika typer av anläggningar
Säkerställa att systemen uppfyller fastställda krav, riktlinjer och standarder
Arbeta med passersystem, inbrottslarm och kameraövervakningssystem
Hantera tekniska frågor kopplade till drift, funktion och systemintegration

Kontrollera och följa upp det fysiska skyddet
Granska teleteknisk dokumentation

Utveckla metoder och arbetssätt för systemförvaltning
Stärka den långsiktiga förmågan att förvalta och vidareutveckla säkerhetssystem
Hantera flera projekt och tekniska frågeställningar parallellt

Samtliga krav ska vara 100 % uppfyllda och tydligt kunna styrkas i CV.

Passersystem
Inbrottslarm
Kameraövervakningssystem

Systemintegration
Teknisk felsökning enligt relevant standard, exempelvis SSF

SSF

Det är särskilt meriterande om du har:

Strukturerad och noggrann
Självständig och ansvarstagande

title: Hardware Engineer (Projecten)
description:
Hardware Engineer Projecten

MBO 4 / HBO | Elektrotechniek of Industriële Automatisering | 32-40 uur | De Klomp

Ontwerp jij de elektrische basis van onze hightech robot- en verpakkingsmachines?

Van de eerste klantvraag tot een draaiende machine op locatie: jij zorgt ervoor dat alle elektrotechnische systemen perfect samenwerken. Je vertaalt technische uitdagingen naar slimme hardware-oplossingen en ziet jouw ontwerpen uiteindelijk werkelijkheid worden in machines die wereldwijd worden ingezet binnen de voedingsmiddelenindustrie.

Word jij enthousiast van elektrotechniek, machinebouw en industriële automatisering? Vind je het leuk om klantspecificaties te vertalen naar complete elektrische ontwerpen die daadwerkelijk gebouwd en getest worden? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Jouw impact bij PWR

Als Hardware Engineer speel je een sleutelrol binnen onze engineeringprojecten. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het complete elektrotechnische ontwerp van geavanceerde robot- en verpakkingsmachines.

Je werkt vanaf de conceptfase mee aan nieuwe projecten en vertaalt functionele eisen naar elektrische schema's, componentselecties en technische documentatie. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met Mechanical Engineers, Software Engineers, Commissioning Engineers en Project Managers.

Het mooie? Je ziet jouw ontwerpen niet verdwijnen in een la.

Onze machines worden namelijk volledig in eigen huis gebouwd, getest en vervolgens wereldwijd in bedrijf gesteld.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Ontwerpen en uitwerken van elektrische schema's in EPLAN.

  • Vertalen van klantspecificaties naar slimme en betrouwbare hardware-oplossingen.

  • Opstellen van machine-, netwerk- en systeemoverzichten.

  • Ontwerpen van paneelindelingen met EPLAN Pro Panel.

  • Berekenen en valideren van veiligheidscircuits met SISTEMA en/of PAScal.

  • Controleren van projectdocumentatie zoals elektrische tekeningen, IO-lijsten en spare parts-lijsten.

  • Bestellen van projectmaterialen via ons ERP-systeem Ridder.

  • Ondersteunen van assemblage, testafdeling en commissioning bij technische vraagstukken.

  • Uitwerken van aanpassingen, revisies en serviceprojecten.

  • Bijdragen aan standaardisatie en doorontwikkeling van onze machines.

Van klantvraag naar technisch ontwerp

Bij ieder project begint het met een technische uitdaging.

Samen met het projectteam analyseer je de klantspecificaties en bepaal je welke hardware-oplossingen nodig zijn. Bij standaardprojecten ben je vanaf de definitiefase betrokken. Bij complexere projecten neem je een reeds uitgewerkt concept over van de Lead Engineer en werk je dit zelfstandig verder uit.

Zo zorg je ervoor dat elk project start met een solide technische basis en eindigt met een betrouwbare machineoplossing.

Samen bouwen aan innovatieve machines

Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams waarin verschillende specialismen samenkomen. Door intensief samen te werken met Mechanical Engineering, Software Engineering, Purchasing, Project Management en Commissioning bewaak je niet alleen de kwaliteit van het ontwerp, maar ook de technische haalbaarheid.

Je denkt actief mee, deelt kennis met collega's en ondersteunt waar nodig tijdens de bouw en inbedrijfstelling van de machine.

Want uiteindelijk bouwen we samen aan één doel:

een machine die bij de klant direct presteert.

Groei door specialisatie

Bij PWR krijg je de ruimte om expert te worden binnen een vakgebied dat jou aanspreekt.

Denk bijvoorbeeld aan:

  • Machineveiligheid

  • Besturingstechniek

  • Servo- en aandrijfsystemen

  • Industriële netwerken

  • Elektrotechnische componentselectie

  • Standaardisatie van machineplatformen

Zo ontwikkel je jezelf niet alleen als engineer, maar word je ook een inhoudelijke sparringpartner voor collega's en leveranciers.

Wat neem je mee?

  • Minimaal een afgeronde MBO 4- of HBO-opleiding richting Elektrotechniek, Industriële Automatisering of vergelijkbaar.

  • Ervaring met EPLAN.

  • Ervaring met EPLAN Pro Panel is een pre.

  • Interesse in machinebouw, robotica en industriële automatisering.

  • Affiniteit met machineveiligheid en relevante normen is een pre.

  • Je kunt technische documentatie lezen, interpreteren en opstellen.

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal voldoende om met internationale collega's en klanten samen te werken.

  • Je bent analytisch, nauwkeurig en denkt in oplossingen.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Werken aan innovatieve robot- en verpakkingsmachines die wereldwijd worden ingezet.

title: Drywall Technician
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Drywall Technician to join our dedicated property management maintenance team. In this pivotal role, you will lead the repair, restoration, and precision finishing of interior walls and ceilings across our premier residential portfolio. The ideal candidate brings comprehensive technical expertise in patching, sanding, texturing, and painting, demonstrating an uncompromising commitment to craftsmanship and ensuring every unit turnover and service request meets our rigorous quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drywall Repair & Precision Finishing: Execute superior drywall repairs, encompassing small patch repairs, large section restorations, taping, mudding, and meticulous sanding to achieve flawless, paint-ready surfaces.
  • Texture Matching Mastery: Expertly match diverse existing wall finishes (including orange peel, knockdown, and smooth textures) to deliver seamless, undetectable repairs.
  • Surface Preparation & Painting: Perform thorough surface prep-including priming, caulking, and minor structural repairs-and apply premium paint finishes to walls, ceilings, and trim during unit turns and service calls.
  • Turnover Efficiency: Drive the unit turnover process by completing comprehensive wall repairs and painting efficiently, minimizing vacancy windows while maintaining exceptional standards.
  • Work Order Management: Systematically manage assigned service requests utilizing property management software, ensuring accurate documentation, timely completion, and proper verification.
  • Quality Assurance & Site Cleanliness: Maintain exemplary workplace cleanliness during and following repairs, ensuring work areas are left pristine and free of dust or debris for residents.
  • Team Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with maintenance teammates to support broader property initiatives and provide general maintenance assistance as operational needs dictate.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Technical Proficiency: Proven track record in professional drywall installation, finishing, and texture matching, with a demonstrated ability to deliver invisible, high-quality repairs.
  • Painting Expertise: Advanced proficiency in interior painting techniques, including precise cut-in work, roller application, and detailed trim finishing.
  • Attention to Detail: Exceptional eye for detail and commitment to producing polished, professional results across all living spaces.
  • Tools & Equipment: Full operational mastery of standard drywall tools (knives, mechanical sanders, straight edges) and painting apparatus (brushes, rollers, sprayers).
  • Customer Service & Professionalism: Professional presentation and strong interpersonal skills when communicating and performing duties within occupied resident homes.
  • Time Management: Strong organizational skills to prioritize multiple service calls and unit turnover schedules concurrently while adhering to firm deadlines.
  • Software Literacy: Working knowledge of computer or mobile maintenance applications used for job tracking and task resolution.

Benefits

  • Health Consumer Cooperative/ICHRA
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance(Company paid and Employee Paid)
  • Supplemental Benefits
  • Paid Time Off
