title: PERM - Staff Data Engineer
description:
Staff Data Engineer | Permanent | Up to £140,000 + Bonus

Location: Hybrid – London (3 days per week on-site)

Salary: Up to £140,000 + c.20% bonus + additional benefits

Employment: Permanent

We're supporting a major UK financial services organisation as they undertake a significant programme of data engineering modernisation and transformation, alongside substantial investment in AI-driven engineering capabilities.

We're looking for an exceptional Staff Data Engineer who combines deep hands‑on engineering expertise with the technical leadership to challenge existing approaches, shape solutions and raise engineering standards across multiple teams.

This is a high-impact opportunity to help modernise a large-scale data estate, develop new data products and influence how modern engineering practices are adopted across the organisation.

Crucially, this is a hands‑on technical leadership role, not a purely strategic or architectural position.

The opportunityYou'll play a central role in transforming the organisation's data engineering capabilities, including the modernisation and migration of thousands of existing data pipelines.

Working across multiple engineering teams, you'll help establish scalable data engineering frameworks, accelerate delivery through AI-assisted development and support the organisation's ambition to build greater internal data engineering capability.

Key responsibilities:

  • Providing Staff-level technical leadership across major data engineering and transformation initiatives.
  • Remaining deeply hands‑on with Python, PySpark and Apache Spark.
  • Leading the modernisation and migration of large-scale data pipelines across AWS.
  • Designing and challenging technical approaches across AWS Glue, Airflow and associated technologies.
  • Shaping scalable data architectures, reusable engineering frameworks and development standards.
  • Supporting the design and delivery of new data products.
  • Championing AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborating with senior technical stakeholders and engineering teams to challenge existing thinking and drive technical improvements.

What we're looking for

  • Extensive hands‑on Python, PySpark and Apache Spark expertise.
  • Deep experience with AWS data engineering, particularly AWS Glue.
  • Strong experience with Apache Airflow and complex data pipeline orchestration.
  • Proven experience delivering large-scale data transformation, migration or modernisation programmes.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to design scalable, maintainable engineering solutions.
  • Experience operating at Staff, Principal or equivalent technical leadership level.
  • Ability to independently shape technical direction, challenge existing approaches and influence multiple engineering teams.
  • A genuine desire to remain deeply hands‑on with engineering and code.
  • Experience adopting modern AI-assisted development tools, such as Claude Code, within engineering workflows.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to engage with senior technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with Snowflake and delivering data solutions within financial services or another highly regulated environment would be particularly beneficial.

Why consider this opportunity?

This is an opportunity to take a leading technical role in an organisation making a significant investment in modernising its data estate and transforming its engineering capabilities.

You'll have the opportunity to influence technical direction across multiple teams, tackle complex data engineering challenges and help establish modern engineering practices, including the adoption of AI-assisted development.

We're particularly interested in engineers who can operate across technical strategy and hands‑on delivery — individuals who can challenge the thinking, define the approach and then get into the code to prove and deliver the solution.

The permanent nature of the position also offers the opportunity to take long‑term ownership of technical decisions, develop internal engineering capability and play a meaningful role in the organisation's wider transformation.

Salary: Up to £140,000 + c.20% bonus and additional benefits

title: Maatschappelijke Zorg Medewerker Revalidatie
description:
Maatschappelijke zorg geriatrische revalidatie Oss

“Revalideren is echt keihard werken, zeker voor ouderen."

De gehele klinische opname staat in het teken van herstelzorg. Naast de vaste dagstructuur en therapieën staat ook welzijn op de GRZ in het teken van het revalidatieklimaat. Als medewerker maatschappelijke zorg vervul je dus een belangrijke rol in het herstelproces. Samen met individuele revalidanten onderzoek je wat de impact is van de (tijdelijke) beperkingen op bestaande activiteiten/hobby's en biedt je ondersteuning aan om dit weer op te pakken of te zoeken naar een passend alternatief. Daarnaast biedt de groepstherapieën aan gericht zijn op verschillende onderdelen van herstel. Hierbij denkend aan cognitieve training, activeren van de fijne motoriek, grove motoriek, gespreksgroep en spel/bewegen. Binnen de GRZ werken wij intensief samen met de revalidant , zijn netwerk en het en (multidisciplinaire) zorgteam. We werken vanuit een revalidatieplan dat aansluit op doelen van de revalidant.

Is dit jouw uitdaging? "Reageer dan op deze vacature!”

Teammanager Zorg en Welzijn GRZ Astrid van Gaal

Dit ga je doen

Als maatschappelijke zorg medewerker werk je op de revalidatieafdeling van de wellen waar cliënten gemiddeld 8 weken verblijven om weer zo zelfstandig mogelijk naar huis te gaan. Je werkt nauw samen met behandelaren.

Naast meedraaien in de zorg (alle diensten), zorg je ervoor dat revalidanten kunnen oefenen met allerhande vaardigheden, die nodig zijn om thuis weer voor zichzelf te kunnen zorgen.

Geen cliënt is hetzelfde en dat maakt jouw werk ook uitdagend. Waar je de ene cliënt moet afremmen, is het bij de ander nodig om te motiveren om weer zelf aan de slag te gaan. Je houdt hierbij rekening met de verschillende ziektebeelden, waar cliënten mee te maken hebben. Je weet dat herstel na een botbreuk heel anders verloopt dan na een herseninfarct. Daarom schakel jij moeiteloos tussen de verschillende methodes om cliënten te motiveren en handelingen aan te leren.

Jij bent het verlengstuk van de betrokken behandelaren en het zorgteam. En daarmee essentieel voor een goede revalidatie. Wanneer een cliënt naar huis gaat heb jij ook een adviesrol: je onderzoekt wat nodig is, zodat de cliënt het leven thuis weer zo goed mogelijk kan oppakken. Wanneer je hoort dat het goed gaat met een cliënt na ontslag van de revalidatieafdeling, geeft dit je veel voldoening. Prachtig werk toch?!

Dit ben jij

Je beschikt over een MBO niveau 4 diploma (Persoonlijk) Begeleider Medewerker Maatschappelijke zorg.

Daarnaast:

  • werk je graag in een multidisciplinair team en kun je goed zelfstandig werken;

  • ervaring of affiniteit met geriatrische revalidatie

  • kun je goed planmatig werken met behandelplannen en ben je sterk in rapporteren en communiceren;

  • ben je geduldig, tactvol en integer;

  • ben je inventief en creatief in het vinden van oplossingen en mogelijkheden;

  • heb je oog voor wat belangrijk is voor cliënten individueel en tegelijkertijd voor de groep.

Dit krijg jij

Je krijgt in eerste instantie een tijdelijk dienstverband en een salaris in FWG 45 volgens cao Verpleeg-, Verzorgingshuizen en Thuiszorg

Daarnaast krijg je:

  • uitzicht op een vaste aanstelling;

  • ruime mogelijkheden voor ontwikkeling en doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen de organisatie;

  • een goede pensioenregeling, vakantiegeld 8%, collectieve verzekeringen en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% (een volledige 13de maand);

  • korting op het leasen van een auto o.b.v. Private Lease;

  • meerkeuze in arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een laptop- en fietsregeling en korting op sporten.

Salaris en arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn volgens de cao Verpleeg- en Verzorgingshuizen en Thuiszorg.

Interesse?

De sluitingsdatum van de vacature is 25 oktober 2026.

De gesprekken vinden plaats op 29 oktober 2026.

Teammanager Astrid van Gaal, 06 100 411 50

title: Database Administrator
description:
Uw rol
Als Database Administrator begeleid je de modernisering van onze infrastructuur door de migratie van onze kritieke databases naar de cloud te sturen en tegelijkertijd de veiligheid, beschikbaarheid en traceerbaarheid te garanderen.

Concrete taken:

- Beheer en optimalisatie van onze productiedatabases (on-premise en cloud)
- De geleidelijke migratie naar beheerde diensten (Cloud Smals, GCloud, MS Azure, AWS, enz.) leiden en beveiligen
- De evolutie van de configuraties beheren in functie van de businessbehoeften
- Een strategie voor beveiligde toegang definiëren en implementeren (IAM-principes, rollen, machtigingen, audit)
- Zorgen voor de versleuteling van data die in rust en in transit is
- Bijdragen aan het aantonen van NIS2-compliance binnen het datadomein
- Robuuste en geteste back-up- en herstelstrategieën ontwerpen
- Incidentherstelplannen regelmatig valideren en herstel garanderen in geval van een ramp
- Kritieke procedures documenteren en bijhouden
- Knelpunten identificeren en verhelpen (SQL, indexen, architecturen)
- Relevante optimalisaties voorstellen en de impact ervan controleren
- Problemen voorkomen voordat ze kritiek worden
- Nauw samenwerken met de teams voor toepassingen, infrastructuur en beveiliging en hen ondersteunen bij kritieke incidenten

Uw profiel
Je hebt een master- of bachelordiploma in IT of gelijkwaardige ervaring en beschikt over aantoonbare ervaring in databasebeheer.

Je hebt bewezen operationele expertise in ten minste twee van de volgende DBMS: SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL.

Je hebt ervaring met migratie naar de cloud en praktische kennis van hoge beschikbaarheid, replicatie en back-ups.

Je hebt een goed begrip van de principes van data-beveiliging en risicobeheer. Kennis van NIS2 en/of ISO 27001 is een pluspunt.

Je bent nauwgezet en zorgvuldig in het gebruik van kritieke systemen en reageert snel en kalm op incidenten.

Je kunt zelfstandig werken en hebt een goed verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.

Je combineert een teamspirit met het streven naar technische uitmuntendheid.

Je hebt een goede kennis van het Frans.

About Samsung Food (Whisk)

At Samsung Food (you might know us as Whisk), we are pioneering the future of everyday care and health — helping individuals and families around the world live better through connected, proactive, and personalized experiences. Our mission is to connect food, health, and home across the Samsung ecosystem, turning data from your devices into personalized guidance that supports you and your loved ones.

We work at the intersection of AI, nutrition, behavior change, and digital health. The Samsung Food app was included in Google Play’s Best of 2020 Everyday Essentials list, has been regularly featured on the Apple App Store, and was nominated for a 2021 Webby Award. We’ve also launched Vision AI, which recognises food and meals using our global Food Genome, and developed deep integrations with Samsung Health and SmartThings.

We are a remote-first team of more than 100 people in over 30 countries, united by our commitment to innovation and impact. As part of Samsung Electronics, we combine the agility of a startup with the scale of the world’s largest consumer electronics company. Join us and help build technology that improves daily life for tens of millions of people across phones, wearables, TVs, and kitchen appliances in the years to come.

Learn more about how we’ve shaped a high-performing global team over the past 14 years.

Summary

Overview

We're building an AI coaching experience inside Samsung Health. Every piece of coaching a user sees is generated, not written. Our platform partner owns the evaluation runtime and functional evals (did the pipeline execute, did the tool call succeed). Nobody owns the layer above that: is the output actually good — right framing, right tone, right structure, does it deliver the coaching logic, does it feel like it's talking to me.

This engagement exists to build that layer: author the failure taxonomy, codify it into a binary rubric, validate an LLM judge against your own human grades, and hand the whole thing to an internal owner. We have a v0.1 rubric and golden scenarios from our product lead, and a functional rubric owned by engineering. We don't have the experience rubric — that's what this engagement produces.

Deliverables by Phase (Overall project ~13 weeks)

1. Failure taxonomy and golden set (within 4 weeks from the contract start date)

At least 150 traces hand-graded with open-coded notes. At least 40 of them come from sparse-data synthetic profiles. The taxonomy has 5–10 categories, each with a frequency count, and the top three failures are shown with their share of all failures. Saturation is evidenced: the last 20 traces produced no new category. At least 50 traces are frozen as a holdout. Head of Product signs off the taxonomy.

2. Rubric v1 and calibration (within 4 weeks from phase 1 completion)

One binary pass/fail criterion per taxonomy category, each with a definition, a pass example and a fail example. Written annotation guidelines. At least 30 traces are double-coded with a second grader, and every disagreement is logged and resolved in writing. A guideline revision log records each change and its reason. Head of Product signs off the rubric.

3. Validated judge and weekly readout (within 4 weeks from phase 2 completion)

Judge prompts for every criterion. A validation report giving true positive rate and true negative rate per criterion on both the dev set and the holdout. A weekly readout on helpfulness, relevance and tone, run at least twice: once by the consultant, and once by the internal owner with the consultant shadowing. A documented revalidation routine, triggered by every model or prompt change and run quarterly regardless.

4. Playbook and handover test (within 1 week from phase 3 completion)

A written playbook covering the whole method: grading, updating the taxonomy, revising the rubric, revalidating the judge and running the readout. The handover test passes when the internal owner reruns the judge validation unaided, gets within ±5 points, and runs one weekly readout with no consultant involvement.

What This Role Is Not

- Not building eval infrastructure, harnesses, or dashboards (owned elsewhere)

- Not functional/module-level evals or accuracy metrics

- Not clinical safety validation

- Not high-volume annotation — grading a few hundred traces to build the taxonomy; volume work goes to vendors/the judge once the rubric exists

What We're Looking For

You've run this loop end-to-end at least once on conversational or generated-text output: error analysis on real traces → a failure taxonomy you built yourself → binary criteria and annotation guidelines → an LLM judge validated against your own labels.

Background: conversation design, AI product quality, model behaviour/policy, content design, human data operations, UX research with strong qualitative coding, or RLHF. Applied linguistics and product management backgrounds also fit.

You'll be strong in this role if you:

- Can describe a failure mode you personally discovered by reading output — one nobody had named before you

- Are comfortable being the arbiter and documenting what you overruled and why

- Understand the rubric is discovered through grading, not written upfront

- Can explain why a judge that agrees with you 94% of the time might still be useless

- Write annotation guidelines that don't need interpreting

- Are comfortable working in notebooks and spreadsheets (no production code required)

Not required: domain expertise in nutrition, weight management, or behaviour change — we have that in-house.

title: TCHP CLINICAL NAVIGATOR ASSISTANT
description:
Assists the RN Clinical Navigator in daily tasks as the main liaison between the physicians and the patients as well as the physicians and the other office staff. Assists in coordinating new patient referrals, bone marrow transplants, testing and research for all the TCHMS II offices.

Assists with screening patient calls to physicians and handling all that do not require direct physician communication and serves as liaison between physician and office staff at various locations.

A. Screen all calls from all inpatient locations and review with physicians then relay to the Clinical Navigator for communication of data and new orders to the inpatient units.

B. Primary liaison for all other office staff communication for the onsite physicians for any given day.

Assists with coordinating procedures for all TCHMS II physicians and all TCHMS II locations and referrals relating to in and out of town based systems for research, second opinions and transplantation which includes:

A. Schedule all procedures TCHMS II physicians and outlying departments preform such as thoracentesis and bone marrow biopsies in CAT scan and ultrasound.

B. Coordinate all out of town referrals and local transplants to include:

1. Verifying patient insurance coverage related to referral location.

2. Coordinating retrieval and forwarding of appropriate pathology specimens and records.

3. Collecting radiology studies either for patient pickup or direct transport via Fed Ex for referral.4

4. Communication details of said appointment to said facility and requirements for patient.

C. Ordering of all specialty testing: Lab and pathologic.

D. Researching new testing and testing modalities, where they are preformed and how we access them.

E. Builds and maintains a network of appropriate contacts and relationships wit Cancer centers / research facilities around the country and the world.

F. Coordinate phone conversations

Between TCHMS II physicians and other specialists around the country and the world for patient care purposes.

G. Performing multi center searches for available treatment modalities / research opportunities for patients.

H. Gathering additional data and records from out of town referrals/visits.

I. Proficiency in literature searches is a must.

J. Maintain a working knowledge of all operating systems employed at the hospital and physician offices to maintain competency and assist the physicians.

Maintains Physicians schedules to include:

A. Opening and closing of schedules with each location as appropriate related to vacations, conferences and special requests.

B. Inputting and maintaining schedules in Google calendar including all meetings, vacations, conferences, procedures, admissions and special requests for 7 medical oncologists, 7 Mid-level providers, and 2 radiation oncologists.

C. Maintaining hard copy of all time off requests for appropriate record keeping as required by administration.

D. Production of reports for meeting attendance for all providers as required by the administration of the Christ Hospital.

Assists with daily rounds with the physicians and gathers data needed for in-patients such as daily labs, test results, and any data that the physicians require for patient care.

A. Draws up and assigns all physicians to rounding responsibilities at all locations, meetings and procedures

B. Interacts with nursing staff to get overnight updates on inpatients for their physician.

C. Takes overnight updates from physicians on call and distribute to appropriate staff/ physicians.

D. Reviews inpatient records and reports any and all abnormal results like labs, radiology and or pathology.

E. Imports and imprints office notes to the inpatient system.

F. Pulls data from outlying facilities to import to TCHHN system.

Assists with scheduling tests and scans for patients per physicians’ requests. Orders specialty testing, i.e. pathology, and keeps updated on new testing offered.

  1. Assists with scheduling of new procedures and teaches the support staff in learning for future scheduling.

Assists with contacting insurance companies to obtain authorizations for additional consults, procedures, bone marrow transplants, and drug trials. Assists with arranging patient participation in phase studies, drug protocols or trials as directed and arranges all appointments directed by the physicians.

Assists with coordinating all new patient referrals by obtaining all pertinent medical records, scheduling consult appointments with appropriate offices and communicating with patients to discuss details.

A. Gathering all required medical records from referring physicians and hospital based systems. Reviewing records for additional items that may be required.

B. Prioritizing the urgency of a new patient visit, adjusting physician schedules as appropriate based on these needs.

C. Contacting each new patient via mail and by phone to inform patient of new patient appointment time.

D. Working with the RN Clinical Navigator to assure the work queue gets printed twice daily and forwarded to the billing staff for approval of insurance, then scheduling new patients accordingly.

Performs clerical duties such as checking physicians’ mailboxes, picking up radiation charges and delivering to Red Bank office, delivering mail from Red Bank office to radiation physicians, and preparing and presenting agendas for office staff meetings.

A. Picks up and delivers mail to onsite physicians at The Christ Hospital Cancer center and picks up documents and mail for the physicians of TCHMS II from outlying facilities.

B. Delivers charges and deposits to the Central Business Office from all TCHMS II locations.

C. Acts as primary resource for all staff to navigate Physician requests.

D. Attends seminars, reads magazines, briefings, memos to receive educational updates as mandated. And maintains electronic system management to all out lying facilities.

E. Maintains access to all city wide systems, i.e. Trihealth, University and Mercy systems.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

Please describe any specialized knowledge or skills, which are REQUIRED to perform the position duties. Do not personalize the job description, credentials, or knowledge and skills based on the current associate. List any special education required for this position.

EDUCATION: High School Diploma or equivalent required.

YEARS OF EXPERIENCE: 3-5 years medical office experience required. 2-3 years research experience including experience with oncology research data (pathology testing, specialty lab testing) and Inclusion/Exclusion criteria for trial participation highly preferred.

REQUIRED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE: Ability to relate and facilitate a good working relationship with patients, co-workers, physicians, and associated facility employees. Ability to utilize effective time management skills to ensure prompt patient treatment as well as to complete required chart documentation and to practice sound judgment in all clinical circumstances required. Exceptional organizational, multitasking, verbal and written communication skills required. Excellent computer skills (Epic preferred) and customer service skills required.

LICENSES & CERTIFICATIONS:

N/A

title: Advanced Systems Engr
description:
Engineer is responsible for leading and driving system level Value Engineering and Component Engineering initiatives across project engineering side of Process Automation (PA / HPS) portfolios. This role owns end‑to‑end VE/CE projects, drives architecture and supplier changes, and acts as a technical authority for cost optimization in PA systems while protecting compliance, safety, and customer commitments.

This position is expected to operate with high autonomy and influence across Engineering, ISC, Manufacturing, and Suppliers. Good communication and negotiation skills are required daily basis in connection with enablers involved in these projects – Engineering teams, ISC, Manufacturing site, Suppliers, Third party sub-contractors, Installation and commissioning Engineers and contractors, System integrators.

Key Responsibilities

Projects VE / CE Execution

  • Lead VE/CE projects for PA system‑level offerings (Experion PKS, cabinets, control platforms, networking, I/O, RTU and related system hardware) from project engineering side.
  • Identify cost‑out opportunities across:
    • System architecture
    • Cabinets and enclosure platforms
    • Electrical, electronic, and mechanical assemblies
    • Third‑party hardware and supplier components
  • Develop and execute VE/CE project charters including scope, baseline cost, savings potential, risks, and mitigation.
  • Drive projects through ideation → feasibility → implementation → validation → closure.

System Engineering & Architecture

  • Analyze PA system designs, block diagrams, BOMs, and drawings to identify:
    • Redundancy reduction
    • Design simplification
    • Standardization and reuse
    • Make‑vs‑Buy opportunities
  • Support architecture evolution initiatives (e.g., platform consolidation, modular designs, common sub‑systems).
  • Ensure VE/CE changes comply with PA system requirements, safety standards, certifications (IECEx, ATEX, CSA, UL), and customer specs.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with:
    • Project Engineering & Proposal teams during execution and bid support
    • Manufacturing sites (e.g., cabinet factories, PA assembly sites)
    • ISC / Sourcing on supplier changes, negotiations, and dual sourcing
    • Quality & Certification teams for impact assessment
  • Support BAE / VECE ideation workshops and factory productivity initiatives.

Financial & Productivity Ownership

  • Deliver quantified savings aligned with PA VE/CE productivity goals (DM and Non‑DM) for project engineering side.
  • Identify new opportunities and new policy identification for Pre and post award stages.
  • Build business cases including NRE, ROI, payback, and risk assessment.
  • Track and report projects in approved VECE tools and governance mechanisms.
  • Support AOP, STRAP, and pipeline planning for PA VE/CE initiatives.

Governance, Documentation & Reviews

  • Prepare and present VE/CE proposals at system, GBE, or COE reviews.
  • Maintain required technical documentation:
    • Design changes
    • Cost analyses
    • Supplier comparisons
    • Risk and compliance assessments

Support audits, lessons learned, and best‑practice standardization

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering.
  • 8–12+ years experience in process Automation systems, control engineering, or industrial automation.
  • Strong experience with system‑level design and cost ownership.
  • Proven track record of delivering VE/CE or cost‑optimization projects.

Preferred

  • Strong knowledge in PA project engineering process, Experion PKS or similar DCS platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of certification‑driven system environments.
  • Experience working with global manufacturing sites and suppliers.
  • Mentoring or technical leadership experience.

Success Indicators

  • Delivery of sustained VE/CE savings
  • Adoption of optimized system architectures
  • Recognition as PA VECE technical authority
  • Positive impact on margin and competitiveness

title: Systems Eng Supervisor
description:
JOB SYMMARY:

As a Systems Eng Supervisor here at Honeywell, you will play a critical role in overseeing and guiding a team of systems engineers in the design, development, and implementation of Fire Alarm, Security access control and other ELV systems. Your leadership will be essential in driving innovation, ensuring project success, and maintaining high standards of quality and efficiency. You will work on cutting-edge projects that transform the way businesses operate, contributing to Honeywell's reputation as a global leader in technology.

In this role, you will impact the design and architectural aspects of complex ELV systems, which may involve hardware, software, and network components. You will ensure that the system design aligns with Honeywell's quality standards and industry’s best practices. Your expertise will be instrumental in addressing complex engineering challenges and providing solutions that meet or exceed the required technical standards for your customers.

At Honeywell, our people leaders play a critical role in developing and supporting our employees to help them perform at their best and drive change across the company. Help build a strong, diverse team by recruiting talent, identifying, and developing successors, driving retention and engagement, and fostering an inclusive culture.

  • KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Strategy and Innovation
    Define the systems engineering strategy, align it with company goals, and steer the development of innovative, advanced solutions.
  • People Leadership
    Lead, coach, and develop systems engineers while building a collaborative, innovative, inclusive, and high-performing team.
  • Assess team performance regularly and provide timely, constructive feedback to support growth.
  • Project Delivery and Risk
    Deliver projects within the project management framework, proactively mitigating risks through data-driven decisions.
  • Technical Excellence
    Promote best practices in systems engineering and integration while maintaining current product knowledge.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for at least one ELV system.
  • Partner with technical experts and leaders to strengthen engineering capabilities and solutions.
  • Operational Performance
    Achieve up to 20,000 billable project hours each year.
  • Maintain compliance with Quality and HSE playbooks.
  • Customer Focus
    Review pre-sales estimates to verify that engineering labor addresses contractual and functional requirements.
  • Enhance customer satisfaction while meeting the engineering team's productivity, utilization, OTTR, and quality targets.
  • Use customer feedback to improve key performance indicators, including Net Promoter Score (NPS).
  • Continuous Improvement
    Encourage effective use of engineering tools, workflows, and methods to improve productivity and quality while embedding a culture of continuous improvement.ments
  • Present complex technical information clearly and effectively to diverse audiences

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 15 years of experience in the fire, security, ELV, or telecommunications industries.
  • Experience leading a team of 10–20 engineers in delivering project packages covering detailed systems design, hardware, software, graphics, and onsite commissioning.
  • Subject matter expertise in design, engineering, and commission of fire alarm, access control, CCTV, intrusion detection, and intercom systems.
  • Experience with front-end integrated systems, SCADA, and interfaces across multiple systems.
  • Practical experience with active and passive ICT components.
  • Experience configuring virtual machines and cybersecurity components, such as firewalls and access control lists, is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of Building Information Modeling (BIM) is an advantage.
  • Experience developing pre-sales solutions is an advantage.

PRINCIPLE DUTIES

  • Lead the team for an assigned pole or region in delivering multiple engineering projects.
  • Plan project and forecast resource requirements.
  • Build team capabilities by developing the technical expertise of senior and junior engineers.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to continuously improve processes and standards.
  • Execute engineering projects within the PMI framework and in accordance with established processes.
    • Manage project scope, risks, changes, quality, and customer satisfaction.
    • Manage stakeholder communications, including PSR reporting and escalations.
    • Ensure compliance with QA processes and maintain quality standards.

title: Data Engineer - Intern (Open to Fresh Graduates)
description:
If you are looking for a valuable opportunity in the healthcare human resources industry, Tenet Health has an internship for you! Tenet Health is comprised of 65 hospitals, approximately 550 outpatient centers and additional sites of care. We are differentiated by our top-notch medical specialists and service lines that are tailored within each community we serve.

We are a community built on CARE. Our caregivers and supporting staff extend compassion to those in need, helping to improve the health and well-being of those we serve, and provide comfort and healing.

This Internship/role in Data & Analytics is all about integrating knowledge and theory learned in the classroom with practical application and developing your skills in a professional setting. You will gain valuable experience in data engineering in a corporate healthcare setting.

Data is a key asset for Tenet Healthcare and the Data & Analytics group work with a variety of data from disparate sources to provide a whole host of analytics ranging from BI reporting and dashboards to advanced analytics like retrospective and predictive models. This directly helps in measuring and improving quality of care provided to communities Tenet serves. You will play a key role in advancing our data engineering capabilities in all facets of data i.e ingestion, curation, orchestration, governance, and analytics to ultimately deliver the right care, in the right place, at the right time.

  • Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements: automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery.
  • Build the infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources
  • Assist with data-related technical issues and support their data infrastructure needs.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Proficient with relational databases and SQL

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Info Systems or equivalent experience, with a passion for data
  • Excellent critical thinking/problem solving skills
  • Interest in learning about healthcare information technology

Work Setup:

  • Opportunities for professional development and advancement within the Controls Division
  • Supportive, collaborative, and forward-thinking work environment

Ready to Grow With VMG?

If you're ready to start or advance your career in HVAC and Controls installation and want to develop your skills with a growing company, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and take the next step with VMG.

title: Infrastructure & Security Specialist
description:
Reports to Head of IT.

Responsible for the day-to-day administration, maintenance, availability and reliability of the Bank's Active Directory, Microsoft 365, messaging, endpoint, network infrastructure, firewall and backup platforms, as well as providing user administration and operational support for vendor-managed banking applications and SWIFT Lite2. Ensure secure and stable operations, maintain appropriate security controls and support in compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements and applicable SWIFT CSP requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Administer and maintain Active Directory and Windows Server environments, including users, groups, organisational units (OUs), service accounts, delegation, lifecycle management, patching, security hardening and troubleshooting.
  • Create, maintain and troubleshoot Group Policy Objects (GPOs) for Windows servers and workstations, including security baselines, drive mappings, printers and software deployment.
  • Manage DNS/DHCP services, monitor domain controller health and replication, and perform routine directory maintenance and housekeeping.
  • Administer and support the Bank's on-premises Microsoft Exchange environment, including user mailboxes, shared mailboxes, resource mailboxes and distribution groups.
  • Troubleshoot mail flows, delivery issues and Microsoft Outlook connectivity issues.
  • Support email security administration, including spam filtering, mail hygiene and message tracking.
  • Administer and support Microsoft 365 services used by the Bank, including Microsoft 365 Apps, licensing, subscriptions and Microsoft 365 Apps.
  • Manage Windows 11 endpoints through Group Policy and local security settings, including security baselines, patch deployment, software deployment and user rights management.
  • Monitor endpoint security alerts and logs, investigate malware detections, suspicious activity and false positives and coordinate remediation activities.
  • Perform routine configuration and maintenance of Cisco switches, including VLAN assignments, switchport configuration and connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Administer and maintain FortiGate firewalls, including firewall policies, NAT rules, VPN configurations and security profiles.
  • Monitor firewall, network and security events using FortiGate and FortiAnalyzer platforms and investigate operational or security-related alerts.
  • Provide operational support for SWIFT Lite2 users, including user account administration, access management and authentication token support.
  • Coordinate authentication token activation, renewal, replacement, and resolution of token-related access issues.
  • Assist in troubleshooting user access, connectivity, and message submission issues, and coordinate with SWIFT support where vendor assistance is required.
  • Administer and maintain the Bank's backup and recovery platforms (Acronis and Veeam).
  • Monitor backup operations, investigate failures and perform periodic recovery testing.
  • Maintain up-to-date architecture diagrams, system documentation, asset inventories, and configuration records for systems under the role's responsibility.
  • Participate in system maintenance activities, planned changes, disaster recovery exercises, and after- hours support for critical incidents where required.
  • Support internal and external audits by providing evidence, logs, documentation, and control descriptions, including support for SWIFT CSP assessments.
  • Administer user accounts and access permissions for infrastructure platforms and designated vendor- managed applications.

Required Qualifications & Experience:

  • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • At least 4 years' experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration or information security.
  • Experience administering Microsoft Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Windows Servers and endpoint management platforms.
  • Experience supporting network infrastructure, firewalls, and backup solutions.
  • Experience in user administration and operational support for business-critical applications.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications & Experience:

  • Experience supporting SWIFT Lite2 or similar financial messaging platforms.
  • Experience with FortiGate firewalls and Cisco switching environments.
  • Experience in the banking or financial services industry.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks, regulatory requirements, and SWIFT CSP.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, Fortinet, Cisco, ITIL, or cybersecurity certifications are advantageous.

Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. You'll serve as a technical leader, developing best practices and mentoring team members while working cross-functionally to balance engineering performance with practical constraints. This position offers the opportunity to shape both individual designs and company-wide standards, taking projects from initial concept through regulatory certification.

  • Create and refine aircraft, assembly, and component level finite element models.

  • Conduct advanced feasibility studies to ensure aircraft designs meet performance, weight, and cost targets.

  • Establish and maintain best practices, analysis standards, and traceability, streamlining workflows through the automation of analysis processes with existing and newly developed tools.

  • Support fast-paced prototype and production aircraft design with a focus on manufacturability.

What you’ve done:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field (advanced degree preferred).

  • 7+ years of experience in composite structural analysis for aircraft, spacecraft, or similar vehicles.

  • Developed a deep understanding of material properties, failure mechanisms, and structural dynamics.

  • Strong expertise in CAD and FEM tools, particularly Siemens NX, Simcenter, Femap, or equivalent software.

  • Led the design and analysis of composite structures throughout the product lifecycle, from conceptualization to production.

  • Familiarity with aviation industry standards and DoD certification requirements.

What sets you apart:

  • Extensive experience in new product development, particularly in small, agile teams.

  • Experience in composite aircraft manufacturing techniques, including bonded structures.

  • Outstanding communication, time management, collaboration, and leadership abilities, with a proven track record of successfully working in cross-functional teams.

We are looking for a Security Operations Consultant to join our Digital Trust & Cyber Security practice. Working on behalf of our clients, you will lead Security Operations Centre (SOC) analysts and incident response specialists.

You will combine hands-on operational leadership with advisory work. This means managing live incident containment and day-to-day SOC operations, while helping enterprise and public sector clients modernise their security operations, improve their SIEM, SOAR and EDR capabilities, and build stronger cyber resilience.

Why consider joining our Digital & Data community? 🤔

  • Join our Digital & Data team and work alongside cyber security, product, design and technology specialists in cross-disciplinary teams to solve complex client challenges and bring ideas to life.
  • Build a flexible and distinctive career in a trust-based, inclusive environment that values excellence, innovation and curiosity. You can progress through a technical career track without needing to follow the Partner career track if that does not align with your ambitions.
  • Work across a broad range of Security Operations engagements, client environments and technology stacks spanning seven sectors. No two projects are the same.
  • Join a supportive and collaborative cyber and technology community, with knowledge sharing, peer support, coaching and mentoring from other specialists.
  • Deepen your expertise through our culture of learning and growth, with access to a development budget for technical and non-technical training and professional certifications.
  • Benefit from a hybrid working approach, with an expectation of being in the office or on a client site for a minimum of two days per week, depending on the role and assignment.

What you'll do 🌱

  • Lead and develop SOC analysts and incident response specialists, providing clear operational direction, coaching and support across day-to-day security operations.
  • Take a hands-on leadership role during cyber security incidents, coordinating investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, stakeholder communications and post-incident reviews.
  • Help enterprise and public sector clients assess and improve their Security Operations capabilities, identifying gaps across people, processes and technology and translating these into practical improvements.
  • Advise on the evolution and optimisation of SIEM, SOAR, EDR and threat-detection tooling to improve visibility, reduce noise and strengthen detection and response capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain incident playbooks, standard operating procedures, automated response workflows and proactive tabletop exercises.
  • Support the development of modern Security Operations services and ways of working, sharing your expertise across our Digital Trust & Cyber Security community through coaching, mentoring and knowledge sharing.

Security technologies you'll work with 🚀

We advocate using the right technology for the right task. Depending on the client environment and engagement, you can expect to work across technologies including:

  • SIEM and security analytics platforms, such as Microsoft Sentinel and Splunk.
  • SOAR and security automation technologies used for enrichment, triage and response orchestration.
  • Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR/XDR) platforms, such as Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and CrowdStrike Falcon.
  • Threat intelligence, detection engineering, investigation and incident response technologies.
  • Cloud security monitoring across Microsoft Azure, AWS and GCP environments.

What you can expect 🌱

  • Work collaboratively across multiple technical teams and stakeholder groups, using your Security Operations expertise to solve complex client problems and contribute to internal initiatives.
  • Participate in live, in-person working sessions to investigate incidents, assess operational challenges and design practical improvements, alongside asynchronous collaboration through Microsoft Teams.
  • Work with the team at client sites or in our offices for a minimum of two days per week. The time you spend and where you work will vary by role and assignment, including the possibility of being on a client site for up to five days per week.
  • Work in an environment that takes its values seriously and places collaboration, inclusion, learning and client impact at the heart of how teams operate.

Essential requirements ✅

Even if you don’t meet every requirement below, feel free to still apply as we are often hiring for similar roles which your background might be better suited to.

  • SOC Leadership: Experience running or supervising a SOC, CSOC, or Incident Response team.
  • Incident Response: Practical experience managing live cyber incidents (such as ransomware, account takeovers, or supply chain breaches).
  • Technical Stack: Direct experience working with major SIEM/SOAR tools (e.g., Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk) and EDR/XDR platforms (e.g., Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, CrowdStrike Falcon).
  • Security Frameworks: Solid understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, NCSC Caf v4.0 and ISO 27001.
  • Communication: Ability to write concise incident reports and speak comfortably with both engineers and business leaders.

Desirable

  • Experience working in management consulting, managed services (MSSP), or client-facing advisory roles.
  • Experience in regulated UK environments (such as Central Government, Defence, or Critical National Infrastructure).
  • Hands-on familiarity with cloud security monitoring in AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Please be aware that some of our UK roles at PA Consulting require a UK security clearance.

All PA people are required to undergo background checks and to achieve the Baseline Personnel Security Standard however, some UK roles also require higher levels of National Security Vetting, where applicants must have at least 5 years of continuous residency in the UK.

We therefore ask that you only apply if you meet the residency requirements (i.e. you are a British citizen or have been resident in the UK for the past 5 years), as this is the prerequisite for a security clearance. If you're unsure about your eligibility, we encourage you to review the UK Government’s guidance on security vetting before applying.

Assessment process ⚖️

Please note that the interview stages may be subject to change based on the specific requirements of the role.

  • Quick call with one of our Tech Recruiters – to discuss your application, the role and PA
  • Round 1: Either a competency or technical interview (60 mins)
  • Round 2: Either a competency or technical interview, whichever you didn’t do at first round (60 mins)
  • Final round 🎉: Meeting with a PA leader - a mini case study and discussion around your client-centricity (60 mins)

Our purpose guides how we work with our clients and our teams, and support our communities, to deliver insight and impact, solving the world’s most complex challenges. We're focused on building a workplace that values human difference and diverse mindsets, and a culture of inclusion and equality that unlocks the potential in our people so everyone can be their best self.

title: Fälttekniker
description:
Fälttekniker

Arbeta med teknik som människor använder varje dag

Gillar du att lösa tekniska problem, arbeta praktiskt och ha stor frihet i din arbetsdag? Vill du kombinera IT, hårdvara, nätverk och installationer i en roll där du får resa, träffa kunder och ta stort eget ansvar?

Vi söker nu en Fälttekniker till ett internationellt teknikföretag som levererar och servar innovativa tekniska lösningar hos några av Sveriges mest välbesökta verksamheter inom restaurang-, retail- och servicebranschen. Här arbetar du med teknik som används av tusentals människor varje dag och som är en viktig del av kundernas dagliga verksamhet.

Det här är en roll för dig som vill komma bort från skrivbordet och istället arbeta med teknik ute i verkligheten. Du får en varierande vardag där du ansvarar för installation, driftsättning, service, felsökning och underhåll av tekniska lösningar direkt hos kund.

Om rollen

Som Fälttekniker ansvarar du för att installera, driftsätta, underhålla och felsöka tekniska lösningar hos kunder runt om i Sverige. Du arbetar självständigt ute i fält och blir en viktig representant för företaget i kontakten med kunderna.

Rollen erbjuder en unik kombination av teknik, kundkontakt och praktiskt arbete. Du kommer att arbeta med allt från hårdvara och nätverk till montering, kabeldragning och tekniska installationer. Samtidigt bidrar du till att säkerställa att verksamhetskritiska system fungerar som de ska och att kunderna får en smidig användarupplevelse.

Arbetet innebär resor över hela Sverige och vissa övernattningar kan förekomma. Du får tillgång till företagsbil, arbetskläder och all utrustning som behövs för att lyckas i rollen.

Kabeldragning, montering och övriga installationsarbeten

Hårdvaru- och nätverksrelaterat arbete

Ansvara för att uppdrag genomförs enligt överenskomna servicenivåer

Utföra underhåll och tekniskt arbete ute hos kund

Arbeta med handverktyg och teknisk utrustning

Samarbeta med kollegor och andra tekniker vid behov

Har B-körkort

Trivs med att resa i tjänsten

Har ett tekniskt intresse och gillar praktiskt arbete

Är självgående och tar ansvar för dina uppdrag

Är serviceinriktad och tycker om kundkontakt

Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska

Meriterande erfarenheter

Fältservice eller teknisk support

Installation och underhåll av teknisk utrustning

IT-support, nätverk eller hårdvara

Fiber-, telekom-, larm- eller CCTV-installationer

El-, automations- eller servicetekniskt arbete

Vi erbjuder

En varierande roll med stor frihet under ansvar

Möjlighet att arbeta med teknik som används av tusentals människor varje dag

En spännande mix av IT, hårdvara, nätverk och praktiskt installationsarbete

Företagsbil, arbetskläder och nödvändig utrustning

Traktamente och ersättning vid resor och övernattningar

Ett engagerat och hjälpsamt team med korta beslutsvägar

Möjlighet att utvecklas långsiktigt inom ett växande internationellt företag

En roll där du får resa och se olika delar av Sverige istället för att sitta bakom ett skrivbord varje dag

Tjänsten inleds som en konsultanställning via Barona under cirka 6 månader. Ambitionen är att rollen därefter ska övergå i en direktanställning hos kunden.

Emma Hjorth

emma.hjorth@barona.se

Barona är en internationell koncern med kontor i 10 länder. I Sverige finns vi i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Falun och Strömsund och levererar lösningar inom kompetensförsörjning över hela landet. Sedan starten i Finland 1999 bygger vår framgång på ett starkt kundfokus och ett nytänkande kring tjänsteutbud och affärsutveckling. title: Software & Data Systems Engineer – Predictive Maintenance
description:
Job Description:

About the Role

Join our Health Management and Predictive Analytics team to shape the future of aerospace software. We are looking for a multidisciplinary Software & Systems Engineer to design and develop advanced ground software tools powering critical aerospace systems and flight operations. This role sits directly at the intersection of software engineering, systems engineering, and data analytics. You won't just write code—you will dive deep into complex aircraft architectures, understand component interactions, and transform complex telemetry data into actionable operational insights. You will play a key role in developing Health and Usage Management Systems (HUMS) across flagship aerospace platforms including the A400M, C295, EuroDrone, SIRTAP, and Hurjet.

Why HUMS Matters

HUMS is a mission-critical capability designed to monitor real-time equipment health, drive safety, and maximize fleet efficiency:

  • Predictive Maintenance: Detects early wear patterns before failures occur.
  • Operational Safety: Delivers real-time health alerts to prevent critical incidents.
  • Reliability & Efficiency: Optimizes asset lifespan and reduces unscheduled maintenance.
  • Data-Driven Insights: Converts complex flight data into decision-support tools for fleet operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • System Architecture & Design: Design scalable backend architectures, APIs (REST, gRPC), and ground tools handling complex, large-scale engineering datasets.
  • End-to-End Development: Build applications for data acquisition, processing, analysis, and visualization—from low-level telemetry handling to user-facing dashboards.
  • Interface & Requirements Definition: Define clear interfaces, boundaries, and system requirements in collaboration with avionics, hardware, and maintenance teams.
  • Predictive Analytics: Apply data analytics, machine learning, and data-driven methods to unlock insights from flight and operational data.
  • Platform Evolution: Drive technical decision-making, system trade-offs, and long-term platform roadmaps using robust engineering practices (CI/CD, containerization).

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Degree in Aerospace, Systems, Software, Telecommunications, or Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of combined experience in software development, systems engineering, or complex system design.
  • Software Core: Strong proficiency in at least one backend language (Python, C++, Java, or Go) and modern software design patterns.
  • Architecture & APIs: Proven experience in scalable, modular, or distributed systems and API design (REST, gRPC).
  • Data Engineering: Hands-on experience processing, managing, and analyzing large, complex datasets.
  • DevOps Basics: Familiarity with version control, CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (Docker).
  • Systems Mindset: Ability to evaluate systems holistically rather than focusing solely on isolated software tasks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Aerospace & Critical Systems: Experience in aerospace, avionics, safety-critical domains, or exposure to software standards like DO-178C.
  • Aerospace Data Protocols: Knowledge of aircraft communication protocols (e.g., ARINC, AFDX).
  • Frontend & UI Capabilities: Hands-on experience with React and TypeScript. Track record of building intuitive UI dashboards for technical metrics, time-series data, and operational telemetry.
  • Advanced Analytics: Background in predictive modeling, machine learning, or data visualization tools for engineering data.

Key Competencies

  • Big-Picture Systems Thinking: Balanced approach between strategic architecture decisions and hands-on coding.
  • Cross-Domain Collaboration: Ability to bridge communication gaps between systems engineering, avionics, and software teams.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: Proactive problem solver comfortable navigating ambiguity in multidisciplinary environments.
  • Technical Curiosity: Passion for understanding how physical hardware and aircraft systems operate under the hood.

WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE?

  • Vacation days and additional days-off along the year (+35 days off in total).
  • Attractive salary and compensation package.
  • Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting the work-life balance (40% remote work).
  • Collective transport service in some sites.
  • Benefits such as health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants.
  • On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office.
  • Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives.
  • Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment.
  • Special rates in products & benefits.

title: Cybersäkerhetstekniker till Vitec Fastighet
description:
Vill du arbeta förebyggande med IT-säkerhet i en molnmiljö för kunder i fastighetsbranschen? Tycker du om att förstå vad som händer under huven på servrar, tjänster och applikationer? Då kan rollen som cybersäkerhetstekniker hos Vitec Fastighet vara nästa steg för dig.

Som cybersäkerhetstekniker arbetar du operativt med säkerheten i våra molntjänster och produktmiljöer. Du samarbetar nära säkerhetsansvarig och kollegor inom Cloud Operations, DevOps, utveckling, arkitektur och produktteam. Tillsammans identifierar och analyserar ni risker, följer upp säkerhetshändelser och säkerställer att beslutade förbättringar genomförs och verifieras.

En stor del av arbetet är förebyggande. Du behöver inte vara färdig specialist när du börjar, men du behöver ha en relevant teknisk grund, viss praktisk erfarenhet av IT-säkerhetsarbete och en vilja att successivt ta ett större operativt ansvar.

Om rollen

Följa upp säkerhetslarm och analysera loggar i Wazuh för att identifiera avvikelser och förstå vad som har hänt.
Delta i utredningar av säkerhetsincidenter och följa upp beslutade åtgärder.
Arbeta förebyggande med säkerhetskonfigurationer, sårbarheter och förbättringar i våra server- och tjänstemiljöer.
Följa upp resultat från sårbarhetsskanningar, säkerhetsgranskningar och pentester.
Registrera och följa upp säkerhetsfynd genom utvecklings- och releaseflödet i Azure DevOps.
Verifiera att genomförda säkerhetsåtgärder fungerar som avsett i våra produkter och tjänster.
Utveckla regler, dashboards och analyser i Wazuh tillsammans med kollegor.
Felsöka säkerhetsrelaterade problem i Windows-, Linux-, nätverks-, databas- och applikationsmiljöer.
Genomföra avgränsade säkerhets- och verifieringstester i testmiljöer.
Dokumentera analyser och bidra till att förbättra våra arbetssätt, säkerhetsverktyg och tekniska kontroller.

Det här tar du med dig

Vi söker dig som har en relevant utbildning och några års praktisk erfarenhet av IT-säkerhet eller av en närliggande teknisk roll där säkerhetsarbete har varit en tydlig del av ansvaret. Det kan exempelvis vara inom IT-drift, systemadministration, nätverk eller säkerhetsövervakning. Erfarenhet från support, utveckling eller test är relevant om du har arbetat konkret med exempelvis behörigheter, loggar, härdning, sårbarheter eller säkerhetstester.

För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du har:

Grundläggande kunskaper i IT-säkerhet och förståelse för hur risker kan uppstå och hanteras i system och tjänster.
Praktisk erfarenhet av Windows Server, Active Directory, nätverk, loggar eller liknande tekniska miljöer.
Förmåga att felsöka metodiskt, dokumentera resultat och följa en teknisk fråga till avslut.
Intresse för att använda exempelvis PowerShell, Python eller SQL i teknisk analys.
God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska.

Det är ett plus om du har arbetat med

Wazuh eller en annan SIEM- eller XDR-plattform.
Sårbarhetsskanning, pentester eller tekniska säkerhetsgranskningar.
Azure samt andra SaaS- och molnmiljöer.
Linux och säkerhet i servermiljöer.
Microsoft Defender eller andra säkerhetsverktyg.
Applikationssäkerhet, säker utveckling eller teknisk testning.
NIS2, ISO 27001 eller andra relevanta säkerhetsramverk.

Personliga egenskaper

Är nyfiken och tycker om att förstå hur teknik fungerar i praktiken.
Tar ansvar för dina uppgifter och tar hjälp av kollegor när det behövs.
Arbetar strukturerat och är uthållig när felsökningen tar tid.
Delar med dig av det du lär dig och tycker om att lösa problem tillsammans med andra.
Förklarar tekniska frågor på ett tydligt och begripligt sätt.

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du en verksamhetsnära roll där ditt bidrag blir synligt och viktigt. Eftersom våra produkter är verksamhetskritiska för kunderna behöver arbetet präglas av ansvar, förtroende och ett professionellt förhållningssätt. Du arbetar nära säkerhetsansvarig och erfarna kollegor inom teknik och utveckling och får successivt ta större ansvar inom säkerhetsövervakning, Wazuh, incidenthantering, sårbarhetshantering samt produkt- och applikationssäkerhet.

Du får arbeta med säkerhetsfrågor som har tydlig koppling till våra produkter och kundernas vardag. Det innebär korta vägar mellan ett upptäckt problem, teknisk analys och faktisk förbättring. Du behöver inte kunna alla verktyg eller områden i annonsen från början, men du behöver ha en stabil teknisk grund, relevant praktisk erfarenhet och en tydlig vilja att fördjupa dig inom IT-säkerhet.

Om Vitec Fastighet

Vitec Fastighet är en del av Vitec Software Group och levererar verksamhetskritiska programvaror och molntjänster för bygg- och fastighetsbranschen. Våra system stödjer bland annat ekonomi, uthyrning, teknisk förvaltning, energi och marknadskommunikation. Vi arbetar långsiktigt och nära våra kunder för att leverera tillförlitliga system som hjälper dem i vardagen, idag och imorgon. Läs mer på vitec-fastighet.com.

Ansökan

Placeringsort: Tjänsten är i första hand placerad på vårt kontor i Stockholm, där flera av de närmaste samarbetena finns. För rätt kandidat kan placering vid något av våra andra kontor diskuteras.

Skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Sista ansökningsdag är den 26 oktober 2026.

För kandidater som går vidare till slutintervju genomför vi, med hänsyn till rollens säkerhetsansvar, en fördjupad bakgrundskontroll via en extern leverantör. Kandidaten får information om kontrollens omfattning och hur personuppgifterna behandlas innan kontrollen genomförs.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Patric Klintfors, Senior IT Security Manager, på patric.klintfors@vitecsoftware.com.

Facklig kontaktperson: Magnus Lind, magnus.lind@vitecsoftware.com

title: FT Overnight Bakery 11pm-7am #6642
description:
We are searching for friendly and professional full-time & part-time Overnight Bakery Team Members (2am-10am) or (11pm-7am) to join our Tim Hortons team at 1106 Main St, Corfu in Pembroke, NY. As a team member, your top priority is guest satisfaction. Whether you are the very first person our guests encounter or you are producing quality food items that our guests have come to enjoy and love you will have the opportunity to deliver and create exceptional guest experiences.

In this position, baking food products and delivering outstanding customer service will be your main objectives. Additional responsibilities include processing food orders, cleaning and re-stocking multiple areas of the restaurant, and preparing food and beverage orders. The ideal candidate will be friendly, with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Job Description:

The Bakery Team Member plays a vital role in delivering an exceptional guest experience through the preparation and monitoring of quality bakery products. • Follow all operational standards and guidelines for product preparation and equipment operation, as provided through training and operational materials.
• Monitor inventory of bakery products in the fridge and freezer and prepare products as needed.
• Prepare products in appropriate quantities to minimize waste and record prepared items and waste on the production sheet.
• Respond to showcase and product needs communicated by the Restaurant Front.
• Assist in serving guests in the Restaurant Front when necessary.
• Regularly monitor and record temperatures of required products, fridges, and freezers.


Policies & Procedures:


• Adhere to all restaurant policies, procedures, and standards.
• Maintain a clean and organized kitchen to ensure a ready-for-rush periods and timely service.
Health & Safety:
• Work in compliance with occupational health and safety legislation.
• Follow safe work practices and procedures.
• Use personal protective equipment or clothing as required.
• Report any injuries, accidents, unsafe conditions, or contraventions of health and safety regulations promptly to the Restaurant Manager or Human Resources.

Physical Demands and Working Environment:


The conditions herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.

Environment:

Work is performed in a busy quick food service restaurant, where employees are communicating
frequently with customers and other employees. Employees in this role must be able to prepare a variety of food and beverage items and work with/train other employees. There are frequent interruptions, tasks, and position changes.


Physical:

Primary functions require sufficient physical ability and mobility to work in a restaurant setting with multiple employees and customers; to stand for prolonged periods of time; to stoop, bend, kneel, crouch, reach, and twist; to lift, carry, push, and/or pull light to moderate amounts of weight from <5 – 50 lbs.; to operate cash register system requiring repetitive hand movement and fine coordination including use of electronic devices; frequent exposure to cold/freezing
below temperatures and high heat temperatures (walk-in freezers/coolers and working with ovens), and to verbally communicate to exchange information.

See in the normal visual range with or without correction.

Hear in the normal audio range with or without correction. Ability to use and wear a headset, if needed, to take and process customer orders.

title: Remote |   Resident Medical Specialist (MD/DO)
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
We are sharing a specialised part-time opportunity for licensed physicians in active clinical practice to contribute to advanced medical AI evaluation through clinical reasoning, scenario design, benchmark development, and structured assessment of model performance.

Selected physicians will work with research teams to evaluate how AI systems approach realistic medical problems, identify gaps in clinical reasoning, and help develop assessment methods that reflect the complexity and nuance of evidence-based practice. The opportunity is open across medical specialties.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Reasoning Evaluation

  • Evaluate AI performance on realistic medical reasoning tasks
  • Assess whether clinical conclusions are appropriately supported
  • Identify gaps in medical knowledge or decision-making
  • Review model reasoning against evidence-based practice
  • Distinguish clinically significant errors from minor limitations

Clinical Scenario Development

  • Create realistic medical scenarios for model evaluation
  • Design cases that require nuanced clinical judgement
  • Incorporate diagnostic and management decision points
  • Develop scenarios reflecting real-world clinical complexity
  • Ensure cases meaningfully test model capabilities

Evaluation Framework Design

  • Design systematic assessment frameworks for medical AI systems
  • Define criteria for evaluating clinical reasoning quality
  • Develop methods that capture nuance in medical decision-making
  • Support consistent evaluation across repeated clinical tasks
  • Refine assessment approaches based on observed model performance

Medical Knowledge & Decision Analysis

  • Identify areas where models demonstrate weak clinical understanding
  • Evaluate diagnostic reasoning and treatment-related judgement
  • Assess model responses for clinical relevance and completeness
  • Apply specialty-specific expertise where appropriate
  • Provide structured rationale for evaluation decisions

Research Collaboration & Feedback

  • Collaborate with research teams on medical AI evaluation
  • Communicate clinical findings clearly and concisely
  • Provide actionable feedback on model strengths and limitations
  • Contribute to strategies for improving medical model performance
  • Support development of clinically meaningful benchmarks

Ideal Profile

  • Licensed physician currently engaged in active clinical practice
  • MD, DO, or equivalent medical qualification
  • Open to physicians across medical specialties
  • Relevant backgrounds may include Public Health, Pediatrics, Emergency Medicine, Obstetrics & Gynecology, or Gynecological Oncology
  • Strong clinical decision-making experience
  • Solid understanding of evidence-based medicine
  • Ability to assess complex medical reasoning objectively
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking capabilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable explaining nuanced clinical decisions clearly
  • Able to identify gaps in medical knowledge or reasoning
  • Interest in the application of AI to clinical practice
  • Comfortable collaborating with research teams in a remote environment
  • Able to work independently around existing clinical commitments

Engagement Details

  • Part-time remote engagement
  • Flexible scheduling
  • Commitment of up to 30 hours per week
  • Initial project duration of approximately 1 month
  • Extension may be available depending on performance and project fit
  • Work will focus on clinical reasoning evaluation, scenario development, and medical benchmark design
  • Physicians from any clinical specialty may be considered
  • Scheduling is designed to accommodate ongoing clinical commitments
  • Compensation is not specified in the source materials
  • Work must be completed without using confidential, proprietary, patient-identifiable, protected health, unpublished clinical, or otherwise restricted information belonging to any patient, employer, healthcare organisation, research institution, client, or other third party

title: Additive Manufacturing Technician I
description:
About the Opportunity

As an Additive Manufacturing Technician I, you'll step into a hands-on role at the center of one of manufacturing's most exciting frontiers: metal additive manufacturing. No prior experience in additive manufacturing is required. What matters most is your curiosity, your commitment to doing things right, and your desire to grow.

This is an entry-level opportunity designed for people who are ready to roll up their sleeves, learn from the ground up, and build a foundation for a meaningful career in advanced manufacturing.

What You'll Do

  • Demonstrates willingness to learn additive manufacturing processes, machine platforms, materials, post-processing methods, and quality requirements; actively participates in all required training to build foundational job skills.

  • Asks questions to understand the rationale behind work instructions, process control requirements, safety protocols, and quality procedures before executing tasks independently; seeks supervisor guidance when any step is unclear.

  • Supports machine setup and operation for metal and polymer additive manufacturing systems under direct supervision — including loading build plates, filling powder or material reservoirs, initiating approved builds, and monitoring machine status as directed.

  • Performs basic post-processing tasks for additively manufactured parts under supervision — including support removal, media blasting using blast cabinets, basic cleaning, and part handling — following approved procedures precisely.

  • Monitors and records basic process control information as directed — including machine parameters, environmental conditions, and build status — logging data accurately in ERP/MES systems in accordance with work orders and process control instructions.

  • Accurately records time tracking data by job, operation, and activity in ERP/MES systems in accordance with company requirements; verifies own entries for accuracy and completeness before submitting.

  • Follows all work orders, specifications, and process control instructions exactly as documented; escalates immediately when instructions are unclear or conditions differ from what is expected.

  • Assists with general machine maintenance and cleaning tasks as directed — including machine exterior cleaning, cabinet and workspace organization, and consumables replenishment — following approved maintenance procedures.

  • Assists with supply organization and inventory control activities as directed, including receiving, labeling, and storing materials and consumables in designated locations.

  • Maintains high housekeeping standards and a clean, organized, and safe workspace at all times; promotes a safety-first culture in all daily activities.

  • Reviews own work for accuracy and completeness before advancing to the next step; ensures all quality documentation and traveler requirements are met consistently.

  • Follows all Quality Management System documentation requirements — including Quality Manual requirements, quality procedures, and associated work instructions — every time without exception; reports non-conformances, safety concerns, and documentation errors immediately with factual information.

  • Contributes to team goals by completing individual assignments reliably and supporting coworkers when asked; participates in continuous improvement initiatives as directed.

  • Supports other projects & duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

  • High School Diploma required; no prior additive manufacturing experience necessary

  • Any exposure to manufacturing, 3D printing, technical training, or hands-on mechanical work is a welcome plus

  • Ability to follow detailed written and verbal work instructions accurately and consistently

  • Strong mechanical aptitude and genuine curiosity about manufacturing technology

  • Sharp attention to detail and a habit of double-checking your own work

  • Positive attitude, punctuality, and a real commitment to safety and your teammates

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, quality-driven production environment

Physical Requirements

title: Flexpool mbo/hbo Verpleegkundige
description:

Dit ga je doen als mbo of hbo Verpleegkundige flexpool

Als mbo of hbo verpleegkundige in de flexpool van Utrecht Stad bepaal jij niet één vaste werkplek, maar zet je jouw kennis en ervaring flexibel in op verschillende intra- en extramurale locaties of wijkteams. Je komt terecht in een team van (flex)medewerkers die elkaar kennen, ondersteunen en hun expertise meenemen naar verschillende locaties binnen Utrecht Stad. Juist die afwisseling maakt het werk uniek: je bouwt brede ervaring op, blijft jezelf ontwikkelen en kunt rekenen op de vrijheid en flexibiliteit die bij jouw werk-privébalans past.

  • Salaris volgens cao VVT, FWG 45/50: € 3.502 - € 4.822 (o.b.v. 36 uur).
